sba gsal snang /sad mi mi bdun gyi ya gyal sbra gsal snang ni chos rgyal khri srong lde'u 5btsan gyi blon po zhig ste/ rgyal po sku na phra ba'i skabs su/ blon po sang shis rgya yul nas khrid 'ongs pa'i hwa shang zhig gis/ sba gsal snang gi bu mo shi ba'i ro'i khar mu tig mtshal gyis byugs pa'i mtshan ma byed bcug nas ma'i mal 'og tu sbas shing bu mo ma'i bur skye ba'i lung bstan pa bzhin btsas pa'i skabs su kha na mu tig byung bas/ gsal snang gis tshe phyi ma yod par nges pa rnyed nas chos kyi ched du lho bal du 'gro bar rje la gsol bas mang yul gyi khang dpon du brdzangs/ de nas byang chub chen po dang na len+d+rar mchod pa byas/ mkhan po rin po che dang mjal te mang yul du spyan drangs/ gsal snang btsan po'i drung du 'ongs nas mkhan po'i gsung dang rgyu mtshan rnams zhus/ bdud blon ma zhang khrom pa skye'i chad pa 'byung dogs nas rgyal pos gsal snang yib tu bcug ma zhang khrom pa skye thabs mkhas kyis bsad rjes/ mkhan po rin po che bo sgri sa ta spyan 'dren pa'i pho nyar gsal snang brdzangs pa bzhin rim gyis phebs te 'om bu tshal du mjal/de'i rjes slob dpon spyan drangs te bsam yas thin gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs shing / sad mi mi bdun gyis gtsos pa'i bod mi blo gsal zhing yid gzhungs pa'i las ldan gyi skyes bu du ma rab tu byung ngo zhes —46
kun gzigs lnga ba chen pos〈〈bod kyi deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs〉〉las gsungs pa bzhin sba gsal snang ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bod du dar ba la bka' drin mchog tu che ba zhig yin/gsham du bkod pa ni〈〈sba bzhed〉〉las bshus pa'i tshan pa zhig yin/sba bzhed ni sga gsal snang gi bzhed par grags pa ste/ de la bsam yas kyi dkar chag chen po zhes kyang zer/ de ni spyi lo dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang bod je khri srong lde'u btsan skabs kyi lo rgyus cung zad zhib pa zhig yin zhing / nang don gtso che ba bsam yas gtsug lag khang bzhengs nas bod du sangs rgyas kyi chos spel ba'i lo rgyus yin zhing / bod dang thang rgyal rabs bar gyi 'brel ba dang / bod dang rgya gar bar chos lugs thog nas 'gro 'ong byed tshul/ btsan po'i bka' gtsigs bsgrags pa/ sgra bsgyur btsugs te chos bsgyur pa sogs skabs de'i chab srid lam lugs dang dpal 'byor rig gnas kyi 'phel rgyas kyang gsal bor 'khod 'dugsba bzhed las sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa/ ( tshan bshus 〉rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam 'phrul gyis/ /sha za gdong dmar 'dul mdzad pa/ /mes dbon gsum dul phyag 'tshal te/ /bka' tshig yi ge zhib mo bri/ /btsan po khri ldo gtsug btsan ②gyis mes srong btsan gyi bka' chems 47
kyi yi r+sā 'chems(mchims) phu'i①phyag mdzod na/ blon po mgar0gyis zangs kyi byang bu la bris nas sbas pa de bltas pas/ nga'i dngos sras①kyi ring la rgyal po lde zhes bya ba'i ring la dam pa'i lha chos 'byung ste bzhin gshegs pa'i rjes su rab tu byung ba dbu rig dang zhabs rjen/ sku la bur zhwag gi rgyal mtshan gsol ba/ lha dang mi'i mchod gnas kyang mang du 'byung ngo / /de las rang dang gzhan gyi tshe 'di dang phyi ma mtho ris darnga thar ba thams cad kyi ba ba 'byung bas/ nga'i dbon sras rje blon rnams kyis 'tsho ba slad (bla) nas sbyor la chab 'og nas bde ba 'byin/ dbu'i mchod gnas su khur cig ces bya ba bris nas 'dug pa de gzigs pas/lde zhes bya ba de nga yin par dgongs nas/ bran ka mu le ko sha dang /gnyags zhutsā na ku ma ra gnyis rgya gar du chos 'tshol du btang bas/ pa3 ta dpal sangs rgyas gsang ba dang / sangs rgyas zhi ba gnyis gangs ti se la brtsom mo zhes thos te/ de gnyis spyan drangs pas ma 'drongs te de gnyis kyi thugs las mdo sde las rnam par 'byed pa dang / gser 'od dam pa'i mdo dang / kri ya dang / u pa ya shas tsam zhus/ gligs bam spyan drangs nas rgyal po'i mchod gnas su phul/ de'i bzhugs khang lta bur lha khang lnga bzhengs te/ lha sa na mkhar brag zag dmar na mgrin bzang0/ mchims phu na na ral/ brag dmar na ka chu/ bsam yas mas gong gi gtsug lag khang dang lnga bzhengs pas/ zhang blon kun rtse bro chag bral bas ma dga' nas/ jed kyi btsan po 'de rna dad pa che la chos la dga' ba/ byad mi mtshar bas tham ze min nam nas gleng ba de rje'i snyan 4
du gsan pas/ nge'i zhal nas nga bram ze yin par gyur na nga'i khab ljang 'o khri btsun 'di la bu nga bas dad pa che ba byad mi sdug pa zhig shog cig nga btsan po ma nor ba gcig yin na/ bu zhang blon rnams kyis bcos mi thub pa gcig shog ces dmod btsugs pas/ khri btsun la lha'i bu pho 'dra ba/sna'i gzengs mtho ba/ dpral pa'i dpyis che ba/ shin tu mdzes pa zhig btsas pas/ zhang blon rnams na re/ bod kyi btsan po 'di rgyal po yang dag pa'o zer/ sras la 'di mi min lha'i dbon po yin zer nas ming yang ljang tsha lha dbon du gsol/de la khab ran par gyur tsa na/ bod kyi mi thams cad spre'u dang brag srin gyi bu yin pas 'di'i jo mo mi 'os/ 'di la rgya'i bu spo zhig slong bar chad do/ /bod kyi rgyal po la bzang ba mes srong btsan sgam po de ar+ya pa lo ke ta'i sprul par grags/ de'i btsun mo lha gcig kong ngo yin/ kong jo'i yul rgya nag po'i yul grong khyer mam shing khri sgo na rgyal po kong 'phrul bya ba 'byor ba rgyas pa/ mnga' thang rgyas pa zhig yod/ de la gtsug lag khang gi gub tshe0sum brgya drug cu yod pas rgya nag gtsug lag gi rgyal por grags/ mtshan rgya je 'brom shing hwan zer/ de'i sras rgya rje spyan bzang /de'i sras rgya rje li khri bzher lang mig ser bya ba/ da lta bzhugs pa de'i sras 'o gyim shin kong ngo bya ba de slong bar rigs so 'chams nas/ gnyags khri bzang yang ston la 'khor sum cu dang bcas pa gnye bor tratang nas/pho nya ba de dag gis rgya ji la sgrom bu phul pas/ rgya rjes byin par dgongs nas bu mo la bsgo bas/ bu mo shong ngos rang gi 'phrul gyi me long srid gsum 49
mthong ba zhig yod pa de la bltas pas/ bod kyi yul yar lung yul bzang ba dang / rgyal bu de byad legs pa lha'i bu 'dra ba de mthong nas 'gro bar byas/ de nas rdzongs la sogs pa byas pa dang / gnye bo dang bcas pa bod du 'ongs so/ /shul du rgyal bus mtshan la rta bcags pas/ 'phang thang0das rar sngags pas zor mda' 'phangs pa rdzog ste grongs so/ /bang so ke'u rtseg pa'i tshe na kong dzo 'phang thang gi pho brang du ston pas/ rgyal po yin zer ba'i rgad po ag tshom can gcig las ma gda' bas/ byad kyi blta bya yin nam me long gi blta bya yin snyam nas yid ma dga' ste/ nyin mo bzhin dngul dkar gyi tam bu ras ram bu bteg cing sdug klu len/ mtshan mo bzhin mchu grang gis ram bu bteg nas klu len par/ rgya gar gyi yul na dam pa'i lha chos yod de/ lam bal yul de tshad pa che/ de la bsams nas sems thag chad/ rgya nag gi yul na ju zhag gi rtsis yod de/ pha yul shul thag ring / de la bsams nas sems thag chad/ bod yul gyi dbus na je rgyal gyi btsan po yod de/ blon po gdug pa che/ bod kyi blon po sdig po che zer zhing glu len/ de blon pos rje'i snyan du gsol pas/ rje'i zhal nas/'o na da mo rang la skyes drag tu skur la pha yul du skyol ces gsungs/ 4skad kong dzo la gsol pas/ kong dzo na re/ rgyal bu byad legs pa zhig yod pa ltar na/ nga dang las ma mthun pa yin pos rdza pha yul du mchi ba mi spro zhing / da mes po dang 'du'o zhes zer/ dus ring zhig phyis kong jo na re/ ba'i ni ne spo kong jo'i mchod gnas gser gyi lha shākya pu na'i zhal 50
blta'o zer nas/ dbu ru lha sar byon pa dang / rgya stag ra mo che na lha mi bzhunas nas/ de kun tu mchod par byed cing btsal yang ma rnyed nas/ ra sa'i lha khang du mchod pa byas pas/ gtsang khang sgo lnga phud rabs 'dug pa la bzhi las med pas/ 'di na gtsang khang gcig sbas yod par nges zhes glo 'burabagyi ya lad kyi 'og tu brdungs/ ser kha byung /de brkos nas sgo phye ba dang / gser gyi lha shākya mu rna sbas pa mthong nas/rna rna mo'i lha la zhal ston gcig gsol zer nas mchod pa btsugs/ blon po shi tshad la zan skal med pas/ jid rgya nag na chos dar bas mi shi tshad la bdun tshigs yod/ bod la chos ma dar bas blon po snying re rje zer nas mi shi ma thag tu lha mi stong tsam la mtshal('tshal) rma 4re ston mo re 'tshal/de la bod kyis tshe zhes bya'o/ /phyis kong 4 la yos bu'i lo la rgyal bu bltams/ de'i dus na rgyal po rna pho brang brag dmar 'om bu'i tshal na bzhugs/ yos bu'i lo dpyid zla ra ba'i tshes bcu gsum la bab pa na/ rgya'i hwa shang mngon shes yod pa zhig na re/ rgyal po khyod kyi btsun mo la sras byang chub sems dpar nges pa gcig btsal(btsa') bar jes/ de la rim gro skyed cig ces zer/ rgyal pos nam phyed la mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs/ 'jam pa'i lhag ma la nga'i sku tshab byed ces gsungs nas mchod rten gres thag can yang brtsigs/nang par pho nya byung ste kong jo la sras gcig bltams so zhes zer/ rgyal pos yar lung 'phang thang du sras bltams pa gzigs su byon pa'i tshe/zhang ngo'i bu sna nam bza' bzhi stengs kyis phyogs nas 'di nga la skyes pa 51
yin zer/ der blon po kun gyis brtas/ par bya ba'i phyir/ thang rtsisas klu pug gar 6 bzhag nas sus thob byed du bcug pas/ kong ngos sngon la zin pa bzhi stengs kyis shi na'ang shi snyam ṇ+ḍi phyogs pas/ kong dzos bu shi dogs nas stod btang ste/ yin dang nga'i yin te dri(dre) mo khyod zer nas btang / bu kong jo'i yin par shes/ lo gcig song tsa na/ 'bas tshugs kyi dga' ston byas te/ sna nam pas bar chung ngu lag na thogs nas zhang po'i pang du shog zer/ rgyal bu na re/ khri srong lde'u btsan rgya tsha lags/ sna nang zhang gi 'u bgyi 'tshal/ gsungs nas rgya'i pang du song nas ming yang rang gis btags so//6/gan 'grelaḥ 0mes dbon rnam gsum/ srong btsan sgam po dang / khri srong lde'u btsan/ khri gtsug lde btsan te bod kyirgyal po rnam gsum la zer/()khri lde gtsug btsan/ bod kyi rgyal po khri lde gtsun brtan me ag tshom ste/ lcags pho 'brug (spyi lo740)lor rgyal po 'dul srong bang po btsan gyi sras sapho brang ldan dkar du 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu la rgyal srid bzur / lha khang rnam lnga bzhengs/ chos 'da' dang sman spyad mang po bod du bsgyur/ rgyal po 'di'i sku ring lali yul nas don pa'i rab tu byung ba rnams dang / rgya nag yul nas hwa shang mang po spyanadrangs ṅgā bstan pa la gus par mdzad kyang bod mi rab tu byung ba ma byung / dgur lo drug cu re gsum pa chu pho rta(spyi lo 802) lor par 'brog sba tshal mkhar du sku gshegs so/ / (tshemachims phu/ 'dir bsam yas mchims phur bshad pa yin la/ di nibod rang skyong ljongs gra nang rdzong gi khongs su yod/ der gnas 6 lte 52
bar brag dmar ke'u tshang du za ra tsa na dang / tho mi ma nan brtson rgya phyag bzo yu rgyan rin po che'i sku bye ma a krong / khri sro nga lde'u btsan gyi thugs dag 'bum sogs rten gsum byin can dang / 6ba phug gi thod du bka' brgyad kyidakyil 'khor sogs rang canagyi rnam pa/mdun du lha lcam pad ma gsal gyi sku gdung bzhag pa'i rjes/ steng sa bai ro'isgrub phug bcas yod/ brag dmar ke'u tshar gsham gu mtsho rgyal gzim phug chos rgyal gyi sgrub phug nyang phug gong 'og tu grags pa/ klu 'dul khyur chen phug kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i gdus'bum/ dben rtsar rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyi rta mgrin sgrub phugsogs yod ces〈dbus gtsang gi gnas rten rags rim gyi mtshan 5byang mdor bsdus dad pa'i sa bon〉〉zhes pa las gsungs so/ / ()mgar/ mgar stong btsan yul sung ste chos rgyal srong btsan sgalpo'i blon chen zhig yin/ khong gis dmag srid sogs phyogs mang po'isgo nas rgyal por rgyal grad skyong rogs mdzad cing bod yul gcig gyur yong ba la mdzad rjes chen po bzhag spyi lo636lor cal po'i bka' bzhin rgya nag tu rgya bza' kong rjo bsu ba'i gnye bor can/ rgya ji tha'i dzung gis mgar la g.yon sung dmag dpon chen po'i(tso lus cang dun)cho lo bskur/ rgyal po srong btsan skugashegs rjes masar gyis rgyal po mang srong mang btsanagyi blon byas nasargyal srid skyong zhing bod kyirgya bskyed pa la'abad pa chen po byas/ spyilo667lor mtsho sngon khongs su g.yul du sku gshegs par grags/ / ()dbos sras/'og tu 'byung pa'i dbon sras zhes pa'i yig nor yin nam snyam/ / ()gnyags / guna'ami bod kyirus ming gi rgya brag cig ()mgrin 53
bzang / 'der mgrin bzang zhes pa'i lha khang lan danas te/〈deb ther sngon po〉〉las 'gran bzang dang / 〈〈rgyal rabs gas la ba'i melong〉〉las 'brin bzang zhes ming thadad du byung yang / de rgyal po khri lde gtsug brtanagyis bzhengs pa'i lha khang rnam lnga'i ya gyal zhig tu ni kha mthun pa red/ / gab tshe/ gab tsi dang don gcig ste 'dir 'byung jis kyi khram kha la zer/ ()'phang thang / bod rang skyong ljongs sne gdor rdzong gi pho zang chus kyi ming ting ste/ sngar rgyal pa/ 3tsa/sdi ra dzosnangaX shāsdigs ༵༵ pa//nga /rin pa /pa pa/ /shā nas zur du 'bur ba'i khang pa lta bu/
bka' gdams bu chos/bka' gdams bu chos ni/ dzo bo dang 'brom ston gnyis ba'i slob mar gyur pa'i ngog legs pa'i shes rab dang khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung rnam gnyis kyis zhus te/ dzo bo rje a ti sha mchog gis gsungs pa'i 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs rnam thar le'u nyi shu dang / mjug tu dzo bos 'brom ston la bka' gdams bstan pa ji ltar gtad pa'i tshul bcas ston pa'i bka' gdams pa'i gzhung zhig ste khyon bsdoms po ti gcig bzhugs/gzhung de'i gsung pa po dzo bo rje a ti sha ni/ rgya gar shar phyogs lha gha la'i yul du yab za hor rgyal po dge ba dpal dang yum dpal mo 'od zer can gnyis kyi sras su chu rta (spyi lo 982) lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu'i ring phyi rol mu stegs pa dang nang ba'i chos lugs kyi sgra tshad sogs la slob gnyer mdzad/ dgung lo nyer dgu bar rgya gar rdo je gdan gyi ma hā bo ti'i gtsug lag khang du rab byung mdzad nas phyi nang thun mong gi rig gnas dang nang ba'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs sbyangs pa mthar phyin par papa dasu/ma ༵ nā dri/ r+nghi py-i ༷k+ta/ /shā kā /dri/ du /shā ṭ+wāṃ ༵ snas la che so pa( shāX/ de nas mnga' ris gu ge rgyal po lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis bod du gdan 55
'drin zhus kyang gdan 'dren ma nus/ rab byung dang po'i chu rta (spyi lo1042 )lor lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyis gdan 'dren zhus pas bod mnga' ris su phebs/ de rjes 'brom ston gyis dbus gtsang du gdan drangs/ der lo ngo bcu bdun ring 'chad nyan gyi 'phrin las spel/ dge bshes khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung / ngog lo tsā ba legs pa'i shes rab/ 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ 'gos lo tsā ba khugs pa lha btsas sogs slob ma mkhas pa mang du byung / dgung lo bdun cu don gsum pa shing rta (spyi lo 1054) lor snye thang du sku gshegs/gzhung de'i sgrig pa po rna ngog legs pa'i shes rab yin te/ de'i rna ngus byang du/ chos de dag 'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i sku/ /ma tshan legs pa'i shes rab don ldan des/ /mchog glegs bam bzang po phyogs gcis bsdus/ /'di gzhan la med pa'i zab chos lags/ /zhes gsungs la/ 'i 'khrungs lo dang 'das lo gsal cha ma thob kyang / spyir dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i mkhas pa zhig yin pa kha tshon gcod thub/ sku na chung dus su mnga' ris gu gi rgyal pos kha che yul du mngags te nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs slob gnyer mdzad nas mkhas par gyur/ phyis su lo chen rin chen bzang por rogs ram mdzad de bka' chos bsgyur/ dzo bo a ṭī sha bod du gdan drangs rjes/ nag tsho lo tsā ba dang lhan du ngo bo dang mjal te jo bo'i thugs sras su gyur/ 〈〈dbu ma snying po'i ṭiska〉〉sogs bstan bcos du ma bsgyur/ rab byung dang po'i chu glang(spyi lo 1073 )lor gsang phu ne'u thog dgon pa btab/ slob ma mkhas pa nyid kyi dbon 56
dzog lo blo ldan shes rab sogs byung /rgya nag po'i yul hwa shang gnas ba'i sar rgyal bu blo gros 'phel du sku skye ba bzhes pa'i le'u/yang nyin cig (zhig)jo b+thā yab sras gnyis po dzo bo'i chab chu'i drung na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ rdzog legs pa'i shes rab kyis/ yab sras gnyis la phyag la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa ①legs bar phul/ khyad par du'ang dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal la dung gis 'phra bkod pa/ jo ko dang spyan ras gzigs la thun mong du phul nas/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi drung du thal mo sbyar te/ phyi rabs kyi mi dmu rgod dgaci sgro skur 'u 'debs na'ang 'debs/ de ring lha tshogs mang po 'dir lhags pa la khyed kyi sku che ba'i yon tan brjod na/ khong rnams la yang mngon shes0mod pa dang / dzo bo la sgro skur mi mnga' zhing don chen por 'gyur bas/ de ring yang skyes rabs khyad par can zhig bkas gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ 'brom gyi zhal nas/ dge bshes pa la zhu na/ 'jig rten pa'i kha ngag la sgog pa che zos chung zos mnyam zer ba cig gda' ste/ de bzhin du 'u cag gi yon tan 'di dag ma brjod na legs te jo bos brjod/ 'on kyang bla ma la mi legs pa mi mnga'/ da dge ba'i bshes gnyen pas kyang / bu mo ngan ma bzhin sa: labs phyir skyel ba de yang ma mdzad/ khyed gang zag dam pa ①cig 57
gis zhus ting la/ dzo ngos kyang / bdag gis pha rol tu ma phyin pa'i stobs kyis 'khor ba 'dir 'khyams tshul mang tsa na/ dge bshes pa gang mnyes pa'i sa nas gsung mdzod cig der rngog gis kyang mthong bar bu mo shing lo sdo ljang gi gos rgyan pa cig 'brom gyi mdun na phar 'chams tshur 'chams mdzad cing / skyes bu dam pas yon tan thams cad ha cang rang sgas na'ang sems can nyon mongs pa can gyis/ yul khyad par can la brnyas pa byas na rung ngam/ he he zer te gar song cha med par song /ngog na re/ de cis kyang yi ge cig 'dod par zhu/ da lta'i mo btsun de sgrol ma yin par 'dug ngas kyang shes/ yi ge 'brir mi btub na rigs kyi bu de de bzhin no/ /yon tan da dung sbos gsungs nas 'ong du gsha' ba la/ skyes bu dam pa'i yon tan sbas drags na rung ngam/ he he gsungs/khong shin tu mad zhus pas/ 'brom gyi zhal nas/ de bas ngas gtam gyis gong du sleb par byas/ bu mo ngan ma'i gtam bya ba de la zer ba yin rtog mi thub/ 'dir jo bos kho bo la brtsams te gsungs tshad yi ger bris na 'bum tsam zhig mchi/ de bas bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rtsod pa med pa 'bri mod/ ngog na re/ de ring gang ltar na'ang skyes rabs shig zhu 'tshal bas rigs ma mdzad ces/ jo bo la phyag gsum btsal te/ zhus len 'di na mar la/ —byams dang snying rje bsgom bya zhing / /byang chub sems ni brtan par bya/ zhes gsungs gda' na/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas rin po che 'dis/ ston byams pa ji ltar bsgoms snying rje chen po ji ltar bsgoms/ ma bu gcig po la brtse ba ji ltar mdzad/ byang chub kyi sems rgya 58
mtsho lta bu brtan par ji ltar bsgoms/ bla ma gsung bar zhu zhus pas/jo bo'i zhal nas/ sngo na rgya nag po'i yul/ bon hwa shang gnas pa'i sar rgyal po nag po lcags 'bar bya ba la btsun mo'ang lcags mo zhes bya ba yo da/ de dag nang ba dang phyi pa gnyis dzi'i lta ba 'dzin pa la de'i tshe/rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'de po ta la na khye'u blo gros 'phel zhes bya ba sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed pa cig tu yod pa des/ nag po lcags 'bar mthong nas skyabs yul cha gnyis su 'dzin pa 'di cha gcig tu 'gril bar bya ste/ deng pazlo ḍi pa// /spya k+ta pa dī nāṃ gh+nā // 'das/thabardzu zlosad sna traṃ snronā sta/ dzosdu gh+nā 'di yang nga rgyal che bas btsan 'jun dang 'chos pas bzlog par dka' snyam nas/ btsun mo lcags mo'i snams su zhukhu/sa/ de nas skyes ma thag tu lha dbang phyug chen po 'dra ba/ gzugs bzang zhing ngar che ba zhig byung /phas mtshar nas lag tu blangs pa dang thal klo sbyar nas/ yab khyod bu dang ldan pa dga' 'am zhes smya sa pas/ pha na re/ bu chung ngu nas labs pa rung ngam/ bu na re/ 'o na rgan kyang mi smra ba cig dgos sam/pha na re/ de yang min de yang min pa cig dgos/ bu na re/ gnyis ka min pa cig dgos na/ bu ma skyes pa cig 'tshal lam/ yab na re/ de yang min/ bu na re/ e ma yab la ni mi srid pa cig dgos so/ /bu skye ni dgos la/ rgan nam gzhon kyang rung ste/ smrar ni mi rung ngo / /der yab na re/ de ma yin/ skyes ma thag nas mi smra/ nar son nas smra ba yin mod/ bu na re/ bu skyes ma thag pa la kha dang lce dang sems med 59
la/ nar son pa dang gzod byung na ji 'dra zhig mchi/ pha na re/ khyod kyi spru lugs kyis sprul pa zhig rang yin nam/ gang gis gang nas spru' te 'ongs pa yin/ bu na re/ nga rgya dkar po'i cha cig nas 'ongs/ pha na re/ khyod la ji skad bya bar grags/ bu na re/ yul de na kho bo la blo thos 'phel zhes zer/ khyod sus btang / bu na re/ rgya gar gyi nang ba dag ni spyan ras zigs zhes zer/ mu stegs①kyi cha mthun pa la la dag la/gshen lha 'od dkar nas su'ang grags zer bas pha'i bsam pa la 'o na 'di ger+shan lha 'od dkar rang yin nam mtshan ltas 'di yang bzang zer nas bu khur te/ rdung khyer gyi sgo na mar phyin pas/ hwa shang gi ston pa dag na re/ 'di rang dbang phyug chen po'i sprul pa yin nam mtshan ltas rang bzang zer/ pha na re/ bu 'di nyid la dris dang smra ba zhig yod kyis zer/ khong rnams kyis kyang dris pas/ rgyal bu na re/ bon gyi gnas lugs la gzhan dang gzhan du khas blang du ga la rung zhes smras pas/ de rnams dga' nas rma thong bar dka' ba mthong ba'i dus 'dir/ mchod pa byed rdzas ci dgos zer ba la/ dong du yun ring du bsdad pa'i btson mang po dgos/ rgyal bu btsan gyis 'u 'tshal zhus pas/ nga de dag la snying na zer/ des khyed la 'u byas zhus pas/ nga'i lus ngan pa 'di de dag gis yang nas yang du bskyed nas 'khor ba 'dir sdug bsngal la gtad zer/ de dag kho nas bskyed cing sdug bsngal ba 'u yin zer/ kyi ston pa dag dang po 'di nas 'ongs kyi khungs med cing / bar du skye 'chi'i phreng ba grangs med pas mi dag la nus skyes dang / drod gsher dang / sgo nga las skyes pa ni nyung /60
des bdag cag mir gyur pa dag la pha ma'ang mi dag 'byung gis/ sa na mi de dag gis yang dang yang du skyed do/ /der stonari pa de dag na re/rgyal bu/ 'o na de tsam du btson de dag tu ma zad/ khyod kyis lus sna tshogs su blangs pas/ sems can thams cad kyis khyod kyi lus ngan pa 2di bskyed cing 'khor ba 'dir sdug bsngal du bcug na/ khyad par du btsan de dag khyod kyi mchod rdzas su dgos pa ci yin/ rgyal bus lan du/ston pa dag mad/ sems can thams cad kyis sems can thams cad (spra nā spra ngadapa pa༈༈ dī sna /lha/ 〉( /shā hūm̐ (( /shā m+p+raṃ ((dī spya 'am/sra mnyam par sems can de dag kyang gnas na/ mchod rdzas la dgos pas ci phan/ dri bus glang po mi 'chun pa bzhin du/ de dag bsdu bar dka'/btson de dag la mdon skyabs gzhan med rang re'i btson khang gi yang dong khri mon phyi nang na gnas te/ de sa na rang dbang ba'i mi yin pas gnas 'dir khrid la shog der rgyal bo dang ston pa dag gis bsam pa la/ rgyalbu 'di'i zer lugs kyis sems can thams cad pha ma bu tsha'i 'khor lor gda' ba la pha ma'i sha khrag mchod rdzas su dgos zer bar 'dug de rigs sam snyam nas rgyal bu la zhus pa/ kye rgyal bu de ltar na rna pha ma yin par gda' bas/ pha ma'i sha khrag bza' bar rung ngam/ rgyal bus lan du/spras rnamachil rgyu so ༷da shug miyi py-i dzo rdzu pa/ dz+wa/ ma/ sras sna twā hūm̐ (gamachi rdzu pa pa/( ngam/ rang nyid ma 'gags par rang nyid las rang nyid skye ba mthong ngam/61
ston pa dag na re/ de ltar ni ma mthong ngo / /'o na pha ma las skye'am/ rgyu yod pa zhig las skye/ kye rgyal bu/ pha ma las skye ba ni rgyu yod pa la sa skye ba'o/ /rgyal bu na re/ pha ma rna rkyen te/ rkyen gyis bskyed par nus pa ni rgyu yod pa'o/ /rgyu med pa ni 'gras bu'ang ma yin no/ /des na rang gi ñtsa bsod nams bsags pa las rna mir 'byung gis/ rang gi rgyu bsod nams ma yin pa bsags pa las ni 'bras bu ngan song ngo / /der ston pa dag gis bsam pa la/ 'de'i dgongs pas sems can thams cad pha ma/ chos thams cad rgyu ldan/ rang rgyu las skye zhing rang la rang skye bar 'gal ba/rgyu ma yin pa las 'bras bu ma yin pa skye ba khregs pa/ las rgyu 'bras thams cad zab cing phra bar ston pa 'ug 'dug snyam nas rgyal pos bka' bsgos te/ btson lnga brgya mdun du khrid nas 'ongs so/ /der rgyal bus/btson dag la smras pa/ khyed rnams las 'us rgyal bos mnar/ ra la la dag na re mi bsad/ la la dag na re 'dod pas log par g.yem pa spyad/la la dag na re ma byin pa chen po blangs/ la la dag na re mi ba na pa'i rdzun tshig chen pos gzhan bslus/ des rgyal pos mnar zer ro/ /der rgyal bu na re/ las ngan bsags pa'i mthong chos 'di nyid du'ang 'byung na/ myi mar bzod glags med pa'i ngan song du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /'ad nyid rna sdug bsngal chung zhing bzod par nus kyi/ 'dis mtshon nas rgyu mi /hā ba pas/dī zlos 11sa dzo lasdu/de ba/( (byin ༷ji shārnyi shāsta dī ༷nā gārakhri yon du bcug na ci 'dra ba cig mchi/ 'on te rgyal pos bdag khri mon du 62
bcug na ji ltar mchi/ pha na re gnyis ka mi rung ngo / /rgyal bus lan du/ 'di dag kyang pha ma bu tsha yin pas mnar bar mi bya'o/ /rgyal po nyid kyis kyang tshe la brtan pa ma thob pas srog 'gags ma thag tu rang gis bsags pa'i las kyi rnam par smin pa rjes su 'brang bas 'di dag gis kyang slar mnar bar 'gyur gyis shes par mdzod cigrgyal po zer bas/ ston pa de dag gis bsam pa la/ 'di mtshan ltas la bltas na ni lha dbang phyug 'dra/ chos kyi gnas lugs la bltas na ni nang pa 'dra/ brjod tshul rna bon gyi skad du gda' bas/ 'di la khyad par dri'o snyam nas phyi nang bar gsum gyi chos gang bden/ khyod lha gang gi yin/ rgyal bus smras pa/ sems can dag la blo rigs re/ /ming yang de dang mtshungs par 'dogs/ /lha yang tha dad du ma skad/ /rgya gar nang ba'i blo ngo na/ /nga rna mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /blo gros 'phel zhes 'bod par byed/ /bon po gshen lha 'od dkar zhes/ /da lta lcags 'bar bu ru 'bod/ /phyi pa dbang phyug chen po zhes/ /chos kyang de dang mtshungs par smra/ /dpyad na tshad med ba'i②ldan bzang / /ma dpyad bza' btung longs spyod skyed/ /rmongs pa mi dge las la 'jug /ston pas pha mar shes dpyod la/ /byams dang snying rje bsten na bzang / /zab mo smras kyang de ma shes/ /rang gi dka' spyad don med 'gyur/ /des na chos lugs tha dad kyang / /don gyi snying bo de nyid bzang / /de ltar min na ngan song 'gro/ /rang yang 'drongs par mi byed pa'i/ /log pa'i chos kyis bsu bar phyed/ /ces smras pa dang / ston pa de dag gis 63
bsam pa la'ang / brten pa med cing rkyen kha bar song bas rgyal bu'i byang chub kyi sems kyis byin gyis brlabs pa ①dang / rang gi mtshan ltas la sogs pa'i rkyen gyis nang ba'i sgor zhugs te tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms te sems las su rung bar gyur to/ /dus re zhig rgyal po yab sras gnyis dben par yod pa na/ rgyal po na re/ nga skyabs gnyis la brten pa la/ khyod kyis skyabs gcig la brten du bcug jes par chos dang bon dang / phyi pa dag gang bden/ rgyal bu na re/ lan cig hwa shang gi yul 'dir kho bo nag po ha su zhes bya bar gyur/ bon dang phyi pa'i chos la spyad/ pon po dang phyi pa gnyis mas kho bo mchod pa la/ kho bo gum ma thag tu dmyal bar skyes pas/ dmyal ba'i gnas de na/ dmyal ba'i thub pa zhes pa nang ba'i lha cig gda' ba de na re/ khyod kyis bon dang pu stegs kyi chos la spyod pas 'dir skyes kyis/da shes par mdzod zer nas/ tshad med pa bzhi bstan pas/ sngar gyi las la 'gyod pa drag po skyes shing bshags pas/ da lta yan chod du mtho ris thob cing bde bar gyur pa yin rna/ /rgyal po shes par mdzod cig deng sang yang / khyod cha gcig nang ba'i chos la dad pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas/khyod kyi bu skal mi bcad (gcod) pa'i don du 'dir 'ongs so/ /da ni nang pa la jes par mdzod la gtan gyi btsan sa zungs shig rgyal po yab yum gnyis kyis bu'i tshig de thos pa dang / rgyal po yab yum gnyis char gyis tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms pa la brten nas gnas lugs kyi don mthong / de'i rjes su yang sras yang 'bar dang yang lcags gnyis 'khrungs 6
) bu gsum yod bzhigadu/ rgyal srid thams cad phyogs med du sbyin par btang nas/ der pho brang min pa nor med pa'i dus su phyi rol pa dang bon po dag na re/ bu de skyes nas nor brlag sa stegs pa dang bon pa'i zas skal tsho yang bcad de/ rgyal bo yab yum yang nang pa'i chos lugs sa'gyur zer zhing 'bar ba rgyal po yab yum gyis thos pa dang 'de skad du/dman pa rang dang mi mthun pas/ /dam pa dag la smod par 6da/ /mi sto brgyal srid me 'obs shig /nyon mongs 'dam rdzab rang sar skams (skem) / /chags med 'ching grol bde bar 'gyur/ /gcan na na lta bu'i grogs bral bzang / /srin po lta bu'i chos lugs shig /khyi phag gnas nas nags kyi khrod/ /rma bya dga' gar rtse bar 'gro/ /nam mkhas gar khyab pha mas khyabazlo/ /stag dang spyang khyi'i snying rje bzhin/ /phyogs su ma zhang kun tu bsten/ /rgyal srid gnas nas bros pa bzang /btson gyi gnas nas grol ba bzhin/ /me 'obs nang nas thar ba bzang / /pad+mo'i sgabs kyi sprul pa bzhin/ /mi gtsang khrod nas thar ba bzang / /gtsang ma'i rigs kyi lha dang mtshungs/ /bzang po'i ro la'ang zhen na 'ching / /rgyal srid skyong ba'i rgyal po bzhin/ /nas rgyal srid spangs te chags pa med pa'i gnas su song ngo /der rgyal bu gsum gzhon pa dang pha ma dang rgyal srid med pa'i stobs kyis blon po dag gis kyang khur du ma 'dod/ drags pa can gzhan yang ma 'chun/ der sngar gyi hwa shang gi ston pa de dag kyang skyo rnos pho brang gi nang rgyal po'i drung du 'ongs te/ pus mo gnyis sa la btsugs/ thal mo sbyar nas 65
'de skad du/ rgya nag zhang zhung rgyal po ni/ /longs spyod mnga' thang rgya mtsho 'dra/ /mchod gnas 'khor bzang smon pa'i gnas/ /kun gyis bkur zhing 'dud byed na/ /rgyal bu khyod bltams rgya mtsho bskams/ /'khor dengs mchod gnas bya bar gyur/ /da ni rgya mtsho bskams pa'i shul/ /sa skyong m+bu ba tsam zhig las/ /klu dbang lta bu'i yab yum dag /mtsho med chu bya ji bzhin du/ /khyod kyi gsung la tshad bzung nas/ /chags med gnas su gshegs par gyur/ /ma rungs sems can dpu rgod dag /gang gi drin lan mi gzo bas/ /nang gi blon po dgra bo yis/ /go cha len zhing rgyal bu 'dor/ /ye ma 'di yi 'dun ma shor/ /da rna phyi ma'i btsan sa dag /zin par ma gyur 'gyod tshabs che/ /mi 'gyod brtan pa'i gdeng 'u mchi/ /zhes zhus pa dang / rgyal bu'i zhal nas/legs par dpyod dang shes ldan kun/ /mi rtag tshe la snying bo med/ /longs spyod mkha' dang mnyam gyur kyang / /'dab chags shugs kyis spyad mi nus/ /rgyal srid dug gi sdong bo 'dra/ /rma bya lta bu'i mthu ldan shānyis/ /za yis phal bas zos na 'chi/ /kha mngar dug gis tshe srog 'bral/ /'phral dga'i rgyal srid thar srog skyel/ /rma bya rgyal srid spangs gyur te/ /nags kyi khrod du 'gro byed na/ /chags ldan su zhig rgyal srid 'dzin/ /klu dbang rgya mtsho mi rtag par/ /shes nas snying bor mi 'dzin na/ /chags ldan su zhig m+bu ba 'dzin/ /e ma shes ldan nga la nyon/ /rnar med nor mchog bdun bstan bzang / /chags srid spangs nas chags med srid/ dga' bde'i btsan sar bskyangs na bzang / /rang 66
don log tsha/'i lam zhugs pa'i/ /rgyud ngan drin lan mi gza ba/ /grogs ngan spangs te gzhan gyi don/ /rtse gcig brtson pa spyan ras gzigs/ /lhar bzang dbang rgyug gshen dkar rna/ /mi shes gzhan gyi sgro btags yin/ /bon dang mu stegs chos dag ni/ /g.yo can tshig bzhin ngo bstod byed/ /de yi phugs ni gzhan bslu zhing / /mthun pa 'byed cing dgra dang sprod/ /pu stegs 'on ni dngos grub myur/ /'phral dga' phugs su ngan 'gror bsgyur/ /ṭa stegs bon ni me dang 'dra/ /cung zad nya bas ba ra gyur na'ang / /jis par gtugs na 'tshig par gyur//nang pa'i chos ni me dang 'dra/ /gshe zhing lus kyis 2ga par byed/ /ye ma na dang tshar gyur na'ang / /bdag gi bu na kye ma'o/ /sman dang sman pa gang nas rnyed/ /'di dang bral na ji ltar bya/ /rab brtse bzod glags med par 'gyur/ /de dang de bzhin spyod par mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa dang / rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa'i byin rlabs bzhugs nas/ ston pa bcu gnyis mchis pa de dag nang ba'i chos la nges par gyur to/ /re zhig rgyal bu gsum dben par gnas pa na/ chung shos yang lcags na re/ 'u cag gsum la pha ma yang med/ rnar kyang r+ya mi gda' na/ pha ma'i rigs ni bu la snying ni brtse/ bdag cag chung bas man mi thon gyis dogs/ phag na rnar skal zhig yod nas mchi/ de gcen gyis 'tshol bar khu zhus pas/ gcen la sgrib pa mi mnga' bas/ rang gi ma lcags mo bzhugs pa'i 'og nas gser bum pa gang bton no/ /gser de byung ba 67
rme sbong ba dang yang lcags na re/ pha ma snying nyi de 'ong bar re/ da bdaka cag kun gsum gyi mdun ma 'dis cung mi 'ong bar 'dug pas/ gcig gis chos bya dgos so/ /gcig gis rnar bsags la rgyal srid 'di bzung dgos/ gzhan du na ngan pa dag ma 'chun par rang gi bstan pa la gnod par 'dug pas/ gcig gis mu stegs byed kyi ngan sngags bslabs la/ngan pa dag tshar gcad 'tshal/ zhes smras pas 'bring po yang 'bar na re/gcen chen po chos pa yin pas/ chos byed pa las 'os med/ chos pas kyang ngan pa mi 'chun zhing / stobs kyis kyang ngan pa mi 'chun par gda' bas/ sngon la ngan sngags shig bslabs la ngan pa gcun dgos pas/sacen chen po dang / rnar 'dir bzhag ste/ rang re gnyis ngan sngags slob tu 'a nga zer ba la/ bcen gyis gdams ngag du ma'i sgo nas bzlog kyang 9ri sa kyi dbang gis ma bzlog par so nga / dus re zhig rgyal bu blo byos 'phel rgya dgongs pa la sa phyogs 'di bon dang mu stegs byed kyi yul yin/gcung nga/nyis po grogs kyi dbang du song nas nor 'di don med kyi phyogs su bo ba srid/ bon dang mu stegs byed kyi yul 'di bsgral nas/ sa thag ring ba na a su ra⑩gsang ba'i brag khung zhes bya ba na bdag gi tshe rabs thams cad kyi bla ma a wa ṭu tī ba (yizhes bya ba grub thob chen po cig sprul pa gsum du mdzad de/ gcig ni kha ba can gyi yul du sems can gyi don la yang yang gshegs/ gcig ni rgya nag gi yul 'dir yang ya nga 'ong /gcig ni rgya gar gyi phyogs thams cad khyab par 'grim/ sku ri nyan thos chen ko'i rnam par byas shing gshegs pa cig yod pas/ de'i drung du ma 68
phyin na drag po mi thul/ sems can la phan mi thogs snyam du dgongs nas rang gis btul ba'i ston pa bcu gnyis po de pho brang du spyan drangs nas/khyed bcu gnyis pol phyi nang bar gsum gyi chos la mkhas/ nga'i pho brang 'dir dgon pa gyis la re zhig la rang gi gdul byar gyur pa rnams dam pa'i chos la 'khod/ cha lugs ni drang don du rang rang dang mthun par mdzod cig da ste lo gsum nas/ yang 'bar dang yang lcags gnyis ngan sngasas bslabs nas 'dir 'ong gis/ thabs kyis ngan sngags las bzlog la chos la tshud/ yang 'bar rgyal srid 'dzin du chug yang lcags la chos slobs la don du gnyer ba la 'chad du chug ) nga ni 'di lta ste/ sdon tshe 'khor ba thog med du/ /yongs kyi bshes gnyen yongs kyi dpal/ /gtsug gi nor bu rin chen mchog /a wa rtsa tī zhes grags pa/ /gsang ba'i brag khung zhes bya na/ /a su ra yi sgrub khang yod/ /de na byams dang snying rje yi/ /pad kor ①mdzes pa phyogs bcur bskor/ /bdag med chos kyi lda rje gsor/ /bdud dang pu stegs lha min tshogs/ /gnas der bsdus te skrag par byed/ /dam pa de yi drung du 'gro/ /bla ma de yi zhabs la gtugs/ /zag med bdud ñtsha snying bo len/ /bsdu ba rnam bzhi'i bka' lung len/ /chos dbyings chen por sngo ba byed/ /ces ston pa de dag gi dbus nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas a su ra gsang ba'i brag ces bya ba rtse mo mtho ba'i rtse la smin dang na bun 'khrigs pa/ ngos rtsi shing nags tshal rgyas pa'i gseb na/dug sprul dang gcan gzan gdug pa can 'grim pa/ smad khrag mtsho 'khyil 69
ba'i nang na dung dang chu srin la sog25 pa chu'i skye b+thā du ma gnas pa/gzugs med sgra skad 'byin pa'i lha ma srin mang po labs pa de lta bu'i brag —khung na/ bla ma a wa r+sha tī ba che chung rim pa gsum brag khung tha dad pa gsum na bsam gtan la rtse gcig tu gnas pa la gser bum pa gang bo de cha gsum du btang ste/ bla ma a wa skyo tī ba chen po'i phyag tu sum cha phul te/ nga yi zhing khams kha ba can gyi ljongs/ /byams pas 'dul byed zhing khams rtsub po der/ dpa' bo khyod byon sa bdag klu gnyan dang / /bdud dang lha min gdug rtsub chen po'i tshogs/ /ma lus khyed kyis 'dul byed skal ba can/ /bdud ji dus las 'doms shing tshim par byed/ /e ma khyed la chags pa mi mnga' yang / /yang 'bar yang lcags la sogs 'gro don du/ /thugs rjes bzhes la de dag zhi bar mdzod/ /dge rtsa chos dbyings dag pas mchog tu bsngo/ /bla ma'i zhal nas 'di skad du/legs pa legs pa'i lam zhugs legs par mchi /bdag gis gzhan don dag kyang gtso bor bde/ /zhes gzhan ce yang mi gsu nga bar bzhugs so/ /yang gser sum cha a wa ñtsha tī ba 'bring bo'i phyag tu phul te/ rgya nag nga rgyal dres/sa pa'i lam zhugs pa/ /mkhas dang mkhas par rlom pa mang po'i tshogs/ /khyod kyis 'dul zhing skal ldan zag med kyi/ /bdud rtsis tshim mdzad bdud dang mu stegs dag /rab 'joms sprul pa chen po nyid la 'di/ /chags pa mi mnga' mod kyis 'bul gyis bzhes/ /bsam dang dngos bzang chos dbyings dag pa yi/ /zhing dag khyed la phul bas mchog tu shog /ces smras pa dang / bla ma'i zhal nas/ chos kyi chos 70
mchod tshad med mchog tu bzang / /gdug pa gang gis 'tshe ོ ma za gyis/ /zhes gzhan mi sasu nga bar bzhus/sa/ yang gser gyi sum cha bla ma a wa t+pa tī ba chung ba la phul te/ rgya gar phyogs ris med par bla ma khyed/ /sprul pa du mas yong dang mthun pa'i chos/ /ston cing ma rungs gdug pa 'dul bar byed/ /skal ldan dus la bdud rtsis tshim mdzad cing / /gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i zhing khams ma lus par/ gdul bya'i dbang gis sprul pa du ma 'gyed/ /'gro ba de dag thugs rjes 'dren mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma khyed la gser g.yu rdo shing dag /khyad par mi mnga' rin chen 'di 'bul gyis/ /bzhes la chos ston 'khor ba ma stongs par/ /nam mkha' bzhin du skye 'bri med par bzhugs/ /thams cad dka pas dag pa'i dbyings su bsngo/ /zhes zhus pa dang / bla ma nam mkha' la cher gzigs nas/ 'di hra/da du/ dpe med dpe 'das spyad bya spyod byed med/ /chags sdang 'dis chod dbyer med ngang du khyer/ /zhes gsungs nas ral gri cig gnang ste gzhan ci yang mi gsung bar bzhugs so/ /de nas rgyal bu blo gros 'phel gyis bla mas gnang ba'i ral gri de bsnams te gsang ba'i brag las babs te 'ongs pa dang / nags kyi khrod nas stag dang spyang khyi 'dres pa drug tsam byung ste/ rgyal bu za bar brtsams pa dang / rgyal bu rang bzhin gyis byams pa dang snying rjer ldan pa la der de dag la dmigs te lhag par yang byams pa dang snying rje dang de dag gis sangs rgyas 'thob 'dod bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'khrungs so/ /de'i tshe 'di skad du/ bdag gi pha ma mche ba can/ /pha ma zos shing bu la yang za 78
ba'i rnam 'gyur bstan rung ngam/ /ma za ma za las la soms/ /zhes smras pas/ gcan gzan de dag ngo zhum byas te/ 'di skad du/ sngon chad du ma zos gyur kyang / /bden pa'i tshig gis grol ma gyur/ /da lan khyed gsung mi bcag 'tshal/ da dung 'jigs chen 'ong dogs yod/ /bsam bzang red dang 'grogs par bya/ /ma 'grogs na ni mi thon no/ /zhes zer nas gcan gzan dag dang rgyal bu bsdongs te/ rgyal bus rang bzhin la spyad pas gnas a su ra gsang ba'i brag gi mi ma yin gcan gzan gyi rnam par bar du gcod du 'ongs pa la/ byams pa dang snying rje'i chu rgyun la 'dod pa'i me phran gyis bar du ma chod par rang rang gi grogs su shar ba gzigs nas/ sngar gyi ting nge 'dzin las ma g.yos par dpag tshad mang por 'grogs te phyin no/ /de nas gcan gzan de dag mi ring ba nas byer te song ngo / /de nas bsil thang zhes bya ba'i grong khyer chen po zhig na skye ngo dpag tu med pa gda' ba la/ la la rna glu gar la sogs pa dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur du ma ston/ la la ri rngu zhing smre sngags du ma 'don/ mi dpa' ba zhig lus la go mtshon du mas brgyan te rta 'ug la zhon pa na skye bo gzhan du mas 'then zhing ngu / der 'di dag gi spyod tshul 'gal ba la snyam nas dris pa la/grong khyir 'di'i dbus kyi pho brang 'di na/ sngar rgyal bo 'jigs byed bya ba yod pa la/ btsun mo shin tu mtshar ba zhig yod pas de la klu bdud zhugs te/ mos rgyal po'ang bkum/ blon 'bangs mang po'ang zos/ deng sang grong khyer ba 'di dag la mi re la zhag re za res bskor pas mi dpa' bo 'di 73
yang za res la 'gro ba yin pas cha lugs 'ad 'dra'ang nang par dzog mi nus pas ngu ba yin/ la la'i dga' gar sna tshogs byid pa rna mos nam za cha med/ zos na dga' ba'i gar rtser mi 'ong bas/ dga' ba'i gar gyi snang ba yud tsam ston pa yin/ bzhin bzang khyed kyis mi shes sam/ rgyal bus smras pa/ 'o na go cha sra zhing mtshon cha rno ba du mas bcom na mi choms sam/ de dag na re/ rkya bzhin bzang dpa' bo mi ro mang bar zad/mo la ni glags che bar mi gda'/ der rgyal bu'i zhal nas/ khyed rnams 〈ga bsngal ma byed cig do nub 'di'i tshab la kho bos chog sar thams cad byang chub sems dpa' zhis dga' ste/ mi de'i chas thams cad rgyal bu la brgyan nas btang ngo / /der pho brang de'i nang na rta dang glang po dang ma he la sogs pa nor mang po gda' ba la mi thams cad mdze mo zhig gis zos nas 'dug pa la/ rgyal bus rta de rin po che'i bres shig la btags te phugs na mdze mo cig gda' ba de'i rtsa na rin po che'i khri cig 'dug pa de la rgyal bus bzhugs pa dang / mdze mo de rgyal bu la cher bltas nas/ mi khyod dag bzhin bzang rlom pa can zhig gda' ste nga'i lus la a tsi snyo la zhes bya ba stobs che ba cig yod pa des/ nga rgyal can ngas bcings pa thams cad des za/ sngar mang bas kyang ma thub/ btsan pas kyang ma thub/ mi khyod ring burababazlums sam/ der rgyal bus/gzugs med mthong ba dang tshig de thos pas dngos dang brgyud pa'i sdug bsngal la bsams te byams pa dang snying rje drag po skyes/ bla mas gnang ba'i ral sgru de cig pa'i logs la bkal/ skye bo de dag gis bskur pa'i 73
ral the reg pa tsam gyis gzhan chod pa 'dra ba de lag tu bzung ste bsad pa dang / mdze mo de na re/ shes rab kyi ral gri cig med na mtshon cha de la re na sdug mchi zer/ de nas nyi ma dmar thag chod pa dang mdze mo des mar me chen po cig la bltams te byung / de nas re zhig nas/ mdze mo de'i sna bug nas sprul nag po gnya' shing tsam zhig bsnyengs te thon nas byung ba dang / rgyal bu'i dadongs pa la/ sems can de dag la gnod pa 'dis byas/ sems can gyi don du ral gri 'das bsgral lam/ bla mas gnang ba'i ral gris bsgral snyam ste/ bla ma'i ral gri la bltas pas/ bla ma'i ral gri de'ang bzhi cha tsam shubs nas 'phar 'dug de nas sprul de'i sum gnyis tsam thon/ ral gri de'i yang sum gnyis tsam thon/ re zhig na sprul de yang mar la thim song / ral hra de yang sbrul ji ltar rgyud pa bzhin byed/ de'i tshe rgyal bus 'di skad du/ dug sprul nag po ma nub cig /brtsams nas ldog na dpa' bo min/ /'thabs nas ma thub rang la ngan/ /mi thub bsdo bayimen pa yin/ /las ngan rang gi rjes 'brang phyir/ /khyod kyi mtha' lam ngan 'gro yin/ /zhes sprus pas/ mdze mo na re/ kye kha pho sngon la ma che cig /rjes su mthong nas 'gyod par 'ong / /zhes pa'i rjes la sna bug nas dug sbrul nag po de thon nas 'doms bdun tsam du byung ba dang / bla mas gnang ba'i ral gri de 'phar nas song ste/ rked pa nas bcad pa dang / lce dmar po zhig gis bldags pas yang slar 'byar/ de'i mod la ral gri'i so )nyis khas dum bu gnyis su btang / gnyis/ bzhi/ brgyud/ bcu drug74
sum cu rtsa gnyis rmya bar du gtubs te/ rgyal bus sa btab pas lces bldags kyang / sa khal khal tsam las 'byar ma nus/ de nas ral gri'i so des dum bu rnams g.yabs pas yisdud pa bzhin du bsdus te lud kyi khung bur sprus so/ /der sngar gyi mdze mo de ni shin tu gsal ba mdzes pa cig tu gyur te/ khang ba'i nang thams cad la byi dor byas/ dri bzang gi chus chag chag btab/ gos gsar ba rgyan/ rgyan dag kyang btags te/ rgyal bu'i mdun du thal mo sbyar nas/ khyed lta bu'i stobs chen gang nas byon/ 'di lta bu'i yon tan 'ong ba 'u lags/ klu bdud 'de ni sus kyang 'dul bar ma nus pa la khyod kyis btul/ khyod rnyed pa'i mchog legs par rnyed pas/bdag gi lus longs spyod thams cad khyed la 'bul/ mi mang po'ang khyod kyis bde ba la bkod/ yul 'di thams cad khyod kyis bskyang zhing bzhugs par zhu/ rgyal bu na re/ klu bdud nag po'i 'byung gnas khyod dang nga gnyis lhan cig tu gnas par byed dam/ bdag gis mi 'di dag gi srog bskyab pa'i don du 'dir 'ongs kyis/ khyod 'dod pa'i phyir rna ma yin no/ /yang bu mo na re/ khyed kyi gsung bzlog pa dka' na'ang / byang chub sems dpa' la sems can dbu rgod kyi don bya ba las med/ nga sems can nyan mongs pa can gyi lus mdzes pa 'ad dgrar langs/ jed kyi grogs rgyal po chen po'ang 'dis bkrongs/ blon po la sogs pa'i mi mang po'ang 'dis zos/ stobs chen gang gis kyang 'dul bar ma nus pa khyod kyis btul ba la/ khyid drin che ba'i ngos nas kyang ci'i phyir mi 'dzin/zugs brtse ba'i sgo nas gzung du gsol/ zhes nan du gsol ba dang /75
rgyal bus kyang brtse ba'i sgo nas zhal gyis bzhis/ bu mos kyang bsnyen bkur phun sum tshoyos pa byas te/ rgyal bus nang par grong khyer ba de dag gi dbugs 'byin du phyin pa dang / krong khyer ba thams cad ya mtshan nas rgyal por gsol ba btab pa/ rgyal bus kyang de'i rgyal po chen po mdzad do/ /skye bo de dag thams cad kyis kyang / rgyal po dang bla ma thun mong du bzung / thams cad kyang chos la spyod par gyur to/ /dus re zhig rgya nag hwa shang gi yul rang gi pho brang gang na yod pa der phyin pa dang rgyal bu yang 'bar gyis ni rgyal po byed/ yang lcags kyang phyi nang gi chos la mkhas par byas nas thun mong gi dngos grub kyang lon/rgyal bu gnyis kyang thams cad kyis bkur zhing gda' ba la/ rgyal po blo gros 'phel gyis kyang chos bstan pas thams cad kyis kyang grub pa thob bo/ /legs pa'i shes rab/ da lta yang grub de dag rgya nag la sogs pa gnas sna tshogs pa na sprul pa du ma 'gyed cing gda'o/ /yang 'bar ni/zla ba sngon ma de la lha ri snying bo'i mgul na chos 'chad cing yod tsa na/ a tsar+ya cig byung nas 'brom la phyag 'tshal ba de yin te/ khyod kyis sems la zin nam gsung / dzog na re/ rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa nges pa mi gda' zer/ de ltar na de 'dra ba'i gdul bar dka' ba thams cad la/ byams pa dang snying rje dpag tu med pa bsgoms shing / thams cad kyis sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi bsam pa brtan par mdzad do/ /de'i tshe blo gros 'phel rna/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas la 'khrul ba med/ bla ma a wa zla tī ba gsum 76
po de kho b+thā yin zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar byams dang gling rje bsgom bya zhing / /byang chub sems ni brtan par bya/ zhes bya ba las brtsams te/'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bstan pa las/ rgyal bu blo thos'phel du ji ltar skye ba bzhes pa'i le'u ste skyes rabs brgyad pa'o/ /mchan 'grelaḥ ()yan lag bdun pa/— tshogs bsags yan lag bdun pa ste/〈〈snang bshags〉〉las/ phyag 'tshal pa dang mchod cing bshags spru dang / /rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi/ /dge ba cung zad bdag gis 'u bsags pa/ /thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen ngo ra bsngo'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phyag 'tshal pa'i yan lag mchod pa'i yan lag bshags pa'i min lag rjes su yi rang ba'i yan lag chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba'i yan lag ca ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa'i yan lag dge ba rdzogsbyang du bsngo ba'iyan lag bcas bdun no/ / ①mngon shes/ rang gi sems rten bas ma gtan gyi snyoms 'jug la brten nas tha malagyi dbang bo'i yul 'as 'das pa'i rangayul mngon sum du rtogs pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi yid shes rna mngon shes kyi mtshananyid yin zhes〈〈rgyan 'grel〉〉las gsungs so/ / ()gang zag dam pa/ gdags gzhi phung bo lnga bo gang rung la brten nas btags pa'i 'grob rigs drug dang theg pa gsum gyi skye 'phags gang dang gang de'irgyud laskyon yon gnyis ka re zhig gang ba dang / re zhig zag pa ste 'jig par 'gyur bas na gang zag ces dang / dam pa ni mchog tu gyur paste/ gang zag dam pa ni skyes bu mchog tu gyurapa'o//(3pu stegs/ sgra don ni/ ṭa ni mtha' la 'jug pas 'khor ba'i 77
pa 'a tshar ba dang / stegs rna par ba ra 'dzeg pa'i rkang stegs lta bul bas sam lam ste/ rang dzor thar ba dang mthoris su 'thob pa'i thabs su 'du shes pa'i lam la phu stegs zhes bya'o/ de ston pa'i bstan bcos 'dzin cing sal ba byed pas na phu stegs can zhes dbyangs can dga' blos 〈〈lam rim chen mo'ibarda bkrol〉〉las gsungs la/ yongs gragasastusu dkan mchog gsum skyabs gnas su mi 'dzin zhing lta ba bkar btags kyi phyag rgya bzhi khas len pa'i chos lugs mthal dag na/ / ()mgal me'i 'khor lo/ shing dum lta bu mes bsregs te me lce 'bar rtse med pa'i me ste/ de bskor pas na me'i'akhor lo lta bu zhig tu snang ba la zer/ ②tshad med bzhi/theg chen pas sems can tshad med par dmigs nas bsgoms te bsod nams tshad med pa 'phen par byed pa'i sems bzhi ste/sems can thams cad bde ba la 'god pas phan gdags so snyam du sems pa byams pa tshad med dang / sems can thams cad nyon mongs pa dang sprul zhing sdug bsngal bsal bas phan gdags so snyam du sems pa )ra n+d+ra tshad med/ sems can rnams gong ma ltar phan pa dang bde bar don byas pa legs so snyam du sems pa dga' ba tshad med/ sems can rnams bde ba dang grol bar byas rin pa rnams yangagrol bar bya mi danas pas btang snyoms su gzhug pa btang snyoms tshad med do/ / 06na gyis brlabs pa/ byin rna sku gsung thugs kyi gzi byin dang / brlabs rna bsgyur pa'i don te blo bsgyur par mu danas/ 0mi sto/ gnod pa med pa'am skyon mi snang ba/ zlonam mkhas gar khyab pha mas cu / /sems can thams cad pha ma yin
pas/ sems can rna ha cang khyab ñtsha ste nam mkhas gar khyab par des kyang khyab par gyur pas na ltar brjod do/ / 0byin rlabs/'phags pa'i lam chos kyi don gang yin pa la gnas pa'i dbang thob cing mthu yod pa rna byin rlabs nas bya'o zhes〈〈chos pyi rnam grangs kyi brjed byang〉du gsungs/ 0a su ra/ rgya gar skad de/ bod skad du lha ma yin zhes so/ / yibla ma a wa rgya tī ba/ rjo bo re'i bla ma byams pa'i rnal 'byor ba zhes grags pa di yin nam dpyad/ 44bad kor/ phyag rgya'i 6 brag cig ⑨ring bu/ rkyang ba'am gcigpu/ yibasdo ba/ brje ba dang / 'gran pa dang / bshad pa bcas don du ma la 'jug ste/ 'dir 'gran pa'o/ / yigayabs pa/ g.yob pa'i 'das pa/ tshur bkug pa'am phyogs gācin tu bsdus pa'i don/
'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas rna/ rab byung dang po'i gong gi lo skor tha ma'i shing 'brug (spyi lo 1004) lor yab rta gsum sku gshen dang / yum khu 'od bza' gnyis kyi sras su yul stod lung phur sku 'khrungs/sku na chung dus khams su phebs nas bla ma se btsun gyi sar 'bri klog dang /pa3 ta spri ti las sgra rig pa dang si skṛ ta'i skad bslabs/ rab byung dang po'i chu rta (spyi lo 1042) lor jo bo rje a ti sha mnga' ris su phebs pa gas na nas khams nas zhabs thang yis mnga' ris su phebs/ spu rangs su jo bo chen po dang mjal zhing bla mar bsten/ de nas jo bo dang lhan du dbus gtsang phyogs su phebs shing bla ma de las bka' chos mang du gsan/dzo bo rje sku mya ngan las 'das rjes/ sngon ngo bos gso skyong gnang ba'i slob tshogs khrid de ra sgreng du phebs/ dgung lo nga bzhi ba me bya (spyi lo 1057)lor rwa sgying dgon pa btab/ dzo bo'i sku gdung dngul gyi mchod rten du bzhugs/ de nas jo bo'i slob ma rnams 'brom gyis chos dang 'tsho ba gnyis ba'i sgo nas bskyangs te bka' gdams bstan pa'i bdag por gyur/ sras kyi thu po po to ba rin chen gsal dang / spyan snga ba tshulakhrims 'bar/80
phu chung ba gzhon nu rgyal mtshan gtso byas pa'i slob ma mkhas grub phul du byung ba mang po byung / 'brom ni dge bsnyen yin yang bslab khrims bsung ba la dge slong las kyang lhag pa mdzad/ dgung lo drug cu re gcig pa rab byung dang po'i shing 'brug (spyi lo 1064 )lor ra sgreng du skugashegs so/ /ngo po rje'i bstod pa sum cu ba/oṃ zhu)bde legs su gyur cig()phun sum tshogs pa lha ga la yi yul/ /tsho rigs btsun pa za hor rgyal po'i rigs/ /byang chub sems dpa' zhi 'tsho 'khrungs pa'i rgyud/ /mar me mdzad pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs//yab dang yum la sri zhu mkhas shing gus/ /gzugs mdzes yid 'ong shes rab snying brtser ldan/ /dul zhing rgyud 'jam thabs mkhas snying stobs che/ mar me mdzad pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jig rton lugs kyi bstan bcos thams cad dang / /bzo dang gso ba sgyu rtsal sna tshogs dang / /rig phyed kun la mkhas shing mkhyen pa rgyas/ /mar me mdzad pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'dod pa'i yon tan rnams la ma chags shing / /rgyal srid 'byor ba phun tshogs spangs nas ni/ /dge lhashā1 pa dī // / ①ba/ duXge basprung ldem (( sde/ bzhi0le/r+shaXl ga /kā ༵ ṭ+wāṃ dzo la bde bar gshegs pa'i bslab pa bcas pa la/ /nyes pa'i skyon gyis ma gos rnam par dag /dpal ldan a ti sha la gsol ba 'debs/ /yongs 81
su 'dzin pa'i mkhas pa mang bsten cing / /sde snod gsum dang sgra dang tshad ma dang / /man ngag kun la mkhas shing mkhyen pa rgyas/ /dpal ldan smyo ti sha la gsol ba 'debs/ /gser gling rgyal cipo sa skyong bla ma las/ /byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi'i sman blangs nas/ /'gro ba kun la phan par mdzad pa yi/ /dpal ldan a ti sha la gsol ba 'debs/ /sems can phongs shing shin tu sdug bsngal ba/ /rab tu mang la snying nas brtse ba yis/ /'jig rten lha dang lha min bcas pa yi/ /skyob pa yab gcig phu la gsol ba 'debs/ /grub pa brnyes pa'i bla ma dam pa las/ /yi dam lha yi mngon rtogs lung mnos nas/ /rtse gcig sgrub pa snying por mdzad pa ②yis/ /lung bstan thob par gyur la gsol ba 'a bas /gdul bya bod du yod par dgongs nas ni/ /kha ba can gyi ljongs su byon nas kyang / /sde ba mi chen rnams kyi bla ma mdzad/ /mchod cing bkur 'os khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhas mchog khyod sku bod du ma byon na/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa yod par gyur kyang ni/ /zab mo'i don la phal cher rmongs gyur pas/ /legs par ston mdzad khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /bstan bcos sgyur dang bsgyur zin 'chos pa dang / /de nyid 'chad dang rang gis rtsom pa sogs/ /yang dag lam la legs par 'khrid mdzad pa'i/ /bstan pa rgyas mdzad khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /lta ngan la zhen log pa'i lam la zhugs/ /bdud dang mu stegs dbang phyug grub mtha' ngan/ /rigs pas tshar bcad thar ba'i lam la bkod/ /thar 'dod ded dpon khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims 82
bzod dang brtson 'grus dang / /bsam gtan shes rab pha rol jin pa drug /skye ba du mar yang yang goms pa yis/ /tshogs gnyis0yongs gardzogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkho ba sbyin dang snyan par smra ba dang / /'jig rten don mthun gdul bya'i don la spyod/ /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhigiyi dpal 'byor gyis/ /gzhan don kyur mdzad khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /dad dang tshul khrims thos dang gtong ba dang / /ngo tsha shes dang khrel yod shes rab ste/ /nor bdun0dag gis smyug par gyur pa'i mdzod/ /yon tan 'byung gnas khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /ston tshe smon lam btab pa'i slob ma mchog /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas ring nas 'ong ba'i tshe/ /u ba si ka de ring sleb bo zhes/ /lha mig mngon shes mnga' la gsol ba 'debs/ /ma ga snya nas slob ma gus pa yis/ /sil snyan dkrol zhing gsol ba btab pa'i skad/ /bod du gnas nas 'brom la sbran pa yis/ /rna ba'i mngon shes mnga' la gsol ba 'debs/ /lha sar lha yi rol mo bsgrags pa las/ /myur bar byon nas bar khang lha tshogs la/ /phyag rten phul nas mkha' la bskor pa mdzad/ /‘ 'phrul mngon shes⑥mngon la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang du rgyal pos bka' chems gter du sgas/ /mkha' 'gros gter kha phyi nas khyod la gtad/ /shākya mu ni'i 'ja' sa khyod kyi drin/ /jo bo bka' drin can la gsol ba 'debs/ /sa bdag nad kyis zin pa'i mi rnams la/ /rtag par tshe 'dzin bsung ba'i skor rnams kyang / /khyod las byung ste 'gro ba'i nad gso mdzad/ /ku sgrub gnyis par grags la gsol ba 'debs/ /snye thang 'or du bye ma'i steng 83
bzhugs tsho/ /brgya byin la sosas bar snang lha rnams kyis/ /rin chen sna lnga'i me tos char ba phab/ /bla ma lha yi lha la gsol ba 'debs/ /g.yor bo mchims phur bu mo/sa mdzo rgyan phul/ /shi ba gsan nas de yi sgrib snyong mdzad/ /rigs kyi bu mo lha ru skyes zhes gsungs/ /'gro ba'i 'dren pa khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /kho bo 'di nas dga' ldan gnas su 'gro/ /nga la dad cing gus par byed pa rnams/ /dga' ldan sa/nas su mjal bar 'gyur zhes gsungs/ /ma 'ongs mngon su ma gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dga' ldan gnas na nam mkha' dri ma med/ /'phags pa'i yul na rī paṃ 7/ ra zhes/ /kha ba can na dpal ldan a ti sha/ sa steng grags pas khyab la gsol ba 'debs/ /'asbom ston bdag yis ra r+sāng lha khang bzhengs/ /'gro ba 'dren phyir gsol ba btab pa las/ dga' ldan sanas nas rab gnas me tog gtor/ /byin rlabs dngos su phab la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyod kyi yon tan ca/thong dang thos pa dang / /dang ba'i yid kyis lhang lhang gsol 'debs na/ /dga' ldan gnas nas thugs rjes gzigs mdzod la/ /gsol ba btab bzhin byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /da dung kha ba can na khyod nyid la/ /dad cing rjes su slob ma mang yod kyi / /thugs la dgongs nas bu la ma ba'i/na du/ /brtse bas bdag gi bshes gnyan mdzad du gsol/ /snyigs dus skye spro dmus lo nga lta bu rnams/ /dam min dge ba'i bshes 'dras rjes bzung ste/ /'khor ba'i gcong rong gnas nas 'dren med rnams/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus myur du drang du gsol/ /dus dang gnas skabs dag ni thams cad du/ /dam pa khyod 84
ni bdag gi mdon lags kyi/ /mngon par rdzogs par myur du 'tshang rgya 'gyur/ /thos bsam sgom gsum bdag la stsal du gsol// //mchan 'grel ()oṃ/ 〈〈rdorje rtse mo〉las/ tsha ni 'u zhig yin par bshad/ /mchog dang rnar gter dpal dang g.yang / /skal bzang rnam pa dang ldan zhing / /dam bca' ba dang bkra shis don/ /rnar 6 'dzin pa'i sngags su brjod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ oṃ rna don chen po dang ldan pa'i bkra shis pa'i tshig yin pas/ de brjod pa po la bar chad mi 'jug cing 'dod pa'i don rnams 'grub par 'gyur ba'i don gyis na/ gzhung gi 'dor oṃ smos pa yin mu/ / ()bde legs su gyur cig gnas skabs bde ba mngonamatho dang mthar thug legs pa thar ba thob par gyur cig ces pa'am/ yang na〈〈gan bsdu pa〉〉las/ bde 'gror 'gro bas na dge ba'o/ /dam pa rnams kyis bsngags pas na legs pa'o zhes pa ltar 'thel na'ang rung ngo / /()dge 'dun phal chen g+ne/ nyan thos kyi rtsa ba'i sde bzhi'inang gses/sde 'di'i mkhan po rna nyan thos 'od sungs chen po yin la/ rnam sbyar gyi rnam phran nyi shu rtsa gsum nas bdun bar du byed pa/ grwa'i rtags dpal be'u dang dung dkar/ so thar gyi mdo 'don skabs sga kro ta'iskad du 'don pa/ zas snod kyi nang du zas blugs te rang gi mdun du bzhag pa tsam gyis byin len chags pa/ dge slong dang dge tshul khang ba gcig gi nang nyal dgos tshe bar du yol bas bcad na nub lhag bsung ba'i go chod bcas la khas len pa'o/ / ()'dul ba'i sde sno da sde bzhi/ dge bsnyen dang / dge tshul/ dge slong rnamasakyi bslab khrims brjod pa gtso bor byas nas ston pa'i theg dmanagyi 85
'dul ba'isde snod kyi gzhung bzhi ste 'dul ba lung sde bzhi yang zer/sde bzhi rna/ 'dul ba rnam 'byed dang / 'dul ba lung gzhi/'dul ba phran tshigs/ 'dul ba gzhung dam pa'am gzhung bla ma bu bcasaso/ / ()sgrub pa 〉nga por mdzad pa/ sgrub pa nyams len gtso bor mdzad pa'i don/ ()tshogs gnyis/ bsod nams kyi tshogs dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis te/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rna/sbyin pa gtong ba dang / tshul khrims srung pa/ bzod pa sgom pa lta bu dang / ye shes kyitshogs rna/ ting nge 'dzin sgom pa dang / stong ba nyad rtogs pa'i shes rab lta bu'o/ / ()bsdu ba'idangos po bzhi/sbyinapa dang / snyan par dz+ra ba dang / don spyod pa dang / don mthun pa dang bzhi ste/ 〈〈mdo lda rgyan〉〉las/ sbyin mtshungs ston len 'khug dang / /bdag nyid rjes su 'jug rnams kyis/ /snyan par smra dang don spyod dang / /don mthun nyid du 'dod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gyin pa'i phar phyin dang mtshungs pa'i sbyin pa ṭa dang / gzhan la phyin drug ston pa'i snyan par dz+ra ba dang / gzhan dag phyin drug len rtswa 'jug pa'i don spyod dang / rang nyid kyang jin drug la 'jug pa don mthun pa ste bzhi'o/ / ()nor bdun/ 'phags pa'i rnar bdun te/ 〈〈bshes dzings〉〉las/ dad dang tshul khrims gtong dang thos pa dang / /dri med ngo tsha shes dang khrel yod dang / /shes rab rnar bdun lags par thub pas gsungs/ /zhes gsungste/ las 'bras dang dkon mchog gsum la yid ches pa rna tshul khrims kyi = ste dad pa'i rnar/ srog gcod pa la sogs pa sdig spru 4dge ba spangs pa ni thar ba dang mtho ris gnyi ba'i rgyu ste tshul khrims kyi
rnar/ dha nang gi dngos po ce bdog pa gzhan la sbyin pa rna longs spyod chen po 'byor ba4rgyu ste gtong ba'inor/ dam pa'i tshos la chog par mi 'dzin zhing mang ru nyan ba rna bsam pa dang bsgom pa'i shes rab 'phel ba'i rgyu ste thos pa'i nor/ rang la bsam ste kha na ma tho ba 'dzem pa ra sdig pa mi dge ba 'dog pa'i rgyu ste ngo tsha shes pa'i nor/sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos la bag cad cing 'dzem pa rna nyes pa mi 'gang ba'i rgyu ste khrel yod kyi rnar/ bsam pa dang bsgom pa'i shes rab kyis chos kyidonartogs pa rna mya ngan lasa'adas ḍo thob pa'i = ste shes rab kyinor ro/ / ()dzu 'phrul gyimangon shes/ mngonashes drug gi 5 gyal/ 〈〈rgyan 'grel〉〉las sprul bsgyur du ma nus pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i yid shes de'imatshan nyid du 'jog go/ /mi chos gnad kyi phreng ba/kho bos byang gi phyogs nas gtso bo'i bu/ /kho bos sa mtha' bskor pas mi mthong myong / /rna gtam mang du thos pas bshad pa tsha/ /yin min mdo ltag phyed pas 0gur bor grags/ /gnas dang phyogs rnams gang du 'gro yang rung / /gzhi dang gunas mal gang du byed kyang rung / /grogs dang 'grogs lugs su la 'tshol yang rung / /gzhan dang bstun pa mi chos rtsa ba yin/ /de yi steng nas 'dun ma bshad kyi nyon/ /bya byed yongs kyi mgo ltag phye yi nyan/ /lha zhi klu zhi'i gdams pa bshad kyi nyon/ /chos la mi chos zab pa 'di ltar legs/ /su yi don du dka' spyad byed na 87
yang / /bya shes/ ko long sdug yus0chung bar na dzod/ /las dang bya ba ji ltar byed na yang / /mdzad spyod thams cad mi dang mthun par mdzod/ /rang la yon tan ji tsam yod na yang / /gzhan la khyad gsod brnyas pa chung bar mdzod/ /rang nyid nor la chags zhen che na yang / /gzhan gyi rnar la hab sha chung bar mdzod/ /rang nyid las thabs 'dun ma mkhas na yang / /spyi yi khrims la sa chod chung bar mdzod/ /rang nyid bsags pa'i nor rdzas yin na yang / /mang po'i gseb tu lkog nor chung bar mdzod/ /rang nyid kun gyis tshad mar khur na yang / /nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal chung bar mdzod/ /rang nyid kun las khyad par 'phags na yang / /che ba'i h+nā rgyal cung zad med par mdzod/ /rang nyid dge ba'i bshes su gsol na yang / /mkhas dman kun la brnyas pa chung bar mdzod/ /rang gi gong na che ba gzhan med kyang / /'og tu zhugs la 'jug pa bde bar mdzod/ /gzhan gyi tshogs dpon ji ltar ngan na yang / /gus pa'i tshul gyis phyag dang phyag lan mdzod/ /rang dang mnyam pa'i gang zag su byung yang / /mgo yang mtho ba'i bkur t+ta gus par mdzod/ /mdze sprang la sogs su yis chos zhus kyang / /kun gyi dbus su gdams ngag can par ston/ /gal te mtho 'tshams kha tshod lta na yang / /ha cang phul du phyin pas lhag par ston/ /tshogs dang bsnyen bkur sogs kyis mchod 'os kyang / /de la ma lta kun la thang mo rdol0/ /nges par gang la gsang bar 'os pa rnams/ /lkugs pa'i tshul gyis kha rog dben sar bzhugs//di yang rags pa spyi yi rnam gzhag yin/ /da dung snying gtam lags pas 88
gsan mdzod dang / /'grogs lugs dgra la 'tshol dang zab pa yin/ /snying gtam bu la gsong0dang brtan pa yin/ /kha 'don gre bar bsgyil dang btsun pa yin/ /mtshang gtam bar du gsong dang mkhas pa yin/ /rang mtshang rang gis brus dang mkhas pa yin/ /gzhan mtshang lhod la zhog dang dge ba yin/ /blo gtad snying gis skyong dang ngo mtshar che/ /snying gtam lags pas da dung gsan mdzod dang / /'phrad ma thag tu snying gtam 'chad pa mtshang / /ma brtag(brtags)pa la blo gtad byed pa mtshang / /brtags nas 'khrul na da rung byed pa mtshang / /bka med mi la bya byed 'tshol ba mtshang / /sha mi tsha la phug bsre chol ba mtshang / /dad pa med la slob mar bsten pa mtshang / /snying rje med la bla mar khur ba mtshang / /khril gzhung med la grogs por bsten pa mtshang / /mi nyan pa la kha ta byed pa mtshang / /mi shes pa la gros phugs 'dri ba mtshang / /mtshang du shes nas da rung mi 'dor na/ /rang nyid snyon pa yin par shes par bya/ /snying gtam lags pas da dung gsan mdzod dang / /bza' btung za dus thams cad bka' slob bde/ /zhag gsum 'grogs nas rang mtshang ston pa mang / /nye ring yongs la lo gcig ma brten par/ /bya byed bcol na myur du nongs par 'gyur/ /rang la brten pa'i mtshang //rdzu ji /(shā ṭ+wāṃ /grags/ga ༈/ gh+nā spra /snakā sna shar na //3 ṭ+wāṃ /shāshā / /gtam/ ngan rlung khyer yin/ /mi mngon dbyings su ya la na mkhas pa yin/ /nga mtshang thabs kyis shes na gad mo 'char/ /dgos pa rang gis bsus 89
na bdud rigs dga'/ /phung byed grogs su bsgyur na mtshang ri che/ /snying gtam lags pas da dung gsan mdzod dang / /zas la zhen pa ma che mi la byin/ /nor la ser sna ma che chos la mchod/ /bzhin la 'gyur dzog ma mang 'dzum gyis bsus/ /dgra zun bsha' ral ma mang spyi snyoms sten/ /'khor la bstod ra ma mang blo khog sdoms/ /myur du smad ra ma mang thabs kyis spong / /su la khas len ma mang lag len skyongs/ /gang la'ang nyes kha ma 'dangs gros kha skyed/ /nyis na 'gyod thal ma byed phyis 'byung sdoms/ /snying gtam lags pas da dung gsan mdzod dang / /sdug kha dgra yi g.yab mo legs par chod/ /bya mang byur0gyi sna 'dren legs par chod/ /blo mang 'dun ma'i dkug shing legs par chod/ /gshis ngan dgra bo'i tshogs sa legs par chod/ /rnam rtog sdug 'dre'i pho khrom legs par chod/ /'khor ngan gtam gyi gzhi ma legs par chod/ /grogs ngan 'gyod pa'i rtsa ba legs par chod/ /yul ngan sdug gi 'khor ba legs par chod/ /mi chos rkang ba'i thi gu legs par chod/ /snying gtam lags pas da dung gsan mdzod dang / /dus ngan snyigs ma lnga ru bdo ba'i dus/ /chos pa yongs kyi bgegs 'dre chags sdang gnod/ /gang du phyin kyang chags sdang chung bar mdzod/ /ji ltar bgyis kyang dman cha blang bar 'tshal①/thag ring bal bo'i thang ni tshad pa che/ /kha skom btung ba'i tshogs la gzab par 'tshal/ /la stod lho yi phyogs rna dgra 'jigs che/ /zhe sdang ngan sngags tshogs la gzab par 'tshal/ /nyang shab byang gi phyogs ni smre mchu0mang / /long gtam tshig gi tshogs la gzab par 'tshal/ /pur 90
rgyal bod kyi yul t+na khril gzhung ngan/ /yid 'byung khong khro'i tshogs la gzab par 'tshal/ /deng dus skye bo'i tshogs ni gsar 'grogs che/ /bslu brid 'khor gyi tshogs la gzab par 'tshal/ /snying gtam lags pas da dung gsan mdzod dang / /yi dam lha la re ltos ma shor bar/ /dung ngan mi la re ltos chung bar mdzod/ /'grogs pa'i mi la khrel gzhung ma chung bar/ /legs nyes gang la bshad gzhung nyung bar mdzod/ /dkar po chos la 6 bshol ma 'dings par/ /dam pa'i chos la snyor ba thob par mdzod/ /'dun ma yongs la skyed 'dod ma che bar/ /bla ma'i phyogs sa/ padzo dī /rtswa ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ /spya/zhin /sna/ k+ti ṭ+wāṃ (sras ba thams cas nyadri pazhi ṭ+wāṃ sakhu (ra/ ⑦/bzhin du dga' bar 'grogs/ /bya ba gang la'ang rang 'dod chung bar mdzod/ /'dun ma yongs la spyi snyoms che bar mdzod/ /'di ltar khyod la bslab bya gdams pa 'di/ /byi'u sgo nga'i 'du shes ma shor bar/ /legs bshad 'di dag la ñtsa'i yi ger bkod/ /dban pa'i gnas su ltad mo che bar ltos/ /yun du bsrings na shin tu 'phrod par gda'/ /'di nas bzung ste skye ba thams cad du/ /'phrin las mnyam du 'gro ba 'dren byed cing / /kun tu bzang bo'i smon lam ji lta ba/ /dga' ba'i smon lam gcig tu gdab par bgyi/ /zhes 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis gsungs so/ /mchan 'grelaḥ 0mgo ltag gyad pa/ bsam blo gtong ba'i don/ tsho〉ko lung sdug yus/ rkyenachung ngu tsam lakhong khro ba dang byas lusal chad pa'i 95
