rje btsun mi la ras pa/rje btsun mi la ras pa ni/ rab byung dang po'i lcags 'thug(spyi lo1040)lor yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan dang yum myang tsha dkar rgyan gnyis kyi sras su mang yul gung thang skya rnga rtsa ru 'khrungs/ chung ngur yab gshegs te sdug mang po mthong / de rjes mthu bslabs nas 'khon glan par mi mang po bsad/ slad nas r+sāg pa la 'gyod de chos byed par sa rta(spyi lo 1078 ) lor lho brag tu phebs te mar pa lo tsā ba chos kyi blo gros dang mjal/ der lo drug zla brgyad tsam bzhugs te bla ma de las dbang dang man ngag rdzogs par blangs/ dgung lo zhe lnga ba shing bya(2 lo 1084)lor stod phyogs skyed grong dang gnya' nang khul du phebs shing sgrub pa'i dam bca' mdzad de lo dgu'i ring dka' spyad drag pos bsgoms pas —mchog gi dngos grub thob/ de nas sa phyogs gzhan du 'byon bzhud mdzad de snod du rung ba'i slob ma rnams la gsang sngasas kyi gdams pa ci rigs gnang / ras chung ba dang dwags po lha rje sogs slob ma grags can mang po byung / nyams mgur mang du brtsams te rjes rabs pas〈〈rje btsun mi la ras pa'i rnam thar rgyas par phye ba mgur 'bum〉〉zhes bya bar bsgribs/rab byung gnyis pa'i chu yos (spyi lo 1 123)lor sku gshegs so/ /93
mi la ras pa'i sha khyi'i mgur0/na mo gu ruX/ rje btsun mi la ras pa de nyid kyis thugs sras rnams rang rang so so'i ri khrod la bzhag nas/ rje btsun rang bal bod gnyis kyi so mtshams①dban gnas gnya shang 'gur rta zhes bya ba'i ri mtho la gnyan pa/ sgrin dang na bun 'thibs pa las dus rgyun chad med par kha char 'bab pa/ g.yas ri brag mtho la gzar ba la/ gcan gzan rnams ngar skad sgrog cing bya rgyal rgod po ldeng ba/ g.yon ri spang ri sdum la 'jam pa la/ ri dwags sha ba dang / dgo ba/ rna ba rnams rang bzhin gyis bag phebs te rtse zhing 'phyo ba/ mdun na nags tshal bzang po me tog sna tshogs bkra ba'i nang na/ spra dang spre'u rnams yang rtsal sbyong ba/ rma bya dang 'dzol mo la sogs te mdzes pa'i bya sna tshogs gsung snyan gyu ru ru glu len cing / sgra sgrogs la 'dab gshog gi gar stabs sgyur ba/ sgrub phug gi mdun na mar g.ya' chu gangs chu rdza chu rnams dus rgyun chad med par kyur myur snyan pa'i sgra sgrog cing 'bab pa/ dben zhing nyams su dga' ba/btsan la mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa'i dban gnas ka ta ya zhes bya ba'i phug pa na/ dkar phyogs kyi mi ma yin rnams kyis zhabs tog sgrub cing chu bo rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang la bzhugs pa las/ dus nam zhig gi tshe gnas de'i phur khyi skad lhang lhang ba dang / de rjes thug sgra chen po zhig byung bas/rje btsun gyi thugs dgongs la sngar yin na nga'i gnas 'di bsam gtan —94
shin tu 'phel ba zhig yin te/ da 'a na bar chad cig yong ba yin rnam dgongs nas phug pa'i mdor byon/ pha bong chen po zhig gi khar dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po zhig gi ngang la bzhugs pa las/ sku mdun na tshur sha ba nag po spu nyag ma re'i rtsa ba la rngul thigs pa re 'bab pa zhig 'jigs skrag dngangs pa'i tshul dang bcas te byung ba la/ rje btsun gyi thugs la mi bzod pa'i snying rje chen po 'khrungs te/ sngon gyi las dbang ris lus 'di lta bu blangs pas/ tshe 'dir 'u yang ma nyes rung mi bzod pa'i sdug bsngal 'di lta bu myong dgos pa snying re rje/ 'di la theg pa chen po'i chos0bshad nas dus gtan gyi bde ba la 'god dgos dgongs te/sha ba la mgur 'di gsungs so/ /rje lho brag mar pa'i ①zhabs la 'dud/ /sems can sdug bsngal zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /khyod sems can sha ba'i lus la tsher ma'i mgo/ /sha lus tsher mgo mi la'i klu la nyon//phyi snang ba'i yul la bros bros nas/ /'khrul snang ma rig pa'i nang nas thar dus med/ /phyi lus sems spangs kyis mi spongs ②kyis/ /'khrul snang ma rig spong ba'i dus la bab/ /las rnam smin bden pa mgyogs drags pas/ /phyi sgyu lus bros pas ga la thar/ /'bros na nang gi sems nyid bros/ /sems nyid byang chub gnas su bros/ /gzhan bros pas thar 'dod 'khrul ba yin/ /sems 'khrul ba shigs la 'di ru sdod/ /da lta khyod kyi snang ba la/ /'chi ba snying nas ma bzod pas/ /ri pha ri'i logs nas thar du re/ /tshu ri'i logs la zin gyis dogs/ /re dogs ngang nas 'khor bar 'khyams/ /khyod la nā ro chos drug 0gi khrid cig 95
'debs/ /phyag rgya chen po'iskyesgom zhi4 ston/ /zhis gsungs/ tshangs pa'i dbyangs lta bu thos na snyan zhing yid du 'ong ba/ 'apro ba gang gi rna lam du song yang yid 'phrog par byed pa'i mgur de skad gsungs pas/ rje btsun gyi thugs rjes sha ba de'i 'jigs skrag dang sdug bsngal nye bar zhi nas mchi ma khrul(phrul) btang ste rje btsun la bag phab nas/ na bza' la ldag cing je btsun gyi g.yon phyogs su nyal nas bsdad 'dug pa la/ rje btsun gyi thugs dgongs la/ gong gi khyi skad des sha ba 'ad la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i khyi zhig yod res pas/ ji lta bu zhig yod dam dgongs pa'i ngang la/ khyi mo dmar mo rnga ma nag po'i tshom/ bu btags pa sder bzhi thams cad brag gis gshags pa/ lce dar yug tsam skyong ba/ zhe snang gnod sems chen pos skad drag po 'don cing bar snang la glog ltar 'khyug pa zhig sha ba de'i rjes gcod cing byung ba las/ sha ba la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa de 'di yin par 'dug ste/ khyi 'di phyi snang ba'i dngos po gang mthor yang dgrar langs te zhe sdang gi bsam pa dang mi 'bral ba 'di'i zhe sdang 'de zhi na 'u ma rung ste dgongs nas/ yid skyo shas kyis kun nas bslangs shing snying je mngon du gyur pa'i mgur 'di khyi mo la gsungs so/ /rje lho brag mar pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /sems can zhe snang zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'gro ba khyi yi lus la spyang zhi'i gdong / /khyi lus spyang gdong mi la'i glu la nyon/ /khyod snang ba gang byung dgrar langs pas/ /zhe ldang sems ngan yid la 'khrug /sdig can khyi yi lus su skyes/ /sdug bsngal ltogs pa'i ngang la sdod/ /nyon mongs zug rngu zhi dus med/ /nang rang 96
sems bzung bas ma zin na/ /phyi gzhan lus bzung bas 'u la phan/ ༈'dzin na rang sems 'dzin pa'i dus la bab/ /sems zhe sdang sprongs la 'di ru sdod/ /da lta khyod kyi snang ba la/ /nyon mongs na sdang ma bzod pas/ /ri pha ri'i logs nas shor gyis dogs/ /tshu ri'i logs la zin du re/ /re dogs ngang la 'khor bar 'khyams/ /khyod la nā ro chos drug gi khrid cig 'debs/ /phyag rgya chen po'i sgom zhig ston/ /zhes gsu ngas pas/ rje btsun gyis thugs je chen po'i ngang nas tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi chos gsungs pa des/ khyi mo de nyid kyi zhe sdang zhi nas skad sna nas 'don zhing / rje btsun la mjug ma bsgril ba dang / na bza' nas ldag pa sogs gus gus kyi tshul du byas nas/ je btsun gyi g.yas phyogs su lag pa gnyis kyi bar du mtshul ba bcug nas mig mchi ma nyil le sha ba dang ma bu'i tshul du nyal nas 'dug 5/ /de nas ye btsun gyi thugs dgongs la/ sems can 'di gnyis kyi phyi la mi sdig can zhig yong gin yod jes te/ brtsad chod na 'dir sleb ste yong dgongs pa las/ re zhig nas mi ngam gnag la mig rtsa 'khrug pa/skra thams cad spyi bor bcings pa/ thu ba g.yas gzed dang g.yon gzed byas pa/ dgo slog zhags pa la brgyus nas ga sha0la drangs pa/ lag na mda' gzhu thogs shing dbugs khar 'tshangs pa rngul nag khrag tu zham me ba zhig slebs byung bas/ khyi mo dang sha ba rje btsun gyi drung na ma bu'i tshul du 'dug pa dang / sgom chen pa 'dis khyi dang sha ba la ngan zhig byasasam snyam/ zhe snang langs te kho na re/ ras pa dang sgom chen pa 'di tsho bas 97
khyab che ba mi 'dug ste/ mtho gangs dkar gyi ltongs su ri dwags gsod sar sleb 'ong / dma' rgya mtsho'i 'gram du nya sram gsod sar sleb yong /bar grong yul du khye tshong dang 'thab mo byed sar sleb yong gin 'dug pas/ri re gnyis gnyis shi rung mi sto ba 'dug khyod kyis nga'i sha ba dang khyi mo bskyil thub 'dug pas/ khyod kyi ras gos kyis nga'i mda' yang e thub blta ba yin rna zer mda' bkang byung ba/ ltong nas yar song ba dang /rje btsun rgya thugs dgongs la dud 'gro ma rig pa'i rang bzhin du gyur pa la yang chos bshad pas go zhing 'dug pas/ kho mi la chos bshad pas dzo ste yong dgongs pa dang / zhal nas mi khyod kyi mda' la ldag long yong gis/de bas nga'i glu la nyan long yong du chug cig gsungs/ thugs mkhyen brtse'i nas pa dang ldan pa'i ngang nas tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis khyi ra ba mgon po lda rje la mgur 'di gsungs so/ /rje grub thob rnams la gsol ba 'a bas/ /dug lnga zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'gro ba mi yi lus la srin po'i gdong / /mi lus srin gdong mi la'i glu la nyon/ /mi lus rin chen dkon gsungs te/ /khyod 'dra mthong na dkon rgyu med/ /srin po'i gzugs kyi sdig pa can/ /ngan song sdug bsngal khyad bsad nas/ /tshe 'de'i 'dod pa sgrub lags kyang / /sdig pas 'dod pa mi 'grub ste/ /nang zhen pa log na dngos grub 'thob/ /phyi snang ba btul gyis mi thul gyis/ /khyod rang sems 'dul ba'i dus la bab/ /khyod sha ba bsad pas mi 'grangs te/ /nang dug lnga bsad na 'u bsam 'grub/ /phyi dgra be btul yang ji mang 'gro/ /nang rang rgyud btul na dgra bo 98
med/ /mi tshe sdig la ma skyel bar/ /dam pa'i lha chos byas na legs/ /khyod la nā ro chos drug gi khrid cig 'debs/ /phyag rgya chen po'i sgom zhig ston/ /'e/sa gsungs pa'i bar la nyan zhing bsdad 'dug ste kho'i bsam pa la tshig de rnams rang la nges pa cher med de/ khyi dang sha ba 'di gnyis sngar yin na zhe sdang dang 'jigs skrag gis mthong glags med pa yin pa la/de ring kho'i g.yas g.yon na phan tshun ma bu'i tshul du bsdad 'dug cing /nga rang gi yang dgun gangs dkar gyi ltongs su yang mda' sa la 'gril ma myong ba la/ da lan rang dbang med par brul song bas/ 'di yang na ngan sngags mkhan zhig yin par 'dug yang na bla ma khyad par can zhig yin par 'dug bas/ spyod lam la brtag dgos snyam nas/ sgrub phug gi nang du phyin nas bltas pas/ sngo'i rtsa ba dang kha lo min pa 'tsho ba dang yo byad ci yang mi 'dug pa la/ dad pa dung dung ba zhig skyes nas/ bla ma lags khyed kyi bla ma dang dam chos nyams len rnams ji skad bya ba yin/ gnas dngu thogis longs spyod rnams ci 'dra yod/ bdag kyang 'thad pa zhig byung na sha ba 'di'i srog phul nas bla ma khyed kyi phyag phyir 'brang ba lags zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ nga'i gnas dang grogs rnams 'di ltar yin pas nga'i phyir 'brang nus na shog cig gsungs/ khyi ra ba mgon po rdo je la mgur 'di gsungs so/ /bla ma te lo dang nā ro⑩mar pa gsum//de gsum mi la'i bla ma yin/ /bla ma 'di gsum gyis yong na ras pa'i ji la shog /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum/ /'di gsum mi la'i mchod gnas yin/ /mchod gnas de gsum gyis chog na ras pa'i phyi la shog /99
sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum/ /de gsum mi la'i skyabs gnas yin/ /skyabs gnas 'di bsubya gyis yong na ras pa'i phyi la shog /lta ba sgom pa spyod pa gsu mayi/ /de gsum mi la'i nyams len yin/ /nyams len 'di gsum gyis yong na ras pa'i phyi la shog /g.ya' ri gangasari rdza ri gsum/ /'di gsum mi la'i sgrub gnas yin/ /sgrub gnas de gsum gyis yong na ras pa'i phyi la shog sha ba dgo ba rna ba gsum/ /'di gsum mi la'i sgo smyugs yin/ /phyugs de gsum gyis yong na ras nga 'i phyi la shog /g.yi dang 'phar ba spyang gi gsum/ /'di gsum mi la'i sgo khyi yir/ /sgo khyi de gsu ma gyis yong na ras pa'i phyi la shog /bya 'dzal mo gong shā 4]—da po tha]sum/ /de sasum mi la'i khyim bya yin/ /khyim bya de gsum/ gyis yong na ras pa'i phyi la shog /nyi ma zla ba skar ma gsum/ /'di —/sum mi la 'i spyan gzigs yin/ /spyan gzigs 'di gsum gyis yong na ras pa'i phyi la shog /lha dang 'dre dang drang srong gsum/ /'di gsum mi la'i khyim mtshes yin/ /khyim mtshes 'di gsum gyis yo nga na ras pa'i phyi la shog /spra dang spre'u dang mi dred gsum/ /'di gsum mi la'i rtse thogs yin/ /rtse grogs 'di gsum gyis yong na mi la'i phyi la shog /bde dang gsal dang mi rtog gsum/ /'di gsum mi la'i skyo grogs yin/ /skyo grogs 'di gsum gyis yong na ras pa'i phyi la shog /zwa dang rug pa thul ba gsum/ /'de gsum mi la'i kha zas yin/ /zas 'di gsum gyis yong na ras pa'i phyi la shog /g.ya' chu gangs chu rdza chu gsum/ /'di gsum mi la'i btung chu yin/ /btung chu 'di gsum gyis yong na ras 100
pa'i phyi la shog /rtsa dang rlung dang zig le gsumadu/ /'de gsum mi la'i rgyan rgyu yin/ /gos 'di gsum gyis yong na ras pa'i phyi la shog /cesagasungs pas/ kho'i bsam pa la mdzad spyod gsung lugs mthun par 'dug snyam/ dad pa lhag par skyes/ mchi ma ga par shor/ phyag btsal zhabs spyi bor blangs te rje btsun rin po che la sha ba dang khyi mo mda' gzhu dka slog zhags pa rnams 'bul bar phul nas/ dngos po 'di rnams kyang bla ma la 'bul/ bdag dang khyi mo 'dis kyang sngar sdig pa mang po byas/ da phyin chad sdig pa mi bgyid pas/ khyi mo glog spyang dmar mo 'di mtho ris kyi gnas su 'dren par zhu/ sha ba nag po 'di bde chen gyi lam la drang du gsol/ bdag khyi ra ba mgon po rdo rje la yang chos gnang nas thar ba'i lam la drang du gsol/ zhes zhu don 'di ltar glur phul ba/nga'i g.yas na 'dug pa'i sha ba nag po dung ru'i kha rgyan can/ /'di bsad na zhag bdun gyi mu ge sel tsam gda' lags te/ /'di mi bdag la mi dgos bla ma khyed la 'bul/ /sha ba nag po bde chen lam la drang du gsol/ /glog spyang dmar mo byang chub lam la drang du gsol/ /mgon po lda je thar ba'i gnas su drang du gsol/ /g.yon na 'dug pa'i khyi mo zlog spyang dmar mo 'di/ /btang na nam mkha'i bya yang zin tsam gda' lags te/ /'di mi nga la mi dgos bla ma khyed la 'bul/ /sha ba nag po bde chen gnas su drang du gsol/ /glog spyang dmar mo byang chub lam la drang du gsol/ /mgon po rdo rje thar ba'i gnas su drang du gsol/ /zhags pa nag po a long gi kha rgyan can/ /'dis bkyigs na byang kha'i 101
'brong yang thub tsam gda' lags te/ /'de mi nga la mi dgos bla ma khyed la 'bul/ /sha ba nag po bde chen gnas su drang du gsol/ /glog spyang dmar mo byang chub lam la drang du gsol/ /mgon po lda rje thar ba'i gnas su drang du gsol/ /dgo slog tim pa'i kha rgyan can/ /'di gon na gangs dkar gyi ltongs su yang dros lags te/ /'de mi nga la mi dgos bla ma khyed la 'bul/ /sha ba nag po bde chen gnas su drang du gsol/ /glog spyang dmar mo byang chub gnas su drang du gsol/ /mgon po rdo rje thar ba'i gnas su drang du gsol/ /nga'i lag pa g.yas na bzung ba'i nyag phran mda'/ /sgro bzhi mtshal gyi kha rgyan can/ /'di brgyab na gang phog phigs tsam gda' lags te/ /'di mi nga la mi dgos bla ma khyed la'bul/ /sha ba nag po bde chen gnas su drang du gsol/ /glog spyang dmar mo byang chub gnas su drang du gsol/ /mgon po lda je thar ba'i gnas su drang du gsol/ /g.yon na bzung ba'i mchog dkar gyi gzhu/ /rgya rgyud gro ga'i kha rgyan can/ /'di bdungs na gnam gyi 'brug kyang ldar tsam gda' lags te/ /'di mi nga la mi dgos bla ma khyed la 'bul/ /sha ba nag po bde chen gnas su drang du gsol/ /glog spyang dmar mo byang chub gnas su drang du gsol/ /mgon po rdo rje thar ba'i gnas su drang du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab/ sha ba'i srog dang khyi mo la sogs pa'i 'bul ba rnams phul nas/ bla ma lags bdag kyang phyag phyir 'brang bar zhu lags/ bu smad rnams kyi lag nas 'tsho rgyags blangs nas 'ong bas/bla ma gnas 'di rang du bzhugs sam/ gang du bzhugs kyi gsal cha zhig 103
gnang ba zhu zhus pas/ rje btsun yang sha ba'i srog phul ba dang / kho rang blo chos la 'gyur ba la thugs mnyes nas/ khyi ra ba la bu sdig pa spangs nas dge ba bsgrubs pa ngo mtshar che phyis gang sdod kyi sar yong rung bsam pa thog tu 'khol ba dka' zhing / thog tu khel rung nga gnas res med la sdod pas rnyed par yang dka' bas de bas chos )da na bu smad kyi 'khri ba chod la/ da lta rang nga'i phyi bzhin chos la phyin na legs/ nga gnas nges med 'grim pa'i rgyu mtshan 'de ltar yin gsung mgur 'di gsungs so/ /pho mi mtshan can ri khrod kyi ras pa nga / /dbyar zla gsum ri khrod kyi gangs la sgom/ /khams thugs pa bsangs pa'i rlung dwangs yin/ /ston zla gsum ro snyoms sdum bu byedayi/ /lus 'byung bzhi gso ba'i 'bru tsam med/ /dgun zla gsum nags ma'i gseb tu sgom/ /rlung gdug rtsub can ngar ma'i sgrib yol yin/ /dpyid zla gsum g.ya' dang spang la sdod//rlung bad tan mkhris pa'i bcags sa yin/ /dbyar dgun med par sgom la yengs med brtson/ /lus 'byung bzhi 'jig pa'i sdug rtses yin/ /dus rgyun du yings med bya ra gtong / /nyon mongs dug lnga'i 'joms thabs yin/ /'tsho ba gang byung za ba de/ /'dod sred chung ba'i skyed rtags yin/ /dus rgyun du chos la 'bad pa de/ /rnal 'byor brtson 'grus che ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pas/ khyi ra ba na re/ bla ma de ltar yin pa ngo mtshar che bdag snying nas chos shig byed pa la/ bu smad rnams la yang kha ta zhig bcug chos rgyags shig kyang khyer nas myur du 'ong ba lags pas/ de bar 'di khar bzhugs pa zhu zer ba la/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas103
khyod snyong nas chos byed na/ bu smad dang 'phrad don yang med/ sdug khur byas chos byed pa la chos rgyags logs pa zhig mi dgos/ sdo dang shing gi 'bras bu la sogs te dka' thub kyi rdzas kyis chog pa yi na/ mi tshe nam 'chi cha med yin zhing da lta'i bsam pa bzang po 'di 'gyur nyen yod pas/ da lta rang nas 'dir sdod/ /6 smad la kha ta bcug pa'i thog mar ngas khyod rang la kha ta cig phyed pas 'di la nyon gsung mgur 'di gsungs so/ /'o na ston dang gson dang khyi ra ba/ /'brug 'ur sgra che yang stong sgra yin//'ja' kha dog legs kyang yal nas 'gro/ /'jig rten nyams su dga' yang me lam tsam/ /'dod yon bde ba che yang sdig pa'i rgyu/ /'dus byas ཿrtag rtag 'dra yang myur du 'jig /rdzas kha sang yod pa de ring med/ /mi na rnang yod pa da lo shi/ /grogs bzang po yod pa dgra ru ldang / /zas phan par zos pa dug tu 'gro/ /drin bzang pos bskyangs pa kha rgyad che/ /rig rang gis byas pa rang la gnod/ /khyod mgo brgya'i nang nas rang mgo gces/ /phyag sor mo bcu la gang bcad tsha/ /bza' mang nang nas rang nyid gces/ /rang mgo 'don pa'i dus la bab/ /tshe 'di mi rtag myur du 'chi/ /chos la phyi bshol byar mi rung / /brtse ba'i gnyen gyis 'khor bar 'phen/ /bla ma bsten pa'i dus la bab/ /r+nghi ༵ / hūm̐ ༵de paX phyi mar snyid ra/ ba mgo// dī pas rje tshesang pa sbya )sna ༵ dī shāg/ par/ dam pa'i chos la 'gyur nas/ bu smad kyi sar ma phyin par khrid zhus nas bsgoms pas nyams cung zad skyed pa rnams rje btsun la phul te/ da dung 104
nyams su len lugs kyi gdams ngag thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zhes zhus pas/ rje btsun mnyes te yon tan gyi mgo ma skyes 'dug da nyams su len lugs 'di ltar gyis shig gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so/ /bla ma dam pa bsten pa la/ /gsol ba snying nas ya nga yang thob 4dam mkha' 'gro sgom pa'i tshe/ /bskyed rim khang nga yang gsal 'a bas gyis/ /'chi ba mi rtag sgom pa'i tshe/ /nam 'chi cha med yang yang soms/ /phyag rgya chen po sgom pa'i tshe/ /chung ngu chung ngu yang yang sgoms/ /sems can pha mar sgom pa'i tshe/ /yang yang drin lan dran par gyis/ /snyan brgyud zab mozlosgo ma pa'i tshe/ /snying la rus pa thon par gyis/ /dam chos mtha' ru 'don pa'i tshe/ /mtho dman med par nar re skyongs/ /chos dang e mthun lta ba'i tshe/ /rtsab rtsub med par gcig la dril/ /so nam lha chos byed pa la/ /'jig rten bya ba thams cad thongs/ /'tsho ba lha yis sbyor ba la/ /sdug bsogs byas pas kha na med/ /ser snas bsags na mi 'phel ba/ /mkha' 'gro spyi yi dam tshig yin/ /de phyir phyis kyi bsam skyor bor/ /de phyir tshe 'ad blo yis thongs/ /zhes gsungs nas/ dbang dang gdams ngag mtha' dag rdzogs par gnang nas bsgoms pas/ nyams rtogs ②mthar phyin pa khyi ra ras pa zhes bya ba thugs kyi sras gcig byung ngo / /khyi dang sha ba yang de nas bzung ste ngan song gi sdug bsngal las grol ba yin no/ /phug pa de na khyi ra bas phul ba'i mda' gzhu yang dus da lta'i bar du yod par grags skad/gnyi shang 'gur rta ru thugs sras khyi ra ras pa dang mjal pa'i skor ro// ///05
mchan 'grel r+sāpha pa'i dbang rgyug ji btsun mi la ras pas sku tshe gang bor theg gichen po'i chos ston pa'i nyams masar mang bo mdzad yod spru de/ khosnyid kyimi ba da kyi gzungs thob pa'i slob ma rnams kyis so sor zin ris su btab 'ung / phyis dus rabs bco lnga bar grub thob gtsang spyon he ru na'am ming gzhan sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes pas phyogs gcig tu bsdus te〈〈rje btsun mi la ras pa'i rnam thar rgyas par ñtsha ba mgur 'bum〉zhes pa bsgrigs/ 'dir 'khod〈〈mi la ras pa'i sha khye'u masar〉〉zhes pa 'di gong zas〈〈mgur 'bum〉〉'ad las bshus ba yin/ phyu'in 5 gu ru/ na mo rna 'dud do zhes pa'am phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa dang / ṭa ru ni bla ma'am slob dpon zhes pa ste bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'o/ / ()so mtshams sa mtshams sam bar mtshamasastazhes pa'i don/ ()theg pa chen po'i chos/ theg pa chen po ni/gumado sde rgyan〉las/ dmigs pa che ba nyid dang rna/ / bzhin sgrub pa gnyis dag dang / /ye shes brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / /thabs la mkhas par gyur pa dang / /yang dag sgrub pa chen po dang / /sangs rgyas 'phrin las chen po ste/ /chen po 'a dang ldan pa'i phyir//theg chen zhes ri nges par brjod/ /ces gsungs te/ de dag kyang rim pa ltar theg chen gyi sde snod rgya chen po la dmigs pa dang /rang gzhan gnyis na'i don grub pa dang / bdag med pa gnyis ka rtogs pa dang / bskal spru grangs med gsum du gus spyor gyibartson 'grus rtsom pa dang / 'khor ba yongs su mi gtong zhing kun nas nyan mongs pa med pasalus ngag gi mi dge ba bdun ca/nang ba lta 6 dang / stobs dang mi 'jigs pa dang sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'des pha
yang dag par sgrub pa dang / 4na gyis grub cing rgyun mi chad pa'i 'phrin las rnams yin la/ de bdun —ba ldan pas na theg pa chen po'o/ /chos rna gsung rab ste theg pa chen po'i 442 rab ces pa'o/ /kyaje lho brag mar pa/ bod kyilo 3ka thokhu/ r+ya tshan rnyan ha cang che ba'i lo tsā ba zhig rje btsun mi la ras pa'i bla ma yin/ rab byung gong gi lo skor drug cu'i tha ma chu byi (spyi lo 1012)lor lho brag chu khyer ñtsha gro bo lung du sku 'khrungs/ ma tshan chos kyi blo gros su gsol/dgung lo bco lnga nas 'brog mi lo tsā ba shākya ye shes kyi drung ca saṃ skṛ —ta'i skad dang sgra rig pa sbyangs/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du lan du ma phebs/ rje nā ro ba dang / pa3 ta ye shes snying bo/ ku ku ri ba/ mi tri ba zhi ba bzang bo la sogs pa'i mkhas grub ca nga po la sagsang sngags kyi chos mtha' yas pa gsan/ grong 'jug gi yo/dpe sa pa dang / bde mchog mkha' 'gro'i snya na rgyud kyichos smor rnaṇa sa thob/ de nas bod yul du tshur phebs nas gsang sngags kyi chos dpe mang po bod skad du bsgyur/ rgya gar du ston tshul gyi nyams mgur masdu gsungs/ skal ldan gyi slob ma mang po bskyangs/ dgung lo gya brgyad pa rab byung gnyis pa'i me glang (spyi lo 1097) lor sku gshegsso/ / ⑧spangs kyis mi spongs/ ji tsam spa ngas kyang spong mi thub pa'i don/ / ⑦dra ro chos drug rgya gar gyi pa: ta nāro ta pa nas brgyud pa'i gdams pa zhig ste/ gdams pa 'di la sngon byon malas pa rnams kyis bzhed pa'i dbye bca khyad par yod kyang / 'der rje skam po pa'i bzhed pa ltaran/ bsgoms kyā sa 'tshang rkya ba gtum mo/sgyu ma lam gu cad pas 'tshang rgya ba ▶▶ lam/ gnyid mthug lam sa 107
byed pas 'tshang rgya ba 'od gsal/ ma bsgoms par 'tshang rgya ba 'pho ba/ sngong 2jun 'pho ba'i cha lag dang / mi lam sgyu lus gcig tu 'duzhing / bar do ya nga de'iya na lag tu byas nas chos drug cabzhed do/ / ()phyag rgya chen ngo / 'bras bu mthar thug gam mchog gi dngos grub phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ste/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba dang / de la rgyas 'debs pa'i rnam pa thams cad pa'i gzugs skad cig gang ngo ra thob pa de las bri ba dang gang ba med par a ji bzhin pa 'i ngo bo nyid kyis nam mkha' ji srid pa ) sri durtag tu gnas shing gzhaji yang las 'dar mi spyod pa nyid kyis phyag rgya yin la/ sprong ba dang rtogs pa dpa sems te chen po gsum dang ldan pas na chen po ste 6 ga rgya chen po zhes bya'o zhes bod rgyutshig mdzod chen mo 'a sa gsu ngas / ()ga sha/ phrag pa dang mchan khung phan tshun bsnol mar 'ching ba'i thag pa la zer/ / gobla ma ) lo dang na ro/bla ma te lo rna dus rabs bcu bar byung ba'i spya gar gyi grub chen zhig ste/ paṇa chen nā ro ba'i bla ma yin/ mtshan dngos shes rab bzang bor gsol/ des nub phyogs so ma pu rilagatsug lag khang du zhabs la lcags sgrog gsol nas lo bcu gnyis su sgrub pa mdzad pa'i mthar bla ma lha'i lung bstan ltar smad 'tshong ma'igayog mdzad nas lam gyi rtogs pa sbyangs pas grub pa chen po'i sa brnyes shing / do ha lda 44glu dbyangs ga sungs pa tsam gyis krong khyer 'bum phrag bcu gnyis kyi skye b+thā grol por grags/ slob ma grub pa thob pa brgyad kyis kyang 'gro ba'i don de bzhin r+ya dzad/ n+ta lo ba khong la mi'ibla ma med de/sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang dngos las dasang ldanas rgyud re bzhi'i ——108
gdabs spru gsan skong / lda rje rnal 'byor mas snyan brgyud nor bu skor gsum gyi mdzod gtad pas gdams pa'i bcad thams cad 'dus par grags/ /je dra ro ba rna dus rabs bca bar rgya gar du byung ba'i grub chen dag ste/ grub pa'i dbang phyug rta lo ba'i dngos slob dang / rje sgra bsgyur mar pa'i bla ma yin/ des dka' chen bcu gnyis spyad pa la mthar tshig dang brna la brten nas gsang sngags kyi don thams cad khong du chub cing grub pa bstes par grags/ 6yilta ba sgom pa spyod pa gsum/ nyams len gyi rtsa don gsum ste/ gnyis su med pa lta ba'i don dang / yengs pa med pa sgom pa'i don/ zugadu 'jug pa spyod pa'i don 5/ / (4rtsa dang rlung dang thig la gsum/ tshe mi 'azu ra zhing srog mi 'gag pa'i rnam par shes pa'i rten te/ yang rtsa khyim lta bu dang / rlung sems bdag po lta 6/ theg le rnar lta bu dang gsum mo/ / 4)ro snyoms ldum bu byed/ rtsa kum gyis lus kyi nus pa rang bzhin snyoms par cad pa ste 'tsho ba'i don/ (nya'adus byas/= rkyen du ma 'dus nas byas pa'am skyes pa'i chos te dngos po dang don gcig 1/ / zhu〉bskyed rim/ sbyang bya'i gzhi dus kyi skye 'chi bar do gsum po sbyong 6da sku gsum gyi lam khyer bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis sgo gsum thamal gyi snang zhen 'tha rog pa'i gsang sngags kyi lam zhig(mesnyan brgyud zab mo/ bla rabs rim bzhin snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i man ngag thab mo/ / (yinyams rtogs/ chos kyi don sgrub spru nyams len byas pa las byung ba'i yon tan/ /109
sa chen kun dga' lhang bo/sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po ni/ rab byung gnyis pa'i chu pojisprel(gyi lo 1092) lor yab 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po dang yum ma gcig zhang mo gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ de sku skyed shin tu che bas/ kun gyis mthong na dga' zhing yid du 'ong ba zhig byung bas mtshan kun dga' snying bor gsol/ sku na phra ba nas yab kyi drung du yi ge 'dra klog dang chos 'ga' zhig gsan/ dgung lo bcu gcig bar yab dkon mchog rgyal po gshegs/ gdan sa ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags la gtad/ de nas bzung sa chen gyis ba ri lo tsā ba dang / dge bshes brang ti ba dar ma snyipa bo la sogs pa'i bla ma mkhas pa mang du bsten nas mngon ba dang / phar phyin/ tshad ma/ gsang sngags gsar ma'i skor bcas slob sanyer mdzad de thugs su chud/ dgung lo nyi shu ba lcags mo yos (spyi lo1111) lo ra bla ma ba ri bas sa chen la gdan sa gtad de yun mi ring bar sku gshegs/de nas rje 'des bla ma gnam kha'u pa dang / bla ma ti chu ba/ bla ma zhang rin po che la sogs pa'i mkhas grub mang po bsten nas gsang sngags kyi zab /lha ༷༵༵ /( /sna/// chosad sramapa /ji nāṃ bamaX snyi dī/rnyi ṭā ༵ //sa kyi mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul la sogs la thogs pa med par grab/sa / gdan 110
sa mdzad nas lo zhe brgyad ring ga dul bya mapa po smin rol la bkod/ bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen po mdzad/ dgung lo drug cu re bdun pa rab byung gsum pa'i sa stag (spyi lo 1158) lor g.yas ru skya bo kha gdong du sku gshegs so //sa chen 'dis rma/jed nga 'i tra /sung rtsom phyong/sa bsgrigs pod gnyis bzhugs/dpal lda na bi rū pa0la bsto da pa/ cena mo bi rū pā ya/ a la la ste lhan skyes spros bral6〉las/ /'ad 'dra'i rab brjid dang/la 'bar bsam la ṭa 'das/ /gang de rje btsun tra rū pa zhes pa/ /bdag gi dpal du gyur pa e ma ho/ /khyod kyi gzi yi rtog pa kun bral te/ /sgo gsum rlung rnams dasa' ba bzhi()rgyas nas//za zi la sa kyang bde stongalagyur nas ni/ /sangs nas rjes dran cung zad bstod par gyur/ /bde legs phun tshogs don gnyis 'byor ba'i dpal//mkhyen dang brtse bas skal ldan gdul bya la/ /lam mchog bstan nas gyang 'das la 'god pa/ /mi g.yo'i mchog tu rol la mgos phyag 'tshal//gang zhig 'jig rten 'dir ni rgyal rigs las/ /rab byung rig pa'i gnas lnga mthar phyin te/ /gnas rigs dge 'dun bye bas legs bsten pa/ /gnas brtan chos skyong grags la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /bslab gsumasnyotadon ldan shing ta chen po'i0gzhung / /smra ba'i dbang phyug rgol bas mi 4 bas/ /bstan pa'i srog shing thams cad mkhyen gnyis par/ /sa 515
steng rtso da pa med la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /kun nas 'dus nga 'i tshobs la nyin bzhin du/ /theg rim duchos kyi bdud rtsis tshim mdzad nas/ /mtshan mor gsang spyod bsgrubs pas rnam grol te/ /bdag med kyis bzung sa drug①gyur la 'dud/ /brtul zhugs khyaspyod pas 'gro rnams drang ba'i phyir/ /dge 'dun gnas nas dman pa 'i spyod pa yis/ /grong bzhud kun tu rgyu bas 'jig rten du/ /kun gyis siskror grags la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /gaṅgā bzlog cing ma rungs rgyal po btul/ /nyi ma bzung nas yul khams myos byed gsol/ /myos min liṅgā rab bkas gtum mo btul/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug grags la mgos phyag 'tshal//de ltar dpag yas nus bstan de yi mthar/ /so rāṣ+ṭar nalta ka btul te/ /dmigs med thugs rjes mkha' dbyings kun khyab pa'i/ /zung 'jug bde chen rol la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /chos rnams bde stong shin tu rnal dag pa'i/ /de nyid kho na myur du rtogs byed thabs/ /snyan brgyud bzhilngayis zab mo'i lam bstan nas/ /skal ldan smin grol mdzad la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /e ma bdag yid dag pa'i dbyings/ /rnal grol go 'phang ma thob par/ /rje btsun khyod nyid mngon sum du/ /'di ltar yang yang gzung du gsol/ /de ltar khyed kyi thugs je yi/ /shugs las byung ba de dag gi /bdud ri'i rgyun yang spel bgyid na/ /don yang phun tshogs mdzad du gso la/ /rjes su slob pa gang rnams kyang / /rilpa gnyisayidang mi 'bral zhing / /lam gyi gegs ldang mi ldan par/ /bstan la phan par mdzad du gsol/ /kun nas dag pa'i sko gsum rlung ///(3
dga' ba bzhi yis rab rgyas te/ /snying po 'gros bal②thim gyur nas//do je 'dzin dbang thob par shog /nye bar bsten pa'i gnas 'de yang //grags pas sa dang mkha' khyab nas/ /zla ba ku cad ltar skya ba'i/ /dge ba'i dpal gyis rol par mdzod//mchan 'grel ①ba rū pa/ rgya gar grub chen brgyad cu'iya gyal zhig ste/ grub chen bar wa pa yang zer/ rigs rgyal rigs yin kyang rgyal srid spangs nas dpal na len+d+rar mkhan po snyam mi tra las rab tu byung / mtshan shri dharma pa la ste bod skad du dpal ldan chos skyong gu btags/ de nas mdo sngags kyichos mtha' dag sbyangs nas mkhas par gar/ na len+d+ra dgon paldemakhan po mdzad/ gsang sngags kyi lam la brten nasadangos grub thob ste grub chen ba rū pa zhes grags/ ()sprosbral/ mtshan mar mi 'dzin pa dang stong nyid dam chos nyid/()dga' ba bzhi/ dga' ba dang / mchog dga'/ khyad dga'/lhan skyes kyi dga' ba ste bzhi/ ()ba stong / sngags 'u gas kyi yul can bde ba chen po dang / yul stong ba nyid gnyis/ ()bslab gsum/ bslab pa gsum gyi bsdus tshig ste/ 〈〈chos kyi rnam grangs rgya mtsho'i gter〉〉zhes bya ba las/ bslab pa gsum gang zhe na/ lhag spru tshul khrims 'phags pa rnams kyi chos mthong zhes pa lta bu mya ngan las 'das pa dang / log par lta ba'i chos min yang dka par lta ba chos min ces bslab pa 'dul ba/ lhag pa ting 'dzin gyi bslab pa mdo ste/ lhag spru shes rab kyi bslab pa mngon pa'o zhes gsungs/0shing rta chen po/ shing rta'i srol 'byed slob dpon klu sgrub dang thogs med rnam gnyis la 5 danas/ ()theg rim/ 'dir theg 113
ba zugagasarigs zer/ gadrug byang chub sams dpagisa bcu las sa drug pha mngon du gyur pa la zer/ de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdzogs pas rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba skye ba dang / 'gag pa med pa'idon mngon du rtogs pas mngon du gyur pa zhes bya'o/ /(nyebartul zhugs/ bya ba snga ma bsdu69nas phyi ma la zhugs pa ste tha mal rang ga ba'i spyod pa brtul nas thun mong ma yin palaspyod pa'iganas la zhugs pa yin la/ dbyangs can dga' blos brtul zhugs zhes pa'i brtul rna bsdus pa'am 'jam pa zhes 'byung zhes gsungs so/ /(yisnyan brgyud bzhi/ tshos gar lung dang bcas pa dang / lung man ngag dang ldan pa/ man ngag brgyud dang ldan pa/ brgyud byin rlabs dang ldan pa'o/ /(yirim pa gnyis/ sngags lam gyi bskyed pa'irim pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim spru gnyis/ 4〉'gros bzhi/ rkang longs dbang gis gza' lam 'ardzasnar 'gros dang / dal 'gros/ 'khyog 'gros / 'byung 'gros bcas9'grogubazhi yod par grags/zhang ston0la bstod pa/bla ma dam pa rnams la mgos phyag 'tshal/ yon tan mchog mnga' gzhan la phan pa'i thugs rje can/ /ting 'dzin6)mchog brnyes nyid kyi /shā sdo( mthar phyin ( 'a/ phrul/rmo rdzu sna dzāshā dzopa // (sprapa sta zlo (( // ṭ+wāṃ 'dud/ /rab mchog gyur pa mthu stobs dbad phyug man ngag yi/sa/ /114
grub pa'i dbang rgyug dam par gyur pa'i bla ma mchog /zab lam chos kyis skal ldam/ ‘ / chos tu tshim mdzad pa/ /'bar ba'i mtshan can yid ñtsha phun sel khyed la 'dud/ /spangs rtogs ①mthar phyin mdzad pa mtha' yas longs spyod ṭ+wā 4/ṭa / rdo rje'i tshig ②rnams rgya cher 'grel mdzad sdud pa por/ /res par rma chis byang mi yi gzugari ṭa 'dzin bla ma mchog /snyan nga/rgyud bzhi sto na yid kyi dpal gyur khyod la bstod/ /rang gis spyad pa'i ༵ gh+nā sna ( par pa gardzu dṛ sayi pa/ra gyu/sra n+d+ra sprapa parmo kā hātā ñtsā //dri rjes /dri 'byor dbang phyu ⑧khyed kyi mthu yis rjes su skyongs/ /dag pa rang bzhin dag pa'i mthu yi4) bla ma la/ /rnam grol 'thob phyir rnam par mi rtog pa nyid du/ /dad pa chen pos dad pa'i shugs kyis gsol 'debs na/ /bugaṭa rje chen pos thugs rje'i lcags kyus gzung du gsol/ /rje btsun bla ma dam pa la 5]sol ba 'debs pa'i tshig /sa mā lta mi thi/ rje dgon pa bas zab don gyi byin rlabs stsal ba'i tshe/ bla ma sa chen gyis bstod pa'o//mchan 'grel 0) zhang ston/ gung zang bla ma zhang brtson 'grus grags pa ste/ rab byung gnyis pa'ichu ltag(spyi lo 1122) lor yab sngags 'chang rdo je sems dpa' dang / yum mang skyid gnyis kyi sras sayul ngam rtsod tsha ba grur sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcan nas yum dang gce na po4drung du yi ge 'bri klog sbyangs/ na nas dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi bar slob dpon mang 5 bsten nas par phyin dang / mngon pa/ tshad ma/ gsang sngags bcas kyi chos la slob gnyer mdzad/ dgung lo nya shu rtsa drug pa la slob dpon grab mkhar ba sogs kyi drung du bsnyeg115
rdzogs bzhes/ mtshan brtson 'grus grags nga/ra gsol:/ de nasangsga lo tsā ba sogs bla ma mang po bsten nas gsang sngags kyitshos gsan/dgung lo so gsum pa ra dwags 4ma tshul khrims snying po dang mjal nas dwags po bsal brgyud kyichos gsan/ de nas lo mang por ri khrod nges med ngu sgom sgrub mdzad/ rab byung gsum pa'i shing lug (spyi lo 1 175) lor tshal yang dgon btab pa dang / me lug (spyilo1187) lor gung thang danan btab nas lha chen dpal 'bar —bzhengs / de nas dar spel byung ba'i chos lu gas la tshal ba bka' brgyud zer/ rab byung gsum pa'i chu glang (spyilo 1 193) lo ra sku gshegs / gsung rtsom gar yod phyogs bsgrigs byas pa pod lngakhabzhugs/ duting 'dzin/ ting je 'dzin dang don gcig ste/dmigs yul brtag pa'i dngos po zhig la dmigs nas rnam pa rang yul la rang stobs kyis rtse gcig pa'i rnam pa can byed las shes rab skyed pa'i sems byung ste/ 〈〈kun bdus 〉〉las / ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ brtag pa'i dngos po la sems rtse gcig pa nyid de shes pa'i rten byed4pa'i las can rna zhes gsungs la/ rang yul la rang stobs kyis rtse gcig par byed pa'i sems byung zhes kyang bya'o/ /()rdzu 'phrul/ khyad gzhi sems kyi'aphen pa'i lus chos ni rdzu ba dang / khyad chos lus kyi spyod pa sems chos rna 'phrul ba'o// (3spangs rtogs/dri ma bral zhing yon tan khong du chud pa ste/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang ba dang / ji lta ji snyed kyi mkhyen pa ma ngon ruparnyes pa rna bde bar gshegs pa'i spangs togs kyi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /zhu)rdo rje'i tshig gsang ji 44 kyi zab 'ung bdeng ba'i tshig go/ /khyarnala'abyor dbang phyug yang dag pa'i lam la dbang du gyur lte yon tan phun tshogs thob pa'o//116
sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/chos je sa skya paṇa chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan rna/ rab byung gsum spru chu stag (spyi lo 1182) lor yab 'khon dpal chen 'od po che dang yum ma gcig gar phu ma nyi khri lcam gnyis kyi sras su gtsang du ṭ+wā 'khrungs/ dgung lo chung dus su mtshan la dpal ldan don grub zhu zhing / rjes su khu bo rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi drung du dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes te mtshan kun dga' rgyal mtshan du gsol/ de nas khu bo'i drung du sa skya gong ma'i gsung bcud mdo sngags kyi zab gnad ma lus pa gsan zhing / gzhan yang zhu don lda rje skyabs las byams chos sogs lung gi skor/ rma bya rgyang brtson dang tshur ston gzhon seng la sa tshad ma/ spyi b+thā lhas pa byang chub 'od las gdams pa sna tshogs gsan te sde snod thams cad la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa brnyes shing mkhas pa'i snyan grags sa steng du khyab/ rgya gar lho phyogs kyi smyu stegs 'phrog byed dga' bo sogs bod du yong nas nang bstan la tshur rgol byed pa la rigs pas tshar bcad de bstan pa la bcug ces grags/ dgung 6)ra gsum pa shing byi (spyi lo 1204) lor kha che paṇa chen shākya shri dang mjal/ paṇa chen dang de'i slob ma salha shrī/ su gha ta shrī la sogs la sa sgra tshad sogs rig sanas/ che ba lnga dang / snyan ngag mngon brjod sob/sa rig gnas chung ba lnga lta rig gnas bcu la sbyangs pa mthar 117
can mdzad de pa3 ta'i mtshan snyan thob/ dgung lo nyer bdun ba rab byung bzhi ba'i sa 'brug lor kha che paṇa chen drung du bsnyen par rdzogs/dgung lo so lnga ba me byi (spyi lo 1216) lor sa skya'i gdan khri mdzad/dgung lo re gsum spru shing 'brug (1244) lor hor rgyal po 1 dan gyis gdan drangs pa bzhin khong rang dang sku tsha 'gro mdzon 'phags ba/ phyag na rdo rje mched gnyis dang bcas lcang chu sde bzhir (deng sang dzin su'u zhing chen khu we rdzo gi mnga' 'og yin)phebs nas rgyal po dang mjal/ yon mchod kyi 'brel ba chags/ bod du dpon rigs bsko gags dang / khral 'ul bskul tshul sogs la zhal 'chams te/ dbus gtsang mnga' ris dang bcas pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyin yon mchod rnams la 'phrin yig btang ste bod kyi sa phyogs hor rgyal po'i mnga' khongs su bcug pas mes rgyal gcig gyur yong ba la mi nyams pa'i mdzad rjes bzhag dgung lo bdun cu ba rab byung bzhi ba'i lcags phag(spyi lo 1251) lor lcang cu sprul pa'i lder sku gshegs/rje 'de'i gsung chos rna pod gsum tsam bzhugs shing / /khyad par du〈〈mkhas pa la 'jug pa'i sgo〉〉dang / 〈〈rol mo'i bstan bcos〉〈〈legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter〉〉〈〈tshig gi gter〉〉〈〈tshad ma rigs pa'i gter〉〉sogs bod kyi rig gnas dang tshad ma rig pa la shugs rkyen cher ▶▶ldan pa'i legs bshad gang mang yod/118
rje btsun ri na po che grags pa rgyal mtshan03 bstod pa/bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshabasha lo/ /srid pa'i 'khri shing dra ba dral mdzad de/ /yon tan rgya mtsho zhi lamadumachog sgrogs pa/ /rkang gnyis dbang po②nya bar brnyes pa yi/ /go 'phang dam pa thob par mdzad pa rgyal/ /blo gros dpag yas tshig gi gter mnga' ba//'gro ba'i bla na 'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ /chos lja dpal ldan chos kyi rgya mtsho yi / /rnam thar me tog gus pas brgyu bar bya/ /khyod ni sbya ngas pa'i shes bya la/ /rnam par mabs pa lta ci smos/ /yang dag tshig 'bru don bcas gzhan/ /'thad bcas mkhyen pa ngo mtshar che/ /gang zhig phun tshogs mi zad mnga'/ /de la'ang 'jig rten spyod mi 'jug /de gcig kho nar ma zad de/ /spros bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod kyi tshig don 'di la rgyu/ /tha dad yod ces gang gsungs pa/ /de la mkhas pa bye bas kyang / /chos dang mthun par brgal mi nus/ /mnal tshe chos rnams zegs bam gyi/ /tshul gyis khong du chud gyur pa/ /de yi mod la chos kun gyi/ /de nyid gzigs pa khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes sems dpa'i ⑧ca/tshan brjod la/ /yang srid rnam pa sradun①dag tu//legs par sbyangs pas skye ba 'dir/ /rang byung nyid du mngon rtogs gyur//de la tog ge bdagu 'dra yi/ /blo yang the tshom mi 'jug ste/ /gtan119
tshigs bzang po dang lda ga ri/ /da bas khyog la bstod phyag 'tshal/ /gang phyir rtong/ ke la sbyangs /ri nga / /sgra la rnam pa ra mkhas pas kyang / /khyod kyi gsung 'a phyon 'di zhes/ /chos bzhin brgal du ma mchis pa/ /de nyid phyir ca snarnga ṭī shugs// /rnam par dag par kho bos 'tshal/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis rnam kun tu/ /bsngags pa khyod la phyag 'tshangan lo//gting dpag dka' ba'i chos la yang / /khyod kyis 'di las mi 'da' zhes/ /nges par gsung ba de las gzhan/ /mdo sde rnams las de bzhin 'byung / /de 'dra kho na les/sa gsungs pas/ /khyod gsung thub pa lo na 'dra/ /bskal pa'i don yang legs gzigs pas/ /dpang gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yi ges 'dul la yi ge dang / /jis pa rnams la rtsis dang ni/ /'tsho byed rnams la 'tsho byed gzhung / /chos 'dod rnams la chos kyang ston/ /gang gis phan dgongs thugs rje yis/ /nye bar phan la de ston pa/ /ston mchog khyod 'dra ma mthong ste/ /kun mkhyen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod kyi legs bshad ser ge'i sgrahū/ /lha dang grub pa'i rig 'dzin gtso/ /lto 'phye'i dbang pos nyer bsten cing / /rgyal ba yis kyang mthun par bsngags/ /de slad khyod kyi rnam thar la/ /dad pas 'jug pa smos ci 'tshal/ /khums pa de dag dgi dpyad na/ /kun nas don ldan khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sdom brtson༄khyod rna thos pa dang / /don yod mthong na nyams su 'phel/ /bsten na dge legs rin chen gter/ /stsol mdzad gcig pur gyur pa lags/ /yon tan med la sgro btags nas/ /skye bo ngan rnams yon tan sgrogs//120

bstan pa dang / sgos dkon mchog gsum la lhan tu gus/ khrims lugs bzang bos 'khor thams cad legs par skyong zhing / khyad par du yang jed la gzhan las lhag pa'i thugs la 'dogs par byung / khor gi zhal nas khyod rang blo bde bar chos shod/ khyod la gang dgos ngas ster ba yin/ khyod bzang po gtong ba ngas shes/ ngas bzang por me gtong gnam shes gsuras/ khyad par 'phags pa kun la thugs 'dogs che bar 'dug rang shes khrims lugs 'khur shes na/ rgyal khams thams cad la phan par bya snyam pa'i thugs dgongs bzang po cig 'dug sgos khyod rang gi mi sde bod rnams la khrims lugs legs par slobs/ skyed du 'jug pa ngas shes gsungs pa dang / rgyal po dang rgyal brgyud rnams tshe ring ba'i smon lam rim gro ba thams cad kyis 'bad pa zhu/skabs don hor 'di'i dmag sde grangs las 'das/ 'dzam bu'i gling thams cad khong gi mnga' ris su 'dug snyam pa'i bsam pa cig 'dug—[spre rang dang mthun pa tsho 6da sdug kho rang dang mnyam par byed/ khong la zhe thag pas gang zer la ma nyan na ngo bltas pa yin zer ba'i ming gis mi chog la/ ting brlag (rlog) par byed pa cig 'dug yu gur gyi rgyal khams 'di yang ma brlag(brlags) par gong du phan/ mi nor rnams khong gis blangs nas/ yig mkhan/ rnar gnyer ba/ bu dganya thams cad khong gis byed/ rgya/ mi nyag sog po la sogs pa ma brlag(brlags) gong du hor 'dra btab yang ci zer ma nyan pas/ brlag (brlags) pa'i ting la 'gro sa ma rnyed nasango blta dgos byung / 'on kyang de ting ci zer nyan 131

'gro mgon 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/'gro mdon 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan ni/ rab byung bzhi ba'i shing lug (spyi lo 1235) lor yab zangs tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang yum ma gcig kun dga' skyed gnyis kyi sras su sa skyar 'khrungs/ dgung lo chung dus nas yi ge 'bri klog sogs rig pa'i gnas lnga la dka' tshegs chen po ma dgos par mkhyen/ dgung lo bcu ba shing 'brug (spyi lo1244)lor khu bo sa skya pa3 ta hor rgyal po rga dan gyis gdan drangs pa ltar lcang cu sde bzhir phebs skabs zhabs phyir byon/ dgung lo bcu bdun pa lcags phag(spyi lo 1251) lor sa paṇa sku gshegs khar rang nyid kyi chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i bdag por bskos/ dgung lo bcu dgu ba chu glang (spyi lo 1253) lor hu tra li(go pe la) se chen han gyis gdan drangs te hor gyi bla mchod mdzad/ lo der sa paṇa gyi sku gdung ngo mtshar can byon pas rgyal po hu tra li sogs dad nas 'phags pa la dbang zhus pas/ thog mar rgyal po gtsos byas mi nya shu rtsa lnga la gsang sngags kyi dbang gnang /dbang yon du bod khri skor bcu gsum dang / ti shrī'i go gnas/ g.yang ṭi las byas pa'i tham gu bcas phul/ dbang thengs gnyas pa gnang ba'i 145
dbang yon du bod tshal kha gsum gyi srid dbang yongs rdzogs phul nas bod sa gnas kyi chos srid gnyis kha'i dbang gi bdag por bskos/ rab byung bzhi ba'i chu byi(spyi lo 1252)lor bod du phebs/ gong mas 'phags pa la bod kyi chos srid gnyis ba'i bdag por bskos pa'i 'ja' sa mu tig ma phul/ de'i phyi lor sa skyar rgyan/ bod du lo ngo gsum bzhugs ring la kha che'i pa: ta shrī ta thā ga da snya dra dang / glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen/snar thang mkhan chen mchims nam mkha' grags sogs mkhan chen nyi shu lhag tsam bsten nas mdo sngags kyi chos mang po gsan/ de nas gong ma'i bka' ltar slar rgya nag tu phebs/ dgung lo nyer gcig pa shing yos (spyi lo 1255) lor snye thang mkhan chen grags pa seng ge'i drung du dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes/ rab byung lnga ba'i sa sprul(spyi lo 1269)lor hor yig gsar pa gtan phab kyis phul te rjes su tham ga'i thog bad spyod byed srol yod/ dgung lo so drug pa lcags rta (spyi lo 1270)lor slar yang rgyal po la gsang sngags kyi dbang gnang ba'i yon du shel dam gling drug ma dang / gnam gyi 'og sa yi steng na rgya gar lha'i sras po/ sprul pa'i sangs rgyas/ yi ge rtsom mi/ rgyal khams 'jags su 'jug pa po/ gnas lnga rig nga'i pa: ta 'phags pa ti shrī zhes pa'i 'ja' sa dang do gnas phul/me byi(spyi lo 1276) lor slar bod du phebs nas sa skya'i chos rgyal mdzad cing / gtsang chu mig ring mor dge 'dun khri phrag bdun la bsnyen bkur te chu mig chos 'khor mdzad/ dgung lo zhe drug pa rab byung lnga ba'i lcags 'brug(spyi lo 1280)lor lha khang bla brang du sku gshegs/146
bstod dbyangs rgya mtsho snyan dngags rin po che'i rgyan rnam par bkra ba/na mo gu ru mañdza snyo ṣā ya0/ bstod dbyangs rgya mtsho snyan dngagsrim ོ/ che'i rkyan rnam par bkra ba zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sem4 rga dpa' thacho 5 sa cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ gang gi rang bzhin nam mkha'i dbyings ltar —— rid nas rnam dag srid dang zhi ba'i 0dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin nyi da gyur nyer zhi yang / /gzhan don dga' ba'i thugs rje'i rgyal mtshan rnam par 'tsher r+ṇi/nga sna tshogs thabs brtson shes bya kun sbyangs smon 'a ca rgya ca/tsho la sa 'khrungs pas/ /thun mong pa dang phul du byung ba'i yon tan dpar gyis rnam par brgyan pa'i sku gsung thugs ldan gsar ba mtha' yas/ mi zadapa/ /4ca gyis grub pa'i phrin las bzang pos sna tsho gas gdul ba'i 'dod dgu'i dpal 'phyo ra yo ngas su rdzob/sa mdzad bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsod nams rgya ma tshos rnam bskrun zhing / /ye shes tshogs ()kyis che ba'i sku / /ba645 pa khyon kyis sri da ga yi/ /nyes ba ca — nas ga'o/ma pa'i slad/ /'jig rten spyod las rnam grol bas/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i yon tan gyi/ /cha yang nyams pa mi mnga' na/ /'chi 'pho lha 5/nga ga spri myo/chis / /de lta mod kyi gdul bya yi/ /ri la 'char dang nub par snang / /'on kyang mdzad pa'i phrin las la/ /'phel 'grib yang ye()ma mchis shing / /dngos grub dag ñtsaṇ+ḍapa mos pa yi/ /yid kyi rjes 147
su 'brang ba'i slad/ /bcom ldan bzhugs dang gshes/sa pa dang / ༈khyod kyi sku dang sku gzugs 'a di/ /tha dad lta bur snang na yang / /rang gi rang bzhin dag pa dang / /mdzad pa dag gis rnam kun tu/ /gnyis su med par bdag gis 'tshal/ /srim la sred pa'i srad bu'i 'ching zalsla da/ /thogs med slad du 'dir yang thogs med lags/ /'gro ba kun la thugs rje goms pa'i phyir/ /'dir yang thugs rjes rjes 'dzin gdon mi za/ /de slad bsod nams ñtsha ba phrag brgya yis /nye bar bsgrubs pa'i sku ltar sku gzugs 'de/ /kun nas mos sla da mkhyen brtse nus pa yis/ /rnam par gzigs shing nye bar dgongs nas kyang / /mos pa ji bzhin byin gyis rlob mdzad la/ /re ba'i 'bras bu yongs su rdzogs bgyi'i oṃ da/ /thun mong pa dang phul du byung ba yi/ /dngos grub rin chen char yang dbab tu gsol/ /de ltar dngos grub don du dngos grub 'byung gnas skyob pa khyod la bdag /dngos po kun gyis 64 tu 'dud cing mchod pa'i sprin gyi rgya mtsho yis/ /nye bar mchod phyir mchod 'os khyod kyi tshul yang tshul bzhin nges bgyi'i slad/ /legs par gsungs pa'i gsung gi mdzod las ji ltar rtogs bzhin gleng bar 'tshal/ /yon tan pha rol phyin pa bzhiX/ /brnyes pa khyod kyis dam pa'i don/ /'gro 'ong med par thugs chud slad/ /mi g.yo bar yang bzhugs pa lags/ /de lta mod kyi cho 'phrul gsuma.agyis rnam par 'phrul khyod 9 ba phrag brgya'i ṭ+ṭa/nga / /gzhan du gzhan la mos pa ji bzhin kun tu sprul pa'i sku yi rnam 'phrul gang / /skad cig gcig la'ang bgrang ba las (46
'gas nye bar ston rna dzad yid lta ra mgyogs pa ste/ /mdzad pa de dag rma/da du byung ba'i 'bras bu mchog gis brgyan par smos 'u 'tshal/ /bsam gyis mi khyab dam pa'i don/ /gzigs pa khyod kyis chos kyi dbyings/ /brjod du med par thugs chud slad/ /mi gsung bar yang bzhugs pa lags///de lta mod kyi mi 'jigs bzhi0yis bsnyengs pa ②dang bral zhing / /so so yang dag rig pa bzhingal kun nas dbar 'byor khyod/ /bye ba phrag brgya'i chos kyi sgo yis sna tshogs rab bkra'i dngos/ /t+yā bar mtshon phyir gzhan don chos kyi char chen 'bebs mdzad lags/ /dag pa gnyisayikyis 5 ma daca/ pas/ /dbyings dang kun tu ro gcig phyir/ /spros pa'i cari tshan ca5 zlochi ba zhi'i slad/ /mi rtog par yang bzhugs pa lags/ /de lta mo — kyi mason po khyod kyis bskal pa rgya mtshoragashes bya kun la kun nas le gas sbya ras shing / /sdug bsnga la rgya mtshor rnam par bying ba'i sems can rgya ma tsho grangs mtha' yas la rab tu brtse ba yi/ /thugs re chen pos rnam par brlan pa'i yang dag thabs la rab tu brtson mdzad smon lam ñtsa mtsho'i tshogs/ /legs par grub pas shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ji snyed mkhyen phyir mkhyen pa'ang shes bya ji bzhin bkra ba lags/ /de lta ra gang la phyag bya ba'i/ /yul de phyag 'os thams cad kyi/ /rang bzhin lags par legs 'tshal nas/ /slar yang de la phyag bgyi'o/ /kha dog med cing dbyibs dang bral/ /gong bu med cing rdul yang med/ /bstan du med cing bltar med pa/ /gzugs bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshanayidang ldan/ /dpe byad brgyad cusayinam par smras/ /'od (49
—zer hrer ngas lam me ba/ /bltar 'os khyod la phyag 'chal lo/ /yi gi med cing ming dang bral/ /tshig gi tshogs ni rnam par spangs / /the med mnyan du mel pa can/ /brjod bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'chag pa med cing sgo kun nas/ /yan lag drug cus brgyan pa yi/ /dbyangs kyis chos rnams legs sgrogs pa/ /mnyan 'os khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam shes med cing yid dang bral/ /rnam par rtog pa kun spangs shing //mtshan ma thams cad rab zhi ba/ /dmigs med (4khyod lu phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji 1 ba dang ji snyed mkhyen/ /ting je 'dzin dang gzungs kyi gter/ /'gro ba'i yid la mnyam 'jug pa/ /bsam bya khyo da la phya ka 'tshal lo/ /gang gi rang bzhin gdod ma nas/ /'dus ma byas pa 'i mgan nyid phyir/ /gzhi med slad du khyad par dang / /bral ba khyo di la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba'i chos rnams bgrang yas pa/ /lam gyi bden pas〈yirab bsgyur phyir/ /po na tan rgya mtshos khyad par du/ /'phags pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzung ba dang ni 'dzi4 pari lnga ri cos //gang lags gang gis rnam kun tu/ /spa nga ba'i slad du bya byed las/ /grol ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshos 45 dang yongs su bsgyur ba dang / /thabs dang rnam par gtong ba yis/ /yul dus rnam par mdzad pa yang //rgya rngu'isko khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mnyam dang mi mnyam srid zhi yi/ /'du byed gang lags bcom(gzhom)pa'i slad/ /mtha' rnams kun la mi sa/nas pa/ /rnam grol khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dzin dang grol ba'i ye sheye kyis/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa la/ /mnyam pa nyid du 150
legs pa yi/ /srid zhi'i dbang myug phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun 'byung spros pa'i mtshan ma yis/ /rnam pa kun tu ma spros shing / /spros pa nye bar gcod mdzad pa/ /spros bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thabs mkhas thugs rje'i spros pa yis/ /rnam pa kun tu rab spros shing / /mdzad pa'i phrin las spro mdzad pa/ /spros bcas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpe rnams bye ba phrag brgya yis/ /dpe tsam nyid du'ang mi bzod cing / /dpe zla kun dang rnam bral ba/ /dpe med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpe dang gtan tshigs thams cad dang / /yi gi ming dang tshig gi tshogs/ /brda rnams kun gyis rnam kun tu/ /mtshon bya khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de slad bla ma'i bla ma ste/ /chen po'i chen por gyur pa lags/ /mchod 'os rnams kyis mchod 'os pa/ /phyag 'os khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar phyag 'os thub pa khyod la phyag bgyis nas/ /slar yang bsod nams zhing gi mchog la bsod nams kyi/ /lo tog dam pa kun nas spel slad kun bzang gi/ /rnam 'phrul ji bzhin mchod pa'i sprin gyis mchod par bgyi/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyis sgyu ma'i rdzas ltar mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i rnam 'phrul spro phyir mchod pa'i rdzas/ /snam sbyar chos gos snam phran glegs bukhikun nas sbyar legs pad+ma dmar po ltar dmar ba/ /gser gyi ri mo gser gyi 'od 'byin bkram pas cher bkra lcags ri'i khor yug pu tig gi/ /phreng ba zung gis phreng du dngar zhing zung du sbyar 'di ting 'dzin sgyu 'phrul gyis sprul pas/ /mchod pa'i rnam 'phrul zhing khams rgya mtsho rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin phung gis/ /rnam par brgyan pa'i rgyan gyi 151
'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba'i 'od kyi rtse mor rgya mtsho yi/ /rdul gyi grangs snyed rin chen pad+mo rin chen 'od 'byin kun nas rgyas pa'i snying po la/ /lha dang mi yi 'dod yon rmad ni 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byung bye ba phrag brgya legs gnas pa/ /kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul ji bzhin kun nas dge ba'i sems kyis sprul pa'i mchod khrin 'di/ /chos dbyings ji bzhin nam mkha'i dbyings kun kun nas khyab cing sems can dbyings mtha' ji srid par/ /rnam par gnas nas chos kyi rgyal po rgyal ba rgyal sras rang rgyal dgra las rnam rgyal bas/ /kun nas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor kun tu rnam par mchod pas mchod pa kun gyis mnyes gyur cig /mchod rdzas dri med lha yi gos/ /yid dbang mdzes pa gang gi sku/ /mtshan gyi dpal gyis 'bar ba gang / /kun nas g.yogs pas mdzes byas pa//rin chen gser gyi snan po'i rgyal/ /tsha zer bye bas bzhu ba'i sprin/ /pad+ma rā ga'i mdog snang bas/ /yongs su bskor ba lta bu lags/ /yang na bcom ldan khyod sku dri med nyin mor byed pa'i dkyil 'khor lta bur kun nas rab tu gsal ba gang / /chos gos 'od zer snam phran glegs bu'i phreng ba spel legs nya bar 'khrigs pa blta na sdug pas yongs bskor pas/ /mdzes pa gzhan kun skar ma'i tshogs ltar zil rgyas mnan nas gdul bya rab dga'i me tog pad+mo'i tshal rab rgyas byed cing / /snyan dngags mkhan gyi sbrang ji 'dzin pas snyan dngags ngag gi bstod dbyangs dar dir kun tu sgrogs par bgyid pa lags/ /yang na khyod sku can po bzhin/ /chos spos nam mkha' lta bur mchis/ /de la gser gyi ri mo ni/ /bkram pa 152
gza' skar tshogs ltar bkra/ /yang na rgyal ba'i gzhal med khang mdzes shin tu dwangs pa'i yid bzhin mtshor/ /na bza' chos gos chu skyes dmar po'i 'dab rgyas lta bur snang ba'i dkyil/ /bcom ldan khyod sku yongs su rdzogs pa'i snying po ltar yang mdzes pa ste/ /mtshan gyi dpal dang dpe byad bzang po'i ze'u 'bru'i phreng bas spras pa lags/ /de slad de yi snyan pa'i dri bsung phyogs bcur khyab pas nyer bsdus pa'i/ /dad ldan bung ba'i sprin phung lta bur nye bar 'khrigs pas khyod kyi sku/ /dpal gyis 'bar ba mngon sum snang bas yid rab 'phrog pas bsngags pa yi/ /dar dir sgra dbyangs sgrogs par bgyid rnams dngos grub sbrang rtsis tshim mdzad lags/ /yang na thub pa khyod kyi khams/ /chos rnams kun gyi dbyings nyid lags/ /de la kun rdzob cher bkra'i chos/ /nye bar bstan pa nyer mtshon slad/ /khyod sku ldan po ltar brtan pa'i/ /rten la zhing khams rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /rnam par bkra ba'i chos gos ni/ /brten pa ltar yang gyur pa lags/ /yang na gang tshe thub pa'i rnam 'phrul mig 'phrul mkhan gyi sgyu 'phrul lta bur sprul mdzad pa/ /de tshe zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed 'grib pa med par khyod kyi sku yi dkyil 'khor la/ /kun tu snang ba'i snang ba dam pa skye dgu kun la kun nas skyed mdzad ji bzhin du/ /'di yi sku gzugs brtan par bzhugs la chos gos zhing khams rgya mtsho bkram pa'ang snang ba lams/ /de 'dra snang bas gang gi yid/ /kun nas 'phyog par brgyad pa ni/ /'dod ldan dag gi lha mo'i lus/ /yid 'or mthong ba lta bur mchis/ /kun nas nyon mongs dra bral slad/ /153
shin tu mtshungs pa'ang ma lags so/ /nga dang nga yir 'dzin pa⑥yis1kun tu rtag pa kun bral yang / /'gro ba'i yid ni yongs bsgyur pas/ /sgyu ma'i sprul pa lta bur mchis/ /dge ba'i sa bon brtas bgyid slad/ /shin tu mtshungs pa'ang ma lags so/ /de yis dad pa'i chu gter ni/ /rnam pa ra rgyas par bgyid pas na/ /char chen rab tu 'bebs bgyid pa'i/ /rnam par sgrogs pa'i sprin 'drar mchis/ /'bras bu 'byin pas mi zad slad/ /shin tu mtshungs pa'ang ma lasas sospyo /'gro ba rnams kyi bsod nams kyi/ /lo tog yongs su 'phel ba yi/ /rten gyi dam par gyur pas na/ /sa chen dang yang 'dra bar mchis/ /kun gyi bla na lham pa'i slad/ /shin tu mtshungs pa'ang ma lags so/ /dad can rnams kyis smon bgyid pa'i/ /'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor gang lags pa/ /de kun yongs su dzogs bgyid pas/ /lha yi dpag bsam shing 'drar mchis/ /ya nga srid rnam par sun 'byin slad/ /shin tu mtshungs pa'ang ma la4/sa so/ /gsol ba btab na sgra med kyang / /dad ldan rnams kyi yid la chos/ /shin tu nges par bgyid pa ni/ /rang rgyal rnams kyi 'phrul 'drar mchis/ /phrin la sa rtsol ba mi mnga'i slad/ /shin tu mtshungs pa'ang ma lags so/ /skye dgu'i blo gros pad+mo ni/ /kun nas kha 'byed bgyid pas na/ /chu skyes rnam par rgyas byed pa'i/ /tsha zer byed pa lta bur ca/chis/ /gdung ba dag kyang sel bgyid slad/ /shin tu mtshungs pa'ang ma lasas so/ /'gro ba'i log par sred pa yi/ /yid kyi dri ma 'phros bgyid pas/ /mig gi rab rib rnam sel ba'i bsil zer 154
