ni/ /yab dang yum dang ma ma dang / /phan par bgyis pas bskrun pa lags/ /de slad dge la dgyes pa dang / /yab dang yum dang gnyan bshes kyi/ /byas pa drin du gzo ba dang / /drin la lan gyis blan par0mdzod/ /mi gang brtul zhugs legs 'dzin dang / /rigs dang yon tan ldan pa ni/ /'dus pa 'am rna re re la'ang / /khyod kyis gus dang bkur bar bgyi/ /mdon med pa dang nad pa dang / /glo bu lhags dang zhan po dang / /dran pa nyams par gyur la sogs/ /nyam thag brtse bas skyong bar mdzod/ /shes ldan nor gyis phongs pa dang / /ya rabs r+sād par gyur pa dang / /log par nyung ba dag la yang / /brnyas par mi bgyi phan par bgyi/ /byad0dang dug stor②bgyid pa dang / /g.yo dang sa②yis spyod pa dag /tshul de dag las bzlog pa'am/ /yang na ring du skyod par mdzod/ /mi gang rig pas 'byor ba dang / /gzhan la phan pa kyur len dang / /drang bo'i tshul la legs brten spru/ /ring na gnas kyang dgug par bgyi/ /sngon gyi rgyal pos bcas pa'i khrims//gna' lugs rnying ba lags mod kyang / /'gro la gnod 'gyur spang bgyi ste/ /phan 'gyur kun tu spel bar mdzod/ /khrims su bca' ba gang lags pa/ /ha cang zhib na skye bo rnams/ /shin tu gdung bar 'gyur ba dang / /bca' ba'ang myur du 'jig 'gyur lags/ /bcas pa snga ma snga ma rnams/ /phyim phyi mas sun phyung na/ /'bangs kyis ci bgyi mi 'tshal bas/ /bca' ba brtan po nyid du mdzod/ /nyung ngu'i don la mang po dang / /chung ngu'i don la chen po la/ /'phral gyi ched du gtan gyi don//174
yongs su nyams par mi bgyi'o/ /'di bgyi 'di las 'di 'dra'i don/ /'grub tshe snyan par gang smra ba/ /rang don bsgrub pa shas che bas/ /dpyod pa zhib mos dpyad par bgyi/ /rtag res 'khor dang sho gom0sogs//ha cang bsdu ba mang gyur na/ /bzho ba mang ba'i ba bzhin du/ /skam par 'gyur ba'i dogs pa mdzod/ /bung ba yis ni sbrang rtsi ltar/ /cung zad dus su sdud pa dang / /bsdus nas chud thos mi bgyid pa/ /'di ni legs par rnyed pa lags/ /gdug pa'i sprul gyis mi la ltar/ /mi brtse thabs la mi mkhas pas/ /dpyod pa gzhan la nyar gnod pa'i//srid pa shin tu smad pa lags/ /khyod kyi sras la ji bzhin du/ /'bangs la phan pa nyar dgongs na/ /bu yis pha la ji bzhin du/ /gus pas rjed par 'gyur ba dgongs/ /byin pas dge ba rjes 'brang bas/ /'jig rten gzhan du ba ba ste/ /spyad pa bde dang rjes 'brel bas/ /'dir ni dga' ba bskyed ba lags/ /de slad bsod nams zhing dang ni//dman pa'i zhing la dus kun tu/ /dgos pa dag dang rjes mthun par//sa pon kyug par gdab tu gsol/ /dus dang gnas skabs mkhyen bgyis nas/ /'tshe ba med pa'i dpal 'phel ba'i/ /longs spyod dag la bdag dang gzhan/ /dgyes dgur spyod pa lha yi tshul/ /longs spyod (/ (( // pa/ dī ra// //zi // /spya /lha /pa rdzuni rtswa /mdzod/lo/ga/pa/ gi bkur lti lhag bgyid dang / /chog mi shes par longs spyod dang / /gzhan gyi dpal la zhe sdung ba/ /bsod namasaparngadzad pa'i rgyu gsum lags//175
gnyid kyi bde ba'i ro myang dang / /sgyid lug pa la brten pa dang / /bre mo'i gtam la dga' ba ste/ /bya ba nyams pa'i rgyu gsum lags/ /'khrig la kun tu sred pa/ dang / /chang gi ro la chags pa dang / /spyod lam bag med bgyid pa ste/ /nad skyed pa yi rgyu gsun lags/ /no ngas med sems can 'gum bgyid dang / /mi ma yin la tho 'tsham dang / /dus kyi cho ga'i rgyun gcod pa/ /tshe 'dzad bgyid pa'i rgyu gsum lags/ /mchod 'os bkur bar mi bgyid dang / /mnyam pa dag la 'gran pa dang //dman pa dag la brnyas pa ste/ /tshul nyams bsgyud pa'i rgyu gsum lags//de dag rnams ni de lta bu'i/ /ngang tshul legs par mkhyen bgyis nas//nyid kyang de las ldog pa dang / /tra/zhan dag kyang ni bzlog tu gsol/ /de yis nyid dpal 'phel ba dang / /don grub bde bar gnas pa dang //tshe 'phel ba dang tshul bzhin du/ /spyad pas bdag gzhan bde bar 'gyur//legs par bgyis la bya dga' dang / /nongs par spyod la chad pa yis//srid 'bangs 'chos par bgyid pa rna/ /sa skyong rnams kyi lugs lags mod/ /de tshul legs par brtag bgyi ste/ /bya das /'a 'tsham pa 'tsham pa yis/ /de nyid la ni sman pa dang / /gzhan yid mi bzod med par mdzod/ /chad pa'ang nad phyir gtar dpyad ltar/ /nad med bgyid pa rigs lags kyi/ /nad med bgyid slad gsod pa ltar/ /srog dang bral bgyid de ltar min/ /ngang tshul ngan pa'i skye ko yis/ /re zhig legs pa bgyis lags kyang / /ha cang gzengs bstong mi bgyi ste/ /de dang gzhan la'ang gnod pa'i rgyu/ /rang bzhen bzang po byen dbang 4/ṭa //176
re zhig 'khrul bar spyad bgyis kyang / /shin tu ngan sman mi bgyi ste/ /de yi ngang tshul de 'dra'i phyir/ /skyes bu'i 'bad pas ma bsgrubs pa/ /rtswa dang chu la sogs pa yi/ /'tsho ba phal bas 'tsho bgyid cing / /'tshe ba med par gnas bgyid ba/ /bya dang ri dwags la sogs la/ /zas kyi ched du de bzhin du/ /rtsed 'jo'i don du 'tshe bgyid pa/ /gna' yi lugs su gda' mod kyang / /rigs pa dang ni mi rigs pa/ /rnam par dpyod pa'i yid gsal ba/ /khyed kyis rigs pa'i tshul brten nas//yang dag ci bzhin dpyad par bgyi/ /'bru dang 'bras bu sna tshogs dang //'o ma zho dang lan tshwa sogs/ /bza' dang btung ba sna tshogs kyis/ /bdag nyid bde bar 'tsho bzhin du/ /bdag gi bde ba khyad bsad nas//mang po'i dka' spyad sna tshogs kyis/ /rang gi sdig dang sdug bsngal dang //gzhan gnod sgrub pa ga la rigs/ /de dag rnams la'ang srog phangs shing //lus la 'tshe ba sdug bsngal ba/ /de yi dpe ni bdag nyid de/ /bdag la ji ltar gda' ba dgongs/ /mtshon chas lag brel 'jigs 'jigs 'dras/ /bskor bas 'bros pa'i gnas med cing / /brtas pas gom pa 'khyor 'khyor po/ /'jigs pas rig rig lta ba yi/ /gnas skabs 'de la mi brtse na/ /khyod la snying rje med pa'am/ /gal te yod na gang zhig la/ /'jug par 'gyur ba gsung du gsol/ /'on kyang lugs su gyur pa'i slad/ /kun nas dgag par mi spyod na/ /cha shas kyis ni spang bar bgyi/ /de tsam khyod kyis cis mi spyod/ /'jig rten dag dang bstan bcos las/ /smad dang 'tshe ba spang bgyi zhing / /bsngags dang phan 177
pa gang lags pa/ /dang du bzhes shing spel du gsol/ /mdor na nyid dpal 'phel ba dang / /gzhan gyi dpal la mi gnod dang / /dpal yang dpal gyi rgyur 'gyur bya/ /de 'dra kho nar mdzad du gsol/ /srid 'bangs bde bar bgyid pa dang / /bde ba rgyud mar brgyud pa dang / /rang gi gdung rgyud rgyun brtan pa/ /lugs kyi 'bras bu de tsam lags/ /dpal mgrin rang byung 'jug srid dang / /lha yi bla ma yid brubs rtsen/ /lha min bla ma 'bod sgrogs sogs/ /che ba'i che bar grags rnams dang / /ser skya0gzegs zan()rkang mig〈yidang / /'ug phug pa(yil sogs pa yi/ /blo gsal rnams kyis sbyar ba dang / /la bgin mi sha ha dang ni/ /ma hā mad la sogs pa yi/ /log rtog rnams kyis sbyar ba'i gzhung / /de kun mtha' gnyisayil 'chel zhing / /dngos dang brgyud pas rang gzhan la/ /gnod par 'gyur ba de slad du/ /srid dang ngan 'gro kho na'i rgyur/ /shes rab gsal ba khyod kyis ni/ /gsal bar mkhyen nas spang du gsol/ /don ngan pa yi tshig legs kyang / /ro zhim pa yi dug bzhin du/ /gnas skabs dga' ba bskyed lags kyang / /ñtsha nas sdug bsngal kho na'i rgyu/ /nang du nye bar ma zhi ba'i/ /kun spyod bzang po ston lags kyang / /yid brtan rung ba ma lags te/ /chu skyar dang ni byi la bzhin/ /srid pa'i rtsa ba mi gcod pa'i/ /gnas skabs zhi bar bgyidang lags kyang / /jes par 'byung ba ma las/sa te/ /tsha ba'i rims la chu grang bzhin/ — /de slad yang srid sun 'byin zhing / /thar ba dalapa thob bgyid pa/ /bde bar gshigs pa kho na'i gsung / /de yang dgi ba'i bshes las btsal/ /tshul 178
khrims phung pos sku dul zhing / /mang du gsan pas gsung yang dag /ting nge 'dzin gyis bugs zhi la/ /brtse bas sems can rjes 'dzin pa'i//bshes gnyan bshes kyi dam pa ste/ /de 'dra gang na su bzhugs kyang / /de la sangs rgyas nyid ji bzhin/ /shin tu gus pas bsten par bgyi/ /de las yan lag brgyad pa yi/ /bsnyen gnas blangs nas bsung bar mdzod/ /de tsam gyis kyang 'dod lha'i dpal/ /thob par 'gyur zhes rgyal bas gsungs/ /gzhan yang ji ltar cas pa yi/ /so sor thar ba'i sdom pa yis/ /khyod kyi brtul zhugs mdzes par mdzod/ /de ni lam rnams kun gyi gzhi/ /theg pa che la ma gtogs par/ /thar ba chen po mi 'thob pas/ /khyod thugs theg pa chen po la/ /kun nas gzhol zhing goms par mdzod/ /dang la skyabs na bslu 'gyur ba'i/ /yul de skyabs gnas ma lags pas/ /lha dang 'byung bo la sogs pa'i/ /chen po'ang 'dir ni mchod bya tsam/ /'phags pa rang rgyal la sogs pa/ /nye bar zhi la rab gzhol ba/ /de dag phyag bgyir 'os pa ste/ /gnas skabs kyi ni skyabs su'ang bgyi/ / slad bag chags bcas pa yi/ /nyes pa yong ye ma mchis shing / /nyamasapa med pa'i yon tan gter/ /thub pa kho na skyabs kyi mchog /skyabs mchog de drangs legs gsungs shing / /de yi go 'phang thob bgyid pa/ /tshul de'ang bgrod par bgyi ba yi/ /skyabs su gyur pa nyid lags la/ /de yi rjes 'jug de nyid kyi/ /ye shes rgya mtshor nyar 'bab pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun yang //slob pa'i gnas skabs kyi ni skyabs/ /de la skyabs pa'ang yang dag par//179
blangs shing brda las byung ba dang / /chos nyid kyis ni thob pa las/ /ji —4 med par phyi ma min/ /de phyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen nas/ /bdag dang sems can ma lus pa/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/༈thob bya'i don du skyabs mchi nas/ /skyes bu mchog la brten pa dang / /de las dam chos mnyan pa dang / /thos pa ji bzhin bsgrub pa ste/ /thun mong bslab bya rnam gsum dang / /sangs rgyas min la ston pa dang //chos ma yin la lam dang rna/ /dge 'dun min la grogs mchog tu/ /yongs su gzung bar mi bgyi ba/ /so so'i bslab pa rnam gsum la/ /kun nas yongs su bslab bgyi zhing / /sdug bsngal tshe na tshul de la sa / /bdag gzhan thar phyir gsol ba dang / /bde ba myong tshe dkon mchog gi/ /bka' drin nyid ces rjes dran bgyi/ /gang tshe sangs rgyas chos sku dang //chos ni don dam zab mo dang / /gang gis dge 'dun byed chos dang / /bdag nyid tha dad med shes pas/ /sangs rgyas cho sa dang dge 'dun las/ /bdud rnams bye ba brgya yis kyang / /gang phyir dbye bar mi nus pa/ /de phyir dge 'dun zhes bshad de/ /de tshe de ni chos nyid kyis//thob pa'i skyabs su 'gro ba lags/ /de lta'i skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ /yon tan ma lus kun gyi gzhi/ /skyabs de yang dag blangs gyur nas/ /byang chubacasems ni bskyed bgyi ste/ /sems de'ang kun rdzob don dam pa/ /rnam pa gnyis kyis bsdus pa lags/ /kun rdzob pa yi byang chub sems/ /smon pa dang ni 'jug pa gnyis0/ /sems can don byed rdzogs pa yi/ /byang chub 'thob 'dod smon pa ste/ /yul gyi mdun du 180
cho ga yis/ /'thob par bya zhes dam 'cha' ba/ /smon pa yi ke sems bskyed lags/ /sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i thabs tshul kun/ /bsgrub par 'dod pa 'jug pa'i sems/ /dam 'cha' 'jug pa'i sems bskyed lags//zhum dang nyid lug 'khor ba yi/ /nyis bas sbrag pa'i yid gsum spang //'gro la byams dang snying rje dang / /srid dang zhi ba'i nyis dmigs dang //sangs rgyas yon tan rjes dran pa/ /bsgom par bgyi ba lnga bo dang / /grogs bzang nya bar bsten pa yis/ /byang chub smon pa bsung bar bgyi//mchod par 'os pa bslu ba dang / /gnas ma yin la 'gyod bskyed dang //sems can mchog la skur 'debs dang / /g.yo dang sgyu yis spyod pa'i tshul/ /nag po'i chos47su gsungs pa bzhi/ /rnam pa kun tu spang bgyi zhing / /bden zhing rigs par smra ba dang / /sgyu med 'gro la phan sems dang / /rgyal sras bkur zhing bsngags pa dang / /theg pa che la yid sbyor ba/ /dkar po'i chos gagasungs bzhi la/ /kun nas yongs su goms par bgyi/ /rnyed dang bkur lta chags ba yis/ /bdag bstod gzhan la smod pa dang / /cag bsngal mgon med rgyur pa la/ /ser snas chos nor mi ltar dang / /gzhan gyis bshags kyang mi nyan par/ /khros nas gzhan la 2ga pa dang / /theg pa chen po sprong byed cing / /dam (pa ji sdir+sha ༷dī lhan ṭ+wāṃ /parnyi/ /rtsa ba/ /sna (zlogadi /spri ngasnang pa/13 pa'i// bshes/ /ci 'apyor ba yis mchod pa dang / /dge ba'i las dang rnal 'apyor la/ /ci dus pa yis brtson pa dang / /rang gi spyod yul gyur 185
pa yi/ /'gro la phan pa nyer sbyor ba/ /thos pa bsags nas thos pa'i don/ /snod dang 'tsham par 'chad pa bzhi/ /bsgrub par bgyi ba'i chos lags pas/ /dus las mi 'da' bsgrub par bgyi/ /sdig la 'gyod cing bshags pa dang / /gzhan gyi dge la yi rang dang / /bsod nams yongs su bsngo ba dang / /chos kun sgyu mar shes pa bzhi/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i chos lags pas/ /tshul de dag la bslab par mdzod/ /'de dag 'jug pa sems bskyed pa'i/ /bslab par gya ba smos pa lags/ /rkyen la ma ltos chos med cing / /ltos phyir ngo bos de ma grub/ /ngo 'o med la skye ba dang / /'gag pa la sogs khyad par ci/ /de ltar kos kun spros bral bar/ /shes nas dmigs pa med pa'i yid/ /mnyam gzhag goms pas gzung 'dzin⑥gyi/ /'ching ba kun las rnam grol bas//dam pa rnams kyi spyod yul pa'i/ /ye shes mngon par byang chub pa/ /'di ni don dam byang chub sems/ /chos nyid kho nas thob pa lags/ /sems de mthar pyin bgyi slad du/ /sbyin dang tshul khri/mas bzod pa dang //brtson 'gus bsam gtan shes rab kyis/ /rang gi yon tan rdzogs bgyi zhing / /zang ring sbyin dang snyan spru dang / /don spyod pa dang don mthun pas/ /gzhan gyi don kun legs bsgrub cing / /zhi gnas lhag mthong ⑰gus bstan pas/ /tshogs kyi lamayidang sbyor lamañtsal/ /bgrod nas mthong ba'i lamagazhugs te/ /rab tu dga'ayidang dri ma medayi/ /'od byed pa②dang 'od 'phro canañtsa/ /sbyang dka' bcadang mngon du gyuraX/ /ring du songayidang mi g.yo bslu/ /legs pa'i blo gros182
chos khrin②gyi/ /sa rnams kun gye rtogs pa dang / /yon tan rim bzhin mngon byas nas/ /bsgom pa'i lam rnams yongs rdzogs te/ /mthar phyin pa yi lam gyis ni/ /sgrib pa bag chags bcas spangs nas/ /dbyings dang ye shes ro gcig pa'i/ /chos kyi skuyilas ma g.yos bzhin//mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar ba'i sku/ /ye shes lnga dang dbyer med la/ /yan lag drug cu'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ /theg pa mchog gi chos ston zhing //sras dang lhan cig zag med kyi/ /bde la rdzogs par longs spyod pa/ /mi 'gyur rgyun mi 'chad bzhin du/ /'gro ba rnams kyi mos pa bzhin/ /kun la sna tshogs kun snang bas/ /kun gyi don mdzad sprul pa dang / /bcas pa'i swo 'phang legs brnyes nas/ /mi bzad rgyan gyi 'khor lo yis/ /'khor ba'i 'khor lo ji srid du/ /srid dang zhi ba'i rgyan du 'gyur/ /sngon gyi skyes mchog dpag med pas/ /tshul lugs de 'dras sangs rgyas brnyes/ /da ltar bzhugs pa'i rgyal sras rnams/ /ring por mi thogs de 'drar 'gyur/ /gang dag 'di la 'jug 'gyur ba/ /de dag ma 'ongs sangs rgyas lags/ /de slad khyod kyang tshul 'de yis/ /srid zhi'i dpal du mdzad du gsol/ /gdung rgyud dam par legs 'khrungs shing / /dpal 'byor mchog gis lham me ba/ /rgyal bu rna mo gan gyis ni/ /ring nas yongs gabaskul gyur nas/ /gtsug lag gnyas kyi tshul gsal bar/ /ston pa'i rab tu byed spru 'di/ /lugs dpalung gi rjes 'brangs nas/ /rigs pa yis kyang dbyad de bshad/ /khyed thugs dad pas bsal nas ni/ /bdaka yid dge bas sbyar 'di la/ /nyan zhing 183
gzhan las gsan pa 'am/ /yang na gzigs par mdzad du gsol / /lung dang shes bya'i dkyil 'khor la/ /shes rab shin tu ma sbyangs pas /'di la nongs pa gang mchis pa/ /dam pa rnams kyis bzod par dgongs //de las dge ba gang bskrun pas/ /bdag dang 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /theg pa mchog gi lam zhugs nas/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par shog /rgyal bu rna mo gan la spring ba'i rab tu byed pa 'di ni/ chos thams cad la bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba'i mkhyen rab can/ chos kyi rje sa skya pa: ta chen po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa/ 'phags pas chu pho spre'u'i loyide bzhin gshegs pas cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa'i zla ba'i tshes bcu gcig la shing kun tu sbyar ba'o// //mchan 'grelaḥ 0) mngon pa ra mtho ba/ gnas skabs kyi bde ba lha dang bcas pa'i bde 'grolaphun tshogs dge legs so/ /()nges par legs pa/gtan du bde ba ste thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang / ⑦blan pa/ brda ting ste/ 'gugs pa dang / phyogs pa/ drangs pa/ bskyar ba/ 'debs ba/ rgyur ba bcas don du ma la 'jug ste/ 'dir lan 'debs pa'i don/ ①byad/ mthu gtad pa sogs gnod par byed ba/ ()dug snyor/ kha zas la dug 'debs pa sogs gzhan la gnad pa ra byed pa/ zlogayo dang sgyu/ rang gi nyas pa bcab pa'i thabs bzung ba'i sems kyirgyu ba rna g.yo dang /gzhan la spru ba'i bsam bas yon tan mi ldan bzhin du ldan tshul sogs ston pa rna = ste/ rang skyon sba zhing gzhan man skor ba'i bsam spyor zhig ()sho rnam/ sho dam ste legs sbyar gyi shuka zur chag184
lam khral dang tshong khral sogs khral rigs spyi/ (3ser skya/ sngar rgya gar phyi rol pa'i drang srong zhig ste grub mtha' grangs can pa'i ston pa yin pa ra grags/ 'dis shes bya thams cad nya shurtsa lngar bgrang par 'dod do/ /zlogazegs zan/ 6 rol pa'i drang srong zhig ste grub mtha' phye brag pa'i ston pa yin pa ra grags/ des gzhan gyis bor ba'i gzegs ma za zhing brtul zhugs la spyod mkhan zhig yin pas ming yang de ltar grags/ 〈yirkang mig 〈sa skya legs bshad〉kyi mchan rtags()par gzigs/ (yi'ug phrug pa/ snga rgya gar 9 spya rol pa'i drang srong zhig ⑨mtha' gnyis/ rtag mtha' dang chad mtha' gnyis / 0 smon pa dang 'jug pa gnyis / byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa la gnyis te/ sngon sems dang 'jug sems gnyis/ sems can don byed rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob 'dod pa rna dran sems dang / sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i thabs tshul kun bsgrub par 'dod pa ni 'jug sems zhes bya'o/ /(khyanag po'i chos/mi dge ba'i tshos la nag po'i chos zer zhing / de la bzhi yod de/ji skad du/ mkhan 5ba bla ma yon gnas kun gyis slu/ /dge 4da 'gyod mi ldan la 'gyod pa skyed/ /sems bskyed ldan la mi snyan brjo da pa dang / /lhag bsam min pas gzhan la g.yo sgyu spyod/ /ces pa bzhi'o/ /artsa ba'i cang ba/ sdom pa nyams par byed pa'i gu ba'i nyung ba ste/ ljon shing gi rtsa ba ltar bsungs na lam dang 'bras bu'i yon tan thams cad bskyed pa'i rtsa ba yin zhing / ga bsungs na ngan 'gro'irgyu dang sdug bsngal gyi rtsa bar gyur pa'i dbang gis phyi ma gnas 'og nas 'og tu nyung bar 'gyur bas rtsa ba'i lhung ba nas bya'o//185
skabasa'adir byang sems kyi rtsa lhung bco brgyad la zer ba yin/ ①gzung 'dzin/ yul dang yul can gnyis la gzur bya dang 'dzin byed gnyis su brjod kyang / 'dir yul dang yul can gnyis su bden par zhen pa'i rnam rtog la 1 dgos so/ /(nyazhi gnas lhag mthong / ñtsha rol gyi yul la sems g.yeng ba zhi bar byas nas bsam gtan gang sgom pa de la sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa la zhi gnasadang / dngos po'irang bzhin lhag pa'i khyad par shes rab kyi mig gis mthong ba la lhag mthong ngo / /(metshogs kyi lam/ lam lnga'iya gyal tshogs lam ste/mya ngan las 'das par bgrod pa'i gzhi gang mug thar ba cha mthun rgya dge bas bsdus pa'i tshogs rgya chen po gsog parabyed cing / bdag med thos bsam gyi sgonasasgra spyi dang don spyi tshul du rtogs pa dang /dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi dang / yang dag spong ba bzhi/ rdzu 'phrul rkang ba bzhi bcas bsgoms pas/ spang gya shin tu rags pa 'khor bar sdug bsngal skyed byed rnams rnam par sun 'byin pa'i tshul gyis spong zhing / spyan dang / mngon shes/ chos rgyun gyi ting nge'adzin gyi yon tan thob par cad pa'i lam mo/ /9)sbyor lam/ lamalnga'i spru gyal te/ rnam par grol ba'i 'jug ngogs gang zhig nges 'byed cha mthun gyi dge rtsa rnams thob ste/ bden pa mngon par rtogs pa la spyor zhing / sgom byung gi shes rab kyis gzung ba rang bzhin med par rtogs pa dang dbang bo gradang stobs lnga bsgoms pas/ spang bya kun btanas rnams rnam bar gnon pa'i tshulagyis spong zhing / ting je 'dzin dang gzungs dang mngon shes sogs kyi yon tan thob par byed pa'i lam mo/ /'jimathong ba'i lam/ lam lnga'i ya gyal mthos186
lam ste/ rnam par grol ba'i 'jugangogs gang zhig de khon )da sngar ma mthong ba gsar du mthong zhing 'phags pa'i sar phyin par cad pa dang / chos nyid ji lta ba bdag med mngon sum rtogs shing choscan ji snyed pa'i don yang ce rigs par rtogs pa dang / byang chub kyi min lag bdun bsgoms pas/ spang bya mthong spong gi nyon songs pa rnams rtsad nasabacom pa'i tshul gyis spong zhing / 'jigs pa lnga dang bral zhing yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis sogs thob par byed pa'i lam mo/ /yirab tu dga' ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa bca'i dang po ste/ sa 'dir gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis sngar ma mthong ba'i tshos nyid kyi don mthob bas rang don byang chub mchog lanya ba dang / gzhan don sems can gyi don rlabs po che 'grub par mthong nas rab tu dgang ba skyes pa'i phyir sa dang po rab tu dka' ba zhes bya'o/ /⑨dri ma med ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu'i nyis pa ste/ sa 'dir tsanas pa'i byang chung sems dpal rnams rna 'chal ba'i tshul khrims dang / theg dam na yid 6da kyirtsol ba'i dri ma dang bral bsas gnyis pa dri ma med pa zhes bya'o/ /44'od sgyud pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu'igasum pa ste/ sa 'dir gnas pa'i byar chub sems dpa' rnams lus srog la mi lta bar rang nyid kyis kyang lung gi chos 'tshol ba la 'bad cing / gdul bya gzhan rnams chos kyi snang bas tshilapar byed pas sa gsum pa 'od byed pa zhes bya'o/ ②'od 'phro ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu'i bzhi ba ste/ sa 'dir gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpal rnams byar chub kyiphyogs mthun pa'i chos bstan pa'i sgo nas rang gi ngos skal 187
ñtsha sgrib gnyis sreg par byed pa'i ye shes kyi 'od me rnya ra 'phro bas sa bzhi ba 'od 'apo ba zhes bya'o/ /②spyar dka' ba/ byar chub semsdpa'i sa bcu'ilnga ba ste/ sa 'dir gnas pa'i byang ⑫ ba sems dpa' rnams kyis sems can smin par byed pa ri tshe gang/6 gyi log nub kyis nyon mi mongs bas sems can gyi zhing dang rang gi ser/sa sbyar dka' ba gnyis po de 'byongs mas sa lnga ba sbyang dka' ba zhes bya'o//sgomemangon du gyur pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu'idrug pa ste/r+sā'adir gnas pa'i byang chub sems dbasarten 'brel 'u gas 'byung ru bsgo6ri sa pas 'khor ba las ldog pa mngon du gyur pa dang / rten 'brel lugs dzog tu bsgoms pas myang 'das la mngonadu phyogs pa ste mngonas tsar pas sa drug pa sangon ru 6 ra nas bya'o/ ⑥ring du song ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu'i bdunapa〉/ sa 'dir gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams lam ngu rna rir du bsgom ba la brten nas mtshan bcas rtsol bcas kyi la ma ngathar thug pa dang /bzod pa gcig pa'i lam gnyis 'brel ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis sa bdun pa ring ru song ba zhes bya'o/ /0mi g.yo ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu'ibargyad pa ste/ sa'adir gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams mtshan gdang bcas pa'i 'du shes dang / mtshan med rtsol bcas kyi 'du she49gnyis kyis mi g.yo bas sa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba nas bya'o/ /4melegs pa'i blo thos/ byang chub sems dpa'i 49bcuchad6 ba ste/ gu'adir gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'i blo gros bzang po thob pa sa sa dgu ba legs pa'i blo thos nas bya'o/ /4)chos sprin/ byang chub sems dpa'i 188
sa bcu ba tshos kyi smin te/ nam mkha' la char sprin 'khrigs te char khub nas 'jig rten gyi lo tog rgyas par byed pa ltar/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu ba'i shes rgyud nam mkha' dang 'dra ba la gzungs dang mang je 'dzin la sogs pa'i chos kyi spren 'khrigs nas chos kyi char phab ste/ gdul bya'irgyud kyi dge ba'i lo tog phun sum tshogs pa rgyas par byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis sa bcu ba chos kyi sprin zhes bya'o/ ༈yichos kyi sku/ rgyan 'grel las rang bzhin gyi 7 dang ngo b+thā nyid sku dang chos kyi sku nas pa rnam grangs yin la/ tshos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa dang me long lta bu'i ye shes rna chos sku'o zhes gsungasaso/ /⑫chu pho spre'u'ilo/ rab byung lnga ba'i chu sprel lo ste spyilo 1272lo yin/189
barma rang byung rdo rje/kurma pa sku zang gsum pa rang byung rdo rje ni/ gtsang stod skyed thong 'phags pa wa ti'i lha khang gi lho phyogs gangs zhur mo zhes par yab chos dpal dang / yum dzo mo g.yang 'dren gnyis kyi sras su rab byung lnga ba'i shing sprel(spyi lo 1284) lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo lnga bar grub chen o rgyan pa rinachen dpal gyi drung du dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa blangs shing mtshan rang byung lda rjer gsol/ dgung lo bdun par khro phu shes rab kyismkhan po mdzad de dge tshul bsgrubs/ dgung lo bco brgyad pa lcags glang(1301)lor gnas brtan gzhon nu 'byung bas mkhan po dang dge 'dun rin chen gyis las slob mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs/ 'dul ba yongs rdzogs gsan/ de nas slob dpon shes rab dpal dang / rgya sgom ye shes/n+ta mdo kun dga' don grub sogs las bka' bstan 'gyur ro 'tshal ma lus pa gsan te rkarma'i gdan sar byon/ shing glang lor kong por gdan drangs te yul der sgrub lda 'ga' btab/ de nasamado khams su byon/ sog chur lcags zam btsugs/ rab byung drug pa'i chu sprel (spyi lo 1332)lo'i zla bcu gcig par gong ma rgyal pos gdan drangs pa ltar rgya nag pho brang chen por 'byor/ rgyal bu rat+na shri sogs kyis bsu ba rgya chen byas/de nas rgyal bu 'das/ de'i gcen po tho gan the sar sman tshe'i yul du gdan 190
drangs te/ rgyal po dang btsun mo blon po sogs la dbang bskur chos bshad gnang / shing khyi(spyi lo 1334)lor bod du phebs/ rgyal pos gnang ba'i 'ja' sa bsgrags shing dngul gyi bstan 'gyur bzhengs/ me glang (1337)lor slar yang rgya nag pho brang chen por phebs/ rgyal po dang mjal/ sa g.yos chen po byung skabs chos rnge dang gong ma mchod yon gnyis lhan du bzhugs pas nyes skyon ma byung bar grags/ dgung lo nga drug pa sa yos (spyi lo 1339)lor rgya nag tu sku gshegs/chos je 'dir slob ma zhwa dmar grags pa seṅge/ mkhas grub g.yung ston pa/ rta sna go shri kun rgyal/ tshal pa si tu/ g.yag sde paṇa chen/kun mkhyen dol po pa sogs mkhas grub mang po byung / gsung chos ston pa'i skyes rabs/ zab yo nang don gyi rtsa 'grel sogs pod gsum lhag bzhugs/'dir 'khod〈〈dpal gyi sde'i skyes pa'i rabs〉〉zhes pa de/ yongs grags su〈〈skyes rabs brgya ba〉〉zhes pa'i nang gses skyes pa'i rabs brgyad cu ba yin/ skyes rabs brgya ba zhes pa 'di rna sngon rgya gar gyi mkhas mchog slob dpon dpa' 'os ston pa'i skyes rabs sum cu so bzhi mdzad cing /phyis dus rabs bcu bzhi bar 'od kyi mkhas dbang kurma rang byung rdo rjes de dang mthud nas ston pa'i skyes rabs drug cu rtsa bdun mdzad de bsdoms pas skyes pa'i zobs brgya dang gcig yod do/ /de bas de'i mtshan byang la/ ston pa thams cad mkhyen pha'i skyes rabs phreng / /bcu phrag gsum dang bzhi rna dpa' bo'i ste/ /phyi nas rang byung rdo rjes bdun lhag pa'i//191
drug cu brgya rtsa rdzogs par mdzad/ /ces gsungs so/ /slob dpon dpa' pos mdzad pa la yongs grags su〈〈skyes rabs so bzhi ba〉〉zhes gsungs la/ chos rjes kurma rang byubardo rjes mdo sde las byung ba'i rgyal ba'i mdzad pa rnams blangs te skyes rabs so lnga ba seṅge'i rgyal po yi dam brtan pa'i skyes pa'i rabs zhes pa nas skyes rabs brgya dang gcig pa byang chub sems dpa' don thams cad grub pa'i skyes pa'i rabs zhes pa'i bar mdzad/ brjod bya gtso bo ston pa'i skyes rangs so so bar pha rol tu phyin pa bcu dang sa bcu mthar phyin pa'i sar sbyor ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa gsal bar ston pa zhig yin zhing / rjod byed tshig rna snyan ngag gi rgyan sna tshogs kyis mdzes par spras pas snyan zhing yid 'gugs pa zhig yin te/ par byang du/ de nas mdzad pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i gtam/ /dpyod ldan snying la sngon med dga' ston gyi/ /legs bshad rin chen gsar ba 'di stsal pas/ /snyan ngag gzhan la gus pa nyod par byas/ /zhes bsngags pa ltar ro//dpal gli re'i skyes pa'i rabs/skyes bu dam pa0rnams kyi gzhan la phan par byed pa dang sbyin pa dang smon lam gyi stobs ni dpag tu med do/ /de yang sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na rgyal po'i pho brang a riṣā zhes bya ba 'byor ba rgyas pa ba ba lo legs pa skye bo dang mi mang pos gang ba/192
chur0dpag tshad bcu gnyis zheng du dpag tshad 0bdun pa gru bzhi ba rnalpar mdzes pa/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang rta babs sgreng ba zhig byung bar gyur to/ /rgyal po'i pho brang der rgyal po dpal gyi sde zhes bya ba stobs kyi 'khor lo bsgyur ba gzugs bzang ba mdzes pa lta na sdug pa kha dog bzang po rgyas pa mchog dang ldan pa/ rang bzhin gyis skye ba dran pa chos dang ldan pa chos kyi rgyal po chos kyis 'dzam bu'i gling gi dbang rgyug gi bdag por byed pa zhig byung bar gyur to/ /rgyal bo de'i btsun mo ni rgyal ba'i 'od ces bya ba gzugs bzang zhing mdzes pa lta na sdug pa yid bzhin du spyod pa byung ngo / /rgyal po de'i blon po ni stong phrag bcu gnyis yod de de rnams kyi mchog ni blo gros chen po zhes bya'o/ /sa bdag sa chen rgya mtsho'i gos rgyan pa/ /skyong phyed bsod nams mthu yi dpal gyis mdzes/ /de ni sems can kun la mnyam par lta/ /snying rje'i dbang gis dngos po thams cad gtong / /chags med yongs su sbyangs shing zhi ba yi/ /bdag gi yan lag mchog kyang sgyin par stsol/ /de bas 'dzam gling gnas pa'i skye b+thā la/ /dbya①dang sho gam tsam ya nga sdud mi byed/ /dge bcu'i bka' khrims mtho ris them skas mchog /rnam dag skye bo'i brag chas bsgrags pa rnams/ /sa 'dir kun tu gsal bar byas par gyur/ /de yis rang gi pho brang a risa'i/ /sgo bzhir sbyin pa'i bkad sa①rgya chen dag /sna tshogs longs spyod kun gyis gang byas te/ /rdzogs ldan0sprin las byung ba'i char rgyun bzhin/ /bza' btung gos dang rgyun gyi tshogs rnams dang / /rta dang shing rta glang po 'gying ba dang ///93
na chung gzhon nu pad+ma rgyas pa'i gdong / /ut+pal mig can rin chen brgyan pa dag /skye bo rnams kyi yid bzhin thob bar gyur//de ltar rgyal po dpal gyi sdes 'dzam bu'i gling thams cad du skye b+thā rnams chos kyi bdag nyid①la bkod pas/ mi'i srid pa nas tshe 'phos pa de thams cad lha'i 'jig rten du skyes par gyur to/ /yang 'i tshe sum cu rtsa gsum0gyi lha rnams kyi/ lha'i grong khyer lta na sdug ces bya ba lha'i tshogs kyis kun tu gang zhing der 1 skabs med par gyur pa dang lta na sdug gi phyi rol yongs 'du dang shing rta sna tshogs can dang dga' ba'i tshal la sogs pa'i skyed mos tshal rnams su gnas par gyur to/ /de nas sngon skyes pa'i sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i tshogs kyis yang dag pa'i 'byor ba de —mthong ste rab tu dga' nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin la 'ad skad ces smras —so/ /ko'u shi na⑨gang du ri'i rgyal po ri rab de nyid lha'i bu dag gis gang ste lha'i tshogs rnams ni 'phel bar gyur lha ma yin gyi tshogs ni 'grib par gyur pa'i ngo mtshar 'di la gzigs/ de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis/ lha'i bu rnams las cas nas ri'i rgyal po tharab thams cad la blta bar brtsams pa dang ji tsam na ri'i rgyal po ri rab lha'i tshogs rnams gyis kun nas gang bar mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang de 'di snyam du sems te/ rgyu gang dang rkyen gang gis sems can ji snyed cig 'dir skyes par gyur snyam nas 'dzam bu'i gling thams cad la blta bar brtsams pa dang / ji tsam na rgyal po dpal gyi sde'i mthu yin par mthong ngo / /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin sems rab tu dka' bas sum ca rtsa gsum gyi 194
lha rnams la smras pa/ grogs po dag khyid rnams nyon cig /'dza'i gling dbangalaphyug rgyal po ni/ /dpal gyi sde zhes rnam grags pa/ /rtag tu chos la gzhol ba dang / /rgyal sachen po chos la gnas/ /thog ma bar dang mthar dgi zhing / /sems can kun la phan par dka'/ /gtso bo mi rnams dge ba la/ /rtag par yang dag phyor bar byed/ /rtag tu snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /gyi rol dngos po res gtong zhing / /de ni sha yang slong ba la/ /rjesasu brtse ba nyid kyis ster/ /nang ngam yang na 6 rol la/ /de ni yongs su 'dzin med par/ /rjes brtse nyid kyis gtong byed cing / /gang chub mthar 'byung ba la brtson/ /des ni rnam dag gser bzhin du/ /'gro ba thams cad rab bsgrubs pas/ /rgyal po de yi mthu yis ni/ /thams cad mtho ris la gzhol gyur/ /rgyal po blo gros che de yis/ /mthu yis su yang dmyal ba dang / /yi dwags dang ni dud 'gro yi /pye sa gunas rnams su skye mi 'gyur/ /de yi gzi brjid mthu yis ni/ /thams cad snang bar 'gro ba dang / /sbyinayidang tshul khrimasayidaga' 'gyur bas/ /dga' ba'i tshal na dga' bas rtse/ /dpal gyi re la rjes brten pa/ /gus dang bcas par gyur pa 'di/ ra lha yi 'jig rten nyam sa dga' bar/ /de yang dga' bar rnam par snang //de nas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha de rnams kyis tshig de thos nas yid dga' ba dang sems rangs par gyur te dka' ba'i sems su gyur cing 'di skad ces kyang smras so/ /gang rgyal bo 'di yan lag dang nying lag kyang sbyin bar gtong 'dod par stsol ba ni ngo mtshar che'o/ /'on kyang 'di ltar 195
yin lag dang nying 'a/ga ster ba 'di ni dka' ba ste/ bdag dang mnyam pa phangs pa gzhan med pas/ de ji ltar na bdag nyid chen po 'di rang n+da/ lus sdug bsngal ba la mi sems par yan lag dang nying lag sbyin par satong bar 'gyur te 'di ni rjes su dpag nus pa ma yin no/ /brgya byin gyis smras pa/ snying rje'i bdag nyid blo ldan rnams/ /dpag med mthu dang ldan pa yin/ /de bas 'di ni mi gtong ba/ /cung zad tsam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes bstan to//de nas dus gzhan zhig gi tshe rgyal po'i btsun mo dam pa 'i rmi lam na/dpalaganyi stan la bdag nyid phab nas slar yang bteg par mthong ba dang rang gi mig phyung nas slar yang skyes par mthong ba dang / bdag nyid kyi dpung ba g.yas pa 'di bcad de sa la kyung ba yang skyes par mthong ba dang /mi ma yin pa dngul gyi do bcag pa zhig gis rgyal po dpal gyi sde'i dpung ba g.yon pa mod la phyung ste phrogs nas slar yang skyes pa mis so/ /gnyid sa da pa dang 'jigs shing bsngangs la spu zingaḥzhes byed de nga'am lha la sdug bsngal 'ga' zhig 'byung bar mi 'argyur agrang zhes bsams nas/ des rgyal po dpal gyi sdo la smras so/ /de rmi ltas la byang ba yin pas 'di snyam du sems te/ 'aris rmi lam 'di lta bu mthong ba lags na ring por mi thogs par chung ma 'di nyid slong ba 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /snyam nas smras pa/ma 'jigs shig sgyu ma lta bu'i mi lam la sems pas ci zhig bya/ dpal gyi sde ra bdag nyid gnas par khyod kyis ma mthong ngam/ mig ma nyams par na bzhim/ du 'dug pa dang / bdag nyid kyi dpung ba g.yas pa de bzhin 196
du yod pa dang / nga'i 'ang dpung ba cagayon pa gnas bzhin pa nyid zhis (ces) dbugs phyung ba dang cang mi smra bar 'dug dzo/ /ci tsam na mtshan mo gnyis pa lablo na ngo 'i mchog blo gros chen po zhes bya bas gilam du rgyal po dpal gyi sde'i rin po che thams cad las byas pa'i khang bzang mod la zhig pa dang / rin po che de rnams sha za mthong na 'jigs su rung ba rnams kyis phan tshun khyer ba dang slar yang khang bzang so sor sbyar ba ni chas so/ /sad pa dang 'jigs shing skrag pa dang yi mug ste spu zing zhes byed pa dang /bsams pa/ sems can thams cad la mnyas gshin pa/ lha dpal gyi sde'i sku lus slong ba 'ong bar mi 'gyur grang / lha'ang thams cad stsol ba/thams cad yongs su gtong ba/ chags pa med par gtong ba ste 'a lta ste dman pa dang / long ba dang / bkren pa dang sdug 'phongs rnams la 'di yongs su mi gtong ba ci'ang med do/ /rgyal po dpal gyi sde la ni zhu bar mi bya ste shin tu kro ba skye bar mi 'gyur grang / de nas sa gsangs ṭī/ mtshan mkhan bos nas dam bsgos te smras pa/ shes ldan ngas 'di lta bu'i rmi lam rmis pa'i 'bras bu ci lta bur gyur pa khyod kyis lung ston cigmtshan mkhan gyis zas pa/ mi lam 'di lta bu las ni ring bo mi thogs par lha'i sku lus slong ba 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /rmi lam bstan pa lta bu 'di thos pa dang blon po blo gros chen po sdug bsngal drag pos gdungs shing mig mchi mas gang ba dang lag pa 'gram pa la gtad de sems khong du chud pas zhanas nas rgyal po dbal gyi sde byams pa 0dang snying rje'i0bdag nyid can sems can thams cad la mnyas gshin pa yon tan du ma dang ldan pa 197
la tra rtag pa'i stobs ṭhi bar gnas pa t+yā ha cang myur ches so/ /de nas nub gsum pa la blon po stong phrag bcu gnyis kyis rmi lam lnga rmis te/ khra yis rgyal po dpal gyi sde'i gdugs dang cod pan phyogs te slar yang byin pa dang / skye 'o thams cad kyi mgo bcad nas slar yang byung ba dang / 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi thams cad kyi mig phyung nas slar yang skyes pa dang / 'dzam bu gling gi mi thams cad kyi rkang ba dang lag pa rnams bcad nas slar yang skyes pa dang / rgyal po dpal gyi sde seng ge'i khri las babs nas slar yang 'dzeg par brtson par rmis pa dang / 'jigs shing skrag la yi mug nas rgyal po dpal gyi sdes chen po skyong bar mdzad pa byams pa'i bdag nyid can ting rje ba sems can thams cad la mnyes gshin pa mi rtag pa'i stobs nye bar gnas par mi 'gyur grang / bdag cag rnams lha dang lhan cig gnas pa las tha dad par gyur cing bye bar mi 'gyur grang / 'dzam bu gling pa'i skyabs dang dpung gnyen med par mi 'gyur grang snyam nas/ de rnams kyis mtshan mkhan rnams bos nas smras pa dang de rnams kyis kyang 'di bzhin du 'gyur zhes lung bstan to/ /'di lta bu'i rmi lam bstan pa thos pa dang grong khyer a riṣā na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs rnams nyam thag pa'i nga ros —ngu bar brtsams so/ /thos pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa/ 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi thams cad mya ngan drag po'i sdug bsngal gyis bcom nas shin tu the sngags 'don par gyur to/ /de ltar gyur pa de rgyal po dpal gyi ldes thos nas bsams pa/ nga'i lus slong ba 'ong bar 'gyur ro snyam nas sems rab tu dga' ba dang mgu bar gyur to/ /de la rgyal pos dbugs dbyung 198
ba'i phyir bstan pa/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi skye bo rnams/ /dngos kun bden par grub min pa/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i rmi lam la/ /su zhig bden par rtogs par byed/ /de bsamya ngan ma byed par/ /bde bar bag yod gnas par byos/ /rang gi dpal la rjes spyad cing / /yid ni dga' bas gnas par gyis/ /nas dril bsgrags pa de thos nas 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi thams cad dbugs phyin par gyur to//yang de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po'i pho brang a riṭa'i byang phyogs na ri bo zhig yod de/ de na drang srongaḥlnga brgya tsam gnas so/ /ci tsam na dus gzhan zhig gi tshe de rnams kyis 'don du 'jug pa'i mkhan po drang srong zhig don gyi bya ba 'ga' zhig gi phyir/ rgyal po'i pho brang du 'ongs so/ /de'i tshe rgyal po dpal gyi lde btsun mo rgyal ba'i 'od dang lhan cig skyed mos tshal du song ngo / /bram zes btsun mo dam spru de mthong bas/ 'di ltar nga'i skye ba snga ma'i chung mar gyur pa'ang yin pas sngon gyi chags pa dang 'brel ba'i dbang gis tshul bzhin mu yin pa yid la skye bar gyur te/ smras pa/ ston gyi bag chags sred(sad) pa'i rjes 'brang dang / /bde ba'i = las zhen pa rjes 'brang phyir/ /gzugs dang lang tso'iyiyon tan rjes 'brang ba'i/ /btsun mo'i dpal la bram ze yid 'brangs te/ /rtse gcig 'dod pas 'jig rten g.yos pa bzhin/ /mngon sum bzhin du sems shing de nas dong / /de yid la na sems shing lam de nas song ste rgyal po'i pho brang du bya ba yongs su rdzogs pa dang / blta gnas su song ngo /na nas dus gzhan zhig gi tshe drang srong des bram ze'i khye'u zhig rig 199
byed 'don pa yongs su rdzogs pa dang / sa ra/khan po'i 7/nga pa la gtugsnas mas pa/ mkhan po la nor 'u lta bu 'bul bar bgyi ba bka' stsol cigdrang srong yis smras pa/ de bas na bu rgyal po dpal gyi sde'i btsun mo'i mchog rgyal ba'i 'od slongs la ba'i bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / mkhan po la mkhan po'i nor dang bla ma la mchod pa'i phyir byin cig /de skad ces smras pa dang / bram ze'i khye'u de gnad du bsnun pa'i ri dwags ba'in du sdug bsngal drag pos gdungs te/ mchog tu yi bug pa dang bsams pa/gnas 'di ni 'byung bar dka' ba dang / rnyed par dka/ 'a na ji ltar ya nga bram ze nyon mongs pa bdag lta bus rgyal po'i btsun mo rgyal ba'i 'od byin ced ces ji ltar smra bar nus/ 'di ltar bslab par bya ba ma yin pa'i gangos po 'di la kun tu sbyor ba gar yin pa des na mkhan po nges par bdag la dmod pa byed par 'dod pa yin no/ /de nas drang srong des de'i bzhin rnam par gyur pas nang gi bsam pa rtogs nas smras pa/ ma 'jibs shig sa bdag 'di ni bdag nyid che bas na/ /thams cad yongs su gtong ba byed pa yin/ /chags shing zhin pas de rgyud dkris pa med/ /de bas ci nas don ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /de bas na bag tsha ba yimed par song zhig bram ze'i khye'u dmod pa de la 'jigs nas/ de ltar bgyi'o zhes rkang ba la gtugs te song ngo //de nas rgyal po'i pho brang a risar phyin nas/ shing shun ni gyon dbyug pa dang ril ba ni thobs lus la rdul gyis gos pa'i tshul gyis rgyal po'i drung du song nas/ tshe spel bar byas te bsams pa/ ji ltar slong ngam 'on 200
te mi slong / ster bar 'gyar ram mi ster bar 'gyur nga'i yid la byed pa 'bras bu dang bcas par 'gyur ram 'bras bu med par 'gyur ram snyam nas bdag nyid smod bzhin du dman pa'i bzhin gyis/ cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /de nas rgyal po dpal gyi sdes bsams pa/ 'di ni nga la slong du 'ongs so snyam nas bram ze'i khye'u re la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bram ze khyod kyi dgos pa gang yin pa de dzes shig dang / 2 ring khyod kyi yid la byed pa'i re ba yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /de skad ces smras pa dang /bram ze'u khye'u de mi 'jigs pa skyes nas byang chub sems dpa' la smras pa/sa bdag chen po dpal ldan rgyal gyur cig /khyod ni 'jig rten chags med cag par gtong / /'jig rten 'di dag 'dod pas zil mnan gyur/ /de bas lha mchog khyod la 'phags ma slong / /bdag ṅges thos pa'i drin lan bsab pa'i phyir/ /btsun mo stsol bas 'jig rten grags par mdzod/ /lha byang phyogs kyi ri bo bdag gi mkhan po drang srong 'don du 'jug pa 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas nas gnas te de la bdag gis rig byed 'don pa yongs su rdzogs pas/ rgyal po chen po thugs brtse bas bcun mo rgyal ba'i 'od bdag la stsol cig mkhan po la mkhan po'i nor dang /bla ma la mchod pa'i phyir te/ bdag gi mkhan po la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / rgyal po dpal sde brtse ba'i dbang gis yid g.yos par gyur te btsun mo rgyal ba'i 'od 'di nga dang bral na ji ltar srog 'dzin par nus/ 'khor de dag thams cad kyang rgya mtsho zab mo'i sgra mi g.yo ba dang gnad du bsnun pa bzhin du sdug bsngal drag pos gdungs te 'di ji 31/
zhes skyo bar rab tu gnas so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' skad cig cang mi smra bar gnas te bsams pa/ bu dang chung ma la sogs pa sbyin pa med pas ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir bram ze 'di la dga' bas chung ma 'di sbyin par bya'o snyam du bsams nas gnyen sdug pa dang bral bas zhum pa'i sems yang dag par bsal te/ 'phral du seng ge'i khri'ulas babs nas byang chub tu smon pa'i sems kyis btsun mo rgyal ba'i 'od lha'i bu mo bzhin du rnam par mdzes pa khyo dang bral ba'i gdung bas shin tu dbugs ring por byung (phyung) ste mchi mas gang ba'i mig dang / phun par g.yang sa chen po nas 〈〈 ba bzhin du mchog tu sdug bsngal bas gdong phab pa lag pa g.yon spra sa bzung ste/ lag pa g.yas pas gser gyi bum pa thogs nas bram ze'ikhye'u de la 'di skad smras so/ /bram ze chen po tshur shog cig /gzugs bza nga sdug pa 'di long (longs) zhig(shig) / /sbyin pa 'di yis myur du ni/ /byang chub dam pa 'thob par shog /ces smras nas/ byang chub sems dpa sa bram ze'i lag par chu rgyun blugs so/ /de tshe de yi sbyin pa'i mthus ]/ /sa 'di rnam drug g.yos gyur te/ /e ma'o rmad du byung ba zhes/ /bram ze'i khye'u yi rang gyur/ /'di 'dra'i mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba dag /bde la ma chags snyen par byed pa ni/ /sa 'di mgon byas mya ngan bya mi dgos/ /je bas dpal ldan spyod pa rmad du byung / /de nas bram zes bde legs su gyur cig ces smras nas/ btsun mo rgyal ba'i 'od khyer te rings pa rings par blta gnas su song nas mkhan po la byin pa dang btsun 203
mo rgyal ba'i 'od nya chu las bton pa bzhin du sdug pa dang bral ba'i sdug bsnga nga drag bor jigadungs shing nyam thag pa dang / byang chub/ sems darnga 'a nyid la mngon par sems shing 'gro ba thams/ cad mun pa bum nag tu gyur pa bzhin du shes shing / kyi hud rgyal po chen po kyi hud rgyal po chen po zhes mchog tu bdung ba'i sem sa dang zas bcad pa la zhugs so//sa g.yo sa pa des brgya byin gyi gnas sayo sa nga ra gyur to/ /chos nyid kyi lha rtsams kyi shes pa 'og tu mthong ba 'jug gi/ gong du ni ma yin dzo//de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bsams pa/ shin tu drag pos sa g.yos pa/ /mtshan ma 'di ni ṭa yi mthu/ /gang gi mthu ni ji 'dra ba/ /shin tu ca/sal ba 'di shes bya/ /'dzam bu gling thams cad la bltas pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'di lta bu mchog tu dka' ba'i las byed pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes te sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams la smras pa/ grogs po dag khyed cag rnams rgyal po dpal gyi re'i ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i las la ltos/ gang zhig 'di ltar sdug pa dang / 'di ltar yid du 'ong ba rtswa bzhin du btang ngo zhes smras nas/gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rmad du byung ba sems can rnams la bsgrag pa'i phyir/ de'i phyi nyin nam langs pa dang lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin lha'i bu bzhi dang thabs cig tu sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas nas ṭ+wāṃ rnyiji rdo/na chaX pa/ /hā k+ham̐ /byi par+sha shā /shā shāshā /snas tshang /shā ṭ+wāṃ gh+nā /lha kyang bram ze'i cha byad 'dzin pas/ bram ze rgan po lus kyi phyed stag gis 203
bcad cing zos shing khrag 'dzag pa de khri la bzhag nas bteg cing 'gro ste de'i khrag gi dri de las kyang steng nas khā dang / chu skyar dang / bya rgod rnams rjes su 'brang ngo / /'og nas kyang4) dang wa rnams rjes su 'brang bzhin du rings pa rings parasang khyer misgor song ngo //de yang 'di ltar ting 4ba'i gnas su gyur pa skyes pa dang bud med rnams kyis mthong nas snying rjes gdungs pa'i yid kyis cig la cig smra ba/grogs po dag bram ze 'di rked par chad cing 'di'i dbang po'ang ma 'khrugs pa ji ltar 'tsho bar 'gyur/ gzhan zhig gis smras pa/ 'di mi ma yin 6)sha zayimi'i cha byad kyithagabadadacag rnams bza' ba'i phyir 'dir 'ongs kyis mi rked pa chad pa ri'atsho ba med do/ /de skad ces thos pa dang skyes bu snga ma rnams ni 'jigs pas 'brolapar brtsams so/ /skyes 6 dpa' bo gzhan zhig 'de snyam sa'osagasha za ga ste de lta na'ang tshor bas nyen bzhin du 'di ltar dbang bo rnams bde bar snang na de 'u lta bu yin/ bdag gis 'di la dri bar byas na 'disastatshig thon par dka' mod kyis gal te tshig thon na ni ngo mtshar du 'gyur ro snyam nas smras pa/ bram ze khyod ci mi yin nam 'on te sha za yin/ de nas brgya byin bram ze'i gzugs su 'dug pa des sdug bsngal6 tshor ba drag pos nyan par ston cing /sna dh+ri /las ṭā phyi shā sprami ma 'ji/lha ṭ+wāṃ /bas/ dī/ ṭ+wāṃ dro lha/ phru( hūm̐ dzon//'di nyid du ni kun bshad na/ /dus ni kun tu 'da' bar 'gyur/ /'chi bdag myur du 'ongs nas ni/ /srog ni 'phrog par 'gyur du 'ong / /204
chos kyi rgyal po'i spyan sngar ri/ /'de dag kun kyang bshad par bya/ /ston gyi las kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /da rung nga la 'bras bcas 'gyur/ /yon tan kun gyi rnaswā mdzes las/ /zla ba lta bur zhi ba dang / /sbyin dang tshul khrims la dga' ba/ /gtso b+thā gang du mthong bar 'gyur/ /rgya mtsho bzhin du zab gyur cing / /ri rab lta bur mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten kun gyi gtsor gyur pa/ /chos kyi rgyal po gang na bzhugs/ /'jigs shing skrag pa rnam sa kyi skyabs/ /slong ba rnams kyi bgrod bya'i mchog /snyan smra sbyin dang tshul khrims ldan/ /bdag nyid che de gang na bzhugs//bdag mdun 'chi bdag nyer 'ongs kyi/ /shi ba'i pha rnams myur du spros//thugs rje can de ma gtogs par/ /nga la lus byed su zhig ster/ /de ltar rgyal po'i rna lam nas snying rje ba dang / dman pa dang zhum pa'i tshig smra zhing / rim gyis rgyal po dpal gyi sde'i pho brang sgor song ba dang / srog chags brgya stong du ma rnams kyang ngo mtshar skyes nas rjes bzhin 'brangs so//de'i tshe 'dzam bu'i gling kun tu ltas kyi khyad par 'di lta bu'ang byung bar gyur te/ de mthong nas der gnas pa'i ri'i drang srong gis tshigs su bcad pa/ mi'am ci yoyi tshogs dang nags kyi lha rnams ngu/ /nam mkhar gnas 4ri lha rnams kyang ni smra bar byed/ /zla ba 'od med nya mas mun pa sel mi bye da/ /de ring rol mo brdungs na sgra mi grag par gyur/ /shing tshogs me to4 'bras bur ldan pa 'di dag kyang / /rlung gis bskyod pa bzhin du sa lakyur gyur la/ /ji ltar 'jigs shing rtsub pa'i sgra kun 205
grag pas na/ /grong tsher dag tu sdug bsngal mi bzad 'byung bar gsal//a riṣā nas skye bo 'di kun sdug bsngal zhing / /mya ngan zuṭa/ rngus bcom nas sgra rnams so sor sgrogs/ /zla ba'i bzhin lda na du ged 'di rnams spre sngags 'byin/ /nam mkhar gnas pa'i sprin 'cha'ang chu med par sgra sgrogs/ /sa la gnas pa'i chu rnams kyang ni skam par gyur/ /rma bya rnam sa ni nags mes bcom zhing sgra sgro gas te/ /de bas 'an+da ni rgyal po'i pho brar nyes pa 'byung / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' steng gi khang bzang gi gzhi la gnas pas skye bo'i tshogs chen po'i cho je'i sgra thos pa dang /rings pa rings par rin po che la sa byas pa'i khang bzar las babs nas seng ge'i khri chen po la 'dug ste/ shin tu brtabs pas shes ldan dag /'di ci yin 'di 'u yin zhes dris so/ /skabs der brgya byin nad pa'i gzugs su bsgyur pa de bram ze'i khye'u bzhi ba des bteg cing rgyal po'i mdun du bzhugs pa dang / /de khri la bskyon pa lus kyi phyed bcad pa de las khrag 'dzag cing rab tu 'dzag pa dang des lag pa g.yas pa brgyang (sa)te snying rje je skad du byang chub sems dpa' la rgyal ba dang tshe spel bar byas nas mchi mas khongs pa'i mig dang rang gi lus kyi zud t+yā bar ston cing byang chub sems dpa' la smras pa/ 'jig rton na khyod snying rje can/ /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal gyis sdug bsngal/ /nyid kyi sku yi phyed stsal bas/ /gtso b+thā bdag ni bskyab tu gsol//de nas de skad ces thos pa dang / blon po chen po'i mchog blo kyos chen pos zas pa/ lha 'di mi ma las/sa kyi sha za'am sha zas byin gyis brla pa sa 206
par gyur pa zhis/ ste mi ni rked par bcad ge 'tsho zhing sngon gyi lta ra tshanaṭa/ pa ba6/na du tshig tu spra ba ni mi srid do/ /de skad ces thos pa dang / bram ze'u t+ma sa pa/ khyid cag rnams ma 'jigs shig /nga ni sha za ma yin gyis gzhan du na nga sgru bram ze yin gyis dbul bas bdag gi bu dang chung ma bzhag ste nor gyi bsam pas rgyal po dpal gyi sde'i thad du chas nas rim gyis 'ongs pa na/ rgyal po'i pho brang 'dir nyi ma nub pa nas phyin pa dang thong khyer gyi sgo rnams bcad par gyur to/ /de nas grong khyer dang ha cang mi ring ba na bsod nams khang ba yod par bdag nye bar song ste nub mo gnas pa na/ lam gyi dub pas gnyid 'thug pos non pa dang sngon gyi las kyi nyes pas nub mo gcan gzan stag 'ongs nas/ bdag gi lus kyi phyed sog le lta bu'i mche ba shin tu rnon pos bcad nas khyer te song ngo / /der bdag tshor ba drag pos kun tu bcom nas gnyid sad pa dang ji tsam na bdaka gi lus kyi ro smad phyed po stag gis sog les dras pa ltar bcad pas bgag tshor ba drang/ pos kun tu bcom kyang sngon byas pa'i mi dge ba'i las rnams kyis kun tu bzung bas shi bar ni ma gyur gyis/ gcig tu sdug bsngal ba drag po rtsub pa dang / yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba nyams su myong zhing nyam thag pa'i nga ros smre sngags 'don par gyur te/ bdag de ltar nyam thag pa'i 2 sngags thos pa dang / nam mkha'i dkyil na gnas pa'i lha gzhan zhig gis bdag dbugs dbyung ba'i phyir smras pa/ ma 'jigs ma 'jigs bram ze mchog /khyod kyi tshe 'di ring bar mthong / /grong khyer a risar myur song / /khyod ni legs gsal dag tu 'gyur/ /na na kun 307
rer rgyal po ni/ /dpal gyi sde zhes nam grags pa/ /de yi lus kyi phyed bslangs na/ /de ni jis par khyod la ster/ /zhes smras nas lha mo de nyid mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas bdag gis lha mo'i tshig thos pa dang /'tsho ba re ba kun tu skyes te tshor ba'ang chung bar gyur to/ /de nas bdag gi lus kyi phyed ro smad med pa langs kyang ma nus na 'gro bar lta ga la nus snyam nas yang yi mug par gyur pa dang / stes dbang gis nyi ma shar ba'i tshe gnyen 'di bzhi 'ongs par gyur to/ /'di dag kyang bdag nyam nga bar bzhugs pa mthong ba dang 'di 'chi ba nyid do snyam nas ngu bar gyur to//de nas bdag gis de rnams la dbugs dbyung ba'i phyir lha mo'i tshig rgyas par smras so/ /de nas bdag 'di rnams kyis khri la bskyon cing 'dir khyer te 'ongs so zhes smras nas gdong mchi ma'i rlabs kyis gang ba lta bur bdag nyid nye bar ston cing smras pa/ byang chub sems dpa' dge mchog chos la gnas/ /thams cad mkhyen nyid mnyam pa med bshad na/ /bdag la sku phyed 'di stsol de ring ni/ /shin tu rnyed dka'i srog ni thob par mdzod/ /rgyal po chen po'i sku yi phyed/ /shin tu btang dka' bdag stsol la/ /chos dang de bzhin grags pa yis/ /'gro ba kun la khyab par mdzod/ /de nas tshig 'di thos pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'aḥsngon goms pa'i dge ba'i bag chags blo la bsgos pas snying rjes sems 'dar zhing slong ba de dbugs dbyung ba'i phyir smras pa/ bram ze chen po ma 'jis/sa shig dang ring po mi thogs par lus 'di rdzogs par 'gyur ba dang yid la re ba 308
yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur gyis/ g.yo med pa'i sems kyis khyod la lus kyi phyed sbyin par bya'o/ /zhes smras nas/ byang chub sems dpa' rab tu dga' ba dang tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ kye ma rang gi lus slong la//yun mi ring bar blta bar bya/ /nga yi yan lag btang ba ni/ /dka' bar gyur pa ma yin no/ /ji ltar yab kyi bu gcig nga yin kyang / /de lta na yang nga yi lus 'di khyer/ /lus 'di byin pas byang chub rnyed gyur cing / /'gro 'di shin tu sdug bsngal la sa grol shog /de skad ces smras nas byang chub sems dpas skyes bu gzhan zhig la smras pa/ kye rings par song la sog le shin tu rno ba khyer la shog cig de brgya byin gyis rmongs par byas pas rings par sog le khyer te 'ongs nas smras pa/ lha sog le 'tshal te mchis so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas blon po rnams la smras pa/ khyed cag gis ji srid du bram ze 'di shi bar ma gyur par nga'i lus 'di sog les chod cig dang bram ze 'di la sbyin par bya'o//de skad ces smras pa thos nas skye bo'i tshogs thams cad sdug bsngal bar gyur te mya ngan gyi ca co 'byin to/ /blon po blo gros chen po des byang chub sems dpa' nyid kyi sku la chags pa med par gtong bar rig nas mchog tu yid gdungs pa'i gdong mchi ma can gyis de'i rkang ba la gtugs te bzlog pa'i phyir smras pa/ lha 'di ni mi srid de/ 'di lta ste/ lus sog les bcad pa'i lus ni jis par 'chi bar 'gyur te/ 'chi na las su mi rung ba'i ro ru gyur la la sa su mi rung bas rna bram ze la'ang byas pa don ma mchis par 'gyur ro/ /gang gzhan gyi yan lag bcad pa gzhan 209
gyi yan lag la sbyor bar rtser pa 'di yang gnas pa ma mchis so/ /de lta na lha'i ngal ba'ang don ma mchis par 'gyur ro/ /de lta bas na lha bzod ṭ+wāṃ ༵ lha rdogārdzu hṝ /ga bltaspya ༷/ lha paXs par /so /sa pa ༵ ngami chupadza ṭ+wāṃ maXng dardonā blon po dbugs dbyung ba'i phyir smras pa/ blo gros chen po bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi gegs ma byed cig 'jig rten na ni chos nyid 'di yin te//'du ba gang yod mtha' ni 'bral bar 'gyur/ /tshe yang glog bzhin 'gyur zhing mi brtan na/ /dus ring 'gro la phan par byed pa yi/ /sbyin la mkhas pas su zhig gegs rgyud 'gyur/ /de bas blo gros chen po yi rang pyos/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' de lta bu'i sbyin pa la mi ldog par shes nas blo gros chen po mchog tu gdung ba'i sems kyis mchi ma char bzhin du babs shing byang chub sems dpa'i zhabs la 'jus te smri sngags 'don par gyur pa/ kyi hud 'dzam gling skyong byed pa//snying rje'i bdag nyid sa bdag che/ /'di ni 'jig rten skal nyams pas//slan chad mngon du mthong mi 'gyur/ /bram ze 'di nyid gcig pu'i phyir//'jig rten thams cad 'dor bar byed/ /de skad ces smras nas sa'i steng du 'gyel bar gyur to//de nas byang chub sems dpas skyes bu shing mkhan gnyis la smras pa/bzhin bzang dag 'dir nga'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yo ngas su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir sog les nga'i lus 'di myur du chod cig bram ze 'di'i re ba rdzogs par bya'o/ /shing mkhan de gnyis mchog tu sdug bsngal bas byang 210
chub sems dpa'i rkang ba la gtugs te smras pa/ lha 'di skad gsung ba mi ritra]sa te/ /sa bdag khyod la gnod pa dag /gal te nga'an gyis byas na yang / /bdag cag mthu yis bzlog rigs na/ /gnod pa'i tshul 'di ji ltar bgyi /yang byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ bu dag 'di rna nga la spunod pa bye pa ma yin no/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid brtan pa rnams/ /gzhan la phan par byed pa na/ /de yis spyo da la grogs cad pa/ /'di ni dam pa'i spyod pa'o/ /de bas na ci nas nga'i ngag bzhin du byos mig ces smras te/ yang bdag nyid khri las bzlas nas skye bo'i tshogs dang lha dang klu gegs byed pa de dag thabs dang tshing/ snyan pa de dag gis so sor bzlog nas smon lam btab pa/ lha dang mi dang gnod sbyinañtsatshogs rnams nyon/ /gang gis bdag ni 'di ltar 'bad byed pa/ /lha dang mi dang brgya byin 'thob phyir min/ /tshangs pa'am rang nyid zhi ba 'dod min te/ /'gro ba sdug bsngal bcas pa bskyab phyir dang / /bla med byang chub yongs/ su rdzogs phyir ro/ /de bas ci nas 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal dag /bskyabs nas sangs rgyas mchog nyid 'thob gyur cig /de skad ces smras nas byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid sa la phab ste shing mkhan la smras pa/ tshur shog bram ze 'di dus ma byas pa la nga'i lus 'di sog les legs par chod la byin cig ces smras so//de'i tshe btsun mo'i 'khor rnams kyis lta bu'i rnam pa de mthong nas stabs cig tu byeng chub sems dpa'i rkang pa la gtugs nas/ ting rje rje skad du smre sngags 'don par brtsams pa/ kyi hud 'dzam bu'i gling yongs 215

klu dang gnod sbyin dang dri za dang lha ma yin dpanam mkha' ldeng dang mi'al'u dang lto 'phye chen po'i tshogs rnams kyang mya ngan drag pos gdungs te ngu bar gyur pa dang de rnams kyis ngus pa'i mchi ma char ltar babs so/ /de nas skye bo'i tshogs chen pos 'di ci zhig yin snyam nas steng du lta bar brtsams pa dang ci tsam na lha brgya stong du ma rnams ngu ba mthong ngo /de nas skye bo'i tshogs chen po shas cher mya ngan drag pos gdungs te byang chub sems dpa' gnas skabs 'di lta bur sdug bsngal bar mthong nas kyi hud lha grongs pa ni sdug bsngal lo zhes bsams nas kun tu rmongs par gyur to//de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis srog chags brgya stong du ma 'di rnams byang chub sems dpa'i mya ngan gyis gdungs pas shin tu snying hra zhing zhum pa mthong ba dang / myur bar ting je ba'i yid kyis bsams pa/ bdag nyid che ba sems can thams cad la mnyas gshin pa/ 〉nga rje can/ thams cad ster ba 'di'i lus la 'di ltar tshor ba drag po'i las kun tu sbyor ba rna bzang po ma yin rna/ /gzhan du na da ni ji ltar srog mi 'jig par gyur pa de ltar bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' la shing mkhan de gnyis kyis sog le drud cing sog le rnon pos lus bcad pa'i tshor ba drag pos gdungs pa dang / brtan pa'i stobs dang ldan pas song ba la byams pa'i sems bskyed nas bsams pa/ ngas 'khor ba'i skyon gyi rang bzhin shes nas brtson 'grus drag cing brtan pa dang ldan pas lus phyogs gcig bcad pa 'di las 'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal skyes na sems can sdur ma rnams phal cher sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal gyis gdungs pa na shin tu sdug 217
bsngal lo zhes de lhag par yang snying rje chen po'i sems su gyur te/ kye ma'o 'khor ba na gnas nga 'i sems can gyi sdug bsngal rna kye ma mi bzad pa yin la/ 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad kyi don du 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad bdag gis spro bar byas kyis/ sems can 'ga' yang sdug bsngal ba'i skal ba can du ma gyur cig ces sems skyes ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa'i tshor ba 'phral du rgyun chad par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas bsams pa/ ci'i phyir nga'i lus bcad pa'i tshor ba 'gags par gyur/ sog le 'ga' zhig gis bton par ma gyur grang snyam nas sog le de la bltas so/ /bltas naso kyang mchog tu yid bde bar gyur nas 'dar bar gyur to/ /'di na 'jig rten cung zad tsam gyis kyang / /kun tu nyam nga spa bkong skrag par 'gyur/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid gzhan gyi don spyod pa/ /srid na rmad byung gang de mtshungs med do//2 nas brgya byin gyis kun tu rmongs par byas pa'i mi de gnyis sog le rnon pos byang chub sems dpa'i lus kyi phyed ro smad bcad ma thag tu sa'i steng du bzhag pa dang 'gul bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rang gi lus bcad pa'i sdug bsngal mi sems par rings pa nyid du skyes bu de gnyis la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bzhin bzang dag khyed cag gnyis kyis myur du nga'i lus 'di rings pa rings par bram ze'i lus la sbyor cig de gnyicas kyis kyang de bzhin du byas so/ /sbyar ba tsam gyis lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis ji ltar skad cig mnywade nyid la rma kun tu 'byor cing mnyam par gnas pa dang mdog 'dra bar snang ba do ltar byin gyis 218

lus kyi byed bcad pa de na ji lta ba bzhin du bzhag go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas sems can thams cad la rjes su 'gro ba'i byams pa'i sems nye bar bzhag nas/ bden pa gsol bar byed cing / de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ ji ltar byang chub 'dod gyur nas/ /snying rjes lus rna btang ba la/ /ser snangamed cing zhum med pa/ /de ni 'gyod par gyur pa med/ /'gyod pa'i sems kyang med gyur na/ /bden tshigs 'ad dang legs byas pas/ /brgya byin de ni nga yi lus/ /'di rna sngon gyi ji bzhin du/ /dbang po ma lus rdzogs gyur cig /de skad ces smras ma thag tu/ byang chub sems dpa'i lus 'phral du sngon ji lta ba bzhin du gyur to//nam mkha'i dkyil na gnas pa'i lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis ngo mtshar de mthong ba dang / ngo mtshar gyi mig gdangs te/ ca co dang ga zha'i sgra sgrogs so/ /skye bo'i tshogs chen po 'di dag thams cad kyis kyang ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba dang lha dang mi rnams yid sdug bsngal bar byed pa'i cho 'phrul dang byang chub sems dpa'i lus yongs su rdzogs pa mthong ba dang /srog stor ba las slar rnyed pa bzhin du mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes so/ /'di skad ces smras te/ kye ma'o khyod ni slar 'tsho ba'i/ /ngo mtshar dag ni blta bar bgyi/ /sa dang nags su bcas pa yi/ /'jig rten 'di rna skal bar ldan/ /de'i tshe brgya byin gyis tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ kye ma'o khyod ni brtson pa drag /brtan pa nyid kyang bla na med/ /kye ma'o 318
semasacan las snying brtse/ /kyi ma'o sems can las yid brtan/ /kye ma'o mi yi 'jig rten 'di/ /mgon po khyod kyis skyong gyur te/ — /sdug bsngal chen po drag 'jigs las/ /yang dag mya ngan 'da' bar mdzod//de skad ces smras nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin mchi ma char bzhin du babs shing skad 'dzer bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' la bzod par gsol te/rgyal po chen po gang bdag gis nyams sad pa'i bsam pas/ tshor ba drag po la kun tu sbyar ba bzod par mdzod cig gzhan yang gang gi tshe khyod kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa de'i tshe na'ang bdag la dgongs shig byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ ko'u shi ka bzod kyis de bzhin du byas te ngas kyang dran par bya'o//2 ma thag tu lha yi rnga sgra yang / /nam mkha'i ngos kun gsal bar khyab par grag /lha mi dga' bas mchod pa brgya stong dag /mi dbang mthu yis bskul ba bzhin du byung / /de lta bu'i rmad du byung ba'i ltas de dag mthong zhing / lhas bstan pa drang srong des thos te 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa btsun mo rgyal ba'i 'od khrid de/ rings pa rings par byang chub sems dpa'i thad du phyin nas/ rgyal ba dang tshe spel bar byas te smras pa/lha yi bu mo bzang 'dra ba/ /lha mo sdug pa 'di rnams la/ /mgon po khyod kyis bskyang ba dang / /dge ldan 'di la dgyes par mdzod/ /khyim thab mi byed btsun mo 'di/ /'a ni khyed la 'bul lags kyis/ /khyed kyis nga rna slong ba la/ /nam du yang ni ma stsol cig /de nas byang chub 222
sems dpa' drang srong de dang lha rnams kyi dbang bos gapa par ba btab pa bzhin du bzhes so/ /'di lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa 'i spyod pa la rjes su yi rang ba de dag kyang phyir mi ldog par gyur to/ /de lta bus na skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi rjes su slob par 'dod pas bdag nyid kyi bde ba la ma chags par gzhan gyi don la brtson par bya'o/ /de bzhin du smon lam gyi mthu bsta na nga dang sangs rgyas kyi yon tan bsngags pa la'ang brjod par bya'o/ /dpal ñtsi sde'i skyes pa'i rabs te brgyad cu pa'o// //mchan 'grel ②skyes budam pa/ 'grodon chen po byed nus pa'i gang zag mchogtu gyu d+ku pa/ 0chu/ 'dir dkyus sa ma srid kyidon te chu zheng gab pa lta bu/ dudapag tshad/ rgyang grags brgyad la dpag tshad gcig ste/ 〈〈chos mngon pa mdzod〉〉las/ so ra mo nyi shu bzhi la khru/khru bzhi la rna gzhu gang ngo / /de dag lnga brgya rnams la rna/ /rgyang grags de la dgon par 'dod/ de brgyad dpa ga tshad ces bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sor nyi shu rtsa bzhi la khu dang / khru bzhi la gzhu ste 'dom gang / gzhu lnga brgya rgyang grags te de rna dgon pa'i gnas ga'adod do/ /①dpya/ 'phya ba/ dpya rna ston thog gi drug cha'isprogs te dpya khral zer ba bzhin no/ /()bkad sa/bkad sa rna zas kyigayos khang ngam zas za ba'ikhang ba zhes dbyangs can dga' blos gsungs pa ste sbyin pa'i bkad sa zhes pa lta bu/ ()rdzogs ldan/ dus bzhi phyi ma'idang po ste/ 'dzam gling mi rnams kyi chos dang / rnar/ 'dod pa/ ba ba bzhi yongs su tshang bar longs spyod pa'i dus yin/ de'i yun tshad la lo grangs sa ya gcig dang 223
bdun nga44 nyi khri brgyad stong yod par gras/sa / ②bdag nyid/tha snyad 'di rang nyid dang / rang bzhin/ bdag po sogs don duma la 'jur ste/ skabs 'dir rang bzhin nam ngo bo'idon rna/ /0sum cu rtsa gsum/ lha'iganasate ri rab kyi steng du nor lha ba cad dang / drag po bcu/ nyi ma bcu gnyis/ tha skar gyibu gnyis te nya dbang so gnyis dang lha dbang brgya gyin dang bcas sum curtsa gsum gyilha rnams rtse zhing rol ba'iganas zhes yongs su grags shing /slob dpon pad+mas/ lha'idabang po brgya byin la btsunag ro bzhiyod de/ che ba ya 'tshams ma la bu saca gnyis yod/ de 'og za ngatshams ma la nyi zla'ibu bdun yod/ 'og sha tsi ka la drag po'i bu bdun yod/ chung ba ye 'id ma la stobs ldan gyi bu drug yod/ de ltar su ma cu rtsa gnyis/ brgya byin rang dang sum cu rtsa gsum zhes kyang gsungs/ skabs 'dir snga ma ltar lha'i gnas su go dgos/ /phu'irka'u shi ku na shi ka ste lha dbang brgya byin gyi ming gi rnam grangs / ()sbyin pa/ ngo bo tsam smros na/ sbyin pa la gsum ste/ bsam pa dngos po zhing dang thabs ma dag pa bzhi spangs pa'i sgo nas bdog pa'i dngos po mtha' dag gtong ba dang / shin tu gtong ba dang / gtong ba chen po ste zang ring gi sbyin pa/ blo'i nus pa dang mthun par theg pa che chung gi chos bshad pa chos kyi spyin pa/ rgyal po stag seng me chu // pa// ༷/pa rnyi/sapa /bas mthacho /nā ṭ+wāṃ //gasta dhī dṛ pa/pa/sa pa ste/ tshul 'chal gyi gdung ba sel ba'am/ bcas rang gi kha na ma tho ba spang ba'i sems pa'o/ /⑩spru zing / spru zing sgyud pa rna 224
ba ku langs ba zhesadabyangs can dga' blosagasungs shing 'jigs pa'i nyams shig go/ /(4grang / dri ba'am thetshom ston byed kyi tshig grogs brda rnying zhig 4〉 byams pa/ sems can rnams kyi bde ba rgyu dang bcas pa thob pa bde ba dang 'phrad par 'dod pa'o zhes 〈〈bshes grangs 'grel ba〉las gsungs so/ /zhu〉snying rje/ snying rje rna sems can sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa dang ldan bzhin pa 5rnams sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa'ozhes〈〈bshes sprengs 'grel ba〉〉las gsungs shing / lcang skya rol pa'i lda rjes / snying je la rna sems can tsam la dmigs pa'i snying je dang / chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje/ dmigs med la dmigs pa'i snying rje ste gsu ma yod ces gsungs/ yoyidrang srong / lus ngag yid gsu ma g.yosgyu med par drang bo'iphyogs su srong ba/ (yilang tso/ lang tsho zhes pa'i brda sring / ⑥bag tsha ba/ 'jigs pa dang zhum pa'i don/ ⑨seng ge'ikhri/ skabs 'dir seng ge'i ri mo'am rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i khri la zer/ 4)mi ma yin/ gzugs med kyi lha 'dri/ 4spresha za/sha za ni yi dwags kyis zag ste sha khrag za ba nag po chen po la so gas pa dang / rdul khrod kyi sha za da phyag dar khrod kyi 'dre'am tshub ma'i 'dre'o zhes〈rnam 'byed 'grel ba〉〉las gsungs/ 〈〈shes rab byed pa〉〉las/ sha za rna mi la kyal ka byed pa den ngo 'am the'u rang lta bu'onas dang / 〈〈gzhi 'grel〉〉las// yi dwags nas pa ri gong ba pyir lta ba ltogs pa rnams so/ /sha zazhes bya ba rna 4 dwags kyi bye zag ste/sha khrag za ba nag po chen po la sogs pa'o napag gsungs so/ /pho'imi'am 'u/ lhasrin lde brgyad mi'ilus por sprul nas sangs rgyas kyi 225
sar chos nyan par yong bas ming de ltar thob zer ro/ /②byaschub sems dpa'/ sgra bshad tsam sna/ nyes spyon byang zhing yon tagchub pas na byang chub dang / 'thodon sems shing bdud las tshar gcod pas na sems dpa'am/ yang na/ bden pa gnyis la yang yang byang zhing de'i don chub pas byang chub/ bden pa gnyis kyi don yang yang sems pa la sran tshugs pas na sems dpa' zhes bya'o/ /pholgnod sbyin/ mi ma yin lha 'dre'irigs dang rnar lha'i rigs shig 4)dri za/ 'dod pa'i bar sred de skal ba bzang ngan gyis dri zhim pa dang mi zhim pa za ba4phyir dri za zhes bya'o/ /'dod lha'iglu mkhan gyi byi brag cig la'ang zer/ phoyilto 'phye chen po/ sa bdag gdon chen zhig 6)dmyal ba/ ngan song gsum gyi nang gses/ dmyal khams bco brgyad yod de/ tsha dmyal brgyad dang grang dmyal brgyad/nya tshe ba/ nya'akhor ba bcas so/ /()skad cig ma/ dus mtha'i ska da cig ma ni/ se gol gyi drug curtsa bzhi'i cha gcig skad cig ma de brgya la de'iskad cig ma zhes〈〈chos kyi rnam grangs rgya mtsholagater〉las byung ngo / /yichad du brjod pa/ tshig bsdus su ched brjod ces kyang bya ste/ bsngags pa brjod pa'i tshig dang rtsom la zer ()ser sna/ ser sna'i ngo bo ni/ dmigs yul rang gzhan gyi dngos rdzas sogs 'u rigs la dmigs nas rnam pa rnyed bkur la chags pa la sogs pa sa yul de rang stobs kyis dam du 'dzin pa'i rnam pa can 6da las gtong ba la gegs byad pa'i sems byung ste/ 〈〈kun btus〉〉las /ser sna gang zhe na/ rnyed pa dang bkur lte la lhag par chags nas / sta/ sdu sna ༵ spya/ pa sprispyi/tsho shādzi/ sna r+shado/ 'icha ḍi hūm̐ sprinacha sna zhes gsungs la/ rang stobs kyis yo byad dam du 'dzin pa'i sems zung nas kyang bya'o//226
bu ston rin chen grub/rje bu ston rin po che rin chen grub rna/ gtsang stod khro phu'i phyogs/ kyi shab smag sgom gnas dmun par/ yab rnying ma'i bla chen brag ston rgyal mtshan dpal bzang dang / yum bsod nams 'bum gnyis kyi sras su rab byung lnga ba'i lcags stag(spyi lo1290)lor sku 'khrungs/ ra gur lo drug pa nas 9/ yum las yi ge'i sbyor klog dang dpon rgyal seng 14 cir/ dang yi ge'i rig pa sbyangs/ dgung lo brgyad par snyang ma'i bla za tshulakhrims dpal bzang gi spyan sngar rnying ma'i chos skor ma lus zhus/gzhan yang gso ba rig pa'i skor gyi sman dpyad dang bzo rig skor gyi thig tshad kyang tsu pū gtson las/sa par mdzad/ dgung lo bco brgyad pa me stag (spyi lo 1307)lor khro phu'i mkhan chen yang rtse ba rin chen seng ges 4 dha nga 4/ po dang / dge bshes bsod nams mgon gyis slob dpon mdzad de rab byung dge tshul gyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs/ slob dpon bsod nams mgon las phar phyin dang 'dul ba tshad ma'i gzhung sogs ma lus pa gas/na te gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son/ lta ba log par lung dang rigapa ṭa pa4 sha sun phyung / mkhas pa'i grags pa dbus gtsang kun tu khyab/dgungalo nyer gsu ma pa chu byi(spyi lo 1312) lor/ dka' bzhi ba grags gzhon nus mkhan po dang / slob dpon bsod nams grags pas las 227
slob/ 'dul 'dzin bso da nam sa bzang bos gas nga ste ston pa'i slob dpon mdzad de bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa yang dag par mnos/ khro phur bar phyin dang / 'dul ba/ mngon pa bcas kyi 'chad nyan legs par mdzad/ slob ma mkhas pa mang po thon/ de nas thar ba gling du phebs nas lo tsā pa chen po thar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan slob dpon du bsten/ lo bzhi tsam la 'bad pa lhod med mdzad pas 'gran zla dang bral ba'i lo tsā ba zhig tu gyur/ dgung lo so gcig pa lcags sprel(spyi lo1320)lor zhwa lu chos sde chen mo'i gdan sa bzung / sngags pa dang mtshan nyid kyi bshad grwa btsugs nas dam chos 'chad spel mdzad/ zhwa lu ri phug tu gtsug lag khang dge 'dun sde gsar du bzhengs/ snar thang gi bstan 'gyur la zhu dag mdzad cing〈〈dkar chag yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi rgyal po'i phreng pa〉〉zhes pa bsgrigs/ sngags dang mtshan nyid kyi bshad grwa chen po btsugs/dgung lo nga lnga ba rab byung drug pa'i shing sprel(spyi lo1344)lor gong ma'i gser yig pa 'byor nas rgya nag tu phebs dgos par zhus kyang dgos pa chen po med par dgongs te ma phebs par dben par sgra dang gusang sngags kyi gzhung mang po 'phro bsgyur dang gzhi bsgyur mdzad/ re gnyis pa lcags yos lor g.ya' phag gnyis kyi 'khrug pa bsdum pa'i ched du dbus phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur/ phebs lam kun tu dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtse bstsal / skal ldan skye bo mang po smin grol gyi lam la bkod/ phyi lor byang chub mchod rten chen mo bzhengs shing rab gnas mdzad/ chu sbrul lor dpal ldan sa skyar byon/ sa skya'i lha khang che na mor dpal rno rje dbyings kyi 228
dkyil 'khor khru bcu gcig can rin thang gzhal du med pa'i rin po ji sna getshogs la sa grub pa bkod pa phul du byung ba bzhengs/ 〈〈gzhal yas khang gi rnam gzhag de nyid gsal ba〉〉zhes pa ljags rtsom gasmod/ dgung lo bdun cu don lnga ba rab byung drug pa'i shing 'brug(2 lo1364)lor sku gshegs/khong gi gsung chos ni/ nyid kyi thugs sras sgra tshad pa rin chen rnam rgyal gyis pod ka pa nas sha pa'i bar po ti nyer bdun du bsdus pa bzhugs//rang gi slob ma la zhe thag pa nas gros 'debs pa'i yi ge snying gi thug ma/sa ste pra dza 6 bu ston gyis rang gi slob ma la zhe thag pa nas gros 'debs pa'i yi ge snying gi thur ma zhes r+bha ba/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis bskal pa'i bskal par dka' ba dpag med kyis/ /tshogs gnyisaXrab bsgrubs byang chub bdud : mchog brnyes nas/ /'gro ba nyon mongs nad kyis gdungs pa'i gdung sel pa/ /sman pa'i rgyal po thub dbang de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi yi cha lugs dge snyong tshul las ma g.yo sa kyang / /nang gi tshul khrims nyon mongs dbang gis rul gyur pa/ /kugriṇ+ḍa yi shing thog smin pa lta bu yi/ /snying med po khyed don 'de rnams la bsam mdo thongs/ /rgya mtsho chen por phyogs bzhi'i rlung gis229
gadrung ba yi/ /gnya' zhing bu gar rus sbal mgrin pa chud pa ltar/ /shin tu rnyed dka'i mi lus rin chen thob gyur nas/ /don me da chu zos rdzu gh+nā /ji ༵ shāX ltaraX ma' kau mita /rta/na mar/ shis spyang rnye/ sadapazlod rnyes dzo( naring yud tsam zhig kyang gnas par nus pa'i gdeng med la/ /gshin rje'i kha ru nges par chud pa mi shes sam/ /bstan pa'i snying po tshul khrims bslab pa rin po che/ /'phral dang yun du bde legs thams cad 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /med thabs med pa'i tshul khrims rin chen dor nas ni/ /dga' dka' ltar snyad ci ste khyod kyi snying ma gas/ /tshul khri rnas 'chal ba'i 'bras bu mi bzad0de/ /ltung ba yang rim bzhin du yang sosazlosogs/ /dmyal ba rnams su rim bzhin skye bar gsungs/ /zla ba sgron mas zhus pa'i mdo las kyang / /ji snyed chos kyi rnam pas byang chub kyang / /thos pas rgyags ()nas tshul khrims mi bsrung na/ /tshul khrims 'chal bas ngan 'gro der 'gro ste/ /de la thos pa mang pos bskyab mi nas/ /khyod ni gser snod mi gtsang 'phyags pa bzhin/ /dal 'byor mi lus thob pa chud gsan te/ /long med tshe 'di bag med spyod pas zad/ /shi nas ngan 'gror 'gro ba mi 'tsher ram/ /las 'bras mi shes blun po mi 'jigs pa/ /bden mod khyod ni sde snod yiridon shes shing / /dkar nag rgyu 'bras shes shing bag med par/ /spyod pa khyo da nying lcags kyi gar bu'am ci/ /log par g.yem pas dmyal ba bsdus 'joms6)su/ /gsal shis()'bar bas ro smad 'drags par 'gyur/ /de nas 230
mi ru skyes kyang ma nitha 'gyur/ /▶▶ lam bud med spyad pas ro myang yang / /dmyal ba pad+ma ltar gas nang du rna/ /bum par 'tshod cing gtun gyis 'tshig 'gyur na/ /dngos su spyod pa lta yang smos 'u dgos/ /༷sa ༷zlo snaX /sa tshul buX nameXd klub dbya//sa thos/ /pa ṭ+wāṃ k+ṣiṃ rnyi // 'bar rna bar ro nya bskol pa zhug par skye/ /bud med glu dang gar la chags pa yis/ /khu ba phyung nas 'gyod par mi byed pa/ /lcags kyi me mdag char ba 'u sa la 'bab/ /gzhan gyi chung ma la spyad rdzun smra ba/ /ngu 'bod chen por mun pas kun khyab par/ /spyi bo nas ngu ga lce chung bcad kyang ni/ /skad cig re re skye zhing gcod par skye/ /mi ru skyes kyang dpus long 'on pa dang / /lam zan slong ba dag tu k+shi bar 'gyur/ /dge bsnyen ma la log par g.yem pa yis/ /rab tu tsha bar thal ba'i lhag ma yang / /med par bsreg cing tshe rabs bzhi brgya ru/ /za ma dag tu skye bar 'byur pa yin/ /grogs kyi chung ma bslus nas spyad pa yi/ /rab tshe 65 la la zhes zer ba ru/ /skyes nas tsha ba'i rlung gis phyogs bcur 'khyer/ /tshe rabs stong phrag du mar yi dwags()su/ /skyes nas rang gi sha la za ba dang / /phag tu skyes nas ma sha za ba dang / /mi ru skyes nas pho mtshan gcod par 'gyur/ /bla ma'i chung ma log par g.yem pa yis/ /snying rje chen po zhes pa nang 'og tu/ /mtshon cha gnyas kyis gcod par skye bar 'gyur/ /mi ru skyes na btsas ma thag tu 'chi/ /bdag nyid mi dbang bu mo la spyad pas/ /krad par seng ge sgal gyis 4ba los/sa dang / /rgyab 231
nas ltag gi4ri za zhir mes bsreg la/ /gshin rje phyogs rnams kun nas mda' 'phen 'gyur/ /bud med mtshan ma snyan ngag gis bstod pa/ /skye ba lnga brgyar mngal gyi srin 'bur skye/ /chags pas spyad cing reg pas smos ci dgos/ /khrims 'chal yul 'khor bsod snyoms spyod pa ni/ /lcags gong me lce 'bar ba za bar skye/ /khrims 'chal dge 'dun btung ba 'thung ba yis/ /zangs zhuga'agu gi'abung bar 4gu 'gyur/ /thos ldan khyod la mang du smos ci dgos/ tshul khrims 'chal bas sa ni 7 ma gang dang / /zas ni kham gcig btung ba chu phor gang / /tsam zhig dge 'du na rdzas la longs spyad na/ log 'tshoyiyin te dmyal bar skye bar gsu nga / /de sogs nyes dmigs dpag med mdo las gsungs/ /gal te khyod ni sdig lta'i dbang gyur te/ /ma mthong 'bras la yid mi ches na yang / /mthong ba'i chos kyi nyes dmigs mang po zhig /rang gi blo yis mthong bar ma gyur tam/ /dal 'byor lus la bsgab gsum rgyan dang ldan/ /bstan la zhugs nas sgrub pa gtsor byed pa'i/ /dge slo ra 'dus nas las la spyod pa'i tshe/ /shing rul bzhin du spong ba ma mthong nga' / /bstan pa'i mtshor skyes lags bshad 'dab stong can/ /bslab gsum dri bsung rab tu 'phro ba la/ /tshul khrims zang ji don gnyer bung ba 'du/ /sad khyer me tog bung bas mi spong ngam/ /tshul khrims mchod rten legs bshad bang rim can/ /bshes gnyan gser gyi mchod rten mthong ba'i tshe/ /da da ldan skye bos phyag dang mchod pa byed/ /mi gtsang mi gtsang khyod dor ma mthong ngam/ /re snod thos pa'i cha shas yongs 232
rdzogs shing / /bslab gsum dri med ri dwasas mtshan mas brgyan/ /snyan pa'i bsil zer 'phro ba'i 'od dkar can/ /gzas bzung mya ngan byed pa ma mthong ngam/ /mi 'jigs smra ba'i spobs pa dang ldan yang / /lung rigs chos smra seng ge'i khri steng du/ /sngon chad rang bas dman dang mnyam pos kyang / /wa skyes yin zhes brtas pa ma mthong ngam/ /sngon chad rang gi yon tan cha tsam yang / /bkun par mi nas gsar bu slo ta'i tshogs/ /thos pa'i nor bu'i gdengs nas mdzes pa'i sbrul/ /shi ba'i ro bzhin brtas pa ma mthong ngam/ /sngon chad rang gis bskyangs shing smin pa'i 'khor/ /legs bskyod zer gyis blo gros kha phye rnams/ /mtshan phyed dus kyi pad+mo ji bzhin du/ /ngo 'dzum rab tu zum pa ma mthong ngam/ /sngon chad rang gis rgyud rgyang tshogs gsum gyis/ /phan btags gyur pa'i grogs ngan srin bya'i tshogs/ /gtam snyan nyi 'od nub nas gtam ngan gyis/ /skad ngan phyogs bcur sgrog pa ma mthong ngam/ /sngon nas rang la phan 'dogs 'dris 'brel ba'i/ /ma bzhin sha tsha snying nye'i grogs mchog kun/ bu gces shi ba'i ma ma ji bzhin du/ /mya ngan khang bur bcug pa ma mthong ngam/ /sngon chad rang la phrag dog 'gran sems can/ /mi mnyam mnyam du re ba 'byung bo'i bya/ /gtam ngan bun pas 'thibs par shes nas ni/ /skad ngan gad mo dgod pa ma mthong ngam/ /sngon chad 'gras 'dris med pa'i lam chen mi/ /chags snang gnyis nas dben pa'i skye bo yang / /lo legs snye ma sad kyis khyer mthong nas/ /mya ngan ca co 55] pa ma mthong ngam/ /ston chad chos dang zang zing gnyis ka yis/ /23 2
