cad brtag/ pa dang / /thams cad dang yang mdza' ba 'thob par 'gyur/ /longs spyod rnams la sman gyi 'du shes kyis/ /gnas na 'dod pa log par mi spyod cing / /longs spyo ga rnams la ma chags spyod par 'gyur/ /rang la bdag med pa yi 'du shes kyis/ /gnas na chos don gnyer zhing bshes gnyen gyi/ /drung song dag chos sgrub la 'jug par 'gyur/ /rgyal po chen po don de dgongs mdzod la/ /rtag tu 'du shes brgyad la gnas par mdzod/ /chos bzhi ldan na log par mi nyung bar/ /yid gnyis yang dag 'jog pa'i mdo las gsungs/ /bstan pa bsung dang mi dge'i chos la smod/ /sgo gsum chos 'dzin byang chub sems bskyed ⑨de/ /'di bzhi ldan na rgyal rigs dbang bskur ba/ /sangs rgyas mnyes shing longs spyod phun chobs 'gyur/ /mi yi dbang po bstan pa bsung ba'i tshul/ /dkon mchog gsum la gnod pa kun spangs te/ /gus pas bsnyen bkur chos kyi rjes 'jug na/ /bstan pa bsung bar mdo sde dag las gsungs/ /rgyal po khyed kyis dge 'dun dbang ba yi /zhing gzhis la sogs yo byad mi 'phrog 'tshal/ de dag 'phrog pa'i rgyal rigs ngan pa las/ /tshe 'di nyid la gnyan gyis 'bor ba sogs/ /mi 'dod chos ni nya shu 'byung 'gyur zhing / /shi nas mnar med yidamyal bar skye 'gyur te/ /bskal pa'i bar du zangs zhun 'thung 'gyur zhing / /me yi gos rgyan tho 'u ma zas za 'a / /de nas thar yang yi dwags dud 'gro'i lus/ /du kha bsam las 'das pa myong 'gyur zhing / /mi ru skyes kyung sangs rgyas med pa yi/ /zhing du long ba mi sdug par 'gyur 245
nas/ /nyi ma'i snying bo'i mdo ③las gsungs pa legs/ /mi dbang chen po snyigs ma'i dge sbyong 'gas/ srog gcod la sogs nyes chen byas na yang / /gnas nas bskrad cing longs spyod dang phral la/ /rjes su mthun pa'i ngag gi chad pas gcad/ /de yi lus la bzhu bzag mi bgyi ste/ /byas na bde ba kun las nyams pa dang / /phyi mar mnar med gnas su skye 'gyur zhing / /tshe 'dir lha yi bsrung ba dang bral ba'i/ /nyes dmigs rnam pa mang po 'byung 'gyur bar/ /zla ba'i snying bo'i mdo yilas gsungs pa lags/ /mi dbang khyed kyis rab tu byung ba yi/ /rtags tsam 'dzin la'ang gnod pa mi bgyi ste/ /sngon tshe srin po yi dwags rigs skyes dang / /glang chen dud 'gro'i skye gnas tshoskyes pas kyang / /ngur smrig rgyan pa'i mi la'ang 'tshe spangs te/ /shin tu gus par byas par gyur la ltos/ /rgyal rigs gdol bas dge sbyong gnod byas na/ /dge rtsa chad nas dmyal bar gzhol bar 'gyur/ /dus gsum sangs rgyari ri kun gyis spang bar 'gyur/ /de bas bzod pa ⑨ma thob rgyal po yis/ /dge bcu'i las lam bzung ste gnas par bya/ /de la yul 'khor longs spyo da dbang phyug gnang / /dge bcu mi ldan rgyal rigs gdol ba ste/ /bstan pa bshig nas mnar med 'gro 'gyur te/ /de bas rtag tu bsgrims pa myur blangs nas/ /dkon mchog gsum gus dam chos mi spang zhing / /tshul khrims ldan nam 'chal yang dge slong la/ /'tshe spangs bsnyen bkur theg chen 'dzin 'jug na/ /rgyal rigs de rna log par ri 6 nga 'gyur/ /tsa nu/ nga/ ka ni sad kyis phog na yang / /me tog phal ba rnams las khyad 246
par 'phags/ /de phyir bstan sung tshul ldan smos ci dgos / /tshul cakhrim sa 'chal ba'ang bsrung zhing mchod byed na/ /de la bsod na' ṭag chadmed skye 'gyur zhing / /lha la sogs pas bsrung ba bcu bsrung 'es/ /'khor lo bcu ba'i mdo ཿla gsungs pa yin/ /de ltar ma dzad sbra sdib/ pa 'i chos smos pa'ang / /gdon mi za bar 'grub par 'gyur bas na/ /khyod kyis bstan pa bsung zhing mi dge spang / /sngon tshe thub pas lo grangs drug cu ru/ /rgyal srid byas nas bskal pa drug cur ni/ /dmyal bar bsregs par 'gyur zhes gsungs pa yang / /rgyal srid dbang gis mi dge spyad pas nongs/ /blo gros chen po de bas rgyal srid dang / /btsun mo gnyen 'dun longs spyod rgya chen kun/ /gshegs pa'i shul du slad rjes mi 'brang gi/ /rig pa'i las ni grib ma bzhin du 'brang / /de phyir bdag dang gzhan la phan 'dod pas/ /srog la bab kyang mi dge mi spyad kyi/ /sgo gsum longs spyod chos kyi phyogs su thongs/ /'bangs rnams dge ba'i la sa la bskul bar mdzod/ /de la'ang lta ba rnam par dag 'tshal bas /chos rnams ngo bo rgyu 'bras ma grub pa/ /stong nyidayimatshan med ⑤smon pa med pa ⑥yi/ /chos ni blo chen khyed kyis bsgom par mdzod/ /gzugs ni dbu ba rdos pa lta bu ste/ /tshor ba0chu yi chu bur lta bu yin/ /'du shes phung pon+t+rasmig rgyu'i chu dang mtshungs/ /'du byed ②chu shing sdong bu lta bu ste/ /rnam par shes pa sgyu ma'i skyes bu ltar/ /rang bzhin med cing dngos pos stong bas na/ /mi dbang khyod kyis rnam pa thams cad du/ /dngos por 'dzin pa'i yigadon ri gzhom 'tshal 'o / /de lta ra khams drug 247
rang nganin stong nyid du/ /thub pa'i dbang pos rgyal po zas gtsang 'a /yab sras mjal ba'i mdo②la sa gdan sa pa ba'i/na/ /chos rgyal khyod kyis nyams su blang ngar mdzod/ /de lta ra chos rnams rang ba'in stong ba ru/ /dngos por zhen pa'i 4/don byis nyan pa yi/ /mar gyur /dpo ba du kha'i mtshor gling ba/ /bsgral phyir byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed mdzod/ /de ltar bla med byang chub sngon pa yi/ /phan yo na bsam gyis mi khyab na do las gsungs/ /de yi bslab par bya ba mdor bsdus pa'ang / /ston pas rgyal po masal rgyal la gsungs pa/ /khyod rna 6 95 byed pa mang po ste/ /nyin dang mtshan mo rnaca/ pa thams cad du/ /phar phyin drug la bslab pa ra mi nus kyi/ /de bas khyed kyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub la/ /dad 'dun don du yonyer dang slon pa ni/ /'gro 'chag nyal 'dug rgyun du dran pa ra gyis/ /sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang so skye dang / /bdag gi dus gsum dge ba kun bsdus nas/ /myang 'das mtshungs par rjes su yi rang mdzod/ /de yi dge bas sangs rgyas byang sems dang / /nyan thos rang rgyal rnams la mchod par 'bul/ /phul nas sems can rnams dang thun mong mdzod/ /de nasa'agro kun rnam mkhyen 'thob pa'i phyir/ /nyin gcig bzhin du rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsngosaphome/ /de ltar byas na rgyal srid skyong byed la/ /rgyal po'i bya ba rnam sa kyang nyams mi 'gyur/ /byang chub tshogs kyang rdzogs par 'gyur ro nge du gsungs pa bzhin du thugs nyams bzhes par rigs/ brtan pa khyod kyis rang gi rgyud tshod dang / /byang sems sdom pa'i sa/nas lu gas dang sbyar te/ /248
gal te nus na khyod kyi nus pa bzhin/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom spra blang bar mdzod/ /blangs nas nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo sde la sa/ /gsungs pa'i rtsa ba'i ltung ba lnga/ /dang po dkon mchog gsum gyi nor 'phrog pa/ /gnyis pa dam pa'i chos ni spong bar brjod/ /gsum pa tshul khrims 'chal ba'i dge slong la/ /ngur smrig 'phrog bdeg bcan du 'jug pa dang / /bzhi ba mtshams med lnga 'o②byed pa ste/ /lnga ba log par lta ba ②'dzin pa yin/ /'di lnga rgyal pos lhag par spong bar bya/ /gzhan ya nga byang sems sdom pa'i mi mthun phyogs/ rtsa ltung nyes byas la sogs ma lus spang / /de yi gnyen po chos la kun nas bslab/ /gal te kyed kyis bslab pa ma lus pa/ /rkyen 'ga'i dbang gis rtogs par ma gyur na/ /ri ltar byas kyang ltung bar mi 'gyur ba'i/ /gnad kyi gnas bzhi dag la bslab par bya/ /lus dang longs spyod dus gsum dge ba rnams/ /sems can kun la ltos med gtang ba dang / /de rnams bsrung dang dag dang spel ba bya/ /de bzhis byang sems bslab spra mthar phyin 'gyur/ /de rnams sgrub byed yang dag spong ba ba'i// /dranachadang shes bzhin②bag yo da ②tshul bzhin sems/ /bdag dang gzhan du mnyam du brje ba bsgom/ /rgyal sras zhi ba lhaphoyiyi man ngag lags/ /de ltar bgyis na sa chen skyong ba khyed/ /rgyal srid chos dang ldan pa byed par 'gyur/ /phyi mar lha dang mi yi rgyal srid thob/ /myur du rnam mkhyen thob par gdon mi za/ /de ltar chos ldan chos kyi rgyal po la/ /chos la skul ba'i 'phrin yid chos ldan 'di/ /chos 'dod chos la gus pa 'i rin 249

med pa zhes gsungs/ 47log par lta ba/ rang yul la rang stobs kyis med par lta ba'i sems byung ste/ 〈〈kun btus〉〉las/ log par lta ba gang zhe na/ rgyu'am 'bras bu'am byed pa la skur ba 'debs pa dang yod pa'i dngos po 'jig pa ste log par rnam par rtog pa'i bzod pa dang 'dod pa dang blo gros dang rtog pa dang lta ba gang yin pa ste da ba'irtsa ba gcod pa'i las can dang mi dge ba'i rtsa ba dam du 'dzin pa'irten rgyud pa'i la sa can dang / mi dge ba la 'jug pa'i las can dang / dge ba la mi 'jug pa'i la sa can nozhes gsungs pa ltararo// pho)dran pa/ rang yul la rab stobs kyis mi bajed pa'i sems byung ste/ 〈kun btus〉〉las/ dran pa gang zhe na/ 'dris pa'i dngos po la sems kyis brjed pa med pa ste rnam par mi g.ye nga ba'ilas can rna zhes gsungs pa lta buyin/ 47shes bzhin/ shes bzhin gyi mtshan nyid rna/ dmigs yul sgo gsum gyi bya ba ci rigs la dmigs nas rnam pa rang stobs kyis legs nyes kyi bya ba gar 'jug ngos zin pa'i sems byung ste/ dbye na shes bzhin ma yin pa dang bsres pa'i shes bzhin gsum yod la/ sgo gsum bya ba gang 'jug shes bzhin du spyod du 'jug pas shes bzhin du bshad do zhes 〈〈don gsal rin sgron〉〉las gsungs/ (yibag yod/ rang stobs kyis sems mi mthun phyogs las sung ba'i sems byung ste/ 〈〈kun btus〉las/ bag yod gang zhe na/ ma chags pa dang zhe sdang med pa dang gti bug me pa brtson 'grus dang bcas pa la gnas nas gang dge ba'i chos rnams bsgom pa dang zag pa'i chos rnams las sems byung ba ste 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das 3ri 'i phunasum tshogs pa 254
mas cad yongs surdzogs par rgyad pa dang yongasasusbrub pa'i las can rnams gsungs/ ②zhi ba lha/ spyi 'o 'i dus rabs bdun pa'am brgyad pa'i rgya gar rgyal po dge ba'i go cha'i sras te/ chung ming zhi ba'igo cha zer zhing na len+d+rar rab tu byung / 〈〈byang chub sems dpa'i spyo da pa la 2jug pa〉〉dang / 〈byang chub sems dpa'i bslab btus 〉〉sogs brtsams chos mang / snyolarten 'brel/ rten 'brel gyi skad dod legs sbyar la/ pra tī bya sa ṭa t+pā da zhes 'byung b.las ṭ+wā bya rna mang po 'tshogs shing 'dus pa'am 'phrad pa'i don yin la/ sa phu t+pā da ni bskyed pa'am 'byung ba'idon yin pas/ dngos po gang rung gcig la sa 'bras bu sna tshogs dang / rgyu sna tshogs la sa 'bras bu gcig kho na skye ba rna mi srid pas/ rgyu rkyen sna tshogs 'phrad cing tshogs pa la ltos nas 'bras bu sna tshogs su'abyung ba'am/ yan lag snga ga la brten cing 6 ma 'brel bar 'byung ba'ichos nyid la dzo/ (spres mo yos kyi lo/ rab byung drug pa'i sa b+thā yos kyi lo ste spya lo1339lo yin/255
ā+o sa tshe m+mu rab 'byam sa pa bri med 'od h+pha hrū/rdzogs chen pa ḍi sbo/la 'dod pa po ting ma'i slob dpon klong chen pa dri med 'od zer ram/ ming gzhan tshul khrims blo gros zhes pa ni/ rab byung drug pa'i sa pho spre'u(spyi lo1308) lor yab bstan pa sung dang yum 'brog bza' bso da nams rgyan gnyis kyi sras su dbus lho g.yo ru gra'i cha stod grong du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo lnga'i steng nas slob gnyer gyi dbu btsugs/ snga gzhug tu kurma pa rang byung rdo rje/ sa skya bdaka chen/ rnying ma rig 'dzin ku mā rā dza sosas mkhas cagrub mang po slob dpon du bsten/ g.yag sde paṇa chen gyi mdun du dogs 0grol mar du mdzad/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs ma lus pa thugs su chud de rma khas pa'i dzo 'phang brnyes/ dbus gtsang gi dgon gnas phal mo che dang / khyad par du rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi dpal chu bo ri dang o rgyan yul sogs su zhabs kyis bcags/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab/ chu stag (spyi lo1362)lha shā ra〈〈chos 'byung rin po che'i gter mdzod〉〉ces pa phyag rtsog/ mdzad/dgung lo nga drug pa rab byung drug pa'i chu yo sa (spyi lo1363) lor dpal bas ma yas mchims phu ru nu gsher/sa/256
khong gi gsung chos ni/ khams pa chos grags bzang pos mdzad pa'i 〈〈kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer gyi rnam thar mthong ba don ldan〉〉zhes pa ltar na/ phyi'i gnas thun mong gi skor bstan bcos dgu bcu swo lnga/ nang gi gnas rgya cher bshad pa'i bstan bcos chig brgya nyer brgyad/ gsang ba'i gnas de kho na nyid ston pa'i bstan bcos sum cu ste gsung chos nyis/ brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum bzhugs par grags/po ta la kun tu dga' ba'i gtam/rgya gar skad du/ po ta la ā na rnya pā ri/ bod skad du/ po ta la0kun tu dga' ba'i gtam/ 'phags spru spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang sku mchog tu dkar zhing 'dzum pa'i mtshan dpes①mdzes pa'i ri bong 'dzin/ /kun mkhyen ri dwags gzugs brnyan gyis bkra phrin las 'od dkar phreng ba can/ /ma lus 'gro rgyud skye bo'i mkhar khyab gdul bya'i ting mun sel ba'i lha/ /gau rī rin chen mtshan mo'i mig ni de ring bdag blo'i kun+dar skyoras/ /yid 'ong pad+ma'i steng na 'dzum pa'i sku/ /'gying bcas kun ltar dkar 'od stong 'phro/ /lha yi lhar gyur mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /yon tan rgyan rnams rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don zab rgya mtsho'i gling nas legs 'khrungs shing / /snyan tshig me tos mdangs bkra 'phags pa'i ri/ /mthong thos dran pas bde ba ster ba'i gnas/ /357
shar ri'i rgyal bo gru 'dzin bsngags par bgyi//de yang 'de ltar gangs ri'i rgyud/ chu bo lo nyi ta dal gyis 'bab pa'i 'gram/ rang byung gi bde bar gshegs pa'i bzhugs gnas/ sngon gyi sems dpa' chen po dag gis bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang dang / skye shing snag po'i phreng bas bskor pa'i grong dag skye bo mang pos gang zhing /'dod rgya'i tshogs kyis mngon par 'byor ba'i yul 'khor bzang po dpal ▶▶gyi bsam yas zhes bya ba yod de/ kyun po'i0lho phyogs gangs ri'i ra ba'i rgyud/ /sngon gyi sems dpa' du ma byon pa'i gnas/ /skye bos gang ba'i grong dang gtsug lag khang / /rang byung thub dbang rgyal po'i mgon dang bcas/ /de dang lho phyogs su ha cang yang mi ring ba zhig na/ rtswa ljang ser gyi myu gus khyab pa'i sa phyogs skye shing sna tshogs kyi sngon pas bskor zhing me tog gi tshal na bung ba snyan par sgrogs pa'i gzhir yid du 'ong ba'i chu pad+ma'i drwa bas khebs par/ ngur ba mang pos glu len cing khrung khrung bde bar rgyu ba'i dzing bu shin tu nyams dga' ba zhig na/ ngang ba'i rgyal po tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / mang du thos pa rgya mtsho'iXchus brlan par byas pa zhig kyang 'dug par gyur to/ /lhag bsam rdzing bu'i nang na gnas pa'i bya/ /thos pa'i lus bzang brtson pa'i 'dab gshog can/ /don bzang bdud rtsi'i btung ba rab 'thungs nas/ /nyams dang rtogs pa'i dar dir sgra 'byin mdzes//de'i tshe grong dang gtsug lag khang rnams ni sdig spyod dag gis gang ste chos bzhin du spyod pa rnams la 'tshe zhing / rab tu byung ba dag kyang thos 258
pa 5 54 chu nar khrim ṭa ge dang nying nge 'dzin don du mi gnyer zhing 'dod yon ②gyi dzir pur 'bab la/ khyim pa rnams kyang ngo tsha dang gna' po'i gzhung lugs bzang po dag las nyams te/ dkon mchog dang pha ma mi mchod cing ngan g.yo'i rnam par spyod pas gnas pa mthong nas/ skye bo dam pa rnams kyi yid kyang mngon par skyo zhing / tshul bzhin du spyod pa kha cig smre sngags 'byin pa ni/ kye ma deng sang phyogs 'dir rna/ /gna' dus bzang po'i nyi ma nub/ /da dus ngan pa'i zla shar bas/ /dam pa'i pad+mo zum pa dang / /mnyam du sdig spyod kun+da rgyas/ /bdud sde'i can pas khebs pa bzhin/ /rin chen ljon shing sprul gdug dag gis dkris/ /skye bo dam pa'i mtsho bsil rdzing bu bskams/ /bstan pa'i nyin byed nub ri'i rtser lhung zhing / /legs ldan 'gro ba'i mig kyang ldong la ltos/ /zhes pa'i gtam gleng ba rdzing bur thos te/ ngang ba'i rgyal po de yang yid skyo bar gyur pa dang / nam zhig gi tshe ri bo gangs can nas 'ongs pa'i lha'i 6 kha cig chu 'dzin dul ba sna tshogs kyi shing rtar zhugs te/ sil snyan 'khrol zhing glu gar byed bzhin pas spos chu'i rgyun dang me tog gi char 'phebs shing / nam mkha'i lam nas shar phyogs su 'gro ba mthong ste/ngang ba'i rgyan ga pos mas pa/ sprin gyi bzhon pa'i cang na lha tshogs dag /mchod pa'i 'od zer phyogs bcur rab 'gyed cing / /rol mo sil snyan bstod dbyangs 'brug sgra can/ /grags chen 'di dag gang du bzhud dam kye/ /lha de dag gis smras pa/ shar ri'i dbang po yid 'ong po ta la/ /drang srong spyan ras gzigs kyi pho brang du/ /sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin 259
casarab mchol cing / /dushāri 5 kyi rnga sgra zab mo nyan du 'gro/ /ngang ba'i rgyal ngo sa smras ba / kye dbang po dag gnas de'i yon tan dang dkod pa ji lta bu/ lhas smya/sa pa/ yid 'ong 'phas/sa pa'i bzhugs gnas po ta la/ /mdzes shing nyams dga' drang srong chen po'i gnas/ /mchod pa'i sgrin gyi 'od zer phyogs bcur0'gro/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang bzhugs gnas de 'dra'o/ /skyed tshal me tog bung ba 'phur ldeng zhing / /mtsho bsil rdzing bu tsan+dan nags khrod rnams/ /bya dang ri dwags mang pos rab tu gang / /spyan ras gzigs dbang bzhugs gnas de 'dra'o/ /shar ri rgyal po'i rtse nas nyi shar bas/ /'jig rtem 'od kyi snang ba phyogs bcur 'gyed/ /ma rig mun pa sel ba'i dpal du shar/ /spyan ras tra zigs dbang bzhu4 gas gnas de 'dra'o/ /yangs nga/'i 'od dang ldan grub nyi zla'i 'od/ /sna tshogs 'od dang rin chen rgya mtsho'i 'od/ /'dres dang ma 'dres 'o no zer phyogs bcur 'gro/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang bzhugs gnas de 'dra'o/ /shing dang 'bab chu nam mkha'i khams kun nasari / /sna tshogs chos kyi sgra dbyangs rgyun me 'chad/ /bsdod kyis/ mi langayo na tan rin chen gter/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang bzhugs gnas de 'dra'o / /dri mtsho 'dir gnas thar ba ga la yod/ /zhi ba'i chal du kun nas 'gro 'dod na/ /shar ri gru 'dzin 'jig rten dbang po'i yonas / /spyan ras gzigs mgon bzhugs der sgom du 'a dos0/ /zhes brjod pa dang / ngang bas smras pa/ gnas der 'gro ba'i lam ni gang / nya sa smras pa/ gangs ri'i yul gyi shar phyogs 260
na/ /me to0 rgyas pa 'i skyed mos tshal/ /'od zer smin nas ñtsa ba yod/ /de dbus rgyal sras pho brang ni/ /gangs ri rin chen ldan zhes bya/ /de yi drung nas shar phyogs su/ /chu klung dri med ldan yang 'bab/ /de 'das rgya mtsho'i 'gralazhig na/ /skye bo mang pos gang ba yi/ /grong khyer tshangs pa'i 'byung gnas yod/ /der ni khyed cag ngal sos la/ /shar ri rgyal po'i lam yang dris/ /zhes brjod de shar phyogs logs su song nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /yon tan dga' ba rnams kyi chos tshul rna/ /dam pa rnams la brten nas rab tu skye/ /bdud rtse'i char gyis dbyar kyi pad mtsho bzhin/ /ngang ba'i rgyal po mchog tu dga' bar gyur//de'i tshe ngang ba'i rgyal po de yang 'dzo 'dod par gyur nas smras pa/rdzing bu'i gnas 'a4 me tog 'bras mang zhing / /yid lha nga ngang ba'i grogs dang ldan na yang / /sna tshogs yul gyi nyasapasarab skyo zhing / /nags kyi yo na tan thos nas gzhan du 'gro/ /zhes brjod pa/ ngur ba mang pos smras pa/ pad+ma'i mtsho na bya tshogs sgra 'byin zhing / /ge sar gsar bas rkang drug myos pa'i tshal/ /bsil bu'i dzing bu 'di dag lhan cig tu/ /bdag cag btang nas 'dab bzang gang du bzhud/ /ngang bas smras pa/ gling gi snying po 'dzam gling shar gyi phyogs/ /ri b+thā ta la legs par brgyan pa ste/ /sman shing me tog ljon pa'i phreng bas dkrigs/ /spyan ras gziyos dbang bzhugs der sgom du 'gro/ /nam yang bde med 'khor ba dug sbrul gling / /las dang nyon mongs0brgyas gtsis grong 261
khyer las/ /zhi ba rin chen gling 'gro thar ba'i gnas/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang bzhugs der sgom du 'gro/ /chags dang 'jungs zhukhung ser snas ma bsags pas/ /'gro kun dga' ba'i nor ni bdag la med/ /chog shes 'phags pa'i rnar dang ldan pa yis/ /spyan ras gzigs dngang bzhugs der sgom du 'gro/ /mdza' dang mi mdza' de bzhin bdag gi lus/ /lhan cig 'dus kyang so sor 'gyes chos can/ /mi rtaga.asnying po med pa'i tshul mthong nas/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang bzhugs der sgom du 'gro/ /thugs rje gangs ri'i ngos la nyi shar bas/ /rmad byung byin rlabs chu rgyun bsil ba 'bab/ /'gro blo gdung ba'i me tshogs zhi mdzad pa/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang bzhugs der sgom du 'gro/ /zhes brjod pa dang / bya'i tshogs de dag gdung ba'i spre sngags 'byin zhing / me tog la sogs pas mchod de bskor pa byas nas ngang ba'i rgyal po de'i zhebs drung na 'khod de/ kye 'dab bzang bdag cag rnams la dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i dga' ston mchog tu gyur pa dag ston cig ces brjod pa dang / ngang bas smras pa/ grogs dag tshe ni ston dzi'i sprin ltar g.yo/ /bsags pa 'dzad cing 'dus pa rnams kyang 'bral/ /'byor ba rgud cing mi rtag snying po med/ /'gro ba 'di dag mtha' bzhi'i yochos can du/ /de ring nyid nas jes par rtogs par bya/ /las dang nyon mongs chu klung bzlog dka' zhing / /sdug bsngal rba la bas shugs drag bzod par dka'/ /ye ma thar dka' srid pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /de ring nyid nas brgal phyir brtson par bya/ /byis pa rnams ni sprul dug khrod 262
'dra 7nga / /'dod yon rnams ni lan tshwa'i chu dang mtshungs/ /mdor na 'khor ba'i nyes pa sna tshogs dag /de ring nyid nas nges par rtogs par bya/ /deng nas zhi ba'i yon tan dran bya zhing / /dben pa'i gnas su byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /yangs pa'i stan la bde ba'i lus bsrangs te/ /sems kyi gnas lugs ji bzhin gnyug ma'i don/ /rang bzhin spros dang bral ba'iyingang la zhog /rjes la 'khor gsumachadag pa'i bsngo ba bya/ /stong ba'i 'dab stong snying rje'i snying ba can/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma myur du 'byon par nges/ /zhes brjod 2 ring bu'i gnas de nas song ba na/ ngur ba'i tshogs mang po de dag gis shar phyogs su gangs ri'i ra ba mthong ba'iri ngos sman shing sna tshogs kyi ljon pas dkrigs pa zhig tu bskyal te/ dad pas②phyag 'tshal zhing gdung ba'i smre sngags 'byin pa/ kye ma grogs dag mi rtag 'gyes rngo5ba can/ /so sor 'bral ba'i chos nyid 'di lta bu/ /de ring bdag cag rnams la mngon sum gyur/ /ngang ba'i rgyal po gcan du bzhud la nya/ /pad+ma med par pad+ma'i mtsho bzhin du/ /de ring bdag cag rje dpon zal bas skyo/ /nang gi tha ma phyi phyag 'tshal ba'i dus/ /slan chad khyod zhal mthong ba shin tu dkan/ /ces zer zhing mngon par mi dga' bzhin du ngur ba de dag phyir log go//snga nas 'dus kyang so sor 'bral ba'i chos/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhi na yin te phan pa med/ /gang la 'bral med bde chen rin chen gling / /zhi ba'i tshal du 'gro ba yong re ran//de nas ngang ba'i rgyal po de yang rang gi nye 'khor ba bzhin bzang dang 263
lhan cig shar phyogs logs su sor ba las/ skyed mos tshal mthing ga nor bu'i 'od ltar 'tsher ba'i nang na ri mchog tu dkar ba zla ba 'char na'i 'od ltar gsal ba'i drung nas shar phyogs su chu klung dkar ro dal gyis 'bab pa mthong ste bzhin bzang gis zhe sa dang bcas dris pa/ rma bya'i mgrin pa lta bur 'tsher ba'i nags/ /yid 3rong nang na rab dkar sa 'dzin zhig /dwangs pa'i chu klung dag dang mnyam du 'gran /mdzes pa 'di dag 'u zhig lags sam kye/ /ngang ba'i rgyal pos smras pa/ 'od zer lda na 3 nags chal mdzes pa'i nang / chu klung dri med ldan yang 'a tsher zhing 'bab/ /phal cher 'jig rten dbang po'i pho brang mchog /gangs ri rin chen ldan de yin pa snyam/ /nas brjod de song ba las/ nags tshal 'od zer ldan pa yid du 'ong ba'i shing ljon pa sna tshogs kyis 'khrigs shing / phu chu bsil ba'i rgyun kyur sgra dang bcas ba kha du ma nasa'abab pa/ nags kyi mthongs rnams nor bu an+da rnyil gyi kha dog 'tsher zhing ut+pala'i drwa bas khebs pa'i dzing bu me tog sna tshogs pas gang bar bya dang ri dwags du ma rgyu zhing bung ba rlang ling du gyur pa zhig tu phyin te bzhin bzang gis smras pa/ zhi ba'i nags 'dabs dben zhing nyams dga' ba/ /bsam gtanakuspyod pa dag gi skyed mos tshal/ /phug dang brag ri chu bsil rdzing bus gang / /me tog 'bras mang sman shing ljon pas dkrigs/ /phu chu'i rgyun dag kyung skra snyan sgrogs shing / /yid 'ong bya tshogs mang po bde bar rgyu/ /rkang drug ldan rnams snyan pa'i glu len zhing / /dus rlung bser bus me tog gsal bar 'thims/ /'gying 264
mdzes ldeng ba sprin gyi phung bo yang / /phyogs 'der dad pa'i glog zang gar byed sbyang / /bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i 'brug sgra sgrogs pa dang / /mnyam du mchod pa'i char zil bsil ba 'phebs/ /de 'dra'i gnas 'di nags tshal 'od zer ldan/ /lha dang drang srong mang pos bsten pa ste/ /rang byung 'jig rten dbang po'i nywaskyed mos tshal/ /sna tshogs bkod pa'i 'od zer 'gyed la ltos/ /ngang ba'i rgyal pos smras pa/ ri ngogs yangs pa'i ljon shing rnams rna dga' bas bro gar byed pa bzhin/ /shang shang 0sman ljongs me tog rnams rna 'dzum pa'i mdangs rab gsal ba bzhin/ /'khri shing khrod kyi bya tshogs rnams ni snyan pa'i bstod dbyangs len pa bzhin/ /chu rgyun gtsang ma'i na chung rnams rna m+bu phreng do shal 'dzin pa bzhin/ /tsan+dan bsil ba'i kha yi spubs bskyod snyan drung bung ba 'phur lding zhing / /nor bu'i do shal sked ngos la reg 'bras bu'i chun 'phyang 'dzin ma'i tshogs/ /lo 'dab gsar ba'i stod g.yogs dang bcas yal ga'i lag rtsed dud pa yis/ /me tog phreng ba'i g.yab mos 'debs shing de ring bdag cag bsu ba 'dra/ /khu byug myos pa'i gdangs snyan rnams ni dri za'i rgyud mang sbreng ba bzhin/ /chur nyal 'dzum pa'i na chung rnams ni bung ba'i gling bu sgyur ba bzhin/ /chu gtsang pad+mas khebs pa rnams ni dwangs pa'i gzugs brtan 'dzin pa bzhin/ /sdo zhing snum pa'i nags khrod rnams ni lhug phran bro gur byed pa bzhin/ /zhes brjod de mthar gyisayisong ba las/gangs ri rin chen ldan zla ba chu shel gyis mdzes pa'i ngos la 'jig rten 365
dbang po'i sku rang pyon yod pa/ tsan+dan sna tshogs kyi sngon pas dkrigs pa'i drung nas bskor pa/ phyogs su chu klung dri med ldan shar gyi rgya mtshor 'bab pa mthong ste/ bzhin bzang gis dris pa/ yid 'ong gangs ri'i tshal na 'dzum pa'i sku/ /dkar gsal 'od kyi drwa ba phyogs bcur 'gyed/ /ston ku'i sprin dkar nang na zla gzugs bzhin/ /mdzes pa 'di 'dra gang gi sku yin nam/ /ngang pa'i rgyal pos zas pa/ gangs ri'i drung na kyun gyis grub pa'i sku/ /'dzum mdzes bzhengs shing 'od stong 'gyed pa rna/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang rgyal sras thugs rje can/ /'gro ba'i don la phyogs 'dir byon pa snyam/ /zhes brjod drung du song nas phyag 'tshal zhing me tog rna tshogs dang spos dri zhim pas mchod nas ngang ba'i rgyal pos bstod pa/gangs ri'i mgul na 'dzum mdzes zhi ba'i sku/ /mi g.yo mi gsung kros dang bral ba ni/ /chos nyid ngang la mnyam par bzhag pañtsabazhin/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo /bzhin bzang gis bstod pa/ gangs ri pad+ma'i drung na mdzes pa'i sku/ /zla ba kun+da'i mdangs 'dra cag g.yas las/ /yi dwags bkres skom zhi mdzad 'o rgyun 'bebs/ /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nas brjod de skyed mos tshal de las kyang 'das nas shar phyogs logs su song song ba las rgya mtsho'i mtha' dang nya zhing thang dang shang shong r+sāshin tu rgya che ba/ snga dro'i tshe nya ma'i dkyil 'khor yang rgya mtsho'i nang nas 'char ba snyam byed cing / ji dro'i dus su sa'i 'og tu nab pa 366
'dra ba/ phyogs rnaca/sa rne smig rgyu 'gyu ba'i nas dang dri za'i grong gis brgyan cing / rkang gis 'gro ba'i mgron po shugs 'byin pa'i sa phyogs mya ngam gyi dkon pa yishin tu bgrod dka' ba zhis/ la nyin zhag 'ga' tsam song ba na/ bzhin bzang rab tu skyo bas nam mkha'i ngos su blta zhing smre sngags 'don pa/ phyog4sga rnams smig rgyu g.yo bas gar bsgyur zhing / /nyi ma rgya mtsho'i nang nas sa 'og nub/ /dri za'i grong yang phyi phyir bsnyesas pa bzhin/ /mya ngam thang las skyobs shig spyan ras gzigs/ /zhes brjod pa na/ ngang ba'i rgyal pos smras pa/ kye bzhin bzang / 'dir de tsam du bgrod dka' zhing skyo ba'ang ma yin gyi/ cung zad spro srings shig ces brjod nas yang smras pa/ srid pa'i mya ngam datshan pa bgrod dka' zhing / /sdug bsngal smig rgyu 'du byed dri za'i grong / /la sa dang nyon yongs nyi zla mdangs bkra'i gnas/ /bzod dka' bzod na 'di dag cis mi bzod/ /rgya mtshor mi 'ga' 'tsho ba tsam gyi phyir/ /sdug bsngal brgya phrag mang po'ang bzod byed na/ /rin chen chos phyir cung zad ngal ba yi/ /dman pa'i sdug bsngal 'u phyir bzod mi byed/ /sdon chad mnar med la sogs gnas rnams su/ /don med byi ra ya nga sdug bsngal bzod byed na/ /rang gzhan don chen 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur pa/ /dman pa'i sdug bsngal dga' bas bzod par bya/ /'on kyang bden pa'i stobs kyi byin rlabs dang / /bdag gi legs smon sngon sbyangs bsod nams stobs/ /de dag mthu yis yid 'ong nyams dga'i gnas/ /mtsho dang jing bus brgyan pa mthong bar shog /ces brjod ma thag tu de nas kyang zla 267
ba spyod skyas bgrod dgos pa'i mya ngam gyi dngo/na pa de nyid snga dro tsam gyis legs par bgrod par gyur to/ /skye bo dam pa'i mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ /legs smon bsod nams stobs kyang bsam mi khyab/ /mchog la bsten pa'i yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /dge dang mi dge'i rnam smin bsam mi khyab/ /de ltar bgrod pa'i shar phyogs na yid du 'ong ba'i gnas skye shing sna tshogs kyi ra bas bskor pa'i dbus na grong yidang gtsug lag khang mang ngo phyed tsam gsal ba dag mthong ste/ bzhin bzang gis smras pa/ 'khri shing ra bas bskor pa yi/ /grong dang gtsug lag khang rnams ni/ /phyed tsam 'dzum pas blta ba bzhin/ /mdzes pa 'di 'dra 'u zhig kye/ /ngang ba'i rgyal pos smras pa/ skye shing phreng bas bskor pa'i krong 6ra dbus/ /gzhal med khang mthong yid 'ong mdzes pa ni/ /nor bu'i chun 'phyang gser gyi drwa bas g.yogs/ /grong khyer tshangs pa'i 'byung gnas yin nam snyam/ /zhes brjod mthar gyis de'i nye 'khor du phyin pa na/ tsan+dan 'khri shing gis bskor pa'i 'obs chus yongs su gang bar me tog sna tshogs kyis khebs shing / chu bya sna tshogs pa rtse zhing lding ba mthong nas bzhin bzang gis smras pa/ me tog 'dzum pa'i na chung dag /mdzes pa'i bya dang lhan cig tu/ /rdzing bu'i nang na gsar du rgyas/ /'di ni lha yi pad mtsho'am ci/ /ngang ba'i rgyal pos smras pa/ 'obs kyi chu rlabs g.yo ba dag /'khri shing gzugs brnyan 'dzin pa yi/ /lha ba sbreng ba'i lo 'dab rgyas/ /268
—— ga ——cag rma rnar 4/ la 'tshongs nga/ bzhin/ /zhis brjod de grong khyer nya sag/ra song ba na/ skye ko mang pos gang ba'i grong dang gtsug lag khang de dag rgya mtsho'i 'gram dang nya ba'i phyir dgun gyi dus su nyi na ri 'od zer ha cang mi tsha zhing / zla ba'i 'od zer chu'i mdangs dang 'dres pa tsan+dan sa mcho ri /cigi tshal ltar shin tu bsil la/ sos ka dang / dbyar dang / ston rnams ni zla ba'i 'od zer mchog tu mi bsil zhing / t+yā ma'i 'od zer rgya mtsho2 4do ba'i stobs kyis nor bu me shel dwangs pa'i phung po nye bar gnas pa ba'itsha/ du rab tu tsha zhing / phal cher rmugs pa'i do shal dang mtsho rlangs 'khyil ba'i khrod nas chu'i zegs ma phra mo dag char zims bu lta ra 'bab cing r+p+pa nga ya'i sgra ska sna tshogs su grags pa de'i phyir/ sbrang skyabs dang /cibsol khang dang / 'phyang khang dang / phyed pheb dang / skar khung drwa ba can dang / smyu ca/ ma'i bsil khang la sogs la bkod pa sna tshogs kyis 4 dzes nyung tshong 'dus dang bzhi mdo rnams su rin po che dang / sman dang / kha zas dang / bco/na pa dang / btung ba dang / gos sna tshogs kyis bkam pa'i tshogs khang yid du 'ong bar skye b+thā mang pos gar rlang /srang dang sum mdo rnams su yul dang phyogs tha dad pa nas lhagasari rma 'i mgrom/ po du ma lang long du gyur cing / gtsug lag khang rnams klong 4 dang bsam paṃ]tan spyod pa'i rab tu byung ba mang pos gang bar mthong ste/ bzhin bzang gis smras pa / yid 'ong grogs dag 'dod rgus rab 'byor cing / /phyogs kyi skye bo mang po nye bar 'dud/ /gtsug lag khang rnams mchod pa'i sprin 'phro zhing / /bsam gtan spyod pa dag gi skye bos gang / /269
zhes brjod n+d+ra song ba las/ grong khyer de'i shar phyosas na yid du 'ong ba'i mtsho me tog brgyan pa zhes bya ba ha ri tsan+dan ②la sogs pa'i ljon shing sna tshogs kyi ra bas bskor pa'i dbus/ pad+ma dang / ut+pal dang / ku mu ta la sogs pa me tog rnam pa du ma'i drwa bas khobs pa'i mtsho/ bzhad dang bur ba sgra 'byin pa zhig tu phyin te/ ngang ba'i rgyal pos smras pa/ me tog drwa bas legs par 'dzum pa'i mtshor/ /gnyis skyes②dga' ba'i sgra snyan sgrogs pa rna/ /yid 'ong 'dod lha'i rdzing bu 'phos pa bzhin/ /zhi ba'i gnas 'dir bdag cag 'dug par 'os/ /zhes brjod de 'khri shing ra ba'i mtshor zhugs pa dang / de na gnas pa'i bya sna tshogs pa dag rab tu dka' bas bsu zhing bstod de smras pa/ pad+ma'i mtsho la sa ma byung zhing / /nyi zer gsal bas ma phyes kyang ༈ /bzhin gyi chu skyes dpal dang ldan/ /mdzes pa khyed cag gang nas lhags/ /ngang ba'i rgyal pos smras pa/ yid 'ong gnas ni yon tan mtha' yas shing / /dpal rgyas pad+ma'i 'byung gnas mtsho chen bzhin/ /gangs ri'i ze bas legs par bskor pa nas/ /zhi ba'i gnas 'dir bdag cag lhasas par gyur/ /de dag gis smras pa/ kye bzang po gnas na'i yon tan ji lta bu/ngang ba'i rgyal pos smras pa/ gangs ri'i yul ni 'phags pa'i skyed mos tshal/ /yid 'ong grong dang gtsug lag khang rnams ni/ /mkhas pa'i skye bo mang pos rab tu gang / /bstan pa'i nyi 'od rgya cher 'phro ba yin/ /zhes pa brjod 2 yang dris pa/ 'jig rten dbang po bzhugs pa'i ri/ /270
yid 'ong me tog brgyan pa yi/ /lam rna gang yin ji tsam zhig /de ring gsal bar rab tu ston/ /na dag gis smras pa/ bdag cag gis ni shes par dka' ste/ 'on kyang gtsug lag khang 'di na dge slong chos smra ba skye bo mang po'i slob dpon du gyur pa zhig mchis kyi der dris shig dang khyed cag la man pa nye bar ston par 'gyur ro/ /des kyang legs so zhes smras te gtsug lag khang nar song ba na/dge slong ba bslab pa gsu ma dang mang du thos pa rgya mtsho'i nor gyis phyug cing / 'phasas pa don yod zhags pa'i zhal mthong ba zhig mchis pa de'i zhabs drung du so nga ste dad pas phyag 'tshal nas smras pa/ gang gis 'ching rnams rab bcad de/ /'gro ba byang chub lam 'dren pa'i/ /rgyal sras thugs rje can gyi zhing / /gru 'dzin lam rna bstan du gsol//dge slong des smras pa/ khyed cag gang nas lhags/ zhes smras pa/ri bo gangs can nas so/ /dge slong gis smras pa/ kye bzhin bzang dag skal ba dang ldan pa rnams kyi lam nyid ni 'di nas shar phyogs logs na yod de/ yi ge zhib mo la brten nas togs mod kyi bgrod par dka'o/ /khyed cag ni lhag par yang skal ba dang ldan te/ 'di ltar lo bcu gnyis nas shar gyi rgya mtsho'i 'gram ku mu ta rgyas pa'i gling du 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang po klu rnams la chos ston pa'i phyir 'byung bar gsungs na sngar rna lo bcu zhig thal te ring por mi thogs par khyed cag dang mjal bar ngos so/ /dang bas sprus pa/ de tsam du 'dug par mi spro na thabs gzhan stsol 37snyo
zhig dge slong gis smras pa/ de lta na zla ba phyed kyi bar du sdod cig dang 'dir po ta la'i yul nas ngang ba zhig chos nyan pa'i slad du na chi ste de dang lhan cig song zhig des kyang legs so zhes bstod de zla ba phyed du nyin mo dge slo nga chos smra ba de las 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i gzungs kyi cho ga dang / a mo lha pā sha'i rgyud la sogs pa chos zab mo rnams nyan zhing mtshan mo me tog brgyan par gnas bcas te 'dug go/ /dam pa gangs ri'i drung na ngang ba dag /yid 'ong thos pa'i chu rgyun gnyer ba ni/ /pad+ma'i dzing bu nyid du rab 'khrul nas/ /don zab zang ji'i snying po 'thung ba bzhin/ /de nas zla ba phyed kyi nyin mo tshes bco lnga'i nam mkha' rdul dang bral ba'i shar phyogs nas ngang ba'i dbang po zhig me tog dang 'bras bu'i tshogs mang po khyer te gtsug lag khang dang dgi slong chos smra ba de la mchod cing bstod dbyangs dag sgrog par byed do/ /dwangs pa'i mkha' la rgyal sras dag pa'i bya/ /thabs dang shes rab gshog gnyis rab brkyangs te/ /bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i dar dir sgra 'byin zhing / /me tog 'bras bu'i tshogs kyis mchod cing lhags/ /de'i tshe dge slong chos smra ba des kyang 'phabs pa zla ba dri ma med pa'i mdo la sogs pa zab mo'i chos mang du bshad de smras pa/ yid 'ong gangs ri'i 'gram nas 'ongs pa'i bya/ /dad dang brtson pa'i gshog yangs ldan pa zhig /sbyan ras gzigs dbang drung du gus pas 'gro/ :/bzang po khyod kyis de yi lam mkhan mdzod/ /ces brjod pa dang / des kyang de 272
ba7na du bgyi'o zhes smras te/ mtsho me tog brgyan pa'i 'gram du 'ongs nas smras pa/ gangs ri pad+ma'i mtsho nas 'ongs pa'i bya/ /rab dkar dge ba'i shugs kyis bskyod pa dag /g.yo ba'i lus kyi 'dab gshog rab bskyod la/ /tshur shog 'jig rten dbang po'i drung du 'dong / /zhes pa'i tshig 'des bskul pa dang / ngang ba'i rgyal pos mchog tu dga' bas smras pa/ legs so dwangs pa'i mkha' la mdzes pa'i bya/ /yid 'ong mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i gangs ri zhig /mkha' la 'ong na de dang mtshungs pa bzhin/ /khyod beng lhan cig gru 'dzin blta bar bgyi/ /zhes brjod nas me tog la sogs pas dge slong chos spru ba de mchod de phyag 'tshal nas rang gi 'khor dang lhan cig tu po ta la'i ngang bas lag mkhan byas nas shar phyogs logs su song ngo /de dang mnyam du me tog brgyan pa'i mtsho/ /yid 'ong nang gnas ngang ba lnga brgya yang / /dwangs pa'i mkha' la gshog pa rab brkyangs nas/ /shar ri rgyal po'i drung du snyegs la brtson/ /de ltar ngang ba'i tshogs dag song ba las nyin zhag 'ga' tsam na/shar gyi rgya mtsho'i nang / yid du 'ong ba'i mtsho pad+mas khebs shing / rin po che sna tshogs kyi gling baiḍūr+sha'i phye ma brdal ba/ tsan+dan sbrul gyi snying po'i tshal mthing gar 'khrigs pa zhig na/ nor bu an+d+ra rnyil gyi rang bzhin nam mkha' dwangs pa'i mdog ltar sngo ba'i khang bzang zhig mthong ste/ ngang ba'i rgyal pos dris pa/ ut+pal mthing ga 'khyil ba 'dra ba las/ /rnar bu'i 4/8 nal med khang mthon 'od kyis mdzes/ /ge sar drwa bas g.yogs pa'i 273
rgyad mos tshal/ /mdzis par gsal ba ci zhig lags sam kyi/ /lam mkhan gyis smras pa/ 'di ni klu'i dbang po nor rgyas kyi pho brang me tog rgyas pa can yin te rin po che sna tshogs kyis kun tu gang ngo / /bzhin bzang gis smras pa/ kye bzang po bdag cag 'gro ba'i gnas der ni ji tsam zhig na yod/ lam mkhan gyis smras pa/ da dung shin tu ring ngo //de nas nyin zhag 'ga' tsam song song ba na/ rin po che'i ri mchog tu dkar ba gangs ri'i rgyal po ༷zla ba'i 'od kyis 'tsher ba lta bu zhig mthong ste ngang ba'i rgyal pos dris pa/ nor bu chu shel 'tsher ba'i ldan po la/ /nyin byed 'od kyi drwa bas g.yogs pa bzhin/ /chu srin 'dzin khri'i chaganas na mdzes pa'i ri/ /ring nas gsal ba 'di 'dra 'u yin kye/ /lam mkhan gyis smras pa/ 'de ni klu'i dbang po pad+ma'i pho brang sprin gyi snying po yin te rnar bu 'od kyi snye ma dang ke ke ruḥdag mang ngo //de las kyang 'das te nyin zhag 'ga' tsam song ba las ri mchog tu dmar ba rgya mtsho'i rlabs kyis gnyer bas res 'ga' chu'i gting du nub pa snyam byed pa zhig mthong ste/ ngang ba'i rgyal pos dris pa/ chu gter zab mo'i nang na mdzes pa'i ri/ /nor bu pad+ma rā ga'i mdog 'dra zhing / /dus rlabs g.yo bas rtsed 'jo bgyid pa bzhin/ /mdzes pa 'de 'dra ci zhig lags sam kyi/ /lam mkhan gyis smras pa/ 'de ni klu'i dbang po mtha' yas kyi pho brang 'od kyi drwa ba yin te nor bu sprug dang pu sa ra gasnya dag mang ngo //274
las kyang 'das te nyin zhag 'ga' tsam song ba na ri bo mchog tu ser ba kur sum gzhon nu'i mdog 'dra ba zhig mthong ste/ rang ba'i rgyal pos dris pa/ gser ri 'od kyi drwa bas mdzes pa la/ /in+d+ra rī la'i stod g.yogs 'dzin pa bzhin/ /mthing ga rgya mtsho'i chu rlabs gos rgyan pa'i/ /mdzes pa 'di 'dra ci zhig lags sam kye/ /lam mkhan gyis smras pa/ 'di rna klu'i dbang po pad+ma chen po'i pho brang gser gyi drwa ba can yin te nor bu mthon ka dang chu dwangasañtsadag mang ngo //de dag kyang 'das te nyin zhag 'ga' tsam song ba na/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi gling ner bu be+eḍūr+ya'i ñtsha ma brdal ba/ tsan+dan sna tshogs kyi skyed mos tshal na dbyar gyi ut+pal rab tu rgyas pa lta bu'i ri ljang gur snang ba zhig mthong ste/ ngang ba'i rgyal pos dris pa/ rma bya'i mgrin pa lta bur mdzes pa'i ri/ /ljang gur 'tsher ba'i 'od zer 'gyed pa ni/ /tsan+dan ljon 4 'i tshogs dang 'gran pa bzhin/ /ring na gnas pa 'di 'dra ci zhig kye/ /lam mkhan gyis smras pa/ 'di ni klu'i dbang po rgya mtsho'i pho brang rin chem snying po yin te nor bu 'od kyi drwa ba dang pad+ma'i snying po dag shin tu mang ngo //de nas kyang 'das te nyin zhag 'ga' tsam song ba'i mtshams na/rin po che sna tshogs kyi ri 'od kyi drwa bas mdzes shing / tsan+dan sa mchog gi tshal mthing gar 'khrigs pa/ gser gyi tshe ma brdal ba'i gling rnar bu sna tshogs kyis bkram zhing rgya mtsho'i mdog kyang ljang gur 'tsher ba zhig mthong lta/ ngang ba'i myal pos dris pa/ dwangs pa'i mtsho na ri chen snying po'i 275
ri/ /tsan+dan ljon pa'i phreng bas bskor pa ni/ /mthing par 'tsher ba'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro/ /nor bu'i gling na mdzes pa ci zhig kye/ /lam mkhan gyis smras pa/ 'di ni klu'i dbang po gtsug na rin ched gyi pho brang 'od kyi snying po yin te/ 'dzam bu'i gling na yod pa 'i rin po che'i rigs thams cad dang / khyad par nor bu mthon ka chen po dar / baiḍūchadang / pad+ma'i drwa ba dang / nyi zla'i 'od dang / sprin gyi snying po dang /mching bu dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu bsam 'phel rnams kyis kun tu gang ngo //de ltar ngang ba'i tshogs dag ri b+thā che'i ri dang / gling dang rnga tsho'i bye brag sna tshogs pa gzhan dang gzhan dag la sa kyang 'das te/ socan la'i dus zla ba gsum gyi bar nyin re bzhin dngas pa'i mkha' la 'gro zhing rma tshan mo rin po che dang pad+ma dang rnar bu'i mtshor gnas bcas te/ 'jig rten dbang po yid la byed cing shar phyogs logs su snyegs pa la brtson par kyur ta//nyin bzhin dwangs pa'i mkha' la mdzes pa'i bya/ /gdangs rtsa na ngang 4pa'i ca co 'phel ba ni/ /pad+mo'i mtsho gling nyid du rab 'khrul mas /'od steng ldan ba dag kyang nya 'od 'gyed/ /mtshan mo chu gling ngang bas brgyan pa dag /dri zhim kun+da'i tshal du rab 'khrul nas/ /skar ma'i tshogs kyis bskor pa'i ri bong 'dzin/ /bsil ba'i 'od zer drwa ba 'a gye da la ltos//de nas gling de dag las 'das pa'i shar phyogs na/ tsan+dan sna tshogs 376
yon pas dkrigs pa'i gling sngo zhing snum snum ltar 'dug pa'i dbus na/ri mchog tu dkar ba zla ba 'char ka ltar mdzes pa'i steng na rin po che'i khang bas brgyan pa/ rgya mtsho'i mdog kyang nor bu 'od kyi snye ma ltar dkar zhing 'tsher ba dag mthong ste/ ngang ba'i rgyal pos dris pa/ gangs can ri ni rin chen 'od 'phro zhing / /khang brtsegs nor bu'i drwa bas g.yogs pa bzhin/ /tsan+dan nags 'khrigs 'o ma'i chu gter nang / /kun nas mdzes pa 'di 'dra ci yin nam//lam mkhan gyis smras pa/ 'ad ni 'phags ma gau rī'i ②'o brang rgya mtsho'i sprin yin te/ lha dang grub pa dang rig sngags 'chang rnams kyis nye bar brten pa'o zhes brjod de/ /gling der song ba las rin po che'i theng ljon pa nor bu'i drwa bas dpyangs spra 'bum phrag du mas dkrigs pa'i bar bar na lha dang drang srong du ma rab tu rgyu zhing pad+ma'i mtsho las bung ba snyan par sgrogs pa'i glu dang ser bur ngad kyis bsu ba zhim po dal bus ldang ba la bsams te/ ngang ba'i rgyal pos smras pa/ rin chen ljon shing du ma'i nags khrod na/ /lha dang drang srong mang pos rab tu gang / /dus rlung ser bu'i ngad kyis g.yo ba yi/ /me tog char ba ldang zhing 'bab la ltos/ /bzhin bzang gis smras pa/ 'od 'phro pad+ma'i sprin gyi khang bzang na/ /sbrang rtsi 'dzin pa chadag gis glu len zhing / /nyi zer gsal bar 'dzin pa'i na chung dag /phan tshun g.yo bas bro gar byed pa bzhin//de nas nags khrod dag kun tu rgyu zhing song ba las/ mthar gyis rin po che rna tshogs kyi ri'i rtse mor gangs ri'i stod g.yogs ltar dpo/ ra ba'i 377
steng na khang bu brtsegs pa mthong ste/ lam mkhan gyis smras pa/ sna tshogs rin chen snying pos brgyan pa'i ri/ /rol pa'i sprin gyis stod g.yogs 'dzin pa bzhin/ /gau rī rin chen pad+ma'i khang bzang du/ /grogs dag tshur shog dga' bas 'dong bar gyis/ /zhes brjod de/ ri de'i rtse mor 'dzegs te phyin pa na 'phags ma rna rī'i pho brang nor bu 'od zer sprin gyi khang ba'i sgo drung na klu'i bu mo mang po rin po che'i srad bu 'khal zhing glu len pa dag mthong nas/ lam mkhan gyis de dag la smras pa/ mya gzhon nu dag 'dzam bu'i gling nas lhags pa'i ngang ba dag 'phags ma blta zhing chos nyan pa'i slad du mchis so zhes thon cig de nas klu'i bu mo gcig song ste 'phags ma la bsnyad pas/ des kyang rjes su gnang nasabu mo de phyir byung ste bang ba de dag la nang du 'jug pa'i brda byas so//de nas gzhal med khang gi nang du song ba las rin po che'i khri la 'phags ma gau rī mchog tu dkar zhing 'dzum pa mtshan dang dpe byad kyis 'bar ba'i sku dar dang rin po che'i rgyan du mas legs par brgyan pa mi'am ci dang klu dang lha ma yin gyi bu mo 'bum phrag du mas bskor te pi wang sbreng ba mthong nas drung du phyin te/ ngang bas phyag 'tshal zhing me tog la sogs pas mchod de/ ngang ba'i rgyal pos bstod pa/ shin tu mi g.yo spros kun bral ba'i lha/ /'dod(gdod) nas zhi zhing rang bzhin mya ngan 'das/ /bsam med brjod bral gau rī chos kyi sku/ /rgyal ba'i yum gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal lo /bzhin pazang gis/ gangs ri'i ngos la zhi ba'i char sprin bzhin/ /378
shin tu yid 'ong bcom ldan thugs rje'i lha/ /na rī rin chen mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku/ gti mug⑩phun bral mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo//lam mkhan gyis bstod pa/ thugs rje zhi ba bsi' ba'i rdzing bu las/ /rmad byung byin rlabs chu rgyun bzang po 'bab/ /'gro ba'i nyon mongs me tshogs zhi mdzad pa/ /kun mkhyen ye shes brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod de zhabs kyi drung du 'khod pa na/ 'phags ma gau rīs de dag gi bsam pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i chos gsungs pa/ dngos kun mi rtagayirang bzhin snying po med/ /gsog dang gsob dang ya ma brla 'dra zhing / /m+bu ba ldas 'dra chu shing asdong bo bzhin/ /rang bzhin med la sna tshosas snang ba'i chos/ /de dngos kyis stong gzugs brnyan dang 'dra bar/ /de ring nyid nas nges par rtogs par bya/ /'gro ba 'khrul ba me lam sgyu 'dra'i tshogs/ /zhi ba'i tshal du bdag gis drang bya zhes/ /byams pa'i rang bzhin snying rje'i chus brlan la/ /byang chub sems nyid brtan por gzung bar bya/ /de bzhin nyid dang rgyu dang kun tu snang / /yon tan gzigs pa rnams kyi spyod yul te/ /yul dang sems bral rang bzhin gdod ma'i ngang / /sems nyid rgyal po dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med/ /gcig dang tha dad babral ba'i chos nyid la/ /bltar med bsam yul bral ba'i tshul gyis bzhag /gang gang mthong ba rang bzhin gnyug ma'i grogs/ /me dang shing ltar mkhas pas rtogs par bya/ /bde dang sdug bsngal bar ma'i dngos kun la/ /sna tshogs las dang byang chub sems nyid dang / /chos nyid grogs te gnyan po gsum dag gis/ /279
'aro ra ba ri 159 bzhin thar ba'i la ma du bsgyur/ /'di ni cho sa kun snying po'e bcuge phyung bas/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma myur du bskrun par byed/ /ces gsu ngas —4 0 4ka tu ngang ba'i tshogs de dag gis chos kyi rgyun zhes bya ba'i ting je 'dzin thob ba ra gyur to//skye bo dam pa rnams dang 'phrad pa dag /sna tshogs yon tan kun gyi gzhir gyur te/ /gzungs0spobs chos kyi mdzod la mnga' brtes nas/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i pha mthar mchog tu 'gro//de nas bya'i tshogs de dag 3sa 'phags/ ma gau rī las rjes su bstan pa thob nas/ lan brgya stong du mar phyag 'tshal 'ing g.yas phyogs nas bskor pa byas te me tog la sogs pas mchod nas pyir byung ste/ gling de dag las kyang 'das nas zla ba phyed kyi bar du song song ba'i shar phyogs nas rgya maca 3re nang gi nor bu'i pye brag gis steng gi chu'i (ba dog kyang sna tshogs su bsgyur zhing / rin po che'i shing ljon pa 'bum phrag du ma'i khagesag gsal nga ri dbus na/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i ri mchog tu dkar zhing 'tsher b.ri ngos la skyed mos tshal mthing ga 'khris/sa shing steng na lha'i gzhal med khong 'od kyi drwa bas mdzes pa mthong ste/ ngang ba'i rgyal pos dris pa/rin chen rgya mtsho'i nang na mdzes ma'i ri/ /rtse mo dkar gsal 'od kyi khang bas mdzes/ /ngos rnams rnar bu an+da rnyil lta ra sto/ /yid 'ong 'di 'dra ci zhig lags sam kye/ /lam mkhan gyis zhe sa dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te smras pa/ spyan ras gzigs dbang bzhugs gnas po ta la/ /me tog brgyan pa'i pho brang chen po ste/ /bdag cag rnams kyang 280
gus brtsisems bcad la/ /dad ba'i 'dab gshog g.yo ba'i phyag 'tshol cig /ces brjod ma thag tu thams cad kyang so so nas phyag 'tshal zhing gsol ba 'debs par byed do/ /lhag par dad pa'i gshog gnyis thal sbyar te/ /'jig rten dbang bo'i drung du phyag 'tshal ba/ /bung ba'i gling bus bsgyur pa'i pad+ma dag /bser bus bskyod pa'i bro gar byed pa 'dra/ /de nas mthar gyis song ba na ri de'i chu mtshams rgya mtsho'i rlabs kyis gnyer ba'i phug cig mthong nas/ ngang ba'i rgyal pos dris pa/ nyer nyer m+bu ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa yi/ /chil chil rlabs kyis bskyod pa'i rgya mtsho dag /yang yang brag ri'i phug 'dir snyegs la brtson/ /kye kye phyogs 'dir ci zhig bzhugs pa lags/ /lam mkhan gyis smras pa/ 'de ni rang byung dbang po'i phug yin te/'phags pa mya na ras gzigs dbang phyug rang byon pa dag bzhugs kyi bdag ca ga dad pas phyag 'tshal du 'dong ngo / /zhes brjod de song ba las/ rin po che'i phug yangs shing nyams dag/'a ba'i nang brag ri'i ngos la so so'i snang ba gang mthun par gzugs brnyan 'tshar ba'i sku rgya mtsho'i rlabs phyir sdud pa'i tshe snang zhing nang du 'jug pa'i tshe mi snang ba zhig mthong nas kha cig ji/sa smras pa/ rin chen phug yangs dag gi brag ri'i ngos/ /rang byung 'jig rten dbang po shar ba la/ /rgya mtsho'i chu yang dag pas phyag 'tshal zhing / /dul ba'i lus kyis khrus gtsang gsol ba bzhin//281
kha cig gis spras pa/ /shar ri rin chen 'jig rten dbang po'i phug /rang byung rgyal ba'i gzugs brnyan shar ba la/ /dad pa'i gdung shugs g.yo bas ma bzod de/ /klu mchog rnams kyi gnas kyang bskyod pa bzhin/ /zhes brjod de me tog la sogs mchod cing phyag 'tshal ba na/ /kha cig gis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bcu gcig zhal phyag stong bar mthong nas bstod pa/ mdzes sku pad+ma'i steng na pad+ma bzhin/ /'dab stong rgyas pa'i phyag stong mdzes pa la/ /spyan stong mnga' ba mgon po bcu gcig zhal/ /zla ba dri med 'od la phyag 'tshal lo//kha cig cig gis phyag bzhi bar mthong ste bstod pa/ yid 'ong gangs ri lta bur mdzes pa'i sku/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi rin chen rgyan rnams rdzogs/ /thugs rje zhi ba bsil ba'i 'od 'phro ba/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo//kha cig gis phyag gnyis par mthong ste bstod pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum dang ldan pa'i sku/ /rtag par brtson pas mi bzhugs bzhengs pa ni/ /snying rje'i ngang can phan ba 'i 'od stong 'gyed/ /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod de mthar gyis ri de'i drung nas 'dzegs te 'jig rten dbang po'i skyed mos tshal rin chen sprin du song ba na/ nang gi nye bar len pa'i rkyen gyis phyi rol gyi yul yang tha dad du snang ste/ gang dag chu bur gyi mig dang ldan pa rnams kyis skyed mos tshal gyi gzhi de nyid tsan+dan gyi ljon pas dkrigs shing / pad+ma dang ku mu tas gang ba'i chu rgyun gtsang ma kha du ma nas 'bab pa/ me tog gi tshal na 282
bub ba ldeng 'ing bya dang ri dwags mang po bde bar rgyu ba'i gnas/ thang mtshar/sa su rgya 4 tsho'i chus bskor cing rtse mo gangs ri'i ze bas gsal ba'i steng na gtsug la ga khang tshon rtsi sna tshogs kyis kha bsgyur pa g.yu'i 'ibs nor bu'i me tog gis cir dzes shing / ri de'i khor yug tu dpag tshad phyed bzhi dang phye/ thug du dpag tshad su ma brgya mtsho'i nang nas 'thon par mthong ste smras pa/ 'phags pa'i bzhugs gnas yid 'ong po ta la/ /rtse mo gangs ri'i drwa bas g.yogs pa'i steng / /khang brtsegs yid 'ong nor bu'i tog gis mdzes/ /ngos rnams dri zhim ljon pas rab 'khrigs shing / /mtsho dang rdzing bu lteng ka ngur bas khengs/ /thang mtshams rgya mtsho'i chu rlabs gnyer ba yis/ /phyogs kyi tha gru'i khyon rnams 'jal ba bzhin/ /sna tshobs 'od zer 'khrugs pas mdzes so kye//sa/nga dag lha'i mig dang ldan pa rnams kyis ri'i rgyal po po ta la rang gi mos pa dang rjes su mthun par chen po dang thung ngu dang yangs pa dang dog pa dang kha dog dang dbyibs rnams skad cig skad cig la ji ltar 'dod pa de'i gzugs dang bkod par 'gyur zhing snang ba'i phyir tshad ma jes shing rgya yongs su mched pa'i tshul gyis mthong ngo //de yang 'di ltar thang mtshams rnams na rgya mtsho'i chus yongs su bskor pa'i nang na lha ma yin dang klu mchog tu gyur pa rnams kyi grong khyir sprin gyi snying po'i khang bzang gis 'khor zhing / ngos rnams gser dngul dang nor bu'i drwa bas g.yogs pa'i rin po che sna tsho /sa kyi shing gis 'khrigs pa'i bar bar dag baiḍūr+sha dang in+d+ra rī la dang gser gyi dril bu tshad du sbreng 383
bas zel legs pa'i nags khrod rin po che'i mtsho dang dzing dang lteng ka ca/nga pos brgyan par sprul pa'i bya dang ri dwags mang pos glu gar dang rtsed 'jo bgyid cing / nam mkha'i mthongs dang skyed mos tshal kun tu 'od kha dog rnam pa lnga'i drwa ba dang / gur dang / bla bre dang / khang brtsegs dang /zlum 'khrigs dang / mig mangs ris dang / grong dang / nags dang /skyes pa dang / bud med kyi gzugs su snang ba rnams 'od kyi gur khyim na glu gar dang rtsed 'dzo bgyid pa'i bar bar rnams su 'od kyi rtsibs gar dang / gyen rgyug dang / rab 'khyil la sogs pas mdzes pa'i bkod ba sna tsho4sa par snang zhing / ri de'i rtse mo nor bu chu shel 'tsher ba'i steng na 'jig rten dbang po'i pho brang rin po che sna tshogs pa las grub pa ma chod pa'i sprin byi 'od zer phyogs bcur 'gyed pas 'jig rten gyi khams tha6 sa cad rgyas par 'gengs pa/ baiḍūr+ya'i phebs 'dzam bu chu po'i gser gyi gtsug tor gyis mtshan pa mig 'phrul ltar kun tu snang ngo / /de dag gi steng gi ngos na nam mkha'i po ta la rgya mtsho'i nang gi po ta la dang 'gran pa lta bu zhig snang ba ni chu dwangs pa'i nang gi zla ba'i gzugs brnyan dang nam mkha'i zla ba ltar snang la rang bzhin med pa'i bkod pa gnyis su snang ba la bsams te/ rang ba'i rgyal pos smras pa/ shar ri rgyal po yid 'ong po ta la/ /me tog sman shing dri zhim dwangs pa'i mtsho/ /rin chen ljon shing mang po'i ra bas bskor/ /rtse mo nor bu chu shel snying po'i steng / /khang brtsegs yid 'ong mchod pa'i 'od zer 'gyed/ /rgya mtsho'i nang na gnas pa ji bzhin du/ /nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor yid 'ong po ta la/ /'od 384
lnga'i nang na ni nga la rang ba'irnga/ med/ /'i tshogs/ bskyo/da pa'i 3 — 8phrul 'gyed la ltos/ /ri'i drung na chu'i rba rlabs gnyer ba la bas4/sa te kha cig gis smra45 pa/ rin chen sprin gyi snying pos brgyan pa'i na tsho/ /mthing gar 'khrigs pa'i lag rtsed dud pa ni/ /dad pa'i gdung shugs g.yo bas rab bskyod de/ /dul ba'i lus kyis phyag kyang 'tshal ba 'dra//nga nga kha cig gis smras pa/ rin chen 'dzin ma'i chu gter chen po ya nga / /chab sgra snyan pa'i bstod dbyangs rab sgrogs shing / /lhun po 'khor bar dus/ rlabs g.yo ba ni/ /bsod nams blo yis skor bar byed pa 'dra//ya nga [ba cig gis smras pa/ ma tshan mo mkha' la gza' skar shar 'dra'i chu/ /m+bu ba zangs pa'i zegs ma 'thar ba ni/ /me tog char ba zil gyis 'bab pa yis/ /'jig rten dbang po'i gnas 'dir mchod pa bzhin//kha cig gis skyed mos tshal gyi bkod pa la bsam te smras pa/ rin chen ljon shing me tog drwa ba can/ /nor bu'i tshal gyis legs par sprengspa dag /dad pas 'jig rten dbang po mchod pa'i phyir/ /shar ri rgyalpo'i drung du lhags pa bzhin//yang kha cig gis smras pa/ chur nyal6)mtsho na bya tshogs sgra 'byinzhing / /'dab gshog g.yo bas bro gar byed pa ni/ /sprin gyi glang bo myos pa 'i tshogs 'di dang / /skyed mos tshal 'dir lhan cig 'gran pa bzhin//285
yang kha cig nas smras pa/ ljang ser rtswa yi myu gu rnams ni me tog 'dzum pa'i do shal 'phyang / /'od zer gsal ba'i shing drung rnams ni zhi ba'i drang srong mang pos gang / /chu gtsang pad+mas khebs pa rnams ni sil khrol m+bu ba'i rgyan phreng 'dzin/ /yid 'ong nags kyi bkod pa rnams ni 'phags pa'i rnam 'phrul lags so kye//yang kha cig gis 'od kyang snang ba la bsams te smras pa/ nags kyi mthongasayidang yid 'ong nam mkha'i khams/ /'od lnga'i snang ba sna tshogs mched pa ni/ /drwa ba drwa phyed n+t+razlum 'khrigs za 'og ris/ ③pad+ma'i dbyibs dang khang brtsegs bla bre'i gzugs/ /gyen 'greng rtsebs shar nyi zla'i 'od ltar 'gro/ /kun gyi nang na lha yi skyed mos tshal/ /lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin rnam 'phrul zhing / /bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i sil snyan 'khrol la ltos/ /zhes brjod de skyed mos tshal gyi nang du rgyu zhing rtso/nga ba las/ bya dang ri dwags du ma gcig la gcig bag phebs shing rdzing dang me tog dang 'khri shing ra ba'i nang na gnas pa dag mthong ste/ bzhin bzang gis dris pa/ skyed mos tshal 'di'i bya dang ri dwags kyang / /phan tshun byams shing dul ba'i ngang tshul can/ /'du 'dzi spangs te bsam gtan sgom pa bzhin/ /drang srong spyod tshul 'di 'dra su las bslab//lam mkhan gyis smras pa/ dam pa rnams dang 'grogs na de yi dri/ /yid 'ong pad+ma'i bsung gis khyab par byed/ /des na 'di dag mgon po'i byin rlabs kyis/ /chos dang ldan zhing zab mo'i ting 'dzin 'phel//zhes brjod 2 mthar gyis ri de'i steng du song ba las/ rin po che 'od kyi 286
snying po'i pho brang rnar bu'i drwa bas g.yogs zhing mchod pa'i spren gyi bla re gsal ba can mthong ste/ de'i sgo drung du song nas sil snyan 'khrol zhing bstod dbyanganā dag blang ba/ 'jig rten dbang smyug bcom ldan thugs rje'i lhamya/ /kun nas dgyes pa'i zhal gyi pad mtsho yis/ /'dab brgya'i sbrang 4ra spyod rnams rab gzigs te/ /bdud rtsi'i chos kyis 'gro ba tshim par mdzod/ /ces brjod pa dang / gzhal med khang de'i nang nas lha'i bu zhig phyir byung ste smras pa/ kye bzhin bzang dag gang nas 'ong ci zhig don du gnyer/lam mkhan gyis zas pa/ 'dzum mdzes gangs ri'i drung nas 'ongs pa ste/ /sna tshogs mchod pa'i 'od kyi sprin 'phro bas/ /'jig rten dbang po mchod cing bstod pa dang / /yid 'ong chos kyi gsung dbyangs nyan du mchis/ /zhes brjod pa dang / dri gtsang khang gi sgo phyes te nang du 'jug pa 'i brda byas so//de nas de dag gzhal med khang gi nang du song ba na rnar bu sprin gyi snying po'i khri la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po zla ba 'char ba ltar 'tsher zhing mtshan dang dpe byad kyis 'bar ba lha'i gos dang rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing shin tu 'dzum pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sum khri drug stong gis bskor nas bzhugs pa mthong ngo / /de'i tshe rang rang gi mchod pa'i yo byad kyis mchod de zhabs la 'dud pa'i phyag 'tshal zhing /ngang ba'i rgyal pos bstod pa/ mchog tu dkar ba gangs ri'i sku ni rta bdun gzi byin 'gyed 'dra zhing / /pad+ma'i mig ni thugs rje'i zhal bzang 287
phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i 'dab brgya 'dzum/ /bde 'byung gtsug gi nar bu'i dpal ni khyod zhabs 'dzin pa'i khur gyis smyu/ /drang srong mchog ni rgyal sras dbus na mchog tu mdzes la phyag 'tshal lo//bzhin bzang gis bstod pa/ 'od zer gsal bas rgyan rnams 'khrol ba'i sku/ /'gying bcas pad+ma'i steng na mi g.yo zhig /thugs rje drwa ba 'khyil ba'i 'od 'phro ba'i/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo//me tog brgyan pa'i mtsho'i ngang ba rnams las kha cig gis bstod pa/dus sprin 'dzum pa'i thor tshugs nang na 'od dpag med kyi glog phreng can/ /thugs rje'i 'brug sgra phyogs kyi mthar khyab tshangs pa'i rnga chen gsal bar sgrog /snyan pa'i gsung dbyangs chu char bsil bas 'gro blo'i yid mkha' rab 'gengs shing / /srid gsumachuphan bde'i me tog gis bkra 'jig rten dbang po'i zhabs la 'dud//yang kha cig gis bstod pa/ khyod zhal ku muta gnyan gyi dpal/ /gdul bya'i mkha' la rab mdzes pa'i/ /nges pa la ni su yis 'gong / /'phrin las 'od dkar can la 'dud//yang kha cig gis bstod pa/ thugs rje'i phyag las bsil ba'i chu sprengs pas/ bdud re'i snying la gdung ba'i drod 'bar zhing / /yi dwags rnams la bsil ba'i bdud rtsirayi'abab/ /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo yang kha cig gis bstod pa/ khyod gdong zla ba shar bas mi zum 288
