pa/ ltang 'dzin/ rnam par grol ba lasanyams pa chad pa ste rtogs pa ma 'dres pa drug sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi'aphrin la sa yeshes kyi sngon du 'tho zhing jes su 'brang ba ste 'phrin las ma 'dres pa gsum/ 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da lta ba la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes mnga' ba ste ye shes ma 'dris pa gsum bcas sdom pas bco brgyad do/ /0rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ sa chen po rnam pa drug tu g.yos pa ste/ shar mthon nub dmal ba/nub mtho gshar dmal ba/ lho mtho na byang dmal ba/ byang mabon lho dma' ba/ mthal mtho na dbus dma' ba/ dbus mthon mtha' dma' bar 'gyur ba ste rnam pa drug na/ /4〉stobs ldan/'dir lham yin stobs ldan la go dgos/ /4〉'jig rten skyong bzhi/ 6la chen rigs bzhi'o/ /4mebasam gtan dang po/ bsalgtan bzhi'i nang gses/ sa 'og ma 'dod khams kyi 'dod yon lnga bo dag la spyod pa ni skyon can yin la/ gzugs khamasakyibasam gtan la sogs pa rna zhi ba dang bde ba yin par rtog cing dpyod pa'i sgo nas gong ma'i yon tan thob pa ste/ mi mthun pa 'i phyogs nyams pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba can rna/ /brten 'brel/ rten 'grel gyi skad dod legs sbyar la pra tī bya sa pu twā da zhes 'byung ba'i pra bhā byarna mang po 'tshogs shing 'dus pa'am 'phrad pa'i don yin la/ sa mu t+pā da rna bskyed pa'am 'byung ba'idon yin bas/ dngos po gang rung gcig las 'bras bu rna tshogs dang / rgyu sna tshogs la 'bras bu gcig kho na skyeb rna mi 'id pas/ rgyu rkyen sna tshogs 'phrad cing tshogs pa laltos nas 'bras 6 sna tshogs su 'byung ba'am/ yan lan snga ma la
rten cing gyi 4rnamasa'abrelabar 'byung ngo / tshasathams cad dpyad na ngo bo 'u yang ma grub pa stong ba nyid du gnas kyang / snang tsams ltos nas grub cing brten nas skyeb rna rten 'brel gyimatshan nyid dam ngo bo ste/ 〈〈rtsa ba shes rab〉las/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gang / /de rna stong ba nyid du brtso/da/ /ces gsungs pa'i gnad kyang 'ad yin rna/ /4yin bgos pa/ mu cha rgyan pa/ 44nyan thos/ legs sbyar skad du shu ba ka zhes pa nyan pa dang thos pa gnyis ka la 'jug pa sa nyan thos zhes bya ste/ slob dpon gzhan la brten zhing 2 las thos pa dag yul gzhan la sgrog pa sa thos sgrog gam nyan thos zhes bya/ skabs 'dir theg pa gsum gyi nang tshan nyan thos gyi theg pa la zhugs pa'i gang zag ste/ theg chen gyi re snod rang gisgtso bor nyams su mi len pa dang / sangs rgyas sogs las nyan zhing thos par byed pas nyan thos zhes bya'o/ 4yirang rgyal/ rang sangs rgyas te/ legs sbyar skad sa za tre ka zhes bya/ srid spru tha ma'itshe slob dpon la ltos par rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i chos nyid brtags nas gang zag gi bdag med dang chos kyi bdag med phyed tsalrtogs te rang byang chub mngon du bstes pa'i dgra bcom rnga 'o/ /bshes gnyen sra ba la gdams pa bya dka' ba a'i dbyangabardo la nges pa/yang dag lam la rab gnas pa/ /las ngan bag chags ①thams cad spangs/ /gzhan phan thabs mang rab mnga' ba/ /dag pa sar 365
nanas 'jam dpal dang / /gzhan yang 'phags pa 0thams cad la/ ༈lhag bsam dag pas rab dad nas/ /zab lam man ngag dam pa 'chad/ /lhag par dka' bas mnyan par 'tshal/ /las ngan bag chags bsags pa las/ /mngal dang gzhan yang gnas ngan 'gar/ /rang dbang spangs nas btsal ba dang / /rnam mang na tshas yang yang mnar/ /rgas pas yan lag nyams dang 'dar/ /rkang lag zha dang mdangs ngan pa/ /thams cad las ngan dbang las lags/ /las ngan chags sdang ma spangs na/ /rang gzhan thams cad las ngan las/ /nam yang thar bar dka' bas na/ /chags sdang spang la 'bad par 'tshal/ /rnam dkar las las thar ba dang / /las ngan bsags pas las ngan 'gar/ /yang yang mnar ba rab bsams nas/ /dkar nag las dul gdam ga 'tshal/ /rab gnag las la gang dga' ba/ las ngan dbang la sa bsad pa dang / /bcad dang btags pas rnam par mnar/ /nags tshal g.yang sa mtha' yas par/ /bshang lam bdar bas bcad pa dang / /rab tsha zangs nang nyam nga bar/ /sha dang pags pa zhag rnams zad/ /mkha' la 'dab ma 'bar ba dang / /rnam mang mda' char yang yang 'bab/ /rab 'bar tsha ba dang ldan par/ /dpag yas bskal par gnas kyang 'tshal/ /gzhan ltang pad+ma ltar gas nas/ /nyam thag par yang gnas pa dag /thams cad las ngan dbang lags pas/ /las ngan spang la 'bad par 'tshal/ /gzhan yang las ngan bsags pa las/ /rta 'am ba glang mngal btsas nas/ /rang 366
dbang rab spangs thag pas btags/ /bsad dang bcad pas nyam thag 'bar/ /la la khal mang bkal bas mnar/ /phan dang dga' ba spangs pa dag /thams cad las ngan dbang lags pas/ /las ngan spang la 'bad par 'tshal/ /las ngan dbang las gang zag 'gas/ /yang dag kha zas ma 'tshal bar/ /thal dang bshang ba za ba 'am kha zas gtan nas ma 'tshal bas/ /nyam thag par yang rnam par gnas/ /la la rkang lag mtha' dag zha/ /sna dang yan lag ma tshang bas/ /gzhan 'gas smad dang brnyas par mdzad/ /la la gcan gzan mngal btsas nas/ /gzhan la sdang bas rnam par gnas/ /la la nya dang phag par gnas/ /'dam bcas gnas na nyal ba dag /thams cad las ngan dbang lags pas/ /las ngan spang la 'bad par 'tshal las ngan dbang las nya ba dang / /bshan pa dag la rab dga' bas/ /rab gnag las lam mang bsags nas/ /las ngan nyam ngar rtag par dzonas/ /mthar yang thar bar dka' bas na/ /las ngan spang la 'bad par 'tshal/ /dar mar gnas pa rgas pas nyams/ /rnam mang na tshas mdangs bzang yal/ /bsags pa thams cad nam yang 'dzad/ /gnas pa thams cad mthar 'gag pas/ /bsams pa thar ba la gtad nas/ /rnam dkar las la 'bad pa dang / /chags sdang mtha' dag spangs na 'thad/ /pad ma rā ga 'bar ba dang / /margad khang pa ba dan can/ /chang dang kha zas rab mang bar/ /dga' ma mdangs bzad dang bcas pa/ /dar zab stan la nyal ba dang / /sa bdag 367
dbal las mthar nyams nas/ /'dam bcas khang pa dag na nyal/ /kha zas yang dag ma 'tshal bas/ /rang dbang dga' ba rab spangs nas/ /nyam thag par yang gnas 'tshal lags/ /dal 'bab pad ma gsar gnas pa/ /yal 'dab dang ldan dpag bsam can/ /dga' tshal dag dang lha rnams dang / /dbang mdzad dpal ldan lha dbang yang / /lha dbang dpal las mthar nyams nas/ /phag gam ba lang mngal nas btsas/ /kha zas rtswa dang bshang ba za/ /sa dang gnas mal ngan pa 'gar/ /nyam nga bar yang gnas 'tshal lags/ /sngar bshad las ngan rab spangs nas/ /rnam dkar gzhan phan bsam pa dang / /yang dag la ma la rab gnas pas/ /las dang bag chags spangs pa dang / /thar lam dag la 'bad na 'thad/ /rab dkar las la gang dga' ba/ /yang dag kha zas rnam mang ldan/ /khang bzang ba dan can la dbang / /thams cad bka' la rab mnyan pa/ /sa la dpal 'bar sa bdag dang / /bsam gtan rab mnga' tshangs dbang yang yang dag sar gnas 'phags pa dang / /gzhal yas khang gnas lha dbang yang / /rnam dkar las la rag las pas/ yang dag lam la 'bad na 'thad/ /yal 'dab rab bzang dpag bsam dang / /mdangs gsal dal 'bab pad gsar can/ /dga' tshal ma la yas khang pa/ /dpag yas ngad ldan gnas gtsang na/ /khang bzang rnam dkar ba dan can/ /lta na rab dga' yangs pa dang / /dar dkar na bza' mal cha stan/ /rnam mang dar zab rat+na0dang / /yang dag kha zas dpal la dbang / /36
sa dang bar snang mtha' dag na/ /dpag yas bsngags pa dang ldan pa'ang / /rnam dkar las la rag las pas/ /yang dag lam la 'bad na 'thad/ /zab yangs gaṅgā pad gsar can/ /pad dkar mdangs bzang 'dab ma 'dab/ /tsan+dan ma la ya ngad ldan/ /snang ba rab 'bar rnam mang gsal/ /rab bzang ngad ldan tsan+dan bdar/ /zhal zas bza' ba lha rdzas①mang / /rdza rnga cha lang0skad snyan dang / /dga' cha mdangs gsal gar nyams can/ /lha rdzas gzhan yang mang ldan pa/ /rab dkar las la rag las pas/ /yang dag lam la 'bad na 'thad/ /rnam dkar las la 'bad na yang / /mtshan ma dang ldan bsam gtan las/ /zag bcasazloganas nas thar bar dka'/ /yang dag lam la gnas pa la/ /zag pa thams cad 'gags pa na/ /mtshan mar lta bzlorab spangs nas/ /bka' dang man ngag mnyan par 'tshal/ /yang dag lam la mkhas pa dang / /gzhan phan bsam pa rab mnga' ba/ /sa dang lam la gnas pa yang / /gang zag da7pa gzhan btsal nas/ /zab lam yang yang nyan na bzang /ji /rnam dag bka' dang 'gal ba rnams/ /gzhan 'gas 'thad par bstan na yang / /tshad mas rnam par bkag pas na/ /nyan yang rang gzhan ngal bar zad/ /bsam gtan dag la ma 'bad na/ /nyan pa tsam las thar dka' bas/ /rang rang khang pa bas mtha'adudang / /gang bsam nags tshal nyams dga' ba/ /'dab chags skad snyan dang ldan par/ /bsam pa gzhan dgu rab btang nas/ /mnyam guzhag lam la 'bad na 369
'thad/ /bdag lta mtha' dag rnam spangs nas/ /za ba lam yang dag lta ba la/ /rnam dag bsam pas 'bad pa na/ /thar ba dam pa rang la gnas/ /yang dag lam la 'bad na yang / /rang la phan bsam ma spangs na/ /nyan rang yidag las ma 'das pas/ /gzhan phan las la 'bad na 'thad/ /gang zag gzhan dag thams cad la/ /pha dang mar yang rab bsams nas/ /rang las gzhan la lhag par yang / /rnam dkar bsam pa ldan par 'tshal/ /gzhan phan bsam pas rab 'phangs nas/ /kha zas mal cha gnas khang dang / /yan lag dag dang dga' ma yang / /ma phangs gzhan la gtang bar 'tshal/ /la las 'dab ma 'bar ba dang / /rnam mang mda' char phab na yang / /bdag dang las la rab bsam nas/ /rnam dkar bsam pas gnas par 'tshal/ /thar sa cad rang la rag las pas/ rang bsam ltag ltar yan pa dag /zab lam ka ba dam pa la/ /bsam gtan thag pas btags na bzang / /lta ngan rnam par ma bsal na/ /thar lam dag las nyams lags pas/ /rtag chad lta ba yirab spangs nas/ /yang dag mtha' la mnyam gzhag 'tshal/ /brtags nas tshad mas bsal ba dang / /tha snyad snang tsam ma 'gags pas/ /rtag chad mtha' las rab 'das par/ /yang dag lam la mkhas pas bshad/ /yang dag lam la ma 'bad na/ /las ngan bar chags spang dka' bas/ /mtshan ma thams cad rab spangs nas/ /sa lamadudag la 'bad par 'tshal/ /bka' rnams gdams par rab shar nas/ /zab lam bsam gtan dag la 'bad/ /mnyam gzhag lam las 370
langs pa dang / /bka' dang man ngag 'chad par 'tshal/ /gzhan phan mdzad pa bsam las 'das/ /las ngan bka chags mtha' dag spangs/ /zab lam thams cad tshang bar mnga'/ /mtshan dang ldan pa gzhan las lhag /rab dang bar dang tha ma la/ /rang rang khams dang bsam pa dang / /'tsham par lam rnams mas cad 'chad/ /tshangs dang lha dbang bka' la nyan/ /mda' lnga baXrnams rang dbang spangs/ /'phags pa gzhan las mkhas pa dag /yang dag lam la rag las pas/ /las ngan thams cad rab spangs nas/ /yang dag lam la 'bad par 'tshal/ /gzhan phan bsam pas rab 'phangs nas/ /zab lam bag tsam bstan pa la/ /bdag la phan bsam ldan pa rnams/ /dga' dang dad pas nyan na 'thad/ /tha mal nad dang bcas pa yang / /sman pa dag la rab nyan na/ /chags dang ldang bas na ba dag /bka' las 'das pa ga la 'thad/ /yan lag zhags pas bsdams pa yang / /bcad thabs dag la rab 'bad na/ /las ngan zhags pas btab pa dag /dal bar gnas pa ga la 'thad/ /dad ldan sba bas riyang dang yang / /nan mdzad ngag las rab nyan nas/ /snyan ngag gnas rnams mtha' dag la/ /mkhas pas lhag bsam dag pas brtsams zab lam man ngag bshad pa la/ /'gal ba snang na mkhas la bshags/ /rnam dkar las dang gang ldan pas/ /rang gzhan bag chags spang bar 'tshal/ /gzhan 'ogs bskal par 'bad na yang / /brtsam par rab dka' snyan ngag dag /lhag bsam rnam par dag pas brtsams/ /375
mkhas pa rnams la ya ma tshan gnas/ /chags dang sdang bas smad na yang / /rang rtags gzhan la bstan par zad/ /bdag la 'dar dpanyam nga ba/ /nam yang mnga' ba ga la 'tshal /zhes pa 'di rna bshes gnyan sba bas bskul ba'i ngor/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab phal mo che la blo gros kyi pad mo rgyas pa shar tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis sbyar ba'o// //mchan 'grel ()bag chags/ nang sems kyis phyi yul bzang ngan bar ma sna tshogs gigoms pa song ba'inus pa bag la nyal rnam shes kyisteng na 'gos yod pa'i cha'o/ /phu'i'aphags pa/ so so skye bo las rir bar 'phags pas na 'phags pa ste/ theg dman gyi mthong la ma thob pa dang theg chen gyi sadang po thob pa yan chad la 'phags pa zhes bya'o/ /phu'idkar nag las / dge ba dang mi dge ba'il sa gnyis la dkar po'ilas dang nag po'i lasasu brtsod/ durat+na/ rin chen nam rnar bu rin po che/ (1rilhapas/ 'a btags dang / lha'i rin po che dang /lha'i rgyan gos yo byang so sas don du ma la 'ju5 / 'dir lha'i yo byad de/ dar ngo]sa rgyan chasogs mchog tu car pa la go dgos/ ⑨cha lang / 6ba cha'irigs su snyur pa'i rol chas kyiming / 0zag bcas/ nyon mongs pa'i zag dang bcas pa'i chos te/ slob dpon yon tan 'od kyis mdzad pa'i〈〈phung po lnga'i rab byed kyi'agrelba〉〉las/ zag pa dang lhan gcig byung pa sa zag pa dang bcas pa'o/ zag pa rnams rna nyon mongs pa rnamasaso zhes gsungs so/ /()mtshan mar lta ba/ mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i shesapa ste/ kos 372
thams cad ba na grub tu'adzin pa'i phyin ci log gi rtog pa lta bu'o/ /()bas mtha'/ zad pa'i mtha' ste grong zad pa'i thag ring ba'i sa gnas/ 4yinyan rang / nyan thosadang rang sangs rgyas/ 6)rtag chad lta ba/ rtag par lta ba dang chad par lta ba gnyis te/ bden grub tu 'dzin pa'i rtag lta dang gtan med du 'dod pa'i chad lta'o/ /()sa lam/ 'dir sa bcu dang la ma lngaldebasdus ming / sa lam zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan 3/ rje 'jigs med dbang bo'i〈〈sa lam theg gsum mdzes rgyan〉〉las/ der sa brjod pa ni/ sasaji shing nags tshal la sogs pa'i rten byed pa bzhin du/ 'dis lam zhugs 'i yogatan du ma'irten byed pas na de lta ra brjod pa'i phyir nas dang / de la lam zhes brjod pa ni/ thar ba'igo 'phang du bgrod par cad pa yin pas na de ltar brjod do zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /4)mda' lnga ba/ 'dod lha'am bdud dka' rab dbang phyug go/ /der gzhan yid subs pa'i mda' lnga dang ldan pas mdal lnga ba zhes brjod/ mda' lnga rna/ 〈〈'grel ba sgron gsal〉〉las/ rengs byed dang / srid byed dang / kun tu rmongs byed dang / brgyal bar byed pa dang / sems med par byed pa dang lnga yin par gsungs/〈〈ma/las pa'i rna rgyan〉〉las/ snyo byed dang / sred byed/ kun tu rmongs gyed/ skem gyed/ 'chi6da dang lnga yin par gsungs so/ /373
ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ngor me waṃ dgon gsar du 'debs po sa skya'i bla ma kun dga' bzang po rna/ rab byung drug pa'i chu khyi(spyi lo 1382 ) lor yab dpon tshang grub pa yon tan dang / yum bsod nams dpal ldan zhes pa gnyis kyi sras su dpal sa skyar sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo drug par chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan slob dpon du bsten nas yi ge 'bri klog snyong bar mdzad/ dgung lo dgu par ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi drung nas dge bsnyen dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa blangs/ de nas rim bzhin chos je ye shes rgyal mtshan nas dge slong dang / byang sems/ gsang ba sngags kyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs/ mdo sngags kyi chos ma lus pa zugs la btags/ khyad par dpal ldan sa skya pa'i lugs kyi dkyil chog dang / sgrub thabs rnams legs par gsan te mkhas pa'i gras su tshud cing chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi sras kyi thu bor gyur/ dgung lo nyer lnga par rje ye shes rgyal mtshan sku gshegs pas shangs chos 'khor sgang dang zhe dgon du phebs nas lo tsā ba skyabs mchog dang bus shrī'i mdun du chos gsan/ de rjes sa bzang dgon par byon nas sa bzang bla ma gzhon nu blo gros bla mar bsten nas dam chos yun ring gsan/ dgung lo nyer dgu pa rab byung bdun pa'i lcags stag(spyi lo 1410)lor sa bzang dgon pa'i bdag po bgyis te dgung lo zhe dgu 374
bar gdan sar bzhugs/ bshad khrid dang / dbang lung / sdom pa 'bogs pa sogs chos sbyin rgya cher mdzad/ dgung lo zhe dgu ba lcags khyi (spyi lo 1430)lor na bza' phug ri khrod dang / bsam gling ri khrod/me waṃ ri khrod du phabs nas 'chad nyan mdzad/ me waṃ ri khrod du gtsug lag khang gsar du bzhengs pa dang sku gsung thugs kyi rten mang du bzhengs pa/bshad grwa btsugs pa sogs byas nas ye waṃ chos ldan gyi gdan sa chen po gsar du spel/ skal ldan gyi slob ma sa skya'i gdung rgyud gzhi thog pa kun dga' dbang phyug bdag chen chu mig pa blo gros dbang phyug ngor mkhan po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ gzhon nu rgyal mtshan sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po du ma bskyangs/ dgung lo don lnga pa rab byung brgyad pa'i me byi(spyi lo 1456)lor e waṃ dgon du sku gshegs so/ /rje 'di'i gsung chos sgrub thabs kyi skor dang / thob yig cho ga rnam thar/ spreng yig sogs me waṃ bka' 'bum du grags pa pod bzhir bsdus yod/chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan0la bstod pa lnga/oṃ sulta sirnyi/ chos kyi rī dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /yid 'ongs mtshan dpe'i tshogs kyis spras pa'i sku/ /yid 'phrog tshangs dbyangs lta bur snyan pa'i gsung / /yid bzhin nor ltar 'gro la snyoms pa'i bugs/ /yid la re ba'i 'bras stsol de la 'dud/ /375
ye shes lnga②yi ro yis gang ba'i thugs/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab ②ji bzhin ston pa'i gsung / /mtshan dpe'i tshogs kyis rnam par mdzes pa'i sku/ /dpal 'byor bzang po bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /ye shes chen po'i bde bas ②yongs gang zhing / /ye shes dam pa'i gzigs pas 'gro ba kun/ /ye shes zag med bde la skyong mdzad pa'i/ /ye shes lnga ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rgyal sras dam pa'i spyod pa mthar phyin pas/ /rgyal ba lta bur kun la snyoms mdzad cing / /rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas mdzad pa/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mtshan mo'i mgon②ltar dri med gsal ba'i sku/ /mtshan dang dpe byad tshogs kyis nyer mdzes shing / /mtshan tsam dran pas yid kyi gdung sel ba/ /mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs bla ma'o⑨zhabs la 'dud/ /dpal mchog bde gsheng/sa gsung gi mdzod 'dzin cing / dpal 'byor dam pa'i chos la legs ro ra pas/ /dpal gyi 'byung gnas bstan pa spel mdzad pa'i/ /dpal mgon mthar thug bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bzang po'i las dang sngon lam yongs dag pas/ /bzang po'i thugs kyis mtha' yas sems can kun/ /bzang po'i spyod pa mchog la sbyor mdzad pa'i/ /bzang po'i lam ston bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /sku dang ye shes tshogs la mnga' brnyes pas/ /sku yi rnam 'phrul sna tshogs dang ldan zhing / /sku mchog mthong pas yid kyi dpal 'phrog pa'i/ /sku gsum mthar phyin bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /gsung rab kun gyi snying po legs bsdus pa'i/ /gsung gi zer gyis 'gro blo'i mun sel zhing / /gsung dbyangs yan lag 376
drug cus legs 'byor pa'i/ /gsung gi dbang phyug bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /thugs rgyud byams dang snying rjes rab gang zhing / /thugs kyi dgongs pa cad byung mnga' ba'i mthus/ /thugs kyis bzhed ltar srid gsum smin mdzad pa'i/ /thugs rje che ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mkhyen pa'i ye shes dpag med mnga' ba'i mthus/ /mkhyen brtse nus ldan gzhan gyis mngon bstod cing / /mkhyen chen gsung rab zab mo'i mdzod 'dzin pa'i/ /mkhyen rab dbang phyug bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rnam dag blo gros mkha' ltar rab yangs shing / /rnam dpyod shes rab thogs pa med ldan pas/ /rnam mang 'gro la dam pa'i chos ston pa'i/ /rnam mkhyenazloganyis pa bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /dbang dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul la sogs la/ /dbang rab 'byor zhing dge legs yon tan gyi/ /dbang phyug dam pa'i chos kyi rgyal srid la/ /dbang rab bsgyur mdzad bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /chos kun rang dang spyi yi mtshan nyid ngal/ /chos bzhin mkhyen pa rmad byung mnga' ba'i mthus/ /chos smra rnams kyi gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa'i/ /chos rje 'gro mgon bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /don grub rgyal ba'i sras kyi gsung rab rnams/ /don bzhin rtogs nas thugs rjes gzhan dag la/ /don min spangs pa'i chos kyi char 'bebs pa'i/ /don gnyis44na grub bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan bsam yas pa/ /mngon du gyur pas dad ldan gdul bya kun/ /mngon par mtho ba'i sa la 'jog mdzad pa'i/ /mngon su ma spyan ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /dge ba'i 'byung gnas thub bstan yid bzhin 377
rnar/ /dge ba'i thugs kyis rtag tu sung mdzad cing / /dge legs yon tan dpal gyis mngon 'byor pa'i/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /'gro ba'i don du byang chub thugs bskyed nas/ /'gro rnams bu ltar brtse bas nyar dgongs shing / /'gro kun srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol byed pa'i/ /'gro ba'i mdon po bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /byams dang thugs rje tshad med mnga' ba'i mthus/ /byams chen lta bur 'gro la phan mdzad cing / /byams pa'i dpal gyis gdul bya'i dpal mdzad pa'i/ /byams pa'i dbang phyug bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /skyabs mdon rgal ba'i bdag sogs sems can la/ /skyabs dang dpung gnyan gzhan nas mi 'tshol bar/ /skyabs gnas mthar thug khyed la gsol 'debs kyi/ /skyabs mchog dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /nas pa dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu ba 'de/ shākya'i dgi slong kun dga' bzang pos dpal sa skyar sbyar ba'o// //oṃ sulta/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis0las grub pa'i/ /thar ba'i rgyal mtshan yon tan nor bus spras/ /'gro la dpal 'byor bzang po'i 'bras stsol ba'i/ /mtshungs med chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs/5 /mkhyen rab nam mkha'i ngos ltar rab yangs shing / /thugs rje zla ba'i zer ltar tog pa med/ /phrin las nyi ma'i 'od ltar legs 'phro ba'i/ /mtshungs med chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /'chad na chos kyi de nyid 378
'byed mkhas shing / /rtsod na log lta'i rgyu skar skyengs gus la/ /rtsom na blo gsar yid kyi dpal 'phyog pa'i/ /mtshungs med chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /thos pa'i khang brtsegs rgya chen gzhal med khang / /bsam pa rin chen nor mang gis gang zhing / /bsgom pa'i snying po'i tog gis nyar mdzes pa'i/ /mtshungs med chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /lung gi bya lam rnam par yangs pa la/ /rig pa'i khrin tshogs stug po rab bsdus nas/ /man ngag char gyis 'gro kun gdung sel ba'i/ /mtshungs med chos kyi je la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhas pa'i bzhin ras gsal zhing bkra ba la/ /btsun pa'i lus rgyas yon tan nor gyis gang / /bzang po'i gos dang rgyan gyis nyer mdzes pa'i/ /mtshungs med chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'a2bas/ /so thar sdom pa'i yirtsa ba legs brtan zhing(cing)//byang sems khrims②kyi sprul gas nyar mdzes la/ /rig 'dzin sdom pa'i ༷'bras bus rnam cad pa'i/ /mtshungs med chos kyi the la gsol ba 'debs//dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa'i yo byad rnams/ /dngos grub 'byung gnas dpal ldan bla ma la/ /dngos po'i gnas lugs ③rtogs pa'i blos 'bul gyi/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas byin rgyas rlobs/ /khyed nyid 'og min gnas①su byang chub kyang / /khyed kyi phrin las 'dzo la 'jug bya'i phyir/ /khyed nyad phal ba'i tshul du bstan pa'o zhes/ /khyed la mos gus skye pa rdzu gā tram̐ gh+nā / parnyi/ sem/rdzu gh+nā ( shā paXn mas phyi /pa gā〉 pakhridris sna'i ra/nga/ bzhin stong pa'o zhes/ /spros med rnal 'byor bskom par byin gyis rlobs/ /379
snang ba thams cad sgyu ma'i rta glang bzhin/ /snang ba 'khrul pa'i ngo bor bden na yang / /snang ba'i chos kun gdod nas zhi ba'o zhes/ /snang ba bden med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /rab ma chog mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /rab gus gdung ba'i yid kyi gsol 'debs kyis/ /rab mar tshe rabs kun tu rjes bzung nas/ /rab zab lam bzang bsgom par byin gyis lkobs/ /zhes pa bla ma dam pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bcu gnyis pa 'di yang / shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos sbyar ba'o// //oṃ sunyi/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis mthar phyin pas/ ༈mo/ra bu rin chen rgyal mtshan rtser son ltar/ /dpal 'byor bzang po'i 'bras stso la chos kyi rje/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo /lung rigs man ngag tshogs la dbang 'byor pas/ /skal ldan gdul bya'i bsam pa ji bzhin du/ /zab yangs chos 'khor skor mdzad chos kyi je/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpyod pa'i gangs rir 'gal 'brel lus stobs rgyas/ /yon tan ral pa'i khur gyis rab brjid pas/ /dngos 'dzin lu tshogs sbrag mdzad chos kyi rje/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sde snod gsum gyi 'dzin ma rab yangs par/ /grub mtha' bzhiḥyi chu bo 'dus pa las/ /lam lngayisa bcu'iyibacud rgyas chos kyi rje/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyud sde bzhi0yi khang bzang mdzes pa la/ /dam tshig sdom pa'i yitog gis rnam par brgyan/ /rim gnyisayinar gyis phyug pa'i chos 380
kyi rje/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtha' yasal 'gro ba'i gnyen gyur chos kyi rje/ /mtha' med 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor gnas pa rnams/ /mtha' bral chos kyi skam sar rab bzhag nas/ /mthar thug rgyal ba'i go 'phang bsgrub tu gsol/ /ces pa 'di yang / shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos gsol ba btab pa'o// //oṃ swat+ta/ dus gsu ma rgyal pa'i mkhyen brtse ye shes sku/ /ga'ug bsdus thub dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /rab 'byams shes bya'idpal 'byor bzang po can/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la spyi bos 'dud/ /da legs chu gter che las legs 'khrungs shing / /yon tan pad+mo'i zeg'bru rab mdzes pas/ /gdul bya bung ba'i tshogs kun tshim mdzad pa'i/ /chu skyes dbang po bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bsgom pa'i lus rgyas thos pa'i mig yangs shing / /lung dang rigs pa'i gshog yangs zung ldan pas/ /nyon mongs lto 'phye'i grong khyer0rlog byed pa'i/ /mkha' ldeng dbang poXbla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rnam dag shes bya'i 6na lam rab yangs par/ /thogs med mkhyen pa'i 'od zer 'dum ldan pas/ /lta ngan rmongs pa'i phun pa sel mdzad pa'i/ /rta bdun da nga po7bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mtha' yas lda snod rgyud sde'i rgya mtsho las/ /rnam mang legs bshad nor bu'i tshogs blangs nas/ /grangs med gdul bya'i dbul ba sel mdzad pa'i/ /ded dpon dbang po bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud//rgya chen tshogs gnyis rkang 'thung rtsa ba brtan/ /phrin las yab 'dab mkhyen pa'i 'bras bu can/ /rnam dag zugs rje'i bsil grib ldan pa yi/ /381
sngon shing dbang po bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /tshad med zugs rje'i ye shes rin chen gter/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser bzung nas/ /'bad med can grub dpal 'byor bzang po can/ /chos kyi rgyal po bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /ces pa 'de yang dge slong kun dka' bzang po'i yid mtsho las skyes pa'o// //oṃ salta sidhi/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes dpag yas shing / /thugs rje'i rgyal mtshan dri ma med/ /phrin las dpal 'byor bzang po can/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /skyabs gdug ston pa'i gsung rab kun/ /skad cig la mkhyen gdul bya yi/ /gnyan gcig gyur pa bla ma la/ /rtse gcig gus pas spyag 'a la lo/ /tshogs gnyis chu gter las 'khrungs shing / /don gnyis 'byor pa'i yal 'dab rgyas/ /sku gnyis tsun grub bla ma la/ /lag gnyis btud de byag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i ngo bo nyid/ /khams gsum 'gro ba'i dpal gcig pu/ /sa gsum mnga' bdag bla ma la/ /sgo gsum gus pas lcag 'tshal lo/ /rigs bzhi'i sems canaXm lus la/ /dbang bzhi'i7lam mchog rab bstan nas/ /'gros bkañtsatram mdzad bla ma la/ /sku bzhi thob jir spyag 'tshal lo/ /dug lngas ②gzer ba'i 'gro ba rnams/ /rigs lnga'iXgo 'phang la snyor ba'i/ /lam lnga 'gas chud bla ma la/ /smad lnga btud de phyag 'tshal lo/ /nas pa 'di yang shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos zag pa'o/ / / /mchan 'thel ①chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ dus rabs bca bzhi bar byung ba'i saskya'i mkhas pa rnam lta/ ngor ge kun dga' bzang po'i rtsa ba'i za ma 382

gnyis/ rangadon dang gzhan don gnyis/ 0bsod nams yi shingtshogs gnyis/ dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i mchod sbyin sogs dkar po dge ba'i las la bsod nams kyitshogs zhes bya ba dang / da gas pa med pa'i ye shes kyitshogs te/ stong nyid byang chub sems kyi jis rin pa'i 'bras 6 ye shes chos sku'athob par byed pa'i zag med kyi dge ba'i tshogs la ye shes kyitshogs zhes bya'o/ /()so thar gyi sdom pa/bu ston rin po che'i〈〈gros 'debs yi ge snying gi thur ma〉〉zhes pa'i mchan rtags ang()la gzigs/ 4yibyang sems kyi khrims/ byang sems 6sdom pa ste/ 〈gros 'debs yi ge snying gi thur ma〉〉zhes pa'i mchan rtags ang0la gzigs/ ⑨rig 'dzin sdom pa/ 〈gros 'debs yi ge snying gi byor ma〉〉zhes pa'i mchan rtags mngazhu)la gzis/sa/ yidangos po'i gnas lugs/ dngos po thams cad = rkyen la brten nas skyes pa ste rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i chos nyid/②'og min gnas/ bsam gtan bzhi ba'i gnas ris brgyad pa ste/gnas 'dir skyes pa'i lha ni gzugs khams kyi mthar thug cing / de yan chad gzugs can gzhan med pas kun gyi dong du gyur pa'i phyir 'og min zhes bya'o/ skabs 'dir 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing r+sāsangs rgyas 'tshang rgya ba'i gnas yin la/ gulang nar gshegs pa'i mdo〉〉las/ 'dod pa'i khams dang gzugs med du/ /sangs rgyas rnam par 'tshang mi rgya/ /gzugs kyikhams kyi'og min du/ /'dod chags bral khyod 'tshang rgya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /()grub mtha' bzhi/ nang ba'i theg pa che chung gi grub mtha' smra ba bzhi ste/ñtsha bras spru ba/ mdo re pa/ sems tsam pa/ dbu ma pa bcas so /

zen las sgo bde'i gdul bya legs bskyangs pa/ /kun dga' gzhon nur grags la 'di skad meng / /khyod sku skabs gsum dbang po'i pho zang0la/ /rnam g.yeng lha min dpung dang mi ldan par/ /blo gsal lha bu'i tshogs dang lhan cig tu/ /chos don bdud ji'i zas la spyod do zhes/ /ring nas 'ongs pa'i slob gnyis rgyud mangs kyi/ /tra wang sga snyan sgrogs pa yang yang thos/ /khyad par lhag bsam dag pa'i chu gter las/ /legs 'khrungs 'bul ba'i me tog rnam mang dang / /dad pa'i blo gros nam mkha'i khyon yangs par/ /phrin yig nya ma'i dkyil 'khor rab rgyas pa/ /pho nya rta bdun shing rtas rab drangs nas/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i skyed mos tshal du shar/ / de tshe kho bo'i yid kyi chu skyes tshal/ /dga' ba'i 'dab stong ldan par byas pa la/ /don gnyer rkang drug ldan pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dge legs snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs sgrog par byed/ /'dir yang kho bo'i dal 'byor rgyun po la/ /rnam g.yeng mi mthun rlung gis mi g.yo zhing / /legs bshad rin chen khams dang ldan bzhin du/ /gdul bya gling bzhi'i dbus na bde bar gnas/ /shin tu rnyed dka'i dal 'byor0thob dus 'dir/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la bya ba byed dgos pas/ /dam chos rin chen tshul bzhin 'chad pa la/ /yengs med brtson 'grus rtsom dang shes ldan dag /rgyud sde'i dgongs pa gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ /tshig sgros dngos bstan tsam la ma zhen par/ /mtha' drug②tshul bzhi'i0gsang ba'i sgo sge nas/ /skabs don nyams su longs dang shes ldan dag /'khor dang longs spyod rgyas pa'i sems 'dzin sogs/ /tshe 'di'i tshe thabs 387
bsgrub pa'i blo spangs nas/ /gang na dam chos 'phel ba'i gnas rnams su/ /bshad sgrub tshul bzhin sgrubs dang shes ldan dag /slad mar dpo'o slob so sor zhabs brtan zhing (cing) / /mkhas pa'i grwa slob tha grur rgyas pa dang / /tshe ring nad med thos bsam 'phel byed du/ /dngos sam yi ge'i ngos nas 'phrad par smon/ /khyed kyis dam chos tshul bzhin bsgrub pa dang / /rgya chen 'bul ba'i rnam gzhag bskur pa sogs/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams/ /bde gshegs bstan pa rgyas pa'i rgyu ru bsngo// // khu60/ /mchan 'grel dun 'o buca ya/ na mo rna 'dud pa'am phyag 'tshal ba/ bus rna sangs rgyas te/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lozhes pa'o/ /()chos brgyad/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad de/ rnyed na dga' ba/ ma rnyed na mi dka' ba/ snyan pa thos na dga'ab/ mi snyan pa thos na mi dgal ba/ bde na dga' ba/ mi bde na mi dga' ba/ bstod na dgal ba/ smad na mi dga' ba bcas brgyad do/ /①rgyud sde/ theg pa chen po gas/nga sngags lda4 theg pa'i dbang dang / lam gyi rnam gzhag sgrub thabs las tshogs sogs ci rigs ston pa'i chos kyi sde tshan/ ()skabs gsum dbang po'ipho brang / skabs gsum pa rna lha63ming dang / skabs gsum dbang po rna lha'idabang po brgya byin rna/ /de'i pho brang ni rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang nyid do/ /①dal 'byor/ dal brgyad 'byor bcu'ibasdus ming ste/ mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad las thar bas na dal ba'o/ /mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad rna/ 〈〈spyod 'jug〉〉'grel ba las/ dmyal ba yi dgas dug388
'gro dang / /klaklo tshering lhadang rnga/ /ro ga lta sangs rgyas ñtshas9stongs pa/ /lkugs pa 'de dag mi khom brgyad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /rang phyogs dang gzhan phyogasaganyis phun sum tshogs pa yinapas na 'byor ba'o/ /rang 'byor lnga ni/ ji skad du/ mir gyur dbus skyes dbang po tshang / /las mtha' ma log gnas la dad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar dang / gzhan 'byor lnga rna/ ji skad du/ sangs rgyas byon dang des chos gsungs/ /bstan paṇaganas dang de rjes 'jug /gzhan phyir snying rna brtse ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /9)mtha' drug 〈〈dus 'khor rtsa rgyud〉〉las/ dgongs pa'i skal dang de bzhin min/ /ji bzhin sgra dang de bzhin min/ /drang pa'i don dang nges don te/ /rgyud rna mtha' drug mtshan nyid do/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'bri gung pas drang don res don gnyis//rdungapa zhi/ spyan da/ /na bas / zlosayi ) zlog ga hūm̐ pado/ da pa/ngas cho /nā /sna hūm̐ spri /zi rdo/ ṭ+wāṃ // la/ pa spras dpa'i rgyu/pa( dī ny+pha r+sha t+na pa'i pa tshur+sha ༷sa ni/dang po rna tshig gi 'gru mun tsam rna yi ge'idon/ gnyis pa spyidon la /shā kā dzī/ zhu/ hā pashāg gh+nā smra sngu zlo/ ṭ+wāṃ /sra pa ༷/ sdo (( pa/'i rnyi /sna rna/ /gsum pa sgas pa ni/ 'dod chags chos sbas dang kun rdzob bden pa sbas pa ste mtha' gnyis kyi dbus su chud pasasnying bo lta bur gyur pa'i phyir sus 3 'o/ /bzhi ba mthar thug rna 'od gsal lam dang zung 'jug 'bras bu'i mthar thug pa'i don rna/ /yangan spyi'idon/gzhung n+t+wa dan/ rgyas pa'i don/ mthar thug gi don rnams mngon su /du gyur pa'i tshul bzhi'o zhes chos kyi rnam grangs las gang / (3shu ’/ ba legs sam dge ba'o/ /389
mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang /mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa'i bshad pa'i shing rta chen po mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa ni/ rab byung drug pa'i shing glang (spyi lo 1385)lor yab kun dga' bkra shis dpal bzang dang / yum bu 'dren rgyal au gnyis kyi sras su gtsang la stod chu 'og tu sku 'khrungs/ sku na chung ngu'i dus nas tha mal pa'i spyod pa las ring du 'das shing / rig pa'i gnas kyi gzhung gang dang 'u la gsan bsam mdzad rgyu'i dad brtson shugs chen pos drangs te ngam ring dang sa skya sogs su phebs nas mkhas chen mang po'i 5zhabs la gtugs te mkhyen rab kyi rtsal dang ldan par gyur pas kun gyi yid 'phrog par gyur/ de nas mkhas grub seng gi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i drung nas rab tu byung zhing / mtshan la mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang po zhes gsog/ dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bdun pa'i shing bya(9 lo 1405)lor rje btsun red mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros kyis mkhan po dang / rje dpal 'asgyur shes rab kyis las slob/ mnyam med blo gros mtshungs med kyis gsang ston mdzad nas bsnyon par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa yang dag par bzhes/ dgung lo nyer gsum pa ṅgā phag(spyi lo 1407)lor mnyam med tsong kha pa chen po dang mjal/ de nas dgung lo so lnga ring phal cher bcar bzhugs kyis mtshan spo tshun dbu sngas sprul te mdo rgyud man 39
ngag gi gdams pa thams cad bum pa gang byo'i tshul du mnas pas/ mkhas btsun bzang grub dang 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i yon tan gyi gter du gyur/ rje tsong kha pa chen pos kyang 'phrin yig tshigs bcad ma'i mjug tu/ bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam pa sdom brtson chen po dka' bcu ba dge legs dpal pa zhes ched bsngags mdzad cing nang thugs kyi sras gcig pur gyur/ gzhan rgyal tshab rin po che dar ma rin chen dang / 'dul 'dzin 'jam dkar pa sogs las zab chos mang du gsan/ de rjes gtsang phyogs su phebs/bdag po rab brtan pa dang mchod yon du 'brel nas rgyal rtse dpal 'khor bde chen chos sde btab cing dge lugs kyi grwa tshang mang du btsugs te 'jam mgon bstan pa'i snang byed dam par bzhings/ de nas ri bo mdangs can du byon te thugs dam mnyam bzhes la brtson pa dang / skal ldan gyi ṭa slob bang por chos kyi bgo bsha' 'gyed pa dang / mdo sngags kyi bstan bcos mang du rtsom pa gsum sprul du mdzad/ dgung lo zhi bdun pa lcags phag (spyi lo 1431)lor dga' ldan gser khrir mnga' gsol ) gser tog cod pan 'chang pa'i mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i dbus su/ dpal mnyam med ri spro dgi ldan pa'i bshad pa'i sheng rta'i srol chen po legs par phye nas/ ji thams cad mkhyen pa'i dbu sngags zung 'brel gyi bstan pa rin po che cha thams cad nas gangs can bod nas shar rgya mtsho la bug gi bar du khyab gdal du spel pa'i phyag rjes khyad par can bskrun/ dgung lo nga bzhi ba sa rta (spyi lo 1438)lor gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus te gshegs so/ /rtse 'di'i gsung chos rna/ 〈〈'grel ba don gsal gyi rnam bshad rtogs 391
dka'i snang ba〉〉〈〈dbu ma'i rnam bshad stong thun skal bzang mig 'byed〉〈〈tshad ma sde bdun gyi rgyan yid kyi mun sel 〉〉la sogs pa gangs can gyi mkhas pa gzhan gyis yun du med pa'i bstan bcos pod dgu brtsams/ chos kyi bdud rtsis bskyangs pa'i bu slob ni/ chos rje blo gros chos skyong dang /zhwa lu legs pa rgyal mtshan/ rje shes rab seng ge/ mkhas chen bsod nams mchog grub/ kun mkhyen 'phags pa 'od/ spyan snga ba blo gros rgyal mtshan/zhang zhung ba chos dbang grags pa sogs mkhas mchog grangs las 'das pa byung /rje btsun bla ma chos kyi rgyal po rtsong kha pa chen po'i yon tan mdor bskus par bsngags pa'i rab tra byed pa dad pa'i rol mtsho/oṃ bde legs su gyur cig /bka' drin mnyam med de nyid kyi zhabs la gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /phun tshogs dga' ldan lha brgya'i0cod pan gyis/ /gang gi zhabs mthil padz+dzakhyal reg pa/ /mi pham chos kyi mdun sa()mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /'jam dpal snying posaklubadag la dge legs mdzod/ /blo bzang mkhyen pa'i gting mtha' mi mngon zhing / /grags pa'i rlabs phreng rol ba'i 'jug ngogs las/ /dpal ldan yon tan chu yi thigs pa zhig /bzung phyir 'di ni dad pa'i 'bab stegs lags/ /thub bstan nub kyi ri rtser rna/ /thun 393
mtshams nas dmar 'dzin gyur pa/ /de tshe khyod kyis shar ri'i rtser/ /lebs bshad 'od brgya'i phreng ba 'dzin/ /de phyir rmongs pa'i tsha gdung gis/ /dus mthar nyen pa'i ①'gro 'di la/ /rgyal ba'i legs bshad 0'jug ngogs 95sa / /khyod kyi thugs rje'i 'o da dkar bsil/ /rgyu med par dzin nga mnyan ga4 na cing / /kun la snyoms par ches bsil ba/ /khyod kyi thugs rje'i zla ba ni/ /e ma snying la shin tu sman/ /nyid kyi don du skabs gsum pa 'i/ /bde ska bas ba'ang me 'obs ltar 'khrigs kyang / /rang gi gnas ngazhin 'a[lor ba 'di/ /gzhan phyir nyid kyis btang ma lags/ /blo gros mig sdongs 'gro 'di la/ /khyod thugs legs bshag rin chen gter/ /da lta spo ba'i thabs gang zhes/ /e ma 'di nyid 'ba' zhig dgongs/ /thub pa'i legs bshad bdud 6'i rgyun/ /'jam dbyangs zhal gyi bum pa las/ /legs 'ongs thos pa'i snyim pa yis/ /lus pa med par khyod kyis gsol/ /de lta'i bde bas khyod kyi thugs/ /rangs pa las kyang bde ba de/ /kun gyi longs spyod ma gyur pa/ /de yis khyod thugs lhag par gdungs/ /khyod kyi thugs rje'i ngang tshul 'ad/ /mthong bas yid gam gyur pa dag /rgyal ba kun gyi thugs je yang / /ji 'dra snyam du khyogs ①la 'phyang / /rang don rtswa ltar dgongs khyod kyis/ /rgyal ba kun gyi dam pa'i chosazlo/ /'dzin pa'i smo na lam lus can gyi/ /dpung gnyen 9 gyur pa ring nas mdzad/ /de phyir 'gro 'di dbugs 'byin cing / /bdud sde'i snying la 'jigs skyed pa/ /khyod kyi rlabs chen spyod pa yis/ /ma bslabs rgyal sras spyod de gang / /mi bzang dus mtha' 393
'di 'ongs tshe/ /khyod kyis ma bzung dam chos kun/ /chu dang bral ba'i pad+mo ni/ /ba mos reg pa lta bur gyur/ /dam chos gzung slad nyid kyi ni/ /sku srog la yang ltos med par/ /dka' ba brgya phrag dag gis kyang / /zhi ba'i bde ba lta bur dgyes/ /snyigs ma 0las kyang ches snyigs pa'i/ /'jigs pa mi bzad 'jig rten 'dir/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras po gzhan/ /mtha' dag mthong ba'i lam la sa 'das/ /de tshe zugs rī ldan pa khyod/ /so ga'i 0nyi mas 'gram pa'i chang / /zags ldan gnyis 'thung pad+mo'i mtshos/ /ring nas bos ltar 'jig rton gzigs/ /gdug pa'i sems can nyes pa yi/ /me lce shin tu bzod dka' ba/ /dam pa'i snying la brnag dka' ba'i/ /zug rngu rnon po sbyin pa yang / /khyod thugs snying rje'i chu 'dzin ni/ /legs bshad dbyar skyes sprin gyi sgra/ /sgrogs ldan chu char gzegs ma dag /phog pa tsam gyis zhi bar bgyid/ /rgyal ba rnams kyang rang nyid kyi/ /bstan la btang snyoms amadzad gyur pa/ gnas skabs 'dir yang khyod kyis ni/ /rgyal ba bzhin du bstan pa spel/ /rgyal sras dag pa'i zhing ཿgzhan na/ /dgyes dgur spyod pa mtha' dag las/ /snying stobs rmad byung mgon po khyod/ /mchog tu dka' ba bgyid pa lags/ /'jig rten kun na mgon khyod dang / /phyogs gcig mtshungs pa'ang rnyed dka' nas/ /de phyir bdag gis khyod kyi dper/ /rgyal ba kho na yang yang sgrin0/ /de tshe de nyid 'byed pa la/ /rgyal dang khyod dbyer ma mchis kyang / /thugs rjes rkyal ba'ang skyengs mdzad pa/ /de nas bdag cag dpe yis dbul/ /rgyal sgas 494
rgyu skar tshogs rnams kyis/ /yongs bskor rgyal ba'i zla ba ni/ /mtha' yas mngon sum mdzad pa yi sa/ /rab dgyes ku pud rgod par mdzad/ /'on kyang rgyal bas rang ñtsha/ sras/ /lung bstan dbugs dbyung mdzad pa gang / /de yi chos nyid de yin gyis/ /su zhig lhag par mtshar du brtsi/ /sdug pa'i bu la brtse ba'i rmas/ /'dzum pa'i bzhin ras⑥bstan pa ni/ /kwa ye rab tu ya mtshan par/ /'dzin pa blo gros shin tu gzhon/ /khyod kyi thugs la nyon mongs kyis/ /glags nywaskabs nam yang rnyed min pa/ /'di la'ang bdag ni de tsam du/ /ya mtshan gyur pa cang ma mchis/ /mtha' dag rnar 'dzin mun pa'i gos/ /'phrog byed nyi ma'i 'od stong gis/ /skyed tshal phun pa bsal ba 'a ji'ang / /skye po su zhig mtshar du brtsi/ /phyogs 'di thub pa'i gzhung lugs la/ /legs sbyangs blo gros ldan rnams dang / /rgyud ldan rnal 'byor⑥brtson pa gang / /sus kyang spyod yul ma gyur pa/ /rgyal ba'i thuyo/sa kyi gces pa'i mdzod/ /ma lus rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bzhin/ /dri med rigs pa'i lam nas drangs/ /log pa'i g.yang sañtsakun la sa bsgral/ /de lta mod kyi khyod kyis ni/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bzhin/ /gcig tu sgrub pa snying por mdzad/ /byang chub dam pa'i tshul yang bstan/ /tshul 'di gzhan du ma mthong bas/ /bdag yid gnyis 'thung dad pa yi/ /lcags kyus lan gcig min par drangs/ /ngo mtshar gyur nas spobs pa skyes/ /gang gi yon tan me tog gi/ /dog pa 6)phyogs kyi mdzes ma'i rgyan/ /rab dkar grags pa'i dre bzhon ni/ /nor 'dzin bu mo'i yid sgabs rgyalayi//395
mi mnyam mkhyen brtse'i rkang stegs kyis/ /mkhas mchog kun gyi mañtsa / rtswa la/ /zhabs skyes rdul tshos/sa 'dze ga45 pa gang / /zla med khyod la phyapa/ bgyid do/ /dpal ldan yis yi mgon po bshes gnyen gyi/ /yo na tan dri ba'on ma la ya yi rlung / /snying la reg pas dang ba'i ཿyid g.yes te/ /mdo rda bsdus bstod pa'i tshig 'di gtam du byas/ /dge ba 'di yis tshe rabs kun tu bdag /khyod kyi legs bshad bdud ji 'thung ba la/ /ngoms pa med par rlabs chen spyod pa yis/ /rgyal ba'i dam smyos mtha' dag 'dzin gyur cig /rgyal ba thams cad tri mkhyer pa rtse ga'ug tu bsdus pa'i ngo b+thā rje btsun bla ma chos kyi rgyal po rung kha pa chen po'e yo na tan rmad du byung ba la mtshar bsdus par bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa dad pa'i ro la ma tsho zhes bya ba 'di ni/yon tan rin po che du ma'i rgyan rgyas nye bar mdzes shing / 'gro ba du ma'i 'dren par gyur pa'i shar rgyal mo rong pa bla ma tsha go ba dpal ldan chos kyi gras/sa pa'i gsung gis bskul nas/ mang du thos pa'i btsun pa dge legs dpal bzang pos lhan bye gling gi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'i// //mchan 'grel ①dgal ldan lha brgya/ 〈〈mngon pa mdzod〉〉ltar na/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi lha la 'dod lha rigs drug tu 3ba las ba3 ba dga' ldan na gnas pa'i lha rnamasakyi ngang tshi (2zhabs mthil 215/ spyir mtshag gi khul skugang yin thams cad )zhabs mthil sa la mi reg cing /'og gi sa gzhi la 'khor lo jibs stong ca gyirimo dang gri zhim pa'i padza rnams byung zhes thub pa'i dar/ngas rgyan las sungam shing /396
