phan pa dang bde bar mdzad pa'i ༈ nyen bshos/ rkyunyathar la ma/ 91 pa 'khor ba las sgrol ba'i lam ste nges 'byung gi bsams pas zin pa'i lam ོ// /()'chimed/ lha'i spru ra gi rnam grangs/ 4yigadengs car/ dab71 ngo/ zhu'i mtshar 64/ ba 'i rgyan la gnangari sha ka bya 7/nga /gdo nar+sha can ni klu'i ming gi rnam grangs te/ de'i dbang po'am rgyal po yin pa sa na gdengs can dbang po 7sa bya'o/ /4 )gcam bu/gtam bcos ma'am bcos ma'i bstod tshig n+t+rarab byed/ rab tu byed pa stetshig le'u 6da pa'o/ /ga rme ci'i cha/'a' bdag nam ca/ kha'i dbang po zhu na tshing /sa sde dpal bzang por phul ba' yog lan/oṃ bde legs su gyur cig /rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i 'od dkar can/ /'jig rtege/ dbar phyug ()sa bcu'i ()zla ba des/ /bod yul mun pa sel slad mi dbang gi/ /rnam rol sprul pa'i zlos gar mang zhig ca/dzad/ /de dag rigs la dus kyi tha mar yang / /grags pa'i 'od dkar nyams pa med pa can/ /gangs can stod ②kyi sa 'jin gdags/ gcig pu/ /khyed kyi lhag bas ma don kun 'byor gyur ci ga /dpal ldan sa yi ngargya 3na snya ma/ ngul la/ /'khyud pa ra 'os pa'i tshim gi me tob phreng / /nyag bral dwangs pa'i yid mtsho las 'khrungs pa/ /don bzang dre bsung 408
rdzogs 'di bdag gis 'bul/ /khengs ldan skye bo du ma'i cod pan gyis/ /zhabs mthil pad+mo'i ngos la ngal bso ba/ /khyod kyi gtsug phud ①dkon mchog rin chen gyi/ /zhabs skyes mchod la bsnyel bar 0ma gyur tam/ /bdag kyang bla 3 'i legs bshad kyis 'tsho zhing / /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi yi don/ jibashad sgrub skyabastan pa'i bya ba ma dor tsam/ /ma rungs skye bo'i khrod na spyod cing mchis/ /zhes gsol nas/ slar ya nga brjod par bya ba ni/ gur kum me tog dri la srod ldan pa'i/ /bka' yi ga bung ba'i phreng ba rings 'ongs nas/ /khyod thugs dge ba sgrogs pa kyur blangs te/ /sor mo'i 'dab phreng rtse la ldeng zhing chags/ /de tshe mig dang rna ba'i caga' ston myong / /yid la khyod sku mngon sum ji bzhin du/ /yang yang bris nas de don bsams pa na/ /bdag yid khyogs la shin tu 'phyang bar gyur/ /ci slad ce na thub bstan nyine mor byed/ /nub ri'i mal stan ngos la gos dmar 'dzin/ /skye dgu phan bde'i pad tshal lhag ma tsam/ /sdig spyod ba mos nyin re bzhin du 'joms/ /gangs can skye bo phal cher legs nyes kyi/ /blang do ra 'byed la shin tu 'thoms gyur pas/ /kha gsag dpung dang 'o ngas spyod phyir 'brang gi/ /thub pa'i gsung bzhin bsgrub rnams rtswa lta ra 'dor/ /de phyir rigs pa'i skya ba 'dzin mkhas pa/ /bshes gnyen ded dpon ra tshog kyang ma rungs pa'i/ /rlung chem nang du ya nga yang gru sbyar bas/ /ya nga yang sgyid lugazhu'agyur bar gdon mi 'tshal/ /'on kyang bod 'bangs skye dgu mtha' dag gi/ /dge legs srog smru yang yang gsos gyur pa/ /bstan 409
pa'i rtsa ba 'jig rten kun gyi mig /sngon gyi chos rgyal sems dpa' che rnams kyi/ /rlabs chen spyod pa'i rjes 'gro pha na bde'i khur/ /da lta khyod kyi zur phud ngos dka la/ /me tog phon po bzhin du rab tu 'dzin/ /dgun gyi pad dkar ya mtshan ci yang bskyed/ /de yi dri bzang phyogs kun dri len ①gyis/ /nor 'dzin bu mo'i 'gram pa'i ngos dag la/ /lan cig min par bsgos pa la sred pa'i/ /mkhas rnams yid ni zhags pa med par 'dzin/ /de slad khyod thugs dgi ba'i lcags kyu yis/ /bdag gi snying ni kun tu drangs mod kyi/ /da dung bya ba du mas g.yengs 0gyar cing / /bdag yid lhag dang bcas pa'i gnas skabs bsten/ /skye bo 'jungs pa nor gyis lhag par tshim/ /nga rgyal 'dzin rnams gcam bu'i ngag gis mgu/ /dam pa legs bshad ro la lhag par chags/ /de phyir slar yang chos kyi skyes 'di 'bul/ /bde legs rtsa ba thub bstan lo thog ni/ /bshes gnyen chu 'dzin dbang po'i②/ legs bshad kyi/ /chu char dus su 'phebs la rab/ las pas/ /mi dbang mdun sa mkhas pas brgyan par mdzod/ /tshig gi yal 'dab mang du rgyas na yang / /rnam dag tshul khrims snying po ma mchis na/ /blun po'i bya tshogs 'drid pa kyur len pa'i/ /khong rul ljon shing bzhin du mkhyen par mdzod/ / skye dgu'i bde skyed bstan la rag las shing / de yang lung rtob]sa dam chos ()rgyas pa la/ /ra ga las de yi slad du khyed kyis ni/ /rtag tu stod pa med pa'i blo gros mdzod/ /tshong 'dus kha dog bsgyur pa'i zas bzhin du/ /'jig rten 'di na chos ltar bcos pa mang / /de phyir yangs pa'i blo ca na khyod kyi 410
thugs/ /legs pa'i lam bzang kun tu bsten par 'tshal/ /rnazlo/ dag tshul khrims rgyan gyis rab mdzes shing / /sa phyogs skye bo'i bsod nams tshogs kyi gzhi/ bag yod dul ba'i gos 'chang rab byung gis/ /sa yi khyon rnams kun tu gang bar mdzod/ /'bangs rnams skye bo'i bde legs ji snyed pa/ /de kun ri / skyong na dzad pa 'i rjes su 'jug /de phyir nyid kyi sras la ji lta bar/ /byams pa 'i thub]sa kyis chos kyi rgyal srid mdzod/ /phan tshun gnod pa'i las las rab bzlog nas/ / kun kyang 'tshe ba med pa'i chos la brten/ /dgi ba'i khrims kyis nyid kyi chab srid rna/ /rdzogs ldan dus bzhin kun tu dga' bar mdzod/ /rkang drug ldan pa kho bo'ang le gi//sa bshad kyi/ /'phur lding snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs kyur len cing / /dad pa grang rtsi'i bcud kyis yongs gtams pa'i/ /'dab brgya'i tshal der 'jug pa'i smon lam bgyid/ /khyod thugs dge ba rgyas pa'i 'od dkar can/ /bdud sde phun can gza' la sa rnam rgyal nas/ /khor yug ri po'i khongs kyi nor 'dzin bzhin/ /thub bstan ku mud dgod pa'i gnyen gyur cig /ces pa'i zhu yig gzigs pa'i rten mtshon par/ /lhag bsam dri ma med pa ltar rab tu dkar ba'i kha btags gcig mchis/ zla gsum pa'i nyer bdun la ri bo mdangs can nas phul ba dge legs su gyur cig /ces pa 'a4 ni gu ge'i mnga' bdag khri nam mkha'i dbang po phun tshogs sde dpal bzang pos 'bul ba phun su ma tshogs pa dang bcas te gdan 'dren pa'i zhu yig nan chen pos phul ba'i lan du/ mang du thos pa'i btsu na ba dan/ legs dpal bzang pos smya sa pa'o// //411
mchan 'grelalha ()'angag rten dbar 〈ga 'a ra 'phabs pa myan ras gzigs dpang 44/ pa / /② sa bcu/ byapa chur sems dpa'i rnga bcu ste/ ngor chen kun dag/'a bzang rgyu'i〈〈cho 45 rje be she gu rgyal mtsham/ci' zu bstod — 〉〉zhes bya ba'i ca jud rtags ang〈skyel gshegs/ ()gangs can stod/bod gang can gyistod ñtsha tsal phyogs ṭī/ 'dir ma nga' rica ṭa tsu ge'iyu 'a gartsa sa/ ⑨ tsug phud/ spa'ither cog gi rtsedang ra ri ba mdud pa'i zur phud/ phurwabasgril ba/ ngal ba'i zhe sa ste sku bsnyel ba zhes pa lta bu/ 9)bshad ku ba/ chos 'chad nyan dang / mar bu thos shing gdango rnga5 par shar ba'i chos don nyams su len pa/ 9)spyad lug le lo ste/ dbyangs can dga' blos/ snyad lug pa na dge ba 'e bya 'a lasems bkyog rnga/'am yid bsang pa'o zhes gsungs/ ()dri 'o —/ sna dang rlung gnyis kur 'jug la 'dir sna'o/ / ()g.yengs pa/ 'dod pa'i yon tan sogs la rnam par 'phro ba'i sems g.yeng ba druka rkyang ngur / yichu 'dzin dbang po/ chu 'dzin rna rgya mtsho la'jug pas/ chu 'dzin dbang po ni rgya mtsho'i dbang po ste klu'irgyal po'o/ yang na nam mkhab+dzakhrin phung la go na'ang chog 〈yilung rtogs dam chos/ lur gi chos dang rtogs pa'i chos gnyis te/ lung gi chos ni mdo'i sde/ dbyangs kyis bstod pa'i sde/ lung du bsnyan pa'i lde/ tshipa sa su bcad pa'i sde/ ched du brjod pa'i g+ne/ gleng gzhi'i sdi/ rtogs pa ba jod pa'i sde/ de lta bu byung ba'i sde/ skyes pa'i rabs kyi sde/ shin tu rgyas pa'i sde/ rmad du byung ba'i sde/ gtan la phab pa'i sde ste sasung rab yan la ga bcu gnyis dang / rnya gas pa'i chos ni/ gang gi chags pa dang 'bral bar byed pa'i lam bden gyichos dang / gang zhig chags pa dang 'gog bden gnyis bsgyus pa'i chos/412
r+yā dge 'acan grub pa/rje tsong kha pa chen po'i dngos slob dge 'dun grub pa ri/ gtsang rulas/ gi sa'i cha dpal ldan sa skya'i nye 'dabs sgad kyi lung lag gur me'i ru par yab mgon po rdo rje dang / yum ngo po nam mkha' cad ces pa gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bdun pa'i lcags lug (spyi lo 1391 )lor sku 'khrungs/mchan pad rdo rjer btags/ dgung lo 'dun lon pa'i tshe yab 'das/khong da ra 'khyar nas/ snar thang du slebs/ dpal snar thang gi mkhan rabs bcu bzhi pa'i sprul sku rje grub pa shes rab las dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes/brgya ston tsan+d+ra pa dang shākya dpal bcas pa las yi gi 'bri klog sbyangs pas tshegs chung ngusano mkhas par ma na/ dgung lo bco lnga pa shing bya(spyi lo 1405)lor gnas brtan chen po'i rnam 'phrul mkhan chen grub pa shes rab las rab tu byung zhing dge tshul gyi sdom pa mdzos/ mtshan dgi 'dun grub pa dpal bzang por gsol/ dgung lo nyi shu pa lcags stag (spyi lo 1410) lor grub pa shes rab kyis mkhan pho dang / slob dpo chen po blo ldan pas las chog pa dang / chen po grags pa shes rab pas gsang ste ston pa mdzad de/ kha sko nga ba 'os pa grangs tshang pa'i dgi 'dun las bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dashe slong gi dngos ngo brnyes/ dgung lo nyar lnga pa shing lug(spyi lo 1415 ) lor dburi5 la phebs ṭī rje bla ma dang mjal/ lo ngo 413
bcu'i bar gsang phu rna'u thog dang / ri po dga' ldan dang / 'phan yul gras la sogs par mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi bla ma drug cu tsam gyi zhabs la gtugs/ khyad par bka' drin mtshungs med kyi bla ma gsum ste/ dang por bka' drin che ba mkhan chen rin po che grub pa shes rab dang / bar du bka' drin che ba thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ tha mar bka' drin che ba mkhas grub shes rab seng ge zhes par grags/ de dag las mdo sngags kyi gsung rab mtha' dag la mkhas par sbyangs shing mi 'jigs pa'i shobs pa brnyes/ dgung lo so lnga pa shing sbrul lor gsang phu'i 'chad nyan mdzad/ so drug pa me rta (spyi lo 1426)lor gtsang du phebs/snar thang byang can dang / ri phud dang / brag dmar sogs su bzhugs te lo bcu gnyis kyi bar 'chad nyan dmar zhing grwa tshogs 'phel bar mdzad/ dgung lo zhe brgyad pa sa rta (spyi lo 1438)lor dbus su phebs/dgung lo lnga bcu pa lcags sprel (spyi lo 1440)lor shes rab seng ge dang lhan du slar gtsang la phebs/ dgung lo nga bdun pa rab byung brgyad pa'i me yos(spyi lo 1447)lor bkra shis lhug/— po dpal gyi sde chen po phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal pa'i gling btab cing rjes nas byams chen sku gsung thugs rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhengs/ dgon pa btab nas lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi bza bstan pa'i bdag por mdzad de 'cha) nyan nam yang chag pa med par gnang / dgung lo gya bzhi pa rab byung brgyad pa'i shing rta (spyilo 1474)lo'i hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad la sku gshegs/spyir dgung lo so lnga nas gya bzhi'i bar dam pa'i chos kyi 'chad nyan 414
mdzad pas/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya mkhas pa dang / btsun pa dang / bzang po dang / rnal 'byor la brtson pa'i slob mas gangs ri'i khrod ma khyab nga mi snang la/ gtso bo rna/ 'dul 'dzin dpal ldan bzang po/ rdo rje slob dpon bzang po bkra shis/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga'i bde legs rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rab 'byams pa bstan pa'i nyi ma/ smon lam dpal legs pa'i blo gros/ mkhan chen bzod pa dpal grub/ mkhan chen shes rab rgyal mtshan sogs mang ngo /brtsams chos 'dul ba'i gling 'bum/ mdo ṭīka tshad ma'i ṭīka rtsa 'jug gi ṭīk+ka sogs po ti bdun tsam bzhugs/brtsom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po'i rnam par bar pa la bstod pa bdud dpung phye mar 'thag pa/oṃ bde legs su gyur cig /bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gser gyi kyun po nyin byed 'bum gyi 'od/ /kun nas 'phro ba bas kyang mdangs gsal zhing / /mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar gzi bajid phung bo'i sku/ /thub pa'i zhabs pad bdag gi spyi bor zhog /be+e tshomagadra ba ma lus gcod pa'i mtshon/ /khams gsum dbugs 'byin bdud dpung skrag mdzad che'i/ /thub pa'i gsusadabyangs ldan lag drug cu'i②mas/ /'gro kun ma rig ①gnyid 415
las da longs shig /shes cadang shes bya'i spro ru pa mi ra nga' yang / /shes bya ma lus pa la gang gi thub /sa/ /skad cib/ 4ci nga gis mngon sum khyab mdzad pa/ /thub pa'i mkhyen brtses 'gro 'de rtas tu skyong sa / /dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ /grangs med shasumazlodu rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /bsten pas sa lam mthar phyin rtsod dus ()'dir/ /mngon par sangs rgyas khyod la bstod par bgyi/ /skye ba 4/cig gis thogs par dga' ldan du/ /dam pa tog dkar nyid du sku 'khrungs te/ /grangs med lha rnams dam chos bdud rtsi'i ros/ /kun tu tshim par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de tshe tshigs su bcad pa'i sgras bskul zhing / /'dul ba'i yul dus gling dang rigs mkhyen nas/ /nga rna 'dzam bu'i gling du 'pho bas na/ /bag yod bsten ces lha yi tshogs la gdams/ /lha rnams r+ya gon dang bcas par bya phyir du/ /nyid kyi cod pan byams pa'i dbu la rdza gecings/ /khyod rna nga yi 'og tu 'tshang rgyabazhes/ /lung bstan rgyal tshab rngu chos tu gabang yang bsku ra/ /lha las babs nas stong gsumadu'od kyis bkang / /phun tshogs glang chen dkar po ltar gshegs te/ /lha mo las lhag lha mo sgyu 'phrulaphu'ini/ /gso snyong mdzad pa'i kyums su zhugs par gyur/ /'dam las skyes pa 'dam gyis ma gos ltar/ /rnams su zhugs kyang mngal gyi dri 6khur dben/ /mngal du lha yi pho zang yid 'phrog par/ /mtshan dang dpe bya / bzang po'i rgyan gyis spras/ /de tshe lha rnams kun gyis so so nas/ /lha yi gzhal med khang chen yul la phul/ /nyid kyi mthu yis bdag gi khyim kho nar/ /yum ni bzhugs so snyam du ri / par gyur/ /416
rgyalab yum ñtsha kyur/sa na bzhugs pa'i tshi/ /tshangs dang dbang po 'jig rten skyong ba rnams/ /nyin bzhin nyid kyi drung du lhags gyur te/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos②mchod cing chos kyang nyan/ /de nas skyed mos tshal du me tog rgyas/ /bter rnams kha zu rin chen myu gu 'thon/ /rin po che yi ljon shing 'khrungs pa sogs/ /ngo mtshar snga ltas sum cu rtsa gnyis byung / /gzhon nu btsa' ba'i dus la bab pa na/ /lha mo lum+bi'i tshal du chas pa la/ /tshangs dbang 'jig rten skyong bas zham ringayibyas/ /'chi med bu mos nam mkha'i dkyil nas mchod/ /lusa'i tshal yidu blaka sha'i sdong bo la/ /sprin dkar dkyil nas glog 'phreng 'khyug 'dra ba'i/ /lag pa g.yas pas yal ga bzung pa'i tshe/ /rtsibs logs g.yas nas gzhon nu bde bar 'khrungs/ /bltams ma thag tu tshangs dang dbang pos blangs/ /dri ma spos chus bkrus te me tog gtor/ /sa la pad+ma chen po rdol gyur cing / /mkha' la rin po che yi gdugs kyang byung / /de tshe bdag dang mtshungs ba ra ma mthong bas/ /sa chen drug ⑨la dom pa bdun bor nas/ /nga ni 'jis/ rten kun gyi mchog yin ces/ /stong gsum kun tu dbyangs kyis keṃ bar mdzad/ /bltar/sa tshe yab kyi don kun grub gyur cing / /lha rnams kun gyis khyod la phyag btsal bas/ /sa/zhon nu don rnams thams cad grub pa dang / /lha yi lha zhes mtshan mchog btags pa lags/ /tshangs dang mngon shes lnga ldan drang srong 0gis/ /'di ni 'khor los sgyur ba'am rgyal bar jes/ /rtsod dus 'khor los sgyur ba mi 'byung bas/ /sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur zhes lung yang bstan/ /417
tshangs pa'i yi ge la sogs yi ge'i rigs/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi'iyipha rol phyin gyur cing / /grangs dang rtsis la shin tu mkhas na yang / /gzhan la phan phyir yi ge'i grar yang zhugs/ /'dzam bu'i shing drung bsam gtan mdzad pa'i tshe/ /'dzam bu'i grib mas nyid sku ma btang zhing / /rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i drang srong mkha' la thogs/ /drang srong lnga dang yab kyis bstod phyag btsalan+t+ra/ /de nas shākya rnams kyis 'di skad gling / /gzhon nu btsun mo'i 'khor gyis dgyes rol na/ /khab nas mi 'byung 'khor los sgyur ba 'thob/ /de phyir 'di la btsun mo blang bar bgyi/ /gzhon nus smras pa 'dod pa skyon can te/ /'thab mo dang bcas mya ngan sdug bsngal rtsa/ /'jigs byed dug ni lo ma 'dra ba ste/ /me dang 'dra zhing ral gri'i so dang 'dra/ /'on kyang sngon gyi dam pa'i rnam thar bzhin/ /chags dang bral yang btsun mo'i 'khor dang bcas/ /tshul bzhin rgyal srid bskyangs pas lus can rnams/ /thar ba'i grong khyir mchog tu bkri bar bya/ /bdag la bud med phal bas dgos pa med/ /gzugs bzang skyes pa gzhan la chags bral cing / /g.yo dang sgyu spangs drang po'i ngang tshul can/ /rtag tu chos la spyod pa de 'dra 'tshal/ /de nas shākya lag na be con gyis/ /gzhon nu'i btsun mor 'os pa sa 'tsho ma/ /rgyal du tshugs 0la sgyu rtsa la 'gran par gyis/ /de skad skye bo mang po'i dbus su smras/ /lhas byinaXdregs pas bsad pa'i glang chen ro/ /gzhon du'i zhabs kyi mthe bong rtse la blangs/ /phyi rol rgyang grags gcig tu 'phangs pa las/ /sa phyogs de ni gshong chen zhig tugyur/ /nga rgyal stobs kyis 418
mtho ba'i lus can rnams/ /'khor ba'i grong las phyi ro1 rgyang ring du/ /'di yi shes rab stobs kyis 'phen no zhes/ /nam mkha'i dkyil nas ltarnams tshigs bcad smra/ /de nas shākya gzhon nu lnga brgya tsam/ /sgyu rtsal ston pa'i phyogs der so nga ba 'khus/ /shākya rnams dang skye bo phal po che/ /'dus nas sgyu ca la 'gran par brtsa mas pa na/ /lha dang lha min dri za'i 'jig rten na/ /yig rigs kun la gzhon nu pha rol phyin/ /'di yis mkhyen pa'i yi ge'i ming tsam yang / /gzhan gyis shes par bya ba'i yul las 'das/ /blo gros myur ba'i gzhon nu lnga brgya dang / /srid sgrub chen po rtsis kyi lam la rdugs/ /'jig rten khams kyi rdul phran ji snyed pa / /'di yis dbugs gcig la yang rtsi bar nus/ /sto bas kyis bsnyems pa'i gzhon nu thams cad kyis/ /cig car nyid kyis sku la rub pa na/ /nyid kyi dpal dang gzi bajid ma bzod par/ /reg pa tsam gyis de dag sa la 'gyel/ /nam mkha'i dkyi'1 nas lha rnams 'di skad du/ /sems can thams cad stobs chen gyad du gyur/ /cig car skyes bu mchog la rub gyur kyang / /reg pa carma gyis sa la 'gyel bar 'gyur/ /lag pas ri spro phye mar 'thag byed cing / /nag po'i rtsa lag sde dang bcas pa kun/ /skad cig gcig gis pham par byed nus na/ /'di dag bskyel pa tsam la mtshar ci yod/ /gzhan gyis bdung ba tsam yang mi nus pa'i/ /mes kyi gnam ruḥphyag tu phul ba na/ /stan las ma bzhengs skyil krung phyed bcas te/ /rtsol ba med par sor mo gcig gis bdungs/ /stan las ma bzhengs rtsol ba ma mchis par/ /thub pas gcaca/ma ru 'di 'dra bdungs pa las/ /419
nges pa ra thuyos nyi —kad pa grub gyur te/ 16 da du bdud kyi sde rna ra/sa choms par 'gyur/ /gzhu de gang sbyar mdar zhi depa ngas pa las/ /lcags kyi sla nga lnga dang ta la()bdun/ /phag pa'i gzugs rnams phug nas sa 'og thirnga/nga/2 /de las mda' chu dro4/ pa zhes bya byung / /'di ni myur du rdo rje'i gdan la ga zhugs/ /zhi canasari gzhu la shes rab mda' spya ra te/ /thogs pa med par nyon mongs dgra bcoca/ nas / /'chi med bdud rtse dam pa brnyes par 'gyur/ /de bzhin phyi dang nang du bsnur ba dang / /bzung dang 'dzing stangs gom stabs la sosas pa/ /sgyu rtsal kun la ca chog tu gyu 4 pa na/ /shākya'i bu mo mchog de yab kyisari pukhyo// /'jig rten chos kyi dri mas ma gos kyang / /'jim rte oṃ chos dang mthun pa'i tshul tsam du/ /btsum mo 'i 'khor bcas lha mi nyo nga phraka brgya/ /yongs su smin par mdzad la phya ba 'tshal lo/ /de nas dus ga'/tsha 'i/ga na lha tshams kyis/ /gzhon nu btsun mo'i gnas su yu cha/ rings nas/ /gdul bya sngar so/nga phyi nas byang chub 'thob/ /de sbyar bab nas myur du byung zhes bskul/ /khab nas 'byung ba'i dus la 'di mags mod/ /phyogs/ bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis 'di tshad bskul/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas sho'/ cig ces/ /sngon byi smon lam btab pa lasangs par 6/dzod/ /gang gi don du yun ring sdug bsngal bzokhu/ /pad 'ong bu dang chung ma srog btang ba'i/ /bla med byang chub go 'phang dam ma de/ /thob nas 'gro ba bsgral phyir rab byung mdzod/ /de nas skyed mos tshal du zhugs pa na/ /na rga 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal6yi420
sna tshogs kyis/ /shin tu nyam thag 'gro la nga/zigs nas ni/ /'khor bas thugs phyung thar ba'i don la dgongs/ /slar yang zhi zhing dul ba'i dge slong gzigs/ /rab tu byung ba mkhas pa rnams kyis bsngags/ /'tsho ba bde zhing 'chi med 'thob par 'gyur/ /rang gzhan phan phyir nga yang 'di bzhed gsung / /bskul pa'i tshul ni yab kyis mthong zhing thos/ /rgyal po'i khab nas 'byung ba dgag pa'i phyir/ /na chung mdzes ma'i sgyu thabs ston du bcug /dpa' ba'i dmag gis phyogs rnams kun nas bskor/ /de nas bzhin nu mchog gi mna' lam na/ /sa 'dir mal bcas myur po snga sa su bcug /'od kyis 'jig rten gsu ma po khyab pa sogs/ /ngo mtshar can 9 mi lam du ma mis/ de tshe de yis yab la 'di skad gsol/ /bdag ni mngon par 'byung ba'i dus la bab/ /na rga 'chi dang rgud pa mi 'byung na/ //96ba nas mi 'byung rtag tu gnas par bya/ /'di ni khyim nas byung ni mi rung 7/sa/ shākya rnams kyis grong khyer chen po'i sgor/ /dpa' ba'i dpung tshams stong phrag 'jog pa sogs/ /gzhon nu srung ba'i thabs la na na tan byas/ /nam phyed skyes pa bud med gnyid kyis myos/ /lha rnaca sa lhas/sa nas mkha' la 'kho — — pa'i tshe/ /'dun pas rta mchog brgyan te phul ba na/ /chibs nas thogs pa med par mkha' la gshegs/ /nga ni zla med byang chub ma thob bar/ /ser skya'i gnas ⑤su nam yang mi 'jug cesari /da pag tshad drug gi pha rol phyin pa na/ /rta mchog rgyan bca45 0du ge pare lag cidu gtad/ /ut+pal mthing kha'i mdog can ral gri yis/ /rang ge 5 /tsu 5/ phud pacarna nas ma/pa' la bor/ /lha yis khyer 421
nas su ma cu ba/sum tu mchod/ /gnas der gtsug phud blangs pa'i mchod rten brtsigs/ /ngur smrig gos pa'i gtsang ma'i lha zhig la/ /ka shi'i nas ②byin de las ngur smrig blangs/ /lha des gus pas na bza' spyi bor blangs/ /rgyus pas mchod phyir lha yi 'jig rten song / /kun la phan phyir skra bregs ngur smrig bgos/ /bdag nyig rab tu byung bar mdzad pa'i tshe/ /gzhon tsa don grub rab tu byung ngo zhes/ /lha rnams dga' nas 'og min bar du bsgrags/ /bsod nams las grub rin chen gzhal med khang / /lha yi pho brang mtshog la 'gran pa yang / /rab 'bar dmyal ba'i grong khyer ltar dgongs nas/ /khab nas khab med par rna rab tu byung / /rin chen bdun ldan gling bzhir dbang sgyur ba'i/ /mi bdag dpal de lag na 'dug bzhin du/ /mi rtag gling po med par thugs chud nas/ /gcig pur dbe+en pa'i nags su gshegs pa layos/ /yid 'ong gzugs mdzes lang tsho'i dpal yon can/ /'chi med bu rma'i dpal 'phrog btsun mo rnams/ /mi gtsang g.yogs pa'i dur khrod ltar dgongs nas/ /chags med zhi ba'i nags su byon la 'dud/ /de nas ni ra: na'i chu yi'agram du/ /lam min lam du 'khrul ba bzlog pa'i phyir/ /mkha' khyab bsam gtan mchog la snyoms zhugs nas/ /lo drug bar du dka' spyad drag po bsten/ /de tshe mgon po'i sku ni shin tu rid/ /dbugs kyi rgyu ba 'gags par gyur pa na /lha mi phal gyis grongs pa lta bur mthong / /lha mo sgyu 'phrul yid la the tshon gyes/ /nyi zla skar sogs sa lalhur ba srid/ /don ma grub par nga ni mi 'chi zhing / /422
myur du sangs rgyas thob pa mthor 'gyur bas/ /yum khyod ma 'jis/sa zhes rna dbugs dbyung mdzad/ /dka' thub drag ngo sa brdungs (gdungs) pa'i lus sems kyis/ /bla med byang chub 'thob par ma gzigs par/ /kha zas rabs pas 'u sa kyi stobs bskyed nas/ /byang chub shing dbang drung du 'gro zhes gsungs/ /de thos zhing pa'i bu mo legs skyes mas/ /ba mchog stong gi 'o ma lan bdun du/ /nying khur byas yipa'i 'o thug sprang rtsi can/ /bkra shis g.yu nga drung 'khyil bas mtshan pa phul/ /de nas nyid kyi bsod nams gzi byin gyis/ /sku lus gser gyi gtan pa phyis pa bzhin/ /mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar 'ong kyi dra bas bskor/ /lta bas mi ngoms dge sbyong chen por gyur/ /bdu da sde 'joms dang byang chub 'thob bya'i phyir/ /byang chub shing dbang drung du chas pa na/ /shing dang ri rnams phyogs der 'dud pa sogs/ /ngo mtshar bkod pas sa dang bar snang gang / /phyogs bcu'i phun tshogs thams cad gros byas nas/ /byang chub snying por②'dus te 'khod 'dra la/ /e ma bsod nams 'bras bu bsam mi khyab/ /ces brjod lha rnams ngo mtshar mchog tu 'dzin/ /mgon po byang chub snying por gshegs pa'i tshe/ /lus kyi 'od kyis ngan song thams cad zhi/ /'gro kun bde bas tshim zhing nyon mongs med/ /phan tshun byams pa'i sems dang ldan par rgyur/ /de nas rgyal bas rtswa 'tshong bkra shis la/ /sngo 'jam 'khyil legs rma bya'i mgrin 'dra'i rtswa/ /bslangs nas byang chub shing drung legs par bting / /dran pa mngon du bzhag nas skyel spung mdzad/ /bdag gi lus 'di bskams sam zhig kyang rung / /bla med 423
byang chub r+ya chong/ de 3/ 4 ba bar/ /sta na las mi g.yo t+pal kung mi gzhig ces/ /ri rab lta bu'i dam bca' btan po ma dzad/ /de tshe nyid kyi smin mtshams mdzod spru nas/ /bdud kyi dkyil 'khor 'dzoms pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /stong gsu ma 'jig rten thams cad 'od kyis bkang / /bdud kyi gnas rnams can par byas shing g.yos/ /'od zer de las zas gtsang sras po rna/ /rgyalasrid spangs nas byang chub shing drung gshesal/ /mngon par sangs rgyas chos 'khor bskor pa'i tshe/ /bdud kyi gnas rnams stongs par 'gyur zhes bsgrags/ /yid sungs bdag po gnyid kyis log pa na/ /rang gnas sdug ba la mun pas khyab pa dang / /bdud rnams skrag nas phyogs bcur 'bros pa sogs/ /bdud la mi lta sa ngan pa so gnyis byung / /bdud de shin tu skrag nas 'khor la smras/ /ltas dang hra lam 'jigs] pa de mthong bas/ /dge sbyong de rna mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ /bdud kyi gnas 'di myur du stongs par nges/ /nas na yan lag bzhi ba'i dpung tshos/sa rnams/ /shing dbang drung gi dge sbyong gcig pu de/ /da lta gzhom par bya phyir rab tu bsgrims//nga la sems rnams phyi bshol ma byed zer/ /ded dpon zhes bya'i bdud kyis 'di skad smras/ /mi ltas de 'dra byung na bshol ba legs/ /mthu chung dpung rnams dpa' bo gcig gis 'jo mas/ /nyi 'od 4/cig gis srin phu me khyer bzhin/ /de nas 'jig rten /4bca45 ge kyi pa dud kyi sdo/ /rab 'jigs lus kyi rnam 'gyur sna tshogs can/ /ca/tshon cha mtha' yas thogs par sprul pa rnams/ /'jigs med dpa' bo de yi drung du lhakas/ /434
'jigs pa'i gzugs can de dag mthong ba na/ /sgyu ma smig rgyu rmi lam lta bu dang / /ngo b+thā nyid kyis med par thugs chud nas/ /thub pa'i ba spu'i rtse yang g.yo ma nas/ /bdud kyi ba spu thams cad lag par gyur/ /lag pa re rer mtshon cha brgya thogs kyang / /byams ldan thub pa mchog gi sku la ni/ /mtshon cha 'phangs pa thams cad me tog gyur/ stos 'di rir bcas ma lus sreg nus kyang / /rdo rje'i thugs mnga' khyod ni sreg mi nus/ /sred gsum lag pas gzhan du 'phen nus kyang / /thub pa'i ba spru g.yo bar ga la nus/ /rab tu rno ba'i mtshon cha ma bsnams shing / /rta glang shing rta rkang thang ma mchis par/ /rang nyid gcig pus bdud kyi dpung tshogs (mas/ /skad cig tsam la pham par mdzad pa lags/ /bdud kyi rlung shugs ji ltar che na yang / /khor yug ri bo'i bar du g.yo ba srid/ /bsod nams mtsho chen las 'khrungs lhu po khyod/ /byang chub snying bo'i gnas las bskyod mi nus/ /sa 'di dug gis yongs su gang gyur la/ /gdug pas stong gsum 'bar bar byed nus kyang / /nyid kyis gzigs pa tsam gyis dug med 'gyur/ /dug gsum rtsa ba ma lus spangs phyir ro/ /nags tshal khrod na wa skyes mang po rnams/ /seng gi'i sgra skad gcig gis phyogs bcur 'bros/ /de bzhin byung rgyal smra ba bdud kyi dpung / /mi yi seng ge'i dbyangs kyis 'bros par gyur/ /bdud kyis ri rab tsam gyi do ba rnams/ /'phangs pa lha yi gzhal med khang du gyur/ /dbugs kyi kha rlangs me lce'i dkyil 'khor kyang / /rgyal ba'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor lta bur gyur/ /thub pas bskal pa grangs med du mar yang / /gtan pa 425
med pa'i mchod sbyin mdzad pa la/ /sa yi lha mo brtan ma dpang du gyur/ /de nas bdud rnams sngangs nas phyogs bcur bros/ /bdud kyi na chung mdzes mas bud med kyi/ /sgyu thabs sum cu rtsa gnyis nyer bstan kyang / /cung zad tsam yang 'brid par ma nas par/ /thub pa'i zhabs la byag 'tshal mngon par bstod/ /thub pa g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i tshe/ /lha mo brgyad kyis dpal ni bcu drug gis/ /bstod cing gtsang ma'i rigs kyi lha rnams kyis/ /bdud la rnam par smad pa bcu drug byas/ /de ltar byams pa'i dpung gis bdud rnams btul/ /bsam gtan mthar phyin mngon par shes pa thob/ /tho rangs rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /bla med byang chub brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpung dang mtshon cha med par dgra las rgyal/ /dag rgyud med par dri ma kun dang bral/ /ma bcol bar yang kun gyi skyabs mdzad pa'i/ /sngon med 'gro ba'i mgon zhig deng 'dir byon/ /yid 'ong nor dang lus sogs gtong ba sogs/ /gzhan gyi blo yul du yang 'ong dka' ba'i/ /dka' ba brgya phrag du mas bsgrubs pa yi/ /rnam dag smon pa'i gnas 'grub gyur cig /byang chub brnyes nas bdun phrag bdun pa la/ /thub dbang sgrol sgyu'i shing drung bzhugs pa'i tshe/ /tshong dpon ga kon bzang po 'khor bcas kyis/ /mtshan dpes brgyan pa de mthong ngo mtshar gyur/ /ci 92di tshangs pa'am 'on te brgya byin nam/ /rnam thos bu'am nyi ma'am zla ba'am ci/ /ngur smrig rgyal mtshan thogs pas rab byung du/ /nges nas gus pas phyag 'tshal zhal zas drangs/ /rgyal chen bzhi yis rdo ba'i myur bzed bzhi/ /426
phul ba de dag gcig tu byin gyis brlabs/ /tshong ba de la phan phyir ṇ+ṭha/la zas gsol/ /don kun grub pa'i bkra shis rgyas par gsungs/ /'jig rten chos la gus pa bskyed pa dang / /yang yang bskul rnamsdge ba spel ba dang / /chos kyang shin tu rtogs par dka' ba'i phyir/ /dam chos gsungs pa re zhig btang snyoms mdzad/ /de nas lha rnams ston pa'i drung du lhags/ /'gro ba bla na med pa'i bde ba la/ /mgron du gnyer nas byang chub brnyes pa'i tshe/ /btang snyoms mdzad pa 'di ni rigs ma yin/ /'gro ba long ba g.yang sar kyungs pa la/ /'di na skyabs dang skyob pa gzhan ma mchis/ /thugs rje'i gter chen myur du bzhengs mdzod la/ /chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa skor du gsol/ /gang du nyid kyis mchod sbyin grangs med dang / /sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig bsnyen bkur 'ung / /sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis bsten pa'i gnas/ /wā ra ṇa si 0zhes pa'i gnas ra byon/ /der rna rin chen bdun gyi khri la bzhugs/ /lha rnams kun dang lnga sde bzang po la/ /bden bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor pa na/ /chos mig dri med bskyed nas grol bar mdzad/ /mngon par sangs rgyas rab byung chos kyi rje/ /rnam par 'dran pa ded dpon chos kyi rgyal/ /nyon mongs spangs pa dpa' po g.yul las rgyal/ /chos kyi sbyin bdag chen po khyod la 'dud/ /dgongs pa yongs rdzogs dbugs phyin don kun grub/ /rab rib mi mnga' kun mkhyen stobs bcu ba/ /sman pa'i rgyal po zug rngu 'byin pa mchog /skyob pa kun 427
tu bzang ngo/ de la 'dud/ /'gro ba'i bla ma mtshan dang skyabs kyi mchos /ཿ byos kyi drokhu me kun gyi gnya na gcig pu/ /rtang tu na nyam bzhag bso da nams zhing gi mchog /kun— gyis mchod 'os bstod 'os khyod la 'du / /nyes pa'i dri mas nam yang ma mus shing / /mkhyen brtse nus pa gzha shā 'a sa khyad zhugs pas/ /mthong thos dran pa tsam gyis bde ster ba/ /khyod la rnam pa kun tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhyen brtse rnam pa kun tu goms pa'i mthus / /srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' la mi gnas/ kyang / /thabs la mkhas pasamya ngan 'da' ba dang / /sku gdung ring bsrel bzhag pa'ang ston par mdzad/ /thub pa'i yon tan mkha' ltar mtha' yas pa/ /ma lus brjod pa'i nus ba su la mchis/ /'on kyang cung zad brjod par spobs pa 'di/ /ye ca/ bdag gi blo gros skal ba bzang / /de lta ra bstod pa'i dge bas bdag dzo/rin /na 6 na/ /yid 'ong rgyal ba'i sku mchog sgrub pa la/ /phyi dang nang gi khur (shug ñtsha/ ba dang / /mthun rkyen ma lus yid bzhin 'grub par shog /bdag kyar thub pa'i thabang po'i bka' drin las/ /'gro ba'i don du rgyal ba'i dam chos kun/ /phyogs dus kun tu rgyas par byed pa la/ /blo chen rgyal sras kun dang mtshungs par shog /ces bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang bo'i rnam par thar pa la bstod pa bdud dpung phye mar 'thag pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rgya cher rol ba'i mdo'i rjes su 'brangs te shākya'i dge slo nga dge 'dun grub pa dpal bzang pos/ byang chub chen po'i dben gnas theg chen pho brang du sbyar — 428
ba'o/ /mdo laṃ// //mchan 'grelaḥ 0)thetshom/ rang yul larang stobs kyis mtha' gnyis su dogs pa'i sems byung zhig ste/ 〈〈mi pham mkhas 'jug〉〉las/ the tshom rna rtse gnyis su 'jug pa sprugs ma chod pa'o zhes gsungs pa dang / 〈〈kun btus〉〉las/ the tshom gar zhe na/ bden pa rnams la yid gnyis za ba ste dge ba'i phyogs rnams lami 'jug pa'i rtenabyed pa'i las can no zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang yulabaden bzhi sogs la dmigs nas rnam pa yul de la rang stobs kyis mtha' gnyis su dogs pa'i rnam pa can byed las blang dor la gegs byed pa'i sems byung zhig 1 /()gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu/ 〈gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa'i mdo〉〉las/ zhi ba'i blo thos de bzhin gshedas pa'i gsung rna rnam pa drug cu rtsa bzhi dang ldan par 'byung ste/ rnam pa drug curtsa bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ mnyan pa'i gsung 'byung ba dang / 'jam pa dang / yid du 'ong ba dang / yid du 'thad pa dang / gaka pa dang / dri ma med pa dang / 'od gsal pa dang /snyan cing 'arebasdu pa dang / mnyam/ par 'os pa dang / 5 tshugs pa dang / snyanapa dang / dulab dang / mi rtsub pa dang / mi ba'ing ba dang / rab tu dul pa dang / rnar snyan pa dang / lus sim par byed pa dang / sems tshim par byed pa dang / snying dga' bar byed pa dang / dga' bde skyed pa dang / yongs su gdung ba med pa dang /kun tu shes par bya ba dang / rnam par rig par bya ba dang / rnalpar gsal pa dang / dga' bar byed pa dang / mngon par dang la bar byed pa dang / kun shes par byed pa dang / rnam par rig par 429
byed pa dang / rigs pa dang / 'brelab dang / zlos pa'i skyo named pa dang / seng ge'isgra'i shugs can dang / glang po che'i sgra skad dang / 'brug gi sgra dbyangs dang / klu'i dbang po'i ṭ+wā dang / dri za'i klu dbyangs dang / bya ka la bang ma'i sgra dbyangs dang / tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs bsgrags pa dang / shang shang te'u yi sgra dbyangs su grags pa dang / lha'i dbang po'i dbyangs ltar snyan pa dag / rnga'isgra dang / ma khengs pa dang / mi dma' ba dang / sgra thams cad kyi rjes su zhugs pa dang / tshig zur chag pa med pa dang / ma tshang ba med pa dang / ma zhum pa dang / ma zhan pa dang / rab tu dga' ba dang / khyab pa dang / chub pa dang / rgyun chags pa dang /'brel pa dang / sgra thams cad rdzogs par byed pa dang / dbang po thams cad tshim par byed pa dang / ma smad pa dang / mi 'gyur ba dang / ma brtabs pa dang / 'khor kun tu grags pa dang / 'dod chags zhi bar byed pa dang / zhe sdang 'dul ba dang / gti mug sel pa dang / bdud tshar gcod pa dang / rnam pa thams cad kyimatshog dang ldan par 'byung ba ste/ zhi ba'i blo gros de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung gi yan lag drug cu rtsa bzhi bo de dag dang ldan par 'gang ngo / /nas gsungs pa ltar ro/ /()ma rig rtsa ba'i nyon mongs drug gi nang gses ma rig pa ste/ dmigs yul bden bzhi la sogs pa'i chos gang yang rung ba la dmigs nas/ rnam pa yul de la rang stobs kyis rmongs pa'i rnam pa can byed las nyon mongs gzhan skyed pa'i sems byung ste/ 〈〈kun btus〉〉las/ ma rig pa gang zhe na/khams gsum pa'i mi shes pa ste chos rnams la logā par nges pa dang /430
the tshom dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa 'byung pa'i rten byed pa'i lascan rna zhes gsungs la/ rang yul la rang stobs kyis rmongs pa'i ser sa byung 8/ga go/ /()grangs med gsum/ bskal pa grangs med gsum zhes pa ste/ 'dir bskal pa rna bskal chen zhig dang / grangs med ni grangs gnas drug cu'i mtha' ma ste/ ston pa shākya thub pas bskalachen grangs med pa gsum la tshogs bsags te sangs rgyas par grags/ khuyirtsod dus/ rtsod ldan dus yi bsdus ming ste/ nang pa'i bshad srol ltar na/ 'dzam bu gling gi mi rnams kyis chos dang ) rnar dang / 'dod pa dang / bde ba bzhi las cha gsum nyams nas cha gcig la longs su spyod cing 'khrug rtsod dar ba'i dus la rtsod ldan dus zhes gya la/na'i yun tshad lo grangs bzhi 'bum sum khri nyi stong yod par bshad do/ /()'tshang rgya ba/ sangs rgyas pa'i ma 'ong ba dang da lta ba yin/ ()stong gsum/ 'der stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten no/ /(tshelha mo sgyu 'phrul/ ston pa shākya bub pa'i yum/ ston pa 'khrungs nas zhag bdun latshe'idus byas nas sum cu rtsa gsum du skyes zhes grags/ ()mchod smin rgya mtsho/ mchod pa rgya chen po ste/mchod pa mang po spren gyi phung po'i gzugs su bkod pa dang / rgya mtsho rna mang po ston pa'i tshig ste mchod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i don/4)zham ring / zhabs phyis sam zhabs g.yog ste/ brdarnying laszhala'abring dang / zham 'bring dang / zhabs 'bring zhes kyang 'byung ṭ+wāṃ // da /r+nghi //byi( rnyi/ mnga' //shā / ṅgi /lha 3 /sgrings sdu/ // drug shar lho nub byang steng 'og bcas phyogs drug gi sa chen po'o/ /433
⑨mngon sheṭa lnga ldan drang sbong / mngon shes lnga rna/ rdzu 'phrulañtsa mngon shes/ lha'i mig gi mngon shes/ lha'i rna ba'i mngon shes/sngon gan ge rjes dran byamangon shes/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes bcapage lnga'o/ /'dir de lnga dang ldan pa'i drang sgrar ri bo gangs can na gnas pa'i drang spong nag po zhes pa la bshad pa'o/ /⑨yi ge'i rigs drug cu rtsa bzhi/ ston pa shākya bub pa'i dus su 'jig rten ngu yig rigs drug cu rtsa bzhi rnga da par grags la/ 〈〈rgya chen rol pa'i mdo〉〉ltar bkod na 'di lta ste/ tshangs pa'i yi ge / kha ro lha'i a gi / pad+ma'i snying po'i yi ge / aṅgā'i yi ge / bca4yi na / ma snya rnya'iyi ge / bkra 3sa pa'i yi ge / sor mo'i yi ge / shā ka na4yi ge/ 5 pa na'i yi ge/ pa ka le'i yi ge/ ba ru sha'i yi ge/ 'grosang ba'i yi ge/ ke ra ta'iyi ge/ lhophyogs pa'i yi ge/ drag shul can gyiyi ge /grangs kyi yi cha /spyi'u tshugs kyi yi ge /rjes su mthun pa'i yi na bru sha'i yi ge/ kha che'i yi ge/ rgya'iyi ge/ bu na4yi ge/ hu na'i yi ge/ 'bring rgyas su ji ba'i yi ge/ /rgyal gyiyi gi /lha'i yi ge/ : klu'i yi ge/ gnod sbyin gyi yi ge/ dri za'i yi na /mi'am 'u'iyi ge/ lto 'phye chen po'i yi ge/ lha ma yin gyi yi ge/ nam mkha'achi lding gi yi ge/ ridwags 'khor lo'i yi ge/ bya ro sgru can gyi yi ge/ sa bla'i yi ge/ bar snang gi yi ge/ ba lang spyod kyi yi 1/ 5mi snyan gyi yi ge/ 'u sa 'phags po'iyi ge/ 'digs pa'i yi ge/ bzhag pa'i yi gi/ banan pa'i yi ge/ rgya mtsho'i yi ge/ rdo rje'i yi ge/ khrir yig dang lan gyi yi 1/ rnam 'thor gyi yi ge/ rings med kyiyi ge/ bstan bcos smor ba'i yi gi/ ris skor ba'i yi ge/ 'degs pa skor ba'i 432
yi ge/ bzhag pa skor pa'i yi gi/ rkang pas bris pa'i yi gi/ tshig lan gnyis su gdab pa mtshams gyi yi ge/ tshig gi mtshams bcur brgyud pa'i bar 9 yi ge/ bla thabs su bsnan pa'i yi ge/ sgra thams cad kun tu bsdus pa 3 a ge/ rig pa dang mthun pa'i yige /rnam par 'dres pa'i yi ge/ drang srong yis dka'achi thub spyad pa'i yi ge /ldang ba'i yin/ sa rdulta ba'i yin/ nam mkha' lta ba'i yi ge/ sman thams cad kyi rgyu mthun pa'i yi ge /snying po thams cad kun tu bsdus pa'i yi ge/ 'byung po thams cad kyi sgra bsdus pa'i yi na ste drug cu rtsa bzhi'o/ /②drang srong lnga dang yab kyis bstod phyag 'tshal/ /skabs 'dir bshad pa rna/ thub pa nags rgyur song zhing / 'dzam bu'i grib ma la bsam gtan dang po nas bzhi ba'i bar mnyam par bzhag pas/ phyi rolapa'i drang sbong 6 'phrul can lngas nam mkha' la 'gro ma nus par nug dang ba'o ra ba byas/ de'itshe shing gzhan gyi sgrub la'phos kyang / de'i ma 'phor/ pas/ yab ngo mtshar te/ bub pa gang tshe bltams pa dang / /gar tshe 'od ldan bsam gtan mdzad/ /'dren pa 'di lha ra lan gnyis su/ /mgon po khyod zhabs phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod cing phyag byas so/ /yirgyal du tshugs pa/ rtsed mo thob shor gyidon sa 'jog ca'i skugs/ 0lhas byin/ bcom ldan 'das shākya bub pa'i gcung po log lta can zhig ②gnam ru/bdating ste gzhu'i mir / 0ta la/ shir ta laste/ de'i lo ma la yi gi 'drachog pa/ mthotshad la slob dpon dul ba lha'ilung rnam 'gyed kyi 'grel ba las/ ta lazhes bya ba rna srid du mi'i khru bdun yidado zhis gsuras/ 0na rga 'chiba'i sdug bsngal/ na ba'i sdug 433
bsngal dang / rga ba'i sdug bsngal/ 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal dang gsugste/ 〈〈rgya cher rol pa'i mdo〉〉las/ dper na dgun smad rlung dang kha ba che/ /rna shing nal pa nags sman mdangs kyang 'phyog /de ltar nad 'dis 'gro ba'i mdangs 'phrog cing / /dbang po zungs dang stobs rna nyams par rgyud/ /ces na ba'i sdug bsngal dang / rga bas gzugs sdug gzugs mi sdug par byed/ /rga bas gzi ba da 'phyog cing thub stobs 'phrog /rga bas bde ba 'phrog cing brnyas par byed/ /rga bas 'chi byad rga bas mdangs kyang 'phrog /ces rga ba'i sdug bsngal dang / 'chi dang 'pho dang 'chi 'pho dus byed pa/ /phangs shing sdug pa'i skye bo rtag tu 'bral/ /phyir mi 'ong zhing 'phrad par 'gyur ma yin/ /shing las lo 'brul 'dra zhing klung rgyun mtshungs/ /zhes 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal stonapa'o/ /⑦ser skya'i gnas/ sngar rgya gar gyi thong khyer zhig ⑨ka shi'i gos/ ka shi rna gsal ldan zhes pa'i yul zhig gi ming ste/ yul 'dir byung ba'i ras sam ras las grub pa'i gos so/ /()rnarañdza na'i chu/ phal skad du pha la gu zhes grags te/ 'ad ga ga rta'i lhonub phyogs su yod par bshad/ 0ba mchog stong gi 'o ma lan bdun nying khur byas pa/ ba mchog stong bzhos nas 'o ma stong na nyid la skud/ yang de bzhos nas ba mchog lnga brgya la blud/ lnga brgya bzhos nas yang lnga brgyal6da cing / tshul de ltar nyis brgya lnga bcu dang / brgya nyer lnga dang / drug cu rtsa gsum dang / so gnyis dang / bcu drug dang / brgyad kyi bar du bgyis te/ na nas ba mchog brgyad po bzhos pa'i 'o ma bskol pa la nas slob dpon dge legs bshes gnyen gyi〈〈lung gzhi'i'agrel ba〉
las gsungs so/ /⑨byang chub snying po/ bcom ldan 'das mngon par byang chub pa'i gnas te rgya gar do rjegadan gyiming / ⑩lha ra ṇasi/ chu bo mā ra ḍā dang chu bo a si zhes bya ba gnyis kyi bar gyi lung ba yin pas chu po'i ming gis wā ra peṃ sir btags par bshad de/ paṇachen tshul khrims bskyangs kyis〈〈lung phranatshegs〉〉kyi 'grel bar wa ra ca si zhes bya ba ni/ chu ngo wa ra 1 si zhes bya ste zhes gsungs so/ /skabs 'dir grong khyed wā ra lco si la bshad pa yin gyi/ 'di ma ga rta'inub na yod cing / rgya gar grong khyer drug gi nang tshan yin/dbyangs can dga' blos/ deng sang grong khyer de'i ming la ka shi ka lte gsalaldan zer ro zhes gsungs/ sgrol ma'i pho brang seng ldeng na gas kyi bstod pa yod kyi lcags ñtsha/mgon po 'od dpag tu med pa sras kyi blu b+thā gnyis dang bcas pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'drin pa 'od dpag med pa'i smon lam dang / /phyag na pad+mo'i①myan chab las 'khrungs nas/ /'gro kun bde ba can du khrid mdzad ma/ /seng ldeng nags kyi lha mo'i②zhubs la 'dud/ /rtag tu thabs mkhas thugs ji'i gru chen gyis/ /mu med srid mtshor bying ba'i 'gro ba rnams/ /mchog tu zhi ba'i gling du sgrol mdzad ma/ /don la mtshan gsol sgrol ma'i ①zhabs la 'dud/ khyod kyi gnas chen seng ldeng nags kyi tshal/ /rnam dag zhing 0gi dpal la 'gran pa bzhin/ /rtsod 435
dus ca'adir yang nges par byung ba ni / /yo ces 'di skad bdag gis gsal bar thos/ /seng ldeng u dum wa ra②rgya shug dang / /thang shing ta la dang ni n+ya gro snyakhya/ /mya ngan med dang sil ba a ka ru/ /tsan darnga dza ti li shi so gas kyi tshal/ /rkang 'thung bu pa༈ lo 'dab gos kyis bklubs/ /me 'oka thong mdzes 'bras bu'i rna rgyun 'chang / /phan tsun yal sa'i lag sbrel do ra na/ /rlung gis skyod pa'i sngon shing gar mkhan ma/ /pad+ma'i na chung sbrang rtses myos pa rnams/ /klu len 'phur ldeng rol bas snang ba 'khrigs/ /ne'u tso spra/ ma/bas pa/den pa'i tshig brjod cing / /rma bya mjug sgro bams nas zlos gar rgyud/ /yid 'ong nags kyi bye'u sna tsho4sa dang / /zab mo'i gling bu sgyur ba'i khu byug sogs/ /'dab chags skad snyan sna tshogs spro ga pa ni/ /nags kyi bsngags pa brjod la 'gran pa bzhin/ /dom dang stag sazig dred dang ce spyang sogs/ /rgyug cing mcho nga dang dregs sbra sa rnam par 'gying / /gdug pa'i rigs can gcan gzam/ de dka kyang / /gnod pa'i sems spangs ri dwags byams pas skyong / /spra dang spre'u yang rtsal 'gran byed cing / /bṛṣ+ṭa chur①yid phebs byi'u mchun ('chun)/ /nu zhos tshim pa'i ri dwags phru gu rnams/ /mig zum mjing ba bltabs nas bde bar nyal/ /'jigs med bde bar rgyu ba'i ri dwags rnams/ /phan tshum/ brtse bas 'ded 34'i bang ga sbyong / /kha cig mgrin pa bteg nas phyogs su lta/ /slar yang sngo ljang rtswa yi rtse mo 'dzin/ /nas/sa tshal lta ba'i lha yi bu mo rnams/ /bdu bu 'khrol ba'i lag sbrel do ra bcas/ /'jam mnyan yan lag skyod pa'i rnam 'gyur 436
dang / /mgrin pa bsdebs nas drug ldan len la mkhas/ /rna ba'i dga' ston 'gyed pa'i dpal yon can/ /dri za'i na chung rgyud mangs sbreng byed cing / /dbyangs can mgrin par byed pa'i dpal yon can/ /ri dwags mig can bstod dbyangs rgya mtsho sgrog /'bab chu'i na chung dbu ba'i 'dzum dkar can/ /yan lag brgyad ldan dal gyis 'bab pa'i rdzing / /gnam sngon zhun ma 'khyil 'dra'i chu ngogs na/ /rig 'dzin dga' ma rtse zhing khrus la 'jug /mthing ril ngur ba chu skyar gzhon nu dang / /bzhad dang khrung khrung ngang ba'i rgyal po sogs/ /mgrin pa'i nang nas snyan sgrog glu dbyangs mkhan/ /chu bya sna tshogs dga' 8/nga mtsho la lding / /phun tshogs nags tshal de yi dben pa'i ngos/ /yangs pa'i rdo leb zla ba lta bu'i steng / /me tog 'bras bu rgyas pa'i shing drung na/ /rig 'dzin grub pa rnyed pa'i rnal 'byor ba/ /'du 'dzis ma gos0zhi ba'i spyod lam can/ /drang por lus bsrang sems la blta ba bzhin/ /mig zur g.yo med ting 'dzin ro la chags/ /'khrul med bsam gtan mdzad pa du ma bzhugs/ /steng nas chu 'dzin dkar po'i stod g.yogs bgos/ /ngos nas 'bab chu'i mu lhag do shal 'chang / /rked skabs nags tshal sngon mo'i sham thabs can/ /sa 'dzin bu mos phyogs nas mdzes par bskor/ /lha yi lam la zloX' 'o/ drir 'a snyispri sprispri/ 'ja' tsho/༈ /rdzu shā hūm̐ ḍi/dī (jam rnyi/ dze+e sbya /rdzu rnams bla re 'dzin pa'i tshul/ /lha yi mkha' las babs pa'i me tog char/ /sa yi rnal gyis gos na mi rung zhis/ /rlung gis bteg nas bar snang 'khod 437
pa rnams/ /nyi na 'i 'od dang 'grogs pas lhag par mdzes/ /'og gzhi bai ḍūr+ya yi ne'u gsing la/ /rin chen me tog du ma gcal du bkram/ /dz+dza ti tsam pa li shi sogs kyi dri/ /rlung gis bkug pa'i dri ngad bzang pos khyab/ 'chi med dbang po'i bkod pa skyengs pa'i gnas/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes sgyu ma sprul pa der/ /mar gad ljon pa gom pa 'god pa bzhin/ /sgrol ma bzhings dang 'byon gshegs spyod lam mdzad/ /de dbus rab gsal shel gyi sa gzhi bltar/ /rin chen tshon sna brgya yis rnam par bkra/ /rin chen sna tshogs 'bar ba'i khri steng na/ /dge ma mar gad mdog can 0nyi 'od 'phro/ /phyag g.yas sgrub la mchog sbyin phyag rgyayidang / /g.yon pa 'jigs pa kun skyob skyabs sbyin 0can/ /gdul bya'i bung ba ye shes sbrang rtsi'i ros/ /tshim mdzad ut+pal sngon pos phyag gnyis mdzes/ /g.yas na gser gyi mdog can 'od zer can/ /zhi ba'i nyams ldan rdo rje o sha 'dzin/ /g.yon na ral gcig sngon po khros pa'i sku/ /gri gug thod pa stag gi sham thabs can/ /gtso 'khor gsum ga lha yi na bza' dang / /mdzes sdug rgyan gyi khyad par sna tshogs kyis/ /brgyan pa'i mig gi bdud rtser gyur pa ni/ /nags tshal de yi thig le lta bur bzhugs/ /rgyal yum mchod par rtsom pa'i lha mo ni/ /phul byung gzugs mdzes rnam dag zhing gi rgyan/ /yid 'phyog rgyan gyis spud pa sna tshogs kyis/ /mchod rdzas 'di dag gus pas bzung nas mchod/ /gnam sngon dri med 'ja' tshon sham bu can/ /khor lug skar ma'i do shal 'chang ba bzhin/ /phu tig chun 'phyangayimadzes pa'i bla re dang / /dri zhim bdug pa'i sprin phung nam 438
mkha'i rgyan/ /rgyab nas dar dkar brkyangs pa'i yol ba dang / /sna tshogs nor bu'i thig le bkra ba yi/ /lha yi gdugs dkar gser gyi yu ba can/ /rab mdzes rgyal mtshan ba dan gnam du bsgrengs/ /g.yas na rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can/ /dril chung g.yer khas brgyan pa du ma dang / /rma bya gdong mdzes gshibs pa'i rlung g.yab rnams/ /zhi ba'i nags rlung g.yob la chas pa bzhin/ /g.yon na tra wang gling bu cang te'u/ /pa na ha dang rnga zlum rdza rnga dang / /'bud dung g.yas 'khyil ka ling rnga bo che/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs la 'gran phyir mchod pa 'dra/ /mdun du mchod yon rgya mtsho kun nas 'khyil/ /nyi zla la sogs nor bu'i snang ba gsal/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i lha yi zhal zas sogs/ /sna tshogs bcud 'dzin gser snod tshar du dngar/ /spel legs rin chen me tog 'phreng ba dang / /zla ba nya 'dra sgeg mo'i me long sogs/ /'dzin mkhas lang tshos bsnyems pa'i mgrin snyan rnams/ /rtsed 'jo glu gar byed pas phyogs kun mdzes/ /gzhan yang lha mi'i mchod pa phul byung dang / /kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho sogs/ /yid 'ong mchod rdzas ma lus gros byas nas/ /nags kyi lha mo'i drung du 'dus pa bzhin/ /lha dang mi dang rig pa 'dzin payisogs/ /skal bzang du ma nyin bzhin 'ongs nas ni/ /sgrol ma'i zhal ñtsha bum pa bzang po'i bcud/ /dad pa'i snyim pas 'thungs te rtag tu 'tsho/ /de ltar phun tshogs mtha' dag 'dus pa'i gnas/ /sgrol ma'i pho brang seng ldeng nags tshal dang / /rgyal yum dge ma 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /zhing rdul mnyam pa'i lus kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge ba 'di 439
yis/ bdag gzhan 'gro ba rnams/ /skye ba kun tu sgrol ṇ+ṭha 'i zhabs rnga/da la/ /btud nas dgyes pa'i phyag gis bzung pa'i mthus/ /rig 'dzin 6/cho ka yi/ go 'phang 'thob gyur cing / /legs bshad ri mo pakra bzhi lung zha gos/ /rnam dpyod gser gyi yu ba la brten cing / /bslab gsu ma chor bu'i tog gis rab rma tshan pa'iyi/ /bstan pa'i rgyab rta/tshan phyos/ri / rnga cur 'dzugs par shog /sgrol ma'i pho brang seng ldeng nags kyi bstod pa yid byi lca kas kyu zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dpal rje btsun ma'i thugs rje'i nyin byed kyis blo gros kyi pad+ma cung zad kha phye ba'i bka' drin la brten nas/ byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljo ngas su byung ba'i snyam/ ngab/ mkhan/ dge 'dun grub dpal bzang pos dpal byang chub chen po'i dben gnas theg chen pho brang chen por legs nga ra sbyar ba'o// //ma/5na'agrel ()phyag na pad+mo/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyimatshan gyi rnam grangs / ()seng ldeng nags kyi lha mo/ seng ldeng nags rna gser ri bdun gyi ya gyal zhig ste/ ri'i rtse mo na seng ldeng gi nags mdzes pa yod pas seng ldeng can zhes grags shing / der bzhugs pa'i 'phags ma sgrol ma laser ldeng nags kyilhamo zhes bya'o/ /()sgrolam/ srid pa'i sdug mtsho las sgrol pa'am 'jigs pa brgyad la sa sgrol pa'i cha nas btags/ pa'i yi dam lha mo'i rigs shig nang gses sku mdog dang phyag can tshan mi 'dra bar brten nas da6 ba nyer gcig yod / ⑨rnam dag zhing / rnam par dag pa'i zhing ste nub phyogs ba ba can gyi zhing khams lta bu/ ()khu dum wa ra/ bod skad du mtshan 'phags sam 440
char 'dzags/ yang na bdud 'joms sam lta ra ltar shing zhes bshad do/ /'di'i me tog tshad shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam yod pa dang / dri paXshā spya/ /pa / sna/ ṭ+wāṃ // pa dh+ri rdzu shārnyi( dzo 7 shā /mi /zha/ gdu stemi/ 'byung bar grags/ phu)ñtsha grodha/ bod skad larkar mang ngam chu zheng gab pa/ yang dpang mnyam zhes bya la/ de'i sa bonayungs dkar gyi bzhi cha tsam yin la lo re la yalag rgyang grags tsam du khyab par skye ba/ mtho dman tshad mnyam pa bcas 'phel stobs ha cang che ba'i shing zhig go/ /zhu'i47 sa ra/ ri dwags khri snyan sa le zhes pa ste/lus yongs rdzogs theg dkar nag gis brgyan cing / gshis ka dul pa/ bkra shis bde legs mtshon pa'i ri dwags shig na//()'du 'dzis ma gos/ zang zang 'du 'dzi'am rnam par g.yeng ba'i dri mas ma nas par zhi ba'am sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i don/ ()dge ma mar gad mdog can/ je btsun sgrol ma ljang gu'o/ /4yimachog sbyin gyi phyag rgya/ phyag g.yas pus mo'isteng gyen gu bkan pa ste/ dngos grub ster tshul ston pa'i lharmeXphyag rgya zhig /〈yiskyabs sbyin/ skyabs sgrin gyi cag rgya ste/ phyag g.yas kyi gu'o phab cing phyag rtse du ma thad ru zang pa'i phyag rgya zhig /4yimu tig chun 'phyang / phu tig gi chun po bar snang la thur ru 'phyang ba zhes pa ste nam mkhar sprin dkar gyi phung po dalagyis g.yo ba'i rnam pa'i/ /6)rig pa 'dzin pa/ rig sngags pa/ dri spra /pa ṭ+wāṃ snyi / ༷/na sdi pa dbya na/ radze// ( dī/ sra ༷༷ ༈ rnyi longs spyod zab pa'i longs spyod kyi rig 'dzin dang / bskyed rim la441
brtan ba thob pas spros bcas spros med gang rung gi spyod pa spyad pas rang rgyud kyi mi lus ma spangs par 'dod pa'i lha dang skal ba mnyam pa'i 'jal lus thob pa'am/ shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa spyad pasrang rgyud kyi mi lus gnas 'gyur nas gzugs kyi lhadang skal ba mnyam pa'i 'jal lus thob pa'i lus kyi rig 'dzin bcas gsum yod la/de rnams kyi grub pa rnyed pa la rig pa 'dzin pa zhes gya la/ 'dir rig 'dzin gyi dngos grub sgrub mkhan la go ba'o/ /kharab mtshan pa/'dir rab tu mdzes par brgyan pa'i don/rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen①la bstod pa dad pa'i ljon shang /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi zhabs kyi pad+mo dri ma med pa la mchog tu gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /rnam dpyod lang tsho dar ma'i lus/ /yon tan rin chen du mas mdzes/ /legs bshad mig dkyus ring po can/ /mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog khyod la 'dud/ /yab rje dam pa'i ②bka' lung gis/ /dri med rig pa'i cod pan bcings/ /chos kyi srid la dbang bskur ba/ /rgyal tshab dar ma rgyal gyur cig /tshangs dang skabs gsum dbang po sogs/ /mtho ris mgon po'i gtsug rgyan gyis/ /zhabs kyi pad+mo la btud pa/ /khyod la bdag cag mngon par dpa /chen po rnams kyang mchod pa'i 442
gnas/ /tshogs kyi nang na mkhas pa'i mchog /skyon med yon tan kun ldan pa/ /khyod la snying nas skyabs su mchi/ /bskal par goms pa khyod kyi thugs/ /'gro la bu gcig ltar dgongs pa'i/ /byams dang snying rje'i gting mtha' ni/ /rgya mtsho'i dpe yis nye bar mtshon/ /'di kun bdag gis bsgral lo zhes/ /'gro la phan pa'i dam bca'i khur/ /shin tu rtsi bas non na yang / /dub par ma gyur e ma mtshar/ /thabs dang shes rab dzom pa'i 'gros/ /drang po'i lam du bgrod pa las/ /dam pa'i khur mthar phyin par/ /gzigs nas rgyal sras lam dul 'bad/ /yid 'ong lus dang longs spyod rnams/ /slong ba'i 'gro la ma zhum par/ /sbyin pa'i phyag ring brkyangs nas kyang / /phongs pa rnams kyi dbugs dbyung mdzad/ /6 dang nang gi dngos po kun/ /gtong ba 'ba' zhig goms pa'i blos/ /ser sna'i dri ma bcom pa las/ /phun tshogs thams cad sprin bzhin 'dus/ /legs spyad 0'byor ba mi dman pa'i/ /dal dang 'byor ba'i khang bzang la/ /bslab gsum nor bus rab mtshan pa'i/ /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan legs par btsugs/ /mdzes shing yid 'phrog brjid pa'i sku/ /ha ri tsan dan ljon pa'i shing / /tshul khrims dri ngad ldang ba yis/ /yid kyi gdung ba ma lus 'phral0/ /dka' ba brgya phrag du mas kyang / /mi 'khrugs bzod pa'i go cha rgyan0/ /khong khro'i dgra b+thā drungs rgyung nas/ /dul ba'i dpal de khyod kyis brnyes/ /le lo'i bud shing bsreg slad du/ /brtson pa'i me chen sngar ba yis/ /nyes pa'i tshang tshing gzhan dag kyang / /jes par bcom pa 'di rmad byung / /bying rgod①443
rlung las mi g.yo ba'i/ /ting 'dzin mar me gsal ba la/ /brten nas chos kyi de nyid ①ni/ /shes rab mig gis mngon sum gzigs/ /do zhing myur ba zab pa'i byos/ /zab cing rgya che'i chos rnams la/ /mkhas pa zhes bya khyod nyid de/ /gzhan rnams de yi ga/zugs brtan no/ /'jig rten ma lus cad pa la/ /byed po mkhas par grags kyang des/ /khyod dang mtshungs pa'i mkhas pa gzhan/ /bgyid par nus pa ma la gas so/ /dri med rig pa'i byi dor gyis/ /khyod thugs dag pa'i me long la/ /shes bya'i gzugs brtan cig car du/ /gsal la ma 'dres rdzogs par shar/ /khyod kyi ye shes dus mtha'i medu/ /chos dbyings mkha' la 'phyo ba na/ /'di yis nges par skems so zhes/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'dar ram snyam/ /mkhyen pa'i snga/da tsis/ gcig gis kyang / /chos kun khong du chud pas na/ /shes bya'i khyon la sa nyid kyi thugs/ /nges par yangs pa lags sam snyam/ /rgol ba'i dkyil 'khor legs bshams pa'i/ /mkhas pa'i mdun sar mgon ngo khyod/ /chos bka' rgya chen sgrog pa la/ /mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri 'a ca dbang / /blo mig bral yang mkhas rlom pa'i/ /phas rgol mtha' dag khyod drung na/ /tshig gi 'khar ba 'khyor bzhin du/ /rtsod pa'i gom pa rgyutshom 'dor/ /rig gzhung chu gter las thon pa'i/ /gang gi 5 gros ri dbang ni/ /pha rol rgol ba'i rlung shugs kyis/ /cung zad tsam yang bskyod pa min/ /mgon khyod gdul bya'i 'jig rten la/ /nyin bzhin legs bshad 'doms pa ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'phrin lasbzhin/ /nam yang dus las 'da' mi srid/ /dpal ldan phyogs kyi ri 444
mo ma/ban/ /gdul bya'i yig kyi jis ngos la/ /rnam dpyod bar gyi 4 au yis/ /legs bshad ri mo ci yang 'bri/ /sangs rgyas nyid du bgrod pa la/ /grangs med sasum la mi bltos pa'i/ /rdo rje theg pa nya ba'i lamakha/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs ba khyod kyis rnyed/ /rnam dag dbang gis rgyud smin cing / /dam tshil/ sdom pa chu la bzhin bsungs/ /rim gnyis zab mo'i mthar son pa /go 'phang mchog tu gyur la 'dud/ / nas skal bzang gdul bya la/ /chos kyi bdud ji'i bgo skal byin/ /rjongs pa'i dri ma ma lus bkrus/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i bka' drin mdzad/ /shes bya kun la mnga' sgyur kyang / /snying rjes gzhan dbang gyur pa khyod/ /srid pa ji srid gnas kyi bar/ /ga'/na gyi don la brtson pa lags/ /na phyir rgyal ba'i bstan pa la/ /bgyi bar 'os pa kun mdzad pa/ /mnyam med thugs rje'i gter chen la/ /rnam pa kun tu phyag bgyi 'o/ /gang gi yon tan chu gter las/ /thigs pa cha tsam 'thungs pas kyang / /dad pa'i spu long cher g.yos te/ /gus pa'i tshig 'di gsol ba la gas/ /dri med ston ku'i zla zer ltar/ /rna chog tu dkar ba'i dge ba 'dis/ /mgon po khyod kyi zhabs drung du/ /bdag kyang skye ba nyid gyur cig /khyod kyi zhal gyi bum bzang las/ /legs 'ongs le sa bshad bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /ma lus dad pa'i snyim pa yis/ / ngom sa pa med par 'thung bar shog /rgyal ba'i gsung gi gces pa'i ngadzod/ /mtha' dag rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bzhin/ /nyams pa med par 'dzin pa la/ /'jame pa'i dbyangs su bdag gyur cig /sku 9ri mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar zhing / /gsung 445
dbyangs yan lag drug cus brgyan/ /thugs rna zab yangs mkhyen brtse'i gter/ /dpa'adzaldan bla ma'i bkra shis shog /rje btsun za ma rin po che dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang /rmad du byung ba'i mkhyen rab mtha' yas pa can gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las rgyun mi chad pa phyogs dus thams cad du mdzad pa la mnga' brnyes pas lus can thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs su gyur pa'i bdag nyid chen po rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen gyi zhal snga nas la bstod pa dad pa'i ljon shing zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa 'di ni/ rje btsun bla ma de nyid kyi bka' 'bangs tha mar gtogs pa shākya'i dge slong dge 'dun grub pa dpal bzang pos mchog tu dad pa'i shugs kyis kun nas bslangs te dpal byang chub chen po'i dben gnas theg chen tho brang du sbyar ba'o// //mchan 'grelaḥ ()rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen/ rab byung drug pa'i shing 'brug(spyi lo 1364) lor gtsang nyang stod kyi yul du 'khrungs/ gnas rnying pa rin chen rgyal mtshan gyi drung gu rab tu byung / dka' bzhi ba rang dor dang rje btsun red mda' ba sogs mkhas chen du ma spyi bor bsten nas mdo sngags kyi gzhung la sbyangs pa mthar phyin mdzad/ sa skya dang /gsang phu/ rtsethang bcas su po ti dka' ba bcu'igrwa skor gnang /mkhas pa'i grags pa thob 'ung dka' bcu pa'i ming btags blangs/rab byung bdun pa'i me 6(spyilo 1396)lor rjetsong kha pa chen po bsnen/ dgung lo nga drug pa sa mo phag (spyilo1419)lor rjerin po che sku gshegs pas de'i tshab tu dga' ldan gser khrir bzhugs te rgyal tshab ces pa'i ming thob/ gudan sa lo bcu gcig 'dzin cing 446
'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi bya ba rgya cher mdzad/ dgung lo re dgu pa rab gang bdun pa'i chu byi(spyi lo1432) lor rtse po ta lar sku gshegs/ ()yab rje dam pa/ 'der rje tsong kha pa chen po lan dgos/ ()rgyal sras lam/ zag chen bya pa sems kyi lam/(be+elegs spyad/ legs byas sa ma dge ba bsod nams kyi tshogs/()'phral/ phral pa'i da lta ba ste/ 'dor ba dang / 'bralas 'jug pa dang / 'bri bar byed pa bcas kyi don la 'jug /()bzod pa'i na cha rgyan/ khyad chos bzhi lda na kyimi 'khrug pa'i sems dge ba sa bon dang bcas pa'i bzod pa de na cha'i gzugs su bkod de bzod pa legs par goms pa'i don ston pa'o/ /②bying rgod/bying ba rna ngo bo dge mi dge lung ma bstan gang rung la dmigs nas rnam pa gsal ler med pa'i shes pa zhig dang / sod pa ni yulayid gu 'ong ba la sred pa'i rnam pas phyir 'phro ba'i sems byung rmug 1/ /de gnyis ting je 'dzin sgom pa la bar du gcod pa'i las can yin no/ /(3chos kyi nyid/ chos kyi gnas lugs te rten cing 'brel bar 'byung pa'am stong ba nyid do/ /②dus mtha4me/ bskal pa 'jig par byed pa'i me/ 〈melda rje theg pa nye ba'i lam/ gsang sngags lda je theg pa la brten nas tshi gcig lus gcig la thams cad mkhyen pa'i 1 'phar 'thob par 'gyur pas nya ba'i lam zhes bya ste/〈〈phar phyin rnam bshad snying bo'i rgyan〉〉las/ phar phyin theg par lasgyis bskal pa grangs med pa gsum gyi bar du bzad nas de'i jes ga sngags kyi lam gyi snon pa btab nas gzugs sku'agrub pa' tshularna gzhan sa shes par bya'o zhes dang / mkhas grub rje'i〈〈rgyud lde spyi 447
rnam〉〉las/ pha rol tu phyin pa rkyang pa'i lam gyis sa bcu ba'i bar ru bkrod nus kyang / mthar 'tshang rgya ba sngags bla med kyi lam du zhugs pa la nges par ltos dgos kyi/ der ma zhugs/ par 'tshang rgya ba mi srid do/ /ces gsungs pa dang / dbyangs can dga' ṇ+ḍa'i 〈〈sngags kyi sa lam〉〉las/ bla med kyi khyad chos rdza/ sngags lam la sngar zhugs ma myong ba zhig gsar ru zhugs nas de 'dra'i dus ring po la mi ltos par snyigs dus kyi tshe thung 'di la 'tshang rgya dus pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phar phyin theg pa'i lam gyis bskal pa grangs med gsum gyi ring latshogs bsags kyang mthar lda rje theg pa'i lam du ma zhugs na 'tshang rgya bar mi nus la/ der zhugs na snyigs maladus 'der tshe ga cig lus gcigu la'atshar rgyanas pas rdo 5 theg pa nye ba'i lam zhes bya'o/ /
spyan snga pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/spyan snga ba blo gros rgyal mtshan ni/ yul lhas lung ba chos grwa grwa dgon gyi zhol/ grwa rnam khang zhes bya bar yab dgyer dpon chos skyabs dang /yum dzo mo bla ma 'bum zhes pa gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bdun pa'i chu rta (spyi lo 1402)lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo gsum bzhi nas yi ge sbyor klog sbyangasalta dgung lo bdun pa sa byi(spyi lo 1408) lor khu bo kun dga' blo gros kyi byeng du rab tu byung / mtshan blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bor gsol/ de nas grwa dgon du mkhan chen bsod nams shes rab pa'i drung du phar tshad mthar phyin par mdzad/ skyor mo lung du mkhan chen chos rgyal dpal bzang bo dang / slob dpon shes rab bzang bo gnyis kyi drung du mdo rtsa gsan sbyong mdzad/ dgung lo bcu bdun pa sa khyi(spyi lo1418)lor gtsang phyogs su byon/ ri bo mdangs can du mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa dang / chos rje blo gros pa rnam gnyis kyi drung du rtsa 'jug gnyis dang mdo sngags kyi gsan sbyong rgya cher mdzad/ dgung lo bco brgyad par zhwa lu gnas snying rnams su phar tshad dang / mdo rtsa/ rtsa 'jug sogs kyi grwa skor mdzad/ dgung lo bcu dgu pa lcags byi(spyi lo 1420 ) lor mkhan po yon tan rin chen dang / las slob slob dpon nor bzang /yo/sangaston na—]cepar nga/4/ kyā na ma 4 ge che dbus su brten par rdzogs/ de nas 449
snga gzhug tu rje tsong kha pa chen po dang / rgyal tshab rje/ mkhas grub rje/chos ji blo gros pa bcas dga' ldan gyi khri thog phebs pa bzhi dang / gzhan rje btsun 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ rje btsun bzang skyong ba/ gnas brtan chen po chos skyong ba/ dgyer kun dga' blo gros/ rin po che gzhon nu 'od sogs bcu hrag gnyis la nye ba'i mkhas grub dam pa rnams legs par bsten nas mdo sngags kyi gzhung kun la mkhas par gyur cing bstan pa rin po che'i gtsug rgyan du gyur/ de nas dus yun ring bor 'gro ba'i don mdzad nas skam dgon du bzhugs/ phag lo zla ba gnyis par rin chen sgang gi gdan sar phebs te khri thog bzhugs/ nyid kyi slob mar gyur pa bstan pa'i bdag po mar du byon/ gtso b+thā rab 'byams pa smon lam dpal/ chos rje kun legs pa/ chos rje rab 'byams blo bzang sogs ni khyad par du 'phags pa yin/ dgung lo mthon po 5 bzhi ba rab byung brgyad pa chu 'brug (spyi lo 1472)lor sku gshegs so/ /rje btsun bzang po skyong sems dpal chen po la bstod pa dri za'i glu dbyangs/na mo gu ru makyu snyo tā ya/ yon tan bzang po'i dpal gyis rab bajid cing / /'gro ba rnams rna bu gcig lta ra skyong la/ /brtse bas gzhan gyi don la zhugs gyur pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma chalus can gtsug na rgyal/ /khyod kyi thugs rje'i 'od stong 'phros pa las/ /srid gsum 450
'dzin ma'i khyon na 'khod pa yi/ /sdug bsngal grang bas nyam thag zhi ba dang / /bde ba'i myu gu rgyas pa 'gran pa bzhin/ /don 'di mthong na thugs s+t+ra chen po zhes/ /sa gsum grags pa'ang khyod las gzhan ni gang / /khyod kyi rnam dpyod me lce mched pa yis/ /gti pung/ pun nag mthug po gzhil pa dang / /som nyi'i tshang tshing sreg par mdzad pa ni/ /'jig dus bskal pa'i zhugs ①la'ang yongs ma mchis/ /don 'de'i phyir na mgon po khyod nyid ni/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dang dbyer ma mchis pa②lags/ /rta bdun ldan pa 0lha yi lam las 'bar/ /mun nag tshogs la gnas pa'i mthu med ltar/ /khyod kyi 'phrin las rgya mtshor zhugs gyur na/ /bdud kyis glags rnyed 'gyur ba'i skabs ma mchis/ /der ni mgon khyod mthu stobs dpal ldan pa'i/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa ②las kyang gzhan ma lags/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pas na/ /khyed las rgyal ba thams cad byung ba'am/ rgyal ba kun gyi mdzad pa sgrub pa'i phyir/ /rgyal ba kun las khyed nyid byung ba'am/ /som nyi'i dpyang thag①'di rna bcad du gsol/ /'gro 'di sred pa'i zhags pas bcings gyur tshe/ /cung zad tsam gyi phyir na srog kyang gtong byed pa/ /srid pa'i mthu lta gang na'ang ma mchis lags mod kyang / /khyod nyid thugs rjes bcings pas mnar med nang du'ang 'jug 'tshal ba/ /khyod kyi thugs rjes srid pa'i mthu lta brgya phrag zil gyis mnan/ /'gro ba ma shes mun par zhugs nas dang zhig 'u bgyid pa/ /legs par rtogs na mkhas la shin tu ya mtshan gyur/ /khyod kyi mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor shes bya'i①mkha' la 'phags pa 451
na/ /blang dor chos kun ma ngo na ru ma gsal 'di me ma 'di bas mtshar/ /khyod sku mthong tshe dang pa'i spu long g.yo 'a gang / /gzugs/ kyis dregs ldam/ 'jig rten mes po②dang / /bde sogs bdag po ②la yang b+dza ltar yod/ /khyod gsu rdza spri 'dzin bu sgar zhus/sa pa las/ /gdul bya ri lus sems tshim par byed de ni/ /gzhon nu'i bde bas dper ༷ nga nus ma lags/ /shar gyi sa 'dzibha/ rtse las 'od zer stong phrag 'gyeg/ /mun pa'itshogs 'dzams skye dgu rnams kyi mig gcig pu/ /nyan byed darang po deṭa/ kyang khyod kyi mkhyen brtse yi/ /cha shas tsam zhig mtshon spyo — thengs rdzogs ji lta ra mtshon/ /de ltar yon tan tshogs la mnga' brnyes gyur kyang zhi ba'i bde 'a/ khyod ma cha nas/ /skyon gyi tshogs rnams rtsad nas phyung yang skyon ldan 'kho ra ba mi spong ba/ /srid zhi'i mtha'〈yilas grol ba sems dpa' che khyo da kyi/ /zhabs kyi pad+mor sgo gsum gus pas phyag btsal nī/ /lus dang 'o ngas spyod dus / gsu ca/ dge ba'i tshogs kyis mchod/ /sdig pa'i tshor/sa rnams gnong 0zhing 'gyod pas so sor bshagasayi/ /dge tshogs ma lus pa la dga' bas rjes yi rang0/ /i/nga gi rdul med ⑨bskal par bzhugs gyur te/ /'gro la chos 'khor bskor bar bdag gsol 'debs/ /de ltar bsgrubs pa'i dgi ba 'dis mtshon nas/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs ci mchis pa/ /'gro ba kun gyi phan ba 'i gsos gcig pu/ /bla med byang chub 'thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ca khyen bza cig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo rje btsun bzang po skyong sems dpa' chen bo la bskyo da pa dri za'i glu dbyangs 452
mes bya ba 'di ni rgyal ba than sa cad kyi mdzad pa dang cho /tshuras sbra 9 brka' drin gyis nye bar 'tsho ba mang du thos pa'i spong ba pa blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis/ sbyar ba'o// //mchan 'grel ()dpalaldan bla ma/ 〈〈rgyud kyi rgyal po〉〉las/ sangs nus zhal 'ad gang gi thugs dang zhal la gnas par gyur pa de 'i dpal sman bla ma'o zhes gsungs pha ltar/ sangs rgyas kyizhalalam sgor gyur pa'e dbang bzhi ba zung 'jug gi lam 'di nyid/ gang gi zhal las rgyud kyi nges pa byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel bas gsal bar byas pa bzhin du slob ma'i blo la'agod par nas shing / ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag thugs la bzhugs pa sa slob ma'i rgyud la gyin rlabs kyi ngo bor rtogs pa spro bar dus pa sngags kyi nges pas sa dang po thob pa rna bla ma tsam las spyar ches khyad par du gyur pa'i dpal ldan bla ma zhes bya'o nas kor sprul yon tan rgya mtshos gsungs la/ skabs 'dir 'ari lta bu'i bka' drin gyi cha shas thob pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid dmigs su 'dzin/tsho'i'ajig dus bskal pa'i zhugs/ bskal pa chags gnas 'jig stong bzhi'igasum pa ste/ 'jig pa'i bskal par nang bcad kyi sems can las mnar med ru sems can du skye ba'i 'phro rgyun chad pa nas 'do tshugs te/ snod kyi'ajig rten me dang chu dang rlung gis 'jig pa yin la/ de'iyun ni bar bskalanyi shu yod/ 'dir zhugs zhes pa rna bldeming ste/ 'jig dus bskal pa'i zhugs rna phyi snod kyi 'jig rten yang 'jig par byed pa'i me shugs ha cang drag po'o/ /budabyer ma mchis pa/ gnyis ka so sor dbye rgyu med pa ste khyad par mel pa'i don/ ()rta bdun ldan pa/ nyi ma'i ming gi na grangs te/ nyi ma 453
rta bdun gyis 'dren pa'i shing rtar zhugs nas nyin bzhin nam mkhar = ba na ming de ltar btags par grags la/ rin spungs ngag ( pa3 (rnyipasale gra pastu rna/ rlung dang pa/ /// gh+nā ( t+t+waṃ gca dī pa/tshan/ dang / /ri bo 'dzoms rnams nyi ma'irta/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar na/ rta bdun dang ldan pas na de ltar btags pa'o/ /()rdo rje 'dzin pa/ phyag na lda rje'iming gzhan te/ de rna sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyingo bo gcig tu bsdus pa mthu stobs nas pa'i bdag nyid can/ phyag na mtshon byed 5 rje bsnams pa'i nya ba'i sras chen brgyad kyi ya gyal/ de dang 'jam dbyangs/ spyanaras gzigs rnam gsum larigs gsum mgon pozer/ 9yisom nyi'idapyang thag som nyi ste the tshom dpyang thag gi gzugs su bkod pa/ ma kyā yongs 'dzin gyis/ mar dpyang ba'i thag pa de phyogs gang la yang ma reg pa ltar/ the tshom yang yul gang la'ang mi phyogs pas/ de skad brjod do zhes gsungs/ 7shes bya/ ji skad gu tshad mas rtogspar bya ba rna shes bya yin la/ yul dang shes bya gzhal bya rnams gtso bor don gcig yin pas/ yul gyi mtshan nyid go bar bya ba'am rig par bya ba/ shes bya'imatshan nyid blo yi yul ru bya rung ba/ gzhal byalamatshan nyid tshad mas rtogs par bya ba'o zhes gsungs la/ chosthams cad rna blo'i yul rtswa bya rung ba yin pas shes bya yin rna/ /()'jig rten mes po/ 〈〈mngon brjod mkhas pa'i rna rgyan〉las tshangs pa'i ming gi rnam grangs la 'jig rten byed po dang mes po sogs bkod la/ 'dir 'jig rten mes po zhes pa'ang tshangs par 1 454
dgos te/ 'jig rten thams cad 'des sprul par 'dod pas na 'jig )na byed po dang / 'jig rten gyi dang po'ipha rnams 'dis bskyed par rlom pas na mes po zhes bya bas/ ming de gnyis 'dus pa las 'ji /—rten mes po zhes bya'o/ /phu'ib sogs bdag po/ bde sogs zhes pa rna lha dbang brgya byin gyi btsun mo bde sogs lha mo yin la/ca de'i bdag pobargya byin nyid yin pas na de ltar btags pa'o/ /(yisrid zhi'i mtha'/ srid pa 'khor ba dang gi ba gang 'das gnyis kyi mthal ste/ nyan 'ongs 64 mas ma dag par sred ma'i phunatshogs la chags na srid mthar lhung ba dang / sems tsun gyi don mi byed par myang 'das kho nar dmigs pa zhi mthar cang ba'o/ /yiganang ba/ nyes pa ste rnangs zhes kyang bya/ 4〉so sor bshags pa/ 'gyod pa drag pos nyes snang phyir bcos chad pa rna bshadas ba'o/ /so sor bshadas pa rna/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi rig pa re re nas bshags pa zhes pa ste/ 〈〈snang bshags〉〉las/ 'dod chags zhe ldang gti bug dbang gis rna/ /lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang / /sdig pa bdag gis bgyis pa ce maris pa/ /de dka thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /4)rjes yi rang / sa su r+yā rang ba ste yanalag bdun gyi nang tshan/ de'i don rna sngar bsags kyi dge ba la dmigs nas phanayon mthong ste dgal ba tsam gyi dad pa yin rna/ /gzhing gi rdul snyed/ 'a ra zhing sa'i rnal ji snyed pa lte/ grangs las 'das pa'i don ston pa'o/ /455
dgyer gzhon nu 'od ces sa gsum na yongs su grags pa la bstod pa nor bu'i phreng ba/na mo gu ru mañtsa snyo ṣā ya/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la bstod pa nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma 'khor lo sdom pa①dang dbyer med pa la gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod sbyin brgya ba ①kun mkhyen ral ba can0/ /pad dkar mig0sogs mngon mtho'i dbang po yang / /gang gi tshogs gnyis ri rab 6na po yi/ /zil gyis gnon mdzad lus can gtsug na rgyal/ /chos kyi rgyal po 'jam dpal gzhon na②ltar/ /gang sku'i nyin byed 'od stong rab 'phros pas/ /lus can phan bde'i pad tshal rgyas par mdzad/ /bla med bla ma mchog de spyi bos mchod/ /khyod sku 'dab brgya gzhon nu nyid nas kyang / /'jig rten 'das pa'i 'od brgya rab tu 'gyed/ /byams dang snying rje'i chu yis legs brlan cing / /dam pa'i gsung gi tsha zer gyis phye bas/ /mgon med skye po'i dga' ston mchog tu gyur/ /khyod zhabs 'gro ba'i dpal du brtan gyur cig /dbang bzhi zlogangs ri'i khrod du legs 'khrungs shing / /rgyud sde bzhi yi mche sder rab tu rno/ /gzhan gyis mi thub rim gnyis 'o mas gsos/ /nyams rtogs 0g.yu ral dbyar gyi chu b+thā bzhin/ /rab rgyas bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khro ba'i①dud pa ma thul par/ /lta ngan mig dag pham par mdzad/ /ma dul martsan cha dang bral yang / /rnal ba'i dmag dpung 456
rapa tu bcom/ /gzhan gyis/ mi pa'i chos la 'dud/ /khyod sku gzi bajid 'bar ba yis/ /ri rang ku po'i tra/zi 'phrog cing / /mtshes pas lha dbang zil gyis gnon/ /de tshe khyod la 'jig rten gyi/ /rgyan mchog gdags kyang ci zhig 'tshal/ /bzo spros bris pa ma yin kyang / /khyo da sku bris pa lta bur 'khums0/ /'phrog byed⑩min yang 'jig rten gyi/ /dpal kun 'phrog byed khyod nyid de/ /dmag dpon min yang phas rgol dag /zhi bas bul mdzad khyod nyid lags/ /ston zla dri med rab rgyas pa/ /rgyu skar pye bas rab bsko ra nas/ /gling bzhi kun tu rgyu ba ni/ /khyod kyis bstan la phan btags shing / /'gro ba bde la bkod pa dag /mtshungs/ 7da ma cho ga tu ya mtshan shes/ /snyan pa sgro ga phyir rgyu ba snyam/ /khyod ni dman la mchog tu brtse/ /'jig rten kun gyis bkur gyur kyang / /nga rgyal btul nas dman pa yi/ /tshul gyis 'gro ba dge la 'dzud/ /khyod kyis dkon mchog gsum gyi rten⑨/ /gsar du bskyed dang rnying pa dag /gsos shing rab tu bcos pa dang / /chos dang zang zing bsdu ba yis/ /'jig rten bsdu ba mdzad pa'i tshul/ /skye bo bsod nams dman pa la/ /bshad na sgro 'dogs 0rdzun du mngon/ /grangs med skye bos bskal pa brgyar/ /bsgrubs kyang khyod kyi mdzad pa yi/ /cha tsam ji ltar sgrub par nus/ /khyod kyi phyag zhabs srin bal gyis/ /lda ba'ang nas zan ltar brdzis shing / /'gro ba'i mchod rten bskrun no zhes/ /'jig rten skye b+thā dag gis 'khyams/ /gzhan yang khyod zhabs yon tan tshul/ /rtsa gcig bska9 ri brgya ri bajokhu 66 ri 4 nga / /ji ltar de yi ma tha' rtogs 457
'gyur/ /dab la ldan 'khor lo sdom bcadang / /dbyer med m+pa ma mchog bstod pa'i/ /dge bas bdag sogs 'gro ba kun/ /skye bar bshes gnyen dam pa yis/ /'bral med dgyes bzhin rjes bzung ste/ /sa lam ma lus mthar phyin nas/ /srid gsum skye bo ma lus pa/ /byang chub mchog la 'god par shog /gang zhig gus pas nyin mtshan du/ /bstod mchog nor bu'i phreng ba 'dis/ /bla ma mchog la bstod byed na/ /de ni skye ba thams cad du/ /bshes gnyen dam pas rjes bzung zhing / /byang chub dam pa myur du thob/ /der rna gus pas kha ton bya/ /zhes dgyer gzhon nu 'od ces sa gsum na yongs su grags pa la bstod pa nor bu'i phreng ba 'di dpal ldan bla ma 'di nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa'i dgyer dpon blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs par gyur tsig/ //mchan 'thel ()'khor lo sdom pa/ 'ayor lo bde mchog ste ba ba chen po'i ye shes mngon ru brnyes parabyed pa'i lam dang 'bras bu'i rim pa ston pa'i bla med rgyud kyi rgyud gzhung dang / de'i yi dam ste don gnyis la 'jug'dir rjes ma'o/ /0mchod sbyin brgya ba/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyi ming ste/ mu stegs pa rnam sa mchod sbyin brgya byas na lha'idbang po thob ces zer la/ brgya byin gyis kyang sngo na mchod sbyin brgya byas par grags so/ /②kun mkhyen ral ba can/ lhadabang phyug chen po/ ()pad dkar mig khyab 'jug gi ming gi rnam grangs te/'dis drag po mchod pa'i phyir/ pad ma dkar po stong gi gtor ma'igzugs byas pa la/ drag pos de las gcig mi snang ba byas pa na/458
'des miparagacig phyung nas pad ma dkar po'i gnas su bzhag pas/pad dkar mig ces gragasaso/ /②'jam dpal gzhon nu/ rang rgyud nyon mongs pa'i rtsub reg dang bral bas 'jam pa sems can thams cad kyi dpal dang mgon du gyur pas na dpal/ de yang rdza mas rang don dang / phyi rnas gzhan don phun tshogs bstan/ yang na ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes rma chog gi dpal dang ldan pa'o/ /gzhon nur gyur pa ni ye shes kyi6 nyid skye 'chi'i spros pa dang bral bas gdul bya'i snang ngor yang rtag par gzhon nu'i tshul ston pas kyang yin mod/ dngos don gtso spo rna spobs pa dang shes rab phun sum tshogs pa'i lang tsho gzhon nu'i dus bzhin rtag tu gang bar 'gyur ba'o zhes 'brug khams sprul bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi mas gsungs/ phro'idabang bzhi/ lus lha skur goms pa'i bskyed rim la dbang thob pa'i phyir ru bum pa'i dbang dang / ngag gi bzlas brjod la dbang thob pa'i phyir sa gsang ba'i dbang / yid 'od gsal stong ba nyid bsgom pa la dbang thob pa'i phyir ru shes rab ye shes kyi dbang / lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med pa'i zung 'jug gi sku 'grub pa'i phyir du tshig gi 5dbang ngam ngag gi dbang ste bzhi'o/ /(1nyams rtogs/ nyams lendang rtogs pa'i bsdus ming ste/ chos don zab mo sgrub pa nyams len byas nas thob pa'i yon tan khyad par can/ 9)khro ba/ dmigs yul zhe sdang gi yul ce rigs la dmigs nas rnam pa yul de la rang stobs kyis deg pa sogs lu sa kyi sbo nas ngartsod par 'dod pa'i rnam pa can byed las gnod par shom pa ste garnal trī ra rgya sa pa'i rten byed pa'i sems byung ste/ 〈kun btus〉〉las / khro ba pa ra zhe na/ gnod 459
par byad pa'i hra nye bar gnas nakhong khro'i char gtogs pa'i sems kun nas mnar sems pa ste mtshon cha len pa dang chad pas gcod pa lasogs pa dang gnod pa shom pa'i rten 6da pa'i las can rnanas gsungs la/ rang yu la la rang stobs kyis lus kyi sgo nas gdod par 'dog pa'i sems byung zhes kyang bya'o/ /()'khums pa/ thos pa dang shes pa dang go ba la 'jug 4yi'aphrog byed/ 'phrog gyed ni/khyab 'jug dang / brgyabyin/ dngul chu/ nyi ma/ nale/ dpa' b+thā/ phyogs / tsan dan dkar po/ ri dwags / rlung / rlung lha/gshin re/ seng gi sa ru ra/ lha dbang phyug chen po sogasadon mang po la 'jug mod/ skabs 'dir dpa' 'or go dgos/yid7/na mchog gsum gyirten/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang /chos dkan mchog dang / dge 'dun dkon mchog bcas pa gsum gyi rten te/ sku gsu ja chusas kyirten rna/ /0sgro 'dogs/ med par yod 'dzin gyi kun btags/spyan snga 'i na chen dpal ba la phul ba/dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la bstod pa tshangs pa'i cod pan zhes bya ba/phyos/sa bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang slob mar zhu)bcas/ pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rlabs chen bsod nams mngon rnga/tho'i byed po yis/ /dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal por①dbang bskur te/ /skal bzang 'gro la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i/ /mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs pad spyi bos mchod/ /bsod nams 460
yi shes tshogs gnyis dpal gyis bajid/ /sku gnyis 0mngon gyur 'phrin la sa bzang po yis/ /'gro ba ma lu sa bde la 'god mdzad pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla mas rtag tu dge legs stsol/ /'phags pa'i yupa du rgyud sde rgya mtsho sbya ngas/ /sum cu gsum du snya rnams bde la bkod/ /ma 'ongs ṭhi/nga mchog dam par sar+shags so zhes/ /mchog tu lung bstan khyod zhabs gus bsten gyi/ /bdag kyang khyod kyi zhing mchog dam pa der/ /dam pa mnyes pa'i 'phrin las bgyid par shog /skye b+thā kun gyi mgo bo'i cod pan rnams/ /gang gi rin chen khri la rab 'dud pa'i/ /nyi ma'i gnyen 0dang mtshungs pa'i rigs brnyes pa'i/ /'khrungs tsam nyid nas 'gro ba'i skyabs su gyur/ /skyabs mchog khyod la rtag tu gsol 'debs kyi/ /bdag sogs sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying ba la/ /lam mchog grusnod rnams la rim gyis sbyangs/ /bar du rgyud sde rgya mtsho thugs su chud/ /tha mar gsung rab bdud 6 rdzogs par gsol/ /thos bsam sgom gsum 0phyi nang theg pa①rnams/ /rim gyis mthar phyin mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten blo gros chu rgyun kun sdoms kyang / /khyod kyi mkhyen pa'i chu sa/ter dgang mi nus/ /mkhyen pa'i gter zhes snyan pa'i grags pa yis/ /'dzam gling 'od kyis bkang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod kyi tshul khrims sa 'dzin dbar po la/ /yid kyi subs shing 'khor dang bcas pa yis/ /'phrin las 'jug pa'i go skabs yongs ma rnyed/ (brtul zhugs grub pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan gyis brgyan pa yi/ /bde gshegs dngos kyis gdul dka' dmu rgod ①rnams/ / 461
sna tshogs thabs kyis dkar po'i las lam la/ /legs par 'tshad mdzad zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byams pa'i chus bcus tshogs gnyis sdong po rgyas/ /pha rol phyin drug yal ga'i khyon yangs shing / /rnam grol 'bras bu yongs su smin pa yi/ /rkang 'thung dbang po0khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod thugs rgyud sde'i bya lam yangs pa la/ /phra rags lha yi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs/ /dga' ba rnam bzhi'idu'od stong rab 'phro ba/ /nyin byed dbang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /byams dang snying rje'i 'od dkar rab rgyas shing / /lhag bsam cha shas bcu drug⑩yongs su rdzogs/ /lnga brgya tha ma'i ②snyigs dus mtshan mo'i mgon⑨// /theg mchog dge ba'i bshes la bstod pha yis/ /bshes gnyen bsten la mi mkhas sgrib pa yi/ /'dam du bying pa'i bdag sogs 'gro ba rnams/ /byams dang snying rje'i phyag gis legs drangs nas/ /dag pa gnyis ldan yignas mchog 'thob par shog /gzhan yang skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ /theg mchog dudagi ba'i bshes dang mi 'bral zhing / /mi mnyan mi byeddga' bzhin bsgrubs pa yis/ /lda rje 'chang dbang go 'phang myur 'thob shog /brgya phrag nyams kyi gar 0gyi rnam 'gyur can/ /snyan ngag yid 'ong gzhon nu khyod nyid kyang / /pho nya'i dri bzhon rta la rab 'dzegs te/ /kun mkhyen bla ma'i spyan sngar 'phur te song / /'dzum mdangs yid 'ong nor bu'i 'od 'khyug cing ༈ /snyan pa'i gre 'gyur g.yo bas 'di skad gsol/ /gang sku nyin phyed gza' yis ma bsgribs shing / /'phrin las 'od stong 'gyed par 'khums pa yis/ /yid kyi shing rta dga' ba'i 'khor 462
lo bzhis/ /gsurnga rab rin chen gling du drangs gyur lags/ /slad mar phan bde kun gyi sgo gcig pu/ /thub bstan kun da'i 0tshal rab rgyas pa'i phyir/ /'phrin las 'od dkar phyogs bcur 'gyed pa dang / /yab rje dam pa'i 'phrin las sgrub pa'i tshe/ /bu yis dgos pa bgyi ba'i dus bab kyang / /'du 'dzi me yi 'obs la snying 'dar te/ /mtshams kyi dam pa'i 'ching ba dam pos bdungs/ /gsung rab sbrang rtsi'i bde ba myang ba la/ /chags pas gang yang bsgul bskyod yong ma nus/ /der ni thub bstan pad+mo'i gnyen khyod kyis/ /thub bstan pad tshal sgang rtsi myang 'dod la/ /'a༄gas med bde bar gnas pa'i mchog stsol zhes/ /gus pas thal mo lan brgyar btud de zhus/ /de ltar gsol slad bya btang yotshul 'dzin la/ /'gro kun dga' ba skye ba'i nor ma mchis/ /gang gi bka' las bla med mchod pa ni/ /sgrub pa'i mchod pa yin zhes bka' stsang: phyir/ /mchod pa 'di ni lhod pa med par bgyi/ /'on kyang nyid la gus pa'i lhag bsam ni/ /snying nas mi 'dor mtshon phyir rgya lam na/ /bsod nams stobs kyis thob pa'i zhal skyems mchog /zho yi phyed la the'u'i ri mos mdzes/ /lto 'gro'i lo la 'od dkar can bzhi ba/ /rgyu skar bdag por gyur tshe legs par phul/ /slar yang gtam snyan nor bu'i skyes khyer nas/ /legs par 'ongs pas don rnams 'grub par byas/ /zhes pa 'di btsun pa blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis gra dgon du dzo bo'i sku tshad bzhings pa'i dus su spyan snga'i drung du phul ba bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs par gyur cig / //463
