tsha 76rnayodag gis/ /bsnyen rdzogs dgra bcom mngon sum nyid/ /brnya ra grong tshogs mchod kyis/ /mnyas byas rnal 'byor grub mchog las/ /de nas yid bzhin bsam 'phel zhes/ /ca ba'i rkang mgyogs dngos grub⑩khunyes/ /grong khyer ta ma la sa)/ /shasnya ka ras 9/dzes der gshegs// /dbang rab mnas shing rgyud kun thos/ /man ngag thob ci cing grub pa brnyes/ /gang yang rang yul gshegs brtson che/ /lhag pa'i lhayiyis lung bstan pa/ /'jig rten rin chen mtha' dag gis/ /rang nyid gcig pu brgyan 'dod 'di/ /gdengs can dbang po nā ro pa'i/ /rin chen mchog 'di 'dor ba mtshar/ /zhes pa tshig mda'i 'jam pa'idbyangs/ /dbyangs can rgyud mangs lta bu thos/ /gur kum dog pos rkang ba yi/ /'degs 'jog 'gog pa lhur len pa/ /pu la ha ri grub pa'i grong / /yi 'grogs 6 'phrul mchog gis gshegs/ /bde chen lang tsho stong nyid kyi/ /dga' mar 'khyud mkhas kun tu bzang / /tshems phreng gi sar khyod kyi gdong / /zla ba sar ba shar pas rgod/ /nyi zla'i rlung bzhon dzogs nas ni/ /gang gis zhon nas dbu ma'i la maX/ /zhugs te zung 'jugayigazhal yas khang / /skad cig gis bgrod 'dus pa'i lam/ /sa gsum rin chen gcig pu des/ /khyod kyi ral ba rnam par mdzes/ /yul dbus 'dzin mar zhabs mthil gyi/ /jibs stong 'khor lo'i ri mo bkod/ /gang dag dgang/ smub khrir 'dug na/ /'jam dpal dpa' spro dngangs byed pa/ /mkhan chen gu ṇa mi tra sogs/ /paṇa chen bcu phrag bdun dang lnga'i/ /rig tshul nor bu'i do shal gyis/ /513
khyod nyid mgrin pa rnam par bkra/ /gang yang na do sngags gzhung bzang brgya/ /bsgyur cing zhus yite gtan la phab/ /rgyal ba kun gyis ma mdzad pa'i/ /ston pa'i bya ba mtha' dag mdzad/ /bya ba byas4te zhag drug gis/ /'phags pa'i yul la sa rang yul byon/ /ti se'i gtsug tor 'chang ba yi/ /pu hrangs ⑥zhes bya gangs kyi yul/ /sa bdag lha sdebadapung pa yis/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can 'khyud byed pa/ /bang mdzod gnod sbyin rmugs 'dzin dang / /gcig gyur lus ngan pham byed byung / /de yis gtsug la ga khang chen byas/ /dge 'dun tshogs r+yā nga rnam par mchod/ /bod kyi dge bshes se tar gyis/ /yid bsgyur 'jag rtser skyel spung 'ching / /khyod kyi sdigs mdzub dus mtha'i mes/ /skad cig nyid la thal bar rna dzad/ /gu gi②zhes bya 'dzam gling gi/ /sa la gnas kyang yon tan gyis/ /srid pa'i rtse mor bgrang bya ba/ /rab gsal yid gzhungs mkhas pas bsten/ /der ni rgyal phran dzhai ba'i mgor/ /zhabs sen nor bu'i 'od chags pa/ /lha yi bla ma ye shes 'odazlo/ /sa gsum mig gi bdud rtsi gang / /ral ba ldan pa'i sangs rgyas )/ /rtsod pa'i dus kyi 'khor lo sgyur/ /'od gsal lhar 'khrungs mi yi dbang / /nyin par zla zer spro ba byung / /da lta'ang snyan grags me tog dkar/ /phyogs kyi bu mo'i rna bar 'chang / /de yis gser gyi gtsug lag khang / /dpe med lhun gyis grub pa bzhengs/ /nor bu'i zhal zhal rgyal ba'i sku/ /grangs med 'od ris 'char ba can/ /nor bu'i 'od kyis sku 5cig kyang / /sku gzugs 4 ba phrag brgyar snang / /ngo mtshar phung po'i 'jig rten 'di/ /514
'dra byed ri mo mkhan de mtshar/ /dpag tshad lnga bcu bar bar rnam gnas pa'i/ /yul khor rnams su brgya phrag gtsug lag khang / /bzhengs pa'i thig gdab rab tu gnas pa sogs/ /dus gcig nyid du khyod sku gcig gis mdzad/ /sa skyong bkas bskul blo bzang khye'u lnga/ /khrid de na ger yul khor chen por gshegs/ /rin chen rgyu las 'phags pa pad dkar 'dzin/ /bzhengs te rgya bod grags bam stong dag dang / /lhan cig glang chen shing rtas rnam par drangs/ /brag ri'i gdong gis 'khor lo chags pa na/ /nga nyid rkang pas 'gro zhes sku de yis/ /gom pa 'dor bar brtsams tshe sa chen 'dar/ /'di la rdul gyis dzos na mi rung zhes/ /pad+ma brgyud pa stong dag byung gyur te/ /ze'u 'bru'i rkang steng gser gyi rkang pa yi/ /'phur lding mdzes pa gser gyi bung ba bzhin/ /'gro ba'i zla ma ye shes 'od/ /bsod nams skas las thar bar gshegs/ /thugs ji che gang byang chub 'odazlo/ /blo gros chen po zhi ba 'od/ /rgyal ba'i zlos gar nyi bzhon ni/ /thub bstan shar ri'i do rar rol/ /de dag dad pa gser gyi ni/ /lcags kyus dpal ldan mar me mdzadayi/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa spyan drangs te/ /rke ri zla ba'i 'od kyis 'bar/ /thub bstan lo ni bcu phrag dgur/ /nad me mu ge med pa yis/ /dar mdzad rkang gnyis gtso khyod dang / /spu hrangs bzhes wer zhes byar mjal/ /lhan cig sangs rgyas gnyis min zhes/ /smra ḍi rdzun gyi tshig tu byas/ /skyeng mchog khyod kyi bdud rtsi'i ros/ /yongs tshim 'gro la ba tshwa'i chu/ /nga yis ci bya 'u bya zhes/ /rī pa ka ras zhum tshig gsungs/ /515
ting 'dzin gang la lo gcig mnyam bzhag na/ /rmad byung rdo rje lta bu zhis grags pa/ /dpal ldan sa bcu'i rtser son de 'grub par/ /dgongs te chu klung chen po pak+ṣa'i 'gram/ /bsam gtan la 'os bzhir rar gtsug lag khang / /bsten mdzad nai rañdza na'i rgyal sras bzhin/ /rgyal rnams zhum mdzad thugs dam bca' ba gsum/ /nam yang 'gyur med do rje'i sku 'dra ba/ /sgo 'phar phyi nang gcig ngos dung dang dngul/ /gser miyi ge ngo mtshar bye ba 'dzin/ /thengs gcig tsam ngas mi dge'i blo skyes dang / /rin chen sems dang yud tsam bral ba dang / /lung ma bstan blo skad cig gcig skyes na/ /yan lag mchog gang mkha' 'gros khos shig ces/ /lhar bcas bdud bcas skye rgu'i bdag por bcas/ /dge sbyong gnyis skyes dang bcas 'jig rten na/ /sus kyang bgom par mi nus mi 'jigs bzhi/ /brnyes 'di nges par rnam dag sangs rgyas te/ /rang don la chags bdag kyang gzhan don du/ /khyod kyi zhabs la snying nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod kyi slob ma grub pa'i dbang phyug tshogs/ /mkha' la 'phur lding rgyu skar grangs mtshungs te/ /'dzin mar rab gnas bstan pa 'dzin pa rna/ /gang gra'i rdul grangs nyung ngur byed pa nyid/ /khyod la 'gran bzhin phur burmyaskyengs byed ba'i/na/ /kun mkhyen bzhin du smra ba byang she dang / /dgi blo sme dang 'jang blo rin gzhon rnams/ /so sor chos kyi khri stan che la bkod/ /yum gyi skyed tshal rin chen myu gu rna/ /sar nga sa rnam mdzes de tshe yon tan kun/ /gtsug phud can dang khu byug smra mkhas kyi/ /gzugs mjes zol gyis 'jo sgeg rol ba 'dzin/ /516
shākya ye/spru senge drug gnyis mdzad pa ⑨ la/ /'gran pa bzhin du rnam sprul 'di'i ba]bha/sa dang / /'tshog chas tshogs la bag med spongs shig ces/ /grub pa'i skye spros snying nas 'doms par mdzad/ /gnyis kyis dman pa bcu potra ba 6 'i/ /loḥl lang tsho gsar ba rna/ /nam yang gos med de brnyes tshe/ /rlung gi zas can pags pa bzhinargya/ /ca ye brag ces bya ba dang / /g.yang sgyur phug gi gnas dang rna/ /go khar re rlung go sogs nas/ /sprul pa so so so so yi/ /mngon sum mya ngan 'das gyur te/ /sku gdung 'dzin byed bsreg za yis/ /ril mid nyid byas ring bsrel ni/ /gsum/ zhig lhag mar las (lus) pa yang / /rtag tu mnyam 'dzog sku ba'i/na du/ /mkha' yi dbyings su mi snang gyur/ /tshul 'de rang sems snang ba zhes/ /mi shes mi dang mi min dag /mig chu'i rgyun dag spro byed pa/ /'jig dus dag byed phung po bzhin/ /ka ye grogs dag 'khor ba 'ad dang mya ngan lhan cig myur du 'ong cig dka' ba yi/ /dga' ston ror chags dga' ma 'di ni brgya phyag bcu gnyis mdzes pa yongs rdzogs rang gi grogs/ /sred ldan 'khyud pa nam yang 'dor min de lta na yang khyed cag lus srog ge sa ra rdul/ mi rtag bung bas kham zas 4da 'de rjes dpag bya sla sgyu ma 'di byas rjes rig bya/ /rin chen za ma tog las ni/ /(dī pa// t+yā t+ta shā spri dī /ji rnyi pas/ / /de/de lta/su ༵ ngacho lta rdotho ( pas ya/ ༷pa/ me/ mdzad/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'phags lam gyis drangs pa'i/ /mngon shes spyan yangs can des yang gsung ba/ /grub pa'i pho nya gser gyi 1 cha 517
sogs/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas 'jig rten 'dren byed de/ /mkha' spyod gshegs zhes grags pa dang mthun par/ /mkha' la ngom pa 'degs 'dzo ga zung gcig gis/ /rmad byung bde ba can kyi 'jig rten gshegs/ /zhing de'i mgon dang gnyis su med par mjal/ /chos kyi bgro ba rgya che'i dga' bdes tshim/ /'dab brgya'i tshal du bung ba rol ba bzhin/ /sgar yang zhing dang zhing gzhan kun tu gshegs/ /skad cig re rer 'gro ba grangs med ni/ /grangs med smin cing grol bar mdzad do zhes/ /ci yang dang ba'i zla ba shar ba des/ /paṇa chen de yi phyag pad spyi bor zum/ /khyod nyid gcig pus bod yul 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing dang 'gro rnams kyang / /rgyal dang rgyal sras sa la bkod/ /mgon der slar yang phyag bgyid do/ /yang yang goms mdzad legs ldan mtha' dag rgya14 rnams/ ljags yangs dbyar skyes rnga gsang grogs po la rna 'khu ba ltar ston rang gi kun spyod nam yang ma rdzogs ngal ba can/ /lhag bsar/ khur dang 'khor ba'i dpal la 'dod chags bral gang dug can ma yi bdag po'i mgo skyes mal stan la chags rin thang rgya che 'di yis gang gi mtshan tsam gyi/ /rgya yi char yang bzod pa ma yin de'i dpal rang mtshungs (tshul)bsngags 'os spyod mtha'(shin tu rgya che zhing ) dbang phyug skra phreng (ste nam —mkha')dog pa nyid byed kha ba sar ba'i spu long gos spyon(bod gangs can gyi)'dzin ma la/ /rnam par bkod pa'i chu mtsho che las sngon med snyan ngag zla ba'i mdangs 'phrog sen mo'i rtse mos zegs ma tsam blangs mngon par 'thor byas mkhas rnams dgyes pas yi rang rgyas/ /mang thos sprobs pa 'i 518
mtheb long 'grogs pa las/ /snyan ngag nyag phran 'bad med spros pa /sna /'angom/tshi dpaXrapoXji sna gapa rdzu ranye /ga rnams dgra yi sde/ /nyan mongs ces bya ba ni bgrang ba las 'das pa'i sngon gyi skye ba rnams su tshobs gnyis rlabs po che kun tu bsten cing mang du bsags pa yongs su smin pa nyid las/ srid pa tha ma ba'i sku'i skye ba 'dir dbang rgyug brgyad dang ldan pa'i byang chub kyi sems rdo rje'i sa brnyes pa/ 8 mchog rin chen bzang po'i rnam par thar ba lo tsā ba chen po nyid kyi slob ma ka bzhi dang gdung ji brgyad du grags pa'i nang tshan khri tang ba dzñā na shris bkod pa de nyid 'dir tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis bstan cing so sor bstan la rnam par rig par byas pa ste/ rang dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho lta bu khong du chud pa'i zhang zhung pa phyogs las rnam rgyal chos dbang grags pa'i dpal gyis 'brog ri spro che dge ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du sbyar ba'o// //mchan 'grel ()lo tsā ba chen po skyes mtshog rin chen bzang po/ bod kyilo rgyusthog mtshan snyan grags shin tu che ba'i lo tsā ba chen po zhig yin/ rab byung dang po ma shar sngonagyi lo drug cu re dgu sa rta (spyilo 958)lor lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi sras su mnga' ris gu gi'i cha waṃ ran ru sku 'khrungs / dgung lo gsum par rab tu byung / bca bdun thog 'phags /pa bai ༈ / sras hūm̐ (/ (sbram pa/ / sdu/ sta shā pa dī (shā hūm̐ shā// mthar phyin par sbyangs nas bod dubyon/ mdo cad kyi gzhung ma nga po dang / gso ba rig pa'i gzhung mang po bod skad du bsgyur/ slob 519
ma sman pa mkhasapa mi dakhu byung / dgung lo dgu bcu do brgyad pa rab byung dang po'ishing lug (spyi lo 1055)lor sku gshegs/ 6)ran lha dra/ 'od skad du rin chen bzang po zhes bya'o/ /③dmigs bu/ long 'khrid mkhan/ phro'inyad kyiyab 4/ mnga' ris rgyal po lha b+thā g.ye thega'od/ 6)yoser 9 'dab bzang /byu ru4ming ste/ 'dir kha dog dmar po ston pa yin la dos dmar po rgyan te rab tu byung ba'i don/ ①'brug sgra'i4/ra/ rma bya/()ngosapar 'byung blo/ ngos 'byung gi sems te/ /'khor ba'i gnas btsan ra lta bu yin bar nges 〉ku shing / de las thar 'dod pa'i sems/ (tasaha ka racha'akhri shing / ma ba'i sdong bo la 'o ma'ichu drangs nasabaskyed cing bsrings ba las byung ba'i 'brasabu khyad par can la sa ha ka ra zhes dang de'isdong po la sa snyad ra'i 'khri shing zhesabashad do/ /6)byang phyogs kha che yul du phyin/ dasang lo bcu bdun ba spyi 5 974lor mnga' ris rgyal po khong sogs mi t+yā shu rtsa bdun kha cheliyul du mngags ) lo bcu tsa la slob gnyer mdzad/6)rnag gi gnyin/ pha ma gcig pa dang / yang na pha'am ma gcig pa gang rung la4ge byupaba'i spun/ 4)ri yig tshogs/ ri yig ni lha dang rgya'adapo gnyis la 'jug pas/ ri yig tshogs rna lha'i bu tshogs sam rgyalapo'i sra brtapo rnams la zer ba'o/ /4〉nyayi tog g+ne/ nyayi tog ni 'dogalha ste/ 'der bar du gcod pa'i bdud sde la go dkar/ 4)srid rtse/ srid gsum gyi yang 4 ste/ 'du shesamed 'du shes med min kyiskyemached do/ / 4)marag gzhug yo nya'am 'khorg.yog yichu bur lta bu'i lus/ chu bur rna char ba 'bab pa'i 7 ṭa
nang du tshosaba'i chu bur la zer/ de ha cang 'jig sla bas/ mi'i lus rten yang mi brtan 'jig par sla ba de chu yi chu bur dang 'dra'o/ /je tsong kha pas〈〈yon tan gzhir gyur ma〉〉las lu kesrog g.yo ba chu yi chu bur bzhin/ /myur du 'jig pas 'chi ba dran pa dang / zhes gsungs so/ /zhu〉girmir/ rang rgyal gyi nub phyogs su yod pa'i yulakhams shig bod skad du kha che zhes bya'o/ / (yithog mar nu zho 'thung ba'i tshogs/ byis pa'i tshogs/ (4nor srung /6ri ming / 6)brgya phrag lnga/ theg chen gyi slob dpon lnga brgya la zer/ 4)gsol bzhi'i chog bsnyenardzogs bsgrub pa sogs la/gsol pa lan gcig dang la sa dngos tshar gsum brjod pa'i cho ga phonyarkang mgyogs dngos grub/ thung mong gi dngos grub brgyad kyi nang gsos/ bsgrubs pa'i rdzas rkang ba la byug pas/ 'dzam gling yongs skad cig gis bskor pa byed nus pa'i dngos grub cig pho〉lhag pa'i lha/ rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bsten bya'i yi dam gyi lha/phyu1dbu ma'i lam/ rtag chad kyi mthal gnyis dang bral ba bden gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i lta ba rtogs pa'i lam/ snyolazung 'jugska bas 'dir sku gnyis zung du 'jug pa lda je 'chang gi 5 'phang /⑨bsgyur cing zhus pa/ yig bsgyur phyed pa dang zhus dag byed pa/44bya ba byas pa/ sems can gyi don du bslab pa gsum gyi bya ba ma lus pa byas pas na bya ba byas pazhes zer/ 6mepu hrangs/ mnga' ris lho phyogs kyi spu theng ngam spu rang rtag la mkhar yin nam snyam/6〉sa bdag lha sde/ mnga' ris rgyal po lhabla ma ye shes 'od/ phoyigu gi mnga' ris gu gi ste ming rnying pa zhang zhung zer/ rgyal po glang 521
dar mcharabs bzhi ba twe gtsug mnan gyis yul de skyong kyong bas gu ge rgyal rabs zer/ 4〉lha yi gla ma ye shes 'od/ mnga' ris gu gi4rgyal po kra gis mdon: zas yin/ chung dus kyiming la srong ji zer zhing / rjesas lasapo byas pa'i ming la khri lde srong gtsug btsan zer/ tshe sgad gu rgyal srid gcen po la gtad nas rang nyid rab tu byung ba'i ming la lha bla ma ye shes 'od zer/ 4yibyang chub 'od/ lha btsun pa byang chub 'od de/ mnga' ris rgyal po mnga' bdang lha lde4sras gsum gyi bar pa bkra shis 'od zer ba de yin/rjes ge rab tu byung ba'i ming la byang chub 'od zer/ des khubo ye shes 'od kyi zhal rims ltar jo bo rje smyo ṭī sha bod du gdan drangs/yidapal ldan mar me mdzad/ rjo bo rje a ti sha ste/ de'i lo tras bsdus pa〈〈bka' gdams bu chos〉〉kyi rtsom pa po'i ngo sprod la gzigs par gyis/ 0phur bu/ lha'i bla ma phur bu sde/ des smra la mkhas pas lha'ibu rnams kyi slob dpon byasazhes phyi rol pa'i gtam rgyud du grags/ 〈medrug gnyis mdzad pa/ ston pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis te/ dgal ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang / lhums su zhugs pa dang /lū bltams pa dang / gnon nu'i rol rtsed dang / btsun mo'i 'khor gyis rol pa dang / rab tu byung ba dang / dka' ba spyad pa dang / byang chub ting bor gshegs pa dang / bdud btul pa dang /mngon par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor pa dang / mya ngan 9pos 'das pa ste mdzad pa'i tshul bcu gnyis so/ /snyonaganyis kyis dman pa bcu phrag bcu yi lo/ bcu phrag bcu na brgya yin la/ der gnyis kyis dam na na dgu cu na brgyad yin te/ lo 522
chen rimachen bzar ngo rjekung dza 4brgyad pa rab byung dang ngo'i shing lug (spyilo 1055)lo sku gshegs pa de sto na pa 'o/ /6〉rlung gi zas can pags pa bzhin/ rlung gi zas can rna sbrulagyiming ste/sprul rna pags pa bzhag ste ranga'u sa gasprin du 'gro ba'i 'u gas ltar rje 'de yang gzugs phung bzhag ste rang nyid gzhan du sor ba nas mya smyongan las 'das pa'i donaston pa'o/ /
go bo rab 'byams pa bsod nams seng ge/go rams pa bsod nams seng gi ni/ rab byung bdun pa'i sa byi (spyi lo 1429) lor mdo khams 'bom zhes pa'i yul du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bdun par bla ma kun dga' 'bum gyi drung du dge bsnyon gyi sdom pa blangs/ yi gi sbyor klog sbyo nga ba dang rim gyis byams chos sde lnga sogs thugs 'dzin mdzad/ dgung lo bcu gsu ma par kye rdo rje sogs gsang sngags kyi dbang lung mang po zhus/ dgung lo bcu dgu ba rab byung brgyad pa'i me yos (spyi lo 1447) lo ra gtsang du grwa skor la phebs/ rong ston chos rdzi nyi ma dang / bla ma shes rab dpal sogs la dbang lung mang po zhus/ e wa dgon du 'jam dbyangs kun dka' bzang po'i mdun lo gsum ring rgyud sde bzhi sogs gsang sngags skor gyi chos mang po gsan/dgung lo nyer bdun pa shing phag (spyi lo 1455) lor mkhan po cas chen mdun nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du lam 'bras gzhung bshad gsan pa sogs mkhas chen dam pa bco brgyad tsam bsten pas/ mdo sngags rig gnas rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son cing / gangs can mkhas mang kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan du gyur/ dgung lo zhe 524
lnga pa chu sprul (spyi lo 1473) lor rta nag thub bstan rnam rgyal btab/'gro don du 'chad nyan gyi 'phrin la sa spel/ dgung lo nga gsum pa lcags glang (spyi lo 1481) lor e wa chos ldan du phebs nas gdan sa lo lnga bzung / sa sprel lor sa skyar phebs te rten bzhugs rnams la mtshod sprin rgya mtsho ltar phul/ dgung lo re gcig pa rab byung brgyad pa'i sa bya(spyi lo 1489) lor sa skya dgon du sku gshegs/khong gi brtsams chos ni/ bstod tshogs dang / dbu tshad kyi skor/gsang sngags kyi skor sogs bstan bcos po ti bcu gsum bzhugs//rje btsun bla ma kun dga' bzang po0la bstod pa/mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshul khrims0rgyan gyis kun nas mdzes pa'i sku/ /tshangs dbyangs ltar snyan dga' ba skyed pa'i gsung / /mi rtog ting 'dzin bzang po'i thugs mnga' ba/ /'gro ba'i bla ma chos kyi rgya mtsho la/ /rab mnyen lag pa'i sor mo snyong gar zum/ /rab snyan ngag gis sgra dbyangs cher sgrogs shing / /rab dang sems kyis yon tan rjes dran te/ /rab tu bstod la mkhyen brtse'i thugs kyis dgongs/ /khyod kyi yon tan dpag yas rgyal ba dang / /rgyal sras rnams kyis rab brjod de lta na'ang / /nyin byed dbang po mkha' la rgyu 'o zhes/ /bung ba gshog rtse spyod pa'ang 'dor ram ci/ /blo gros rgya mtsho'i dbus na 525
mngon maspri tshir / /rnam dag bslab ngasum gser gyi ra bas basmor/ /'chad phyo da tsong ji — ri bang rim phreng ba can/ hra ba tsutsha/ ri —bang0che la bdang cas dad/ /rgyud sde'i rin chen la sa grung 4 sa po'i spor/ /rim — gnyis bdud rtsi'e ju ri ri ci ci ke 7 ge rol cing / /man nga ga gling bzhir lta pa'i mig stong can/ /rig 'dzin lha yi dbang po de la 'dud/ /phul byung mkhyen pa thub bstan gsal ba'i 'od/ /thugs rje dag pa'i mkha ra la rnam rol zhing / /dpag yas dge legs lo thog smin mdzad pa/ /dam chos smra ba'i nya ma de la 'dud/ /khyod kyi blo gros shes bya la/ /thogs med 'jug nga de yi dpe/ri /gzur ba/nas blo①yis dus kun tu/ /rnam par btsal tshe 'di ltar rnyed/ /skyes stobs sbyangs pa'i mthu ldan pas/ /zab dang gsal dang rgya che'i pyir/ /rgya mtsho nyi rma nam mkha' ni/ /6 gi(khu tsam mtshon pa'i dpe ru mthong / /mu mtha' med pa'i shes bya 9ge/ /chags thob/sa med par 'jug pa'i phyir/ /'jam dpal dbyangs/ khyi mkhyen pa ni/ /ma lus mtshon pa'i dpe ru mthong / /kun mkhyen 5 ]sung la mkhyen pa rab rgyas kun la brtse ba'i thugs mnga' kun rtog ma lus 'dzoms/ /dga' ba'i 'byung gnas rlung sems rdzing bur dga' ba'i/'i 'gros kyis dga' mgur rtse bar byed pa can/ /smon lam bzang pos bskal par legs bsgrubs brtul zhugs bzang pos gdul bya skal ba bzang po'i dpe la snyor/ /mtha' yas mkhyen brtse'i gter mnga' brtse chen khyod la snying nas 'dud do brtse ba'i lcags kyus zungs/ /rab 'byams shes bya'i nam mkha' yangs pa la/ /rab gsal blo gros dkyil 'khor rab rgyas 526
te/ /rab tu brtson pa'i rta bdun gyis drangs nas/ /rab rib ma lus sel bar byed pa 'di/ /ngo mtshar las kyang 'di ni ngo mtshar zhes/ /ri bdun⑥gser gyi me tog rab bkra zhing / /mtsho brgyadabumachod yon phreng ba 'khrigs pa 'dis/ /rgyun du mchod pa'i khyad par bkod pa 'dra/ /snyags dus 'gro ba'i dpal du su 'gyur zhes/ /spyan ras gzigs mgon thugs rje'i dbang phyug gis/ /'od zer drwa bas phyogs bcu'i can bsal te/ /stong phrag phyag tu de snyed spyan spruladunas/ /mi mjed zhing0'dir gzigs tshe mgon khyod kyis/ /bstan la ston pa'i bya ba byed mthong nas/ /thub pa bzhin du 'di ni bkur 'os zhes/ /'dzum pa'i bzhin dang thal mo sbyar ba 'dra/ /gang sku tshul khrims 'dab ma 'bum ldan zhing / /zhi zhing dul ba'i gi sar mdzes gsal bas/ /sdom gsumadusbrang rtsi'i ro mchog myang ba'i phyir/ /don gnyer bung ba spren gyi tshogs bzhin 'du/ /de tshe mkha' la rol ba'i lha rnams kyis/ /mchod 'os 'di la mchod pa bya'o zhes/ /bkod legs nyin byed 'od zer lhab ca' can/ 1mjes pa'i gdugs mchog g.yas su bskor pa 'dra/ /kun mkhyen rgyalba'i go 'phang mchog brnyes kyang / /dga' bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa spel ba'i phyir/ /thugs rje bzang pos mi yi gzugs 'dzin pa/ /khyodla bsams pa dag pas bdag skyabs mchi/ /gang sku mdangs gsal dran pas ba zu g.yo/ /gang gsung rnar snyan dran pas mchi ma4ra / /gang thugs mkhyen bzang dran pas dran pa stor/ /nyam thag bdag la thugs je'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /gang las thob pa'i sdom gsum nor gyi mchog /527
gang yang bdag blo'i mdzod du sbas pa rnams/ /gang gi mkhyen brtse'i lcags kyis rab bsdoms nas/ /gang zhig byang chub bar du gnas par mdzod/ /rab dkar bsod nams gangs ri mthon po'i spor/ /dri med lung gi nga ro cher bsgrags te/ /smra ngan wa tshogs zhum zhing blo gsal gyi/ /ri dwags skyong ba'i seng ger 'gyur bar mdzod/ /ston pa bde gshegs chos kyi dbyingasayis bzhugs/ /bstan pa nyin byed nub rir son dus 'dir/ /bstan 'dzin khyod kyis zhing 'di spong ba'i phyir/ /bstan la sems pa min snyam the tshom gyur/ /'on kyang 'dul 'os gdul bya smin mdzad nas/ /slar yang spros bral chos skur bzhugs pa ni/ /rgyal ba kun gyi ngang tshul yin pas na/ /bdag gis 'khang pa'angayirgyu mtshan ci zhig yod/ /dpag med bskal par bzhugs pa'i mthu ldan zhing / /thub bstan khrin bzhin dengs par rab mkhyen kyang / /zhing 'di spangs nas zhing gzhan gshegs pa ni/ /mkhyen bzang khyod la brtse ba med snyamsems/ /'on kyang dkon mchog go 'phang mchog brnyes nas/ /thub bstan gser gyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa de/ /brtse chen khyod kyi thugs las sprul pa'i phyir/ /tshad med thugs rje'i bka' drin lhag par dran/ /de ltar bstod pa'i rnam dkar dge ba des/ /nam zhig tshe 'de'i snang ba②nub ma thag /'gro mdzon khyod kyi zhing bzang der skyes nas/ /'jam dbyangs bla ma'i zhal mchog mthong bar shog /der yang dges pa chen pos rjes bzung ste/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi0la dbang bzhi'iyichar phab nas/ /yang dag lam bzang bzhingayis grol byas te/ /skya bzhi'iyon 'phang 528
mngon du 'gyur bar shog /'bras bu mchog de ma thob de srid du/ /khyod sku na tshan dpe kun ldan blta ba dang / /de'i gsung legs bshad dga' ston rtag nyan cing / /gang thugs mkhyen brtse bzang pos skyong bar shog /rgyu rgyuda'urang bzhin rnam dag lugs kyi khams/ /thabs rgyud(menus ldan ji yis rin pa yis/ /'bras rgyudayigaser gyi phung por bsgyur pa yi/ /gdams pa'i rgyal pos bdag rgyud gtams par shog /bla chen khyod kyi thugs rje'i gzi 'od dang / /skyabs mchog rin phen gsum gyi byin rlabs dang / /dpal mgon sung ma rnams kyi nus mthu yis/ /bdag gi smon lam 'di rnams 'grub gyur cig /de ltar bstod 'di bstod yul de nyid la/ /dad dang bsod nams lus stobs rab rgyas nas/ /des bstan gzhung lugs ral ba'i khur gyis brjid/ /de'i gsung smra ba'i seng gi gang de'o/ /sgri ha ti dang rab dga' bstan 'dzin dang / /slar yang gyi ha ti yis rim bzhin du/ /dus me zla ba mkha' lag bsdebs pa 'a /khyu mchog dong gi tsan+d+ra mkha' zlar sbyar// //mchana'agrel 0rje btsun bla ma kun dga' bzang po/ ngor me chadagon gsar du 'debs po sa skya'ibla ma ngor chen kunadaga' bzang po zhes pa de yin/je de'ilo rgyus bsdus pa〈〈chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshanal bstod pa〉〉 zhes pa'i rtsom pa po'i ngo sprod la gzigs par gyis / ()tshul khrims/spong pa'i sems pa ste/ tshul 'chal gyi gdung ba sel ba'am rang gi kha na ma tho ba spong pa'i sems pa'o/ /ming gi rnam grangs la sdogkhrims dang / sdom ja// tshangs par spyod pa bcas so/ /①ri 529
dbar / ri rab lhunango zhugazur danas blo/ rang gzhan rgyasmyosas su ma lhung par drang por gnas pa'am gzuyor gnas pa'i se 6ris/ pa/ ②ri bdun mngon pa 4/sa bshad 34'i rirab kyi khor yu ga shu bskor pa'i gser gyiribadun te/ ku khyad 'a dzinadang / rnam 'du de/ rta rna/ lta na sdug seng ldeng can/ gsholamadal 'dzin/gnyan shing 'dzin bcas so/ /dus 'khor gyilugs nas bshad pa'i ri rab kyi khor yug tu bskor pa'i ri bdun rna/ 'od sngon dang /man da ra/ rna dzi ṭa/ nor bu'i 'od/ tra ṇa/ gangs ri/ lda rje'i ri rnams so/ /(3mtsho brgyad/ mngon pa dang dus 'khor gyi lugs 4/nyis la rol ṇ+ṭha/tsho bdun du 4sungs pas/ mtsho brgyad ces pa grangs so so ra 'dren rgyu yod med brtag 0stong phrag phyag tu de snyed spyan sprul/ de yang ljon 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs daphaṭa phyug gis bod kha ba can gyiser/sa can la dgongs nas/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi drung du thugs bskyed nas smon lam btab ste/ba ga bi sa khams 5]su ma rigs drug n+da/ sems can thams cad ba ba la 'god par gar cig khyad par bod kha ba can gyi sems can thams cad bde ba'i lam la 'god par gyur cig bdag gis sems can 'dul dka' ba de rnams thar ba byang chub kyi lam la ma 'khod kyi bar du/ rang ngal zhing dub nas zhi bde'ibasam pa skad cig kyang mi skye bar gyur cig sal te skyes pa na nga'imago 'ad ardza na'idog pa ltar tshal ba bcur 'gas shing / lus po yang pad+ma'i 'dab ma bzhin du durtsa bu stong du 6 bar gyur cig ces brjod nas/ khams gsum rigs drug gi sems can bde ba la bkod/ de nas slar po ta la'i rtse 530
5 nas gzigs pas/ kha ba can pa'i sems can rnams brgya'i cha tsam yang bad ba la 'khod snyam pa mi 'dug nas/ thugs shin tu lug par rgyur/ rang zhi bde'i bsam pa zhig skyes pa'i skad cig nyid la sngonagyi smon lam gyi mthus rang gi mgo tshal pa bcur gas shing / ṭ+wā lus dum bu stong du zhig par gyur/ der sangs rgyas snang ba mthal yas la gsol ba btab pasabyin gyis brlabs te/ dbu tshal pa bcur gas nga 'dizhal bcur gyur pa dang de'ister du ma mi de ba dang bcas pa 'a/la bcu gcig par gyur/ sku lus stong du bye ba 'di phyag stong du gyur cing phyag stong gi mthil du spyan stong du sprul par grags so/ /()mi mjed zhing / 'jig rten gyi khams te/ gusang 4 pad dkar〉〉las / 64phyir 'jig rten gyikhams de rna mi mjed ces gya zhe na/se /sa can de dag 'dod chags la mi mjed pa dang / zhe snar la mi mjed pa dang / gti mug la mi mjed ma dang / nyanamongs pa'i 'ching ba rnams la mi mjed pas de'iphyir/ 'jig rten gyi khams de rna mi mjed ces bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang / ṭa ston rin po ches/zhing 'di la mi mjed ces zer ba rna/ mi mjed rna bzod pa'i ming ste/ nyan mongs nga dug gsum gyis mi 'dzog ring 'dod 6ja bzod la sems sran 6ba pas mi mjed ces gsungs so/ /9nyasdom gsu ma/so thar gyi sdom pa dang / byang sems kyi sdom pa/ sngags kyidzom pa ༵ (dī k+ṣiṃ zlo'i/ radzi (snanakyi sto/byi((da/ ga( shākhu dī ༈ phung spra gh+nā //lha pa bde bar gshegs pa chos skur bzhugs pa'i don/ 6〉'khang pa/mi dka' ba dang / sdang ba'am khros pa'i don/ yitshe 'di'isnang 531
ba/ tshi 'de'i snang shes te/ mi'ilus rten thob pa'i tshe 'dalishespa'o/ /6)dkyil 'khor bzhi/ rdul tshon dang / ras bri4ri/ yid dkyil/ lus dkyil te bzhi/ (medabang bzhi/ bla med kyi dbang la dbang bzhir bshad de/ gsang 'dus rgyud phyi mar/ bum pa'i dbang rna dang po ste/ /gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang yin rna/ /gsum pa shes rab ye shes te/ /bzhi ba de yang bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bum dbang / gas nga dbang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbar / tshig dbang ngam dbang bzhi ba bcas bzhi'o/ /yilam bzang bzhi/ bum dbang gi lan bskyed rim/ gas nga dbang gi lam grol lam/ shes rab dbang gi la ma zabs lam tshig dbang gi lam zab lam ston par〈〈mkha' 'gro mdzod〉〉la sa gsu ngas so/ /〈yisku bzhi/ sangs rgyas kyingo bo nyid sku dang / ye shes chos sku/ longs sku/ sprulasku ste bzhi/ (nyurgyu rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud brjod bya donagyi sgo nas rgyud gsum du dbye ba'i nang gses ste/ nye bar len pa'i rgyu'idabang du byas nas rang bzhin nam = yi rgyud ces bya ste/ sems can nas sa ngas rgyas kyi bar du sems rang bzhin gyi tshul nam mkha' ltar 'gyur ba med par gnas pa'o/ /de yang rang bzhin nam rgyu zhes pa ni/ rkyenagyis gsar du bcos pa'am sgro btags pa lta bu min pa ra sems kyingo bo nyid kyi gshis tshul yin pa'i don gyis rang bzhin zhes bya la/ 53zang 'jug byang chub 6 nyar len yin pa'i cha nas rgyu zhes bya'o/ /de la nang gses kyi dmya ba bcu bzhi yod do/ /kuthabs rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud donagyisgo nas gsum du da4ba'i nang gses /532
lhanacig byed pa'i rgyun gyidabang du byas nas kena'am thabs kyi rgyud ces bya ste/ smin )da nyidabang dang grol byed kyi lam yan lagadang bcas pa la gzhi zhes bya la/ la ma nyid byang chub kyi 'bras bum ngon du byed pa'i lhan cig byed rkyen yin pas thabs zhes bya'o/ /de la nang gses kyid6 ba bco lnga yod do/ /du'abras rgyud/ rnal 'apyor bla med kyi rgyud don gyi sgo nas rgyud gsu ma du dgye ba'inang gses/ don gnyis phun tshogs kyi byang chub kyidabang gu byas nas mi 'phrog pa'am 'bras bu'irgyud ces gya ste/ nyer len gyisnyo de nyid glo bur gyi dri ma thams cad dang bral ba las gnas gar pa'i tshul gyis dag pa gnyis ldan gyi 6ra mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par gzhan don gyi )na du gyur pa'o/ /der mi 'phrog pa zhes pa ni/ re zhig sgrib pa'i bar cha da de ldog pa'am/ rig pa rgyun chad pa'i mtshan nyid kyis dman pa'i mya ngan las 'das par 'jug na gzha4 don gyi rten nyams shing 'dzog pa yin la/ de lta bu ma yin par rgyun gtan tu 'jug pas na mi 'phyog pa zhes bya'o/ /'bras bu zhes pa ni sngags kyi sgor spyad pa spyod pa'i byang chub sem sa dpa' rnam sa kyis shin tu 'dod par bya ba ra thar thug gi gtso bo yin pas na 'bras bu nas bya'o/ /rakā t+nahāpasal pa ba rnyipas pa rgyas oṃ su lta/ ka la pa sogs rig gnas mthar son nas/ /kha ba can 533
'a4ra sangs rgyas gsung rab r+ya chog /ga na bzhugs kyang bsam 'phel mo ra bu ltar/ /nga bdag spangs bha/sa/ myu ra grub ston la 'a su da/ /ca co mi rnga/ra' legs bshad ston pa'i gsu nga / /cha shas nyes nyu nga0dri mas dben 95'i sku/ /ja sogs sred pas mi rdzi dag pa'i thugs/ /nya ba'i zla ltar dri med de la 'dud/ /ta thā ga ta'i.agras kyi thu bo ste/ /tha mal cod pa ring du rab spangs nas/ /da lta blo gsal bung ba 'dus pa la/ /na rga sel mdzad bdud ji ston la 'dud/ /pa sangs ltar gsal blo gros ldan rnams la/ /pha rol phyin sogs zab mo mdo sde dang / /ba ma cho ka lta bur 'dod 'jo'i 'dul ba dang / /ma mo0mngon pa'i tshig don ston la 'dud/ /tsa ra kazhu)sos/sa mu stegs gzhung lus/sa rnams/ /tsha zer rgyal pos mun pa ltar 'joms ming / /dza ya sras bcas stong nyid seng ṅga/'i spras/ /wa ltar log smra skrag mdzad de la 'dud/ /zhwa bzang lta bur mkhas pa'i thod du mdzes/ /za ma tog ltar yon tan rin chen gnas/ /'a 'ur snyan ltar dam chos sgra dbyangs ldan/ /ya mtshan kun gyi 'byung gnas de la 'dud/ /ṇ+ṭha rtse lta bur rno ba'i rigs pa yis/ /la la dag tu log rtog glang po'i lus/ /sha rus bcas pa ma lus bshig nas kyang / /sa steng 'gran zla bral ba de la 'dud/ /ha ha bzhad pa'i bde nyams ldan pa'i thugs/ /tsā li kra li'i sngags kyi rang bzhin gsung / /zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi sku brnyes nas/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba rjes su 'dzin la 'dud/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel la bstod pa bod kyi spru la su ma cu dang 534
spel ba 'di ni bya bral ba bsod nams seng gis sbyar ba'o// //shu lha//mchan 'grel ()nyas ltung / sdom khrims nyams pa'i nyes pa/ ()ta thā ga ta/de bzhinagashegs pa/ ①ma mo/ spyir ma mo ni phyi mo dang / rtsa ba/gzhi ma bcas don du ma la 'jug mod/ 'dir 22ka zhes pa'i chosmngon pa la 'jug go/ /①tsa ra na mad dpyad/kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel la bstod pa/na mo rnyarmā swa mi bud snya war snya ye/ dpal ldan lha dbang klu rgyal dpag bsam shing / /rta bdun ri dwags rgyal po yid bzhin nor/ /glang po bsil zer can 'dra'i bla ma la/ /rjes bsngags ldeb sbyor phreng bas bstod par bgyi/ /dge tshogs shan po'i spo la brtan bzhugs/ /blo gros spyan stong ldan pa'i gzi ldan/ /blo gsal nya dbang0tshogs kyis nyar bsten/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel la phyag 'tshal/ /mtha' gnyis ①gnas bsal dbu ma'i rgya mtshor/ /yang dag rigs pa'i gnangs mas0bajid cing / /stong nyid smra ba'i phaṭa sgra cher sgrogs/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel la phyag 'tshal/ /rnam mang thos pa'i rtsa ba brtan cing / /bsam byung rigs pa'i①yal gas nyer mdzes/ /zab don bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu stong ldan/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel la phyag 'tshal/ /ma lus gsung rab mkhyen pa'i nam mkhar/ /skyon bral sdom gsum dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs/ /byams dang snying rje'i 'od zer stong 535
'phro/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel la phyag 'tshal/ /legs bshad 'chad pa'i lus stobs cher rgyas/ /rigs la ma rtsod pa'i mche sder rno zhing / /spel legs rtsom pa'i ral ba'i khur ldan/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel la phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dbang gi rgyal po0/ /bshad sgrub rgyal mtshan rtse mor mchod nas/ /gdul bya'i dgos 'dod 'phel ba'i mthu ldan/ /kun ma khyen sangs rgyas 'phel la phyag 'tshal/ /rnam dkar 'dul ba'i drwa bas nyer mdzes/ /rgya chen mngon pa'i yan lag bdun ldan/ /zab mo mdo sde'i khur gyis brjid pa'i/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel la phyag 'tshal/ /dngos stobs rigs pa'i①dkyil 'khor las byung / /sgrub dang sun 'byin0'od dkar drwa bas/ /thub bstan kun da'i phreng ba rgyas mdzad/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel la phyag 'tshal/ /bsngags 'os gang de'i yon tan cha tsam/ /rjes bsngags sdeb sbyor phreng bas spel ba'i/ /bsngags 'os dge des kun mkhyen bla ma/ /'gro ba'i gtsug na bsngags par shog cig /thub bstan pad mo'i tshal rab rgyas shing / /'gro la lam bzang snang ba'i ched du/ /'dren mchog nyin byed sku tshe brtan cing / /phrin la sa phyogs bcur rgyas par shog cig /tshul 'di bsod nams seng ge'i mgur nas/ /phyung ste skyed tshal mdzes pa'i blo gsal/ /'dus pa'i tshogs la skyes su 'bul gyi/ /bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i rdza rnga sgrogs shig/ //shu lhe//mchan 'grel ①nye dbang / lha'idabang po brgya byin gyi 'khor du gtogs pa'i sulcu rtsa gsum du grags pa'i lha ste/ rnar lha brgyad/ tha skar gyi bu 536
gnyis/ drag po bcu gcig nyi 'angabacu gnyis zhes bgrang pa 'tshangdbang tha r+ya gtogs pa'i ga9na so gnyis ni nye dbang zhes grags so/ /()mtha' sanyis / rtag mthal dang chad mtha' gnyis/②ga dengs 1 6'i rgyal ngo 'i ma gor skyes pa 'i rgyan lta bu la gderas ka zhes bya/ ()bas rna byung rigs pa / jos pa 'i don lasems shing dngu da nas tshad mas the tshom gyi sgro 'dogs chod cing nges pa rnyed pa'i rigs lam/ khu〉dbang gi rgyal po/ yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po ste danas 'dod thams cad 'byung ba'i nor bu/ ()dngos stobs rigs pa/ rang gi rten dngos po'i stobs shugs kyi rtags yang dag la brten nas gzhal bya gsar ngu rtogs pa'i rigs lam/ ()sgrub dang sun 'byin/ ñtsha ma tshan yang dag la brten nas bsgrub bya cib pa dar dgazha bya 'asku/gu pa/
gtsang smyon hi ru ka/ rubasga pa'i rgyan can/gtsang spyon he ru ka rus pa'i rgyan can ni/ 'khrungs yul gtsang myang stod stag tshal du myang ral ba can dang nyi ma 'od zer sogs kyi rgyud pa yab sngags 'chang sangs rgyas dpal ldan dang / yum sangs rgyas 'dren gnyis kyi sras su rab byung brgyad pa'i ani ra zhes pa'i chu sprel(spyi lo 1452)lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bdun pa sa stag (spyi lo 1458) lor mkhan chen kun dga' sangs lhos kyi drung du rab tu byung ste mtshan sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ de nas bzung dgung lo bcu bdun gyi bar rang yu95 du slob gnyer mdzad/ dgung lo bco brgyad par tsa rir byon te rje btsun sha ha rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas seng ge dang mjal/ ri chos skor gsum/thar gru skor gsum/ nā ro chos drug phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan/ lhan gcig skyes sbyor/ do ha ṭā ra gsum dang mdzod drug ro snyoms sogs bka' brgyud kyi chos skor phal mo che'i lung gsan/ rje btsun ma lhan cig skyes ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur te gsang mtshan mi skyod rdo rje zhes btags/ de nas dpal 'khor chos sder byon nas g.yu lung ba yon tan rgya mtsho'i drung nas chos mang po gsan cing / de gzhan slob dpon kun dga' nya ma dang paṇa chen don grub grags pa sogs bsten nas gsang sngags kyi dbang dang rgyud kyi bshad pa bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa sogs mang po gsan/ gangs 538
ste se cang / tsa ri/ la phyi chung bar/ bal yul sogs yul nges med sabyon/ cha lugs kyang skabs 'ga' zhig tu sku gcer bu la mi'i g.yang ga khrag can gsol/ rgyu rlon gyis ga sha dang gdu bu byas/ mi thod rlon par klad pa dang rgyu ma sogs 6bas mas dkrugs te gsol/ phal cher he ru dzo'i cha byad rus rgyan dang thod pa/ rkang gling / kha ṭī rnams 'char zhir dur khrod dang grong gseb nges med du rgyan nas tha mal gyi blor mi chud pa'i tho co'i spyod pa sna tshogs mdzad pas gtsang snyon zhes grags/ mdzad pa ni/bal yu la gyi 'pha gas pa shing kun gyi zhig gso dang / grub gnas mang por bska/'a brgyud kyi sgrub lde btsugs/ snyan brgyud grags bam du bkod pa po ṇ+ḍi bcu gsum la zhu dag gtsang ma dang / rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar ljags rtsom mdzad/ nyams mgur phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs shing par du brkos/grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs kyang las 'bras la ji 'jog che bas dge sdig chung ngu tsam yang khyad du mi gsod/ slob ma grangs kyis mi chod pa 'dus/ yongs grags su thugs sras zhe dgu /thun mongs ma yin pa'i thugs sras brgyad/ bla chen bla chung drug cu/ rtogs ldan nyer brgyad/ ston sgom nyi shu/ grub chen bco brgyad sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon/mthar dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa drug pa rab byung dgu ba'i me yos(spyi lo1507)lor ras chung phug tu sku gshegs so//539
mi la ras pas chung dus rtsag mthong tshul①/mi la ras pa lo bdun tsam slebs pa'i tshe/ yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan de bsnyung gas②drag po rang zhig gis zin nas/ sman pa dang mo ma0rnams kyis kyang mi 'tsho bar lung bstan cing bor/ gnyan nye 'brel rnams kyis kyang mi 'tsho bar shes/ khong rang yang mi 'tsho bar lo/ thag chod nas/ a khu dang a ne la sogs gnyen nya ring grogs dga' 44be+es yul mi khyim mtshes drag pag/ kun bsags te/ bu smad nor dang bcas pa bcol gdams byas nas/ mthar pha shul bus 'dzin du 'jug pa'i kha cher/sa yi 1 rgyas par byas te/ kun gyis thos par bsgrags/ don bsdu la ngag tu nga da lan gyi nad 'dis mi gtong ba 'dug cing / des bha/ nga'i bu 'di yang da lta chung 'dug pas/ a khu dang a nes gtso byas cipa'i gnyen bshes kun la bcol gdams bya rgyu la/ nga'i phu na nor gnag rta lug gsum/ mda' na 'or ma gru gsum gyis gtso byas pa'i zhing grang mig tu mi tshud pa 'ga'/ khang pa'i 'og na phyugs ba ra bong gsum/ steng khang na rig gser dngul zangs lcags g.yu dang gos dar 'bru'i bang mdzod la sogs te/ mdor na mi nor gzhan la smon mi dgos pa yod pas/ 'di rnams kyi steng nas cha shas shig nga rang gi rjes su thongs/ 2 lhag rnams khyed 'dir tshogs kun la nga rang gi bu 'dis khyim so ma rin gyi bar la bcol lo/ /khyad par du a khu dang a ne gnyis la bcol lo/ /bu 'dis khyim si pher ba dang /540
mdzes se dang chung gnyen bsgrigs yod pas/ yo rang mna' mar bsu nor rnams lhag lus med par phog la/ pha shul bus 'dzin tu chug cig de bar la nga'i bu smad gsum gyi skyod sdug khyed a khu dang a rnas gtso byas pa'i gnyen tshan kun shes so/ /sdug tu ma 'jug cig nga shi dur khung nas blta'o zhes gsungs nas thongs so//ṭa nas yab kyi gshegs rdzongs0rnams byas/ de lhag gi rnar rnams kun kha 'chams par/ myang tsha dkar rgyan rang tshags byed du chug kha 'dzin dgos pa kun gyis zur nas 'u legs gyis zer ba la/ a khu dang a ne gnyis na re/ mi nye byas rung drung po nya/ khong ma smad①red kyis sdug tu mi 'jug nor rnams kha chems bzhin nged kyis tshags byed zer nas/nga'i zhang po dang mdzes se'i pha mingazhwagi lo rgyus byas rung ma nyan par pho nor rnams a khus byas/ mo nor rnams a nes byas/ gzhan rnams phyed mar bgos te/ khyed ma smad rnams gso res byed zer nas/ jed ma bu gsum la nor dbang rgyu ma byung ba'i khar/ dbyar zhing las byed dus a khu'i g.yog dgun bal las byed dus a rna'i g.yog lto khyi'i lto la las bong bu'i las/ gos 6la phrag thag chad pa la dres ma'i skye rags bcings pa rgyan nas/ las dal med byed dgos byung bas yan lag rnams ser gar song / lto gos ngan pa'i stobs kyis kha mdog kyang skya la sha rid pa/ skra dang po gser g.yu'i ral pa nyil le bdul/ phyis skya bo seng seng shig sro'i ral pa nyil le ba byung bas/ mthong ba dang thos pa'i mi sems chung kun mchi ma 'chor ba dang / a khu dang a ne la lkog lab dir re ba byung rung 541
'dzem med byas/ jed ma smad la sdug po rang btang bas/ a mas a nai la khyung tsha dpal 'gran du mi 'dug bdud mo stag 'gran du 'dug byas pas/ a rna la bdud mo stag 'gran du ming chags/ de dus 'jig rten pa'i gtam dpe la/ mi bdag bdag tu re/ bdag po sgo khyir 'don zer ba de nged ma smad la byung / sngar yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan bzhugs pa'i tshe/ mi drag zhan kun nged kyi zhal 'dzum dkar nag lta ba yin rte/phyis nor yod rgyal po'i tshul du song nas/ a khu dang a ne'i zhal 'dzum dkar nas/ lta ba byung / a ma la yang mi rnams kyis lkog lab tu khyo phyug chung ma grung / bal 'jam snam bu legs zer ba de bden par 'dug ste/mi go chod re med tsa na dpe 'di dang 'dra/ dang po myang tsha dkar rgyan khyo bzang gis mgo 'don dus/ mo blo khog che la grung / lag bcud che zer ba yod de/ da grung zhan gyi shan phyed nas gda'o zer/ sdug res byung na lab res kyi dpe der/ rang la sa zhan pa kun gyis rgyab nas 'phya bzlobyung / nga la mdzes se'i pha mas gos lham so ma re byin nas/ mi nor du ma so nga na/ nor mi rtag rtswa kha'i zil ba bya ba yin pas rnar med snyam pa mi dgos/ dang po yab mes rnams la'ang rnar ting sor byung ba yin/khyed rang tsho la'ang nor yod pa'i dus yong zer nas sems gso yang ya ra btang /de nas nga lo bco lnga tsam lon pa'i tshe/ a ma la pha mas byin pa'i zhing skal bre pe stan chung bya ba ming mi snyan rung ston thog gzhun po 'ong ba zhig yod pa de/ zhung pos so nam byas pa'i nas skye 'phel du ci 'gro byas 542
nas/ phag tu gsog gin yod pa yang mang rab tu song ba la sha mang po nyos/ nas dkar mo mang po la phye byas/ nag po mang po chang du bco dzosha pas myang tsha dkar rgyan ma smad rnar slong byed pa yin pa 'dug zer ba byung /de nas red rang gi khang pa ka bzhi gdung brgyad ma der pa dan mang po g.yar nas bting ste/ a khu dang a nes gtso byas pa'i gnyen nye 'khor/grogs dga' bshes yul mi khyim mtshes rnams dang / khyad par yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan sku gshegs khar zhal chems kyi yi ge rgyus yod pa rnams bos te/ a khu dang a rna la sha khog 'dzugs/ gzhan gzug thob pa la gzuka 4 thob pa la kyu/ chang dkar yol gyi g.yang tshe dang bcas pa'i ston po bzang po drangs nas/ a ma gral gyi dbus su langs te/ 'o la gas so/ bu skyes pa la ming / chang drangs pa la gtam bya bar gda' bas/ nga yang gtam tshig gsum pa zhig gtong ba lags pas/ yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan sku thim kur zhal chems gsungs pa rgyus yod kyi mi bgres pa a khudang a nas gtso mdzad/ 'dir bzhugs kyi gral pa rnams snyan gsan par zhu zhes brjod nas/ zhang pos yab kyi yi gi bkrags pa'i mthar a ma'i yi gi 'di'i don gsung ngag dang bcas pa/ 'dir bzhugs kyi bgres pa kun gyi thugs la gsal bas rgyas par zhu mi dgos par gda'/ don dril ba la/ sngar phan a khu dang a ne gnyis kyis jed ma smad gsum la mgo 'don yang dag mardzad pa thugs la btags/ da nga rang gi bu dang /mdzes se gnyis nas khyim so zin par 'dug pas/ nged rang gi nor bcol rnams sprod pa dang / mdzes se yang mna' mar bsus nas yab kyi zhal 543
chems bzhin pha shul bus 'dzin du 'jug par zhu byas pas/ a khu dang a rna gnyis ci la mi 'cham rung lto la 'cham pa dang / nga bu gcig por song ba dang / a khu la bu mang po yod pa'i stabs kyis/ a rna dang a khu gnyis gcig tu dril nas khyed kyi nor ram de gang na yod pa yin/ dang po mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan kho rang khams bzang ring la khang zhing gser g.yu mdzo rta gnag lug rnams nged kyis g.yar btang ba/ kho rang 'chi khar nor bdag po la sprad pa yin/ khyed rang dbang ba'i nor gser se gcigayogam/nas phul gang ngam/ mar nyag gcig gam/ gos dar rkyang sna gcig dud 'gro tshe 'dzugs gcig kyang mig gis ma mthong ba la da 'di 'dra zer ba/khyed kyi kha chems kyi yi ge sus bris/ sdug smad tsho ltogs grir ma bsad par gsos pa nged rab yin/ lar②mi ngan la dbang bskur na chu la bre 'jal byed bya ba de 'di 'dra la zer ba yin zer/ snam bu'i stan la har langs byas/ se gol gtogs/ thu ba sprugs/ rkang pa brdabs nas nan tar ma song na khang pa yang nged dbang bas/ ma smad tsho phyir songs zer zhing a mar thal lcag gis brdungs/ jed ming sring gnyis phu rung gi lcag gisbrdungs/de'i tshe a ma ni/ yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan/ nged ma smad milas skos la gzigs dang / nga shi dur khung nas blta'o gsungs pa de da gzigs pa'i dus la bab gda' 'o zer/ ngu zhing 'gyel nas khri log log byed cing 'dug jed ming sring gnyis kyis ni ra mda'ayibu ba min pa ma byung / a zhang gis ni a khu la bu mang po yod pas rgol ma nus/ gzhan 544
yul mi red rang khudakar ba rnams rna ma sma da tsho'i snying rje ba la zer mi ngu ba mi 'dug gzhan rnams kyang shugs ring nar nar 'dug sa khu dang a ne ni jed la nor dgos zer/ nor khyed rang la 'dug pa/ yul mi khyim mtshes la sha chang phangs med bshigs nas sto ri bsham rgyu 'dug pa/ khyed kyi nor ram de nged la med/ yod na'ang mi gtong bas ma smad tsho mang na dmag drongs/ nyung na mthu thongs zer zhing thon song /de'i phyi bzhin khong la dkar mi rnams kyang thon song / a ma rna de nas kyang ngu thag ma chod par 'dug pa la/ zhang po dang mdzes se'i pha ming sogs jed rang gi dkar mi kun a ma'i sems gso phyir bsdad nas chang lhag rnams 'thung zhing / a ma la da ma ngu ngus pas mi phan/ de ring 'dir ston gral du tshogs pa kun la nor slong re gyis/ nged 'di na yod pa kun gyis kyang 'u drag re ster/ a khu dang a ne gnyis kyis kyang ci drag re ster yong zer ba la/ a zhang na re/ de ka gyis la bu 'di yon tan zhig slob tu thongs/ khyed rang ma smad nga'i sar sdod la zhing gi so nam gyis/ci phan byed pa las 'os med/ gang na'ang a khu dang a ne la ngo mi tsha ba zhig byad dgos zer ba la a ma na re/ rang gi nor la dbang rgyu ma byung ba'i slong byas pa'i rnar gyis ṭa tsha mi sos/ a khu dang a nes jed rang gi nor micha gcig sprad rung ster dgos med/ bu 'di yon tan zhig slob tu cis kyang gtong / jed ma smad a khu dang a nas gsha' ma rang ma bcol ba'i ting la/ rnga gdang rgyug dang dud pa lang rgyug byas nas/ khong gnyis gyi mngon blo 'char ba yin/ zhing gi so nam yang 'di ka nas byed zer 545
nas/ rtsa'i mi thod gad kha bya ba na sngags ting ma ba'i slob dpon klu brgyad mkhan grong chog la shin tu brin pa zhig yod pa der nga klog slob tu btang /de dus gnyen rnam sa tris kyang nor slong sna re sna gnyis byin 'dug khyad par mdzes se'i pha mas rgyags chu sdor me shing yan bskur nas/ nga klog slob sar mdzes se mo rang sems gso la yang yang btang byung / a zhang gis a ma dang sring mo mi las dang sprang du mi 'gro ba'i dus kyi lto byin/ a ma sprang du a zhang gis ma bcug par mi'i las nyin 'khal nyin thags byed cing / jed ming sring la ci phan dang nor ci gsog byas/ sring mos ci rtsogs kyis mi g.yog dang / rnga gdang rgyug dud pa lang rgyug byas nas lto gos ci rnyed byas rung / lto skya la gos 6la ba yid pham pa las skyed po rang ma snyong gsungs pas/ de'i che chos nyan du 4 ra chad bung sa skyo 4/ sa z+ya dang nges 'byung yigi sko nas mchi ma 'dor zhing dar ci ge] ku na kha rog par 'dug 7///sdug bsngal gyi bden pa(yiphul phyin thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i mdzad pa ste gnyis pa'o//mchan 'grel ()〈〈mi la ras pa chung dus sdug mthong tshul〉〉zhes pa'i rtsom 'ad rna 〈〈rnal 'byoragyi dbang phyug rje btsun mi la ras pa'i rnam mgur〉las bshus shing kha yig sgrig mazanagyis sbyar ba yin/ 〈〈je btsun mi la ras pa'irnam mgur〉rna rab byung brgyad paris sprel(spyi lo 1488)lor gtsang snyon ) ru ka rus pa'irgyan can gyis mdzad pa yin la/brjod bya rna rje btsun mi la ras pa'i tshe gang bo'i bsnganas 'os pa'i 546
mdzad chen bcu gnyis rnam par thar ba'i tshul zab cing rgya che ba rnams rim gyis bltan te/ thog mar yab mes brgyud pa'i 'byung khungs dang bcas te sku bltams pa'i mdzad pa dang / gnyis pa nya ba dgra ru gyur )sdug bsnga la bden pa thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i mdzad pa/ gsum par mthu bsgrubs nas dgra b+thā rnams tshar bcad parimadzad pa ste thun mong 'jig rten nga 'i mdzad pa gsum dang / mtshan ldanagyi bla ma btsal ba'i mdzad pa dang / dka' spyad kyis sgrib pa sbyangs pa'imdzad pa/ smin grol gyi gdams pa thob pa'i mdzad pa/ nyamsrtogs kyi myu gu 'khrungs pa'i mdzad pa/ chig brgyud kyi gdams ngag thob ste bla ma'i drung nas byon pa 'i mdzad pa/ slar yang sgrub la yi dam bcas pa'i mdzad pa/ tshe gcig tu ri la bsgoms pa'imadzad pa/ sgrub 'bras sngon ngu gyur te 'gro don spel ba'i mdzad pa/gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdus nga/'irna dzad pa ste zhi ba myang 'das kyi mdzad pa dgu bcas mdzad chen bcu gnyis bltan pa'o/ /()snyung ba'i/ (sna gu 5ri zug rngu byung ba'i nad gzhi/ 0mo ma/ mo 'debs mkhan/ yo pa yang zer/ ⑦drag pa/ 'dir mi drag pa ste/ chab srid dang dpal 'byor gyiphyogs la dbang nges can ldan pa'imi sna/()gshegs rdzongs/ gshin po'iche4 du yar dkon mchog la mchod pa/ bar dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur/ mar ngan slong la sbyin gto nga sogs rnam dkar dge sgrub gang rung byed pa'i 'das mchod/ 〈 ma smad/ phul du byung ba'am ma dang ñtsā mo gnyis/ 'dir ma bu gnyis la go danas/ (3pha ming / pha dang mir po ste/ pha rgan dang pha ma gcig pa'i spun che ba/ ()nyil le ba/ bur du sil bur 'phyar 547
ba'am babs pa ()'phya ba/ gzhan la smod pa'am skyonasbyor ba/〈yise gcig se ba gcig ste/ gser zho gang brgya cha la bgos pa'i cha gcig gi sngad tshad/ ()lar/ gzhi'am rtsa ba dang spyir zhes pa'idon gnyis la 'jug ⑨ra mda'/ dpung rogs dang / zla bo/rjes 'ded/ rjes 'brang bcas don du ma la 'jug 'dir rjes su 'brangs paradon/ 6)skyo shas/ sems sdug drag po byung ba'am zhen pa gting nas log pa4don/ (nyanges 'byung / 'khor ba'i gnas btson ra dang 'dra bar jes pa dang de las thar bar 'ardod pa'i sems/ (yisdug bsngal gyi bden pa/ bden pa bzhi'i nang gses/rang rgyu las nyon gyi bskyed pa'inyer len gyi phung po ma dag pa'i snod bcud zag bcas 'bras gyur gyi dngos po thams cad de/ de dag rna sdug bsngal gyi phung po nad lta bu shes par bya ba yin pa 'phags pa'igzigs ngor mi bslu bar snang bas sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya'o/ /548
rgyal ba darga 'dun rgya mtsho/rje thams cad ma khyen r+p+pa da she /'dun rgya mtsho rna/ rab byung brgyad pa'i shing lug (spyi lo 1475) lor gtsang rta nag tu 5/sang sngags gsar rnying ris med kyi bstan pa'i bdag po rdo je 'chang kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang ma gcig kun dga' dpal mo'i sras su 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu gcig pa me rta (spyi lo1486) lor bkra shis ci tsud por phebs/ paṇa chen lung rigs rgya ca tsho las rab tu byung / mtshan dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal zhes gsol/ bcu dgu ba shing pho stag gi lor 'bras spungs su phebs/dgung lo nyi shu ba shing yos (spyi lo1495) lor gnas rnying kun dga' bde legs las bsnyen par rdzogs / 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen dang mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho sogs bla mar bsten nas mdo sngags kyi gdams pa yongs su rdzogs pa gsan/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis bstan pa'i rgyal ga /cha na bla ru bsgrengs/ rab byung dgu ba'i sa sprul (spyi lo 1509) lor chos 'khor rgyal me tog thang gi chos grwa btab/ sa ltag (spyi lo1518) lor smon lam gyi tshogs dbu mdzad/ 'di lo nas se 'bras dge gsum slar yang sngar rgyun ltar smon lam chen spo tshugs/ ri gdong mi dbang bkra shis grags pas 'bras spungs lda khang sdon mo rje 'di la phul rjes ming dga' ldan pho brang du bsgyur/ snga phyir bkras lhun dang /549
'bras spungs/ se ra so so'i mkhan po mdzad/ bka' rtsom〈〈mtshan sdajid drang jes rnam dbye〉〉〈〈dbu ma'i lta khrid〉〉〈〈bstod tshogs〉〉sogs ngo ti lnga tsam bzhusas shing / rgya gar gyi chu spro gaṅgā'i tshun chad snyan ngag la rna bas nga ra grags / dgung lo re brgyad pa chu stag (1542) lor zhi bar gshegs/ phe 'di pa ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng gnyis pa yin no//khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po rtsong kha pa chen po'i yon tan cha/dor bsdus par bsngags pa lha'i shra bo che'i sgra dbyangs/na mo 9ri ñtsha gho khri ya/ ji btsun bla ma dam pa de'i zhabs la gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo/ /blo bzang dri med 'dren byed stong gis rgya chen shes bya'i gzugs kun rnam gsal 'chi med sgeg mo'i me long bzhin/ /rtsam dkar grags pa'i rnga dbyangs 'bum phrag phyogs kyi bu mo'i 'grim/ nga ra rdzam bsgra gas dbyar dus gabyar skyes rnga sgra bzhin/ /grong 'joms dbang pozlomga' lnga ba rnang gtsugu/ ma/ zla ba mgrin sngo na carna/②so gas ral ba'i thod la gtsug rgyan bzhin/ /ngal gso nyer mdzad zhabs sen 'char kha'i 'od 'phreng dag gis gtsug pyon rab mdzes bdag blo pad+mo'i dpal gyur cig /blo chen ldan gang bya bas bskal pa brgyar/ /snyan ngag chu klong stong gis drangs gyur kyang / /zad med yon tan yid bzhin mtsho chetsha po/ /bdas/ blo'i skra rtses dpag par ji ltar nus/ /de ñtsa na yang dad pa'i dri bzhon 550
gyis/ /bdag blo'i ljon shing rnam par bskyod pa las/ /ngo mtshar dri gsung (bsung)zlogayo ba'i me tog phreng / /mgrin par bzung ste dga' ba'i gar byed do/ /ma lus rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse'i gter/ /sa gsum skye rgu yongs kyi gtsug rgyan du/ /gcig tu bsdus nas gzus/sa can bzhin gyur pa/ /'jam dpal snying pos rtag tu skyong gyur cig /cha shas yongs rdzogs khyed sku'i ri yong can0/ /chos dbyings kun gsal mdzes ma'i lang tsho las/ /gsal bar shar tshe skal bzang ku cad tshogs/ /mtshes sdug ze'u 'bru'i so phreng bzhad pa dang / /mnyam du thub bstan nor 'dzin bu mo'i lus/ /stod g.yogs gos dkar g.yo ba'i mdzes sdug 'dzin/ /rang gzhan grub mtha'i sa chen ma lus pa/ /blo gros rnam pa gcig gis rab 'gongs te/ /kun mkhyen thub pa'i ①rgyal sa 'dzin mkhas pa/ gang khyod rgyal ba kun gyi gdung 'tshob lags/ /mang thos lung rigs smra ba'i khya mchog①ces/ /chen por mngon rlom bye ba phrag brgya yi/ /spobs pa'i myos bumadum lusadral mdzad pa/ /'jigs med gdong lnga'i dbang po khyod nyid lags/ /bslab gsum nor bu'i 'od zang g.yo ba can/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa kun gyi cod pan la/ /zhabs sen gsal bar 'god pa'i rol rtsed mkhan/ /kun mkhyen thub pa chen po khyod nyid lags/ /dge legs ku mud zum par mi byed cing / /mdo sngags gzhung lugs pad tshal stong 'byed pa'i/ /lung rigs 'od kyis sa gsum snang byed pa/ /kun mkhyen nyin mo'i dbang phyug khyod shar tshe/ /smya ba'i nya ma gzhan dag khyod drung na/ /dman pa'i rgyu skar phreng ba lta 551
bur spyod/ /snyan grags ma la ya yi dri bzhon gyis/ /phyogs kyi bu mo'i dri 'dzin sem pa'i dpal/ /legs bshad ga pur 'bul ba'i dpag bsam khyod/ /ston mongs tsha ba'i srog len gshin rje lags/ /thabs shes gshog rlabs g.yo ba'i rlung shugs kyis/ /mtha' gnyis g.yang sar nam yong mi lhung zhing / /bdag lta'i klu dbang tshogs kyi srog 'phrog pa/ /mkhas mchog gnyis skyes kun gyi dbang po lags/ /skye rga na 'chi'i rba rlabs stong 'khrug pa'i/ /mi bzad 'khor ba chu srin 'byung gnas0las/ /'gro kun thabs mkhas gru yis sgrol mkhas pa/ /ma/bas mchog ded dpon kun gyi dam pa lags/ /khyod kyi thugs rje'i pho nya bye ba yis/ /'gro 'di thar ba'i grong du khrid gyur te/ /'khor ba'i gnas 'di nges par stongs 'gyur zhes/ /rab dgyes rgyal rnams zhi ba'i dbyings su zhugs/ /rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse'i chu klung 'bum/ /nyin bzhin sdud byed rol mtsho'i dbang po ste/ /legs bshad bdud ji'i gru char stong 'bebs pa'i/ /sngon med dbyar skyes chu 'dzin dbang po lags/ /mdzes sdug 'od 'bar rab tu bajid pa yi/ /khyod kyi mdzes sku 'chi med ri 'o⑨'dra/ /mtshan dpe'i rgyan phreng g.yo ba'i mdzes sdug la/ /ri dbang mchog gis 'gran par nus ma lags/ /snyan cing yid 'bab chos kun sgrog pa'i gsung / /yan lag drug cu'i dril chen 'khrol ba na/ /mes po'i dbyangasayikyis 'gran par ma bzod nas/ /spru bcad bsam gtan ngang du zhugs sam snyam/ /rab yangs khyod kyi mkhyen pa'i pha mtha' la/ /'gran 'dod nam mkha' 'di yis 'ongs sam snyam/ /'on te lha yi lam yangs skyes slad 553
du/ /khyod kyi ma khyen pa bsam bzhin ba sna /da dam ci/ /khyod kyi mkhyen pa rab yangs chu har bzhin/ /klung brgyas drangs kyang cung zad bri ba med/ /'gro nga ji(radod dgu sbyin pa'i dpag bsam ste/ /sgrib mun kun sel sngon med snang byed lags/ /gdul bya'i gling kun 3sa par 'bab pa yi/ /khyod kyi 'phrin las nyi ma'i 'od dang 'dra/ /'char nub bral zhing sprin gyis mi sgrib pas/ /nyi zla'ang de yi dpe ru 'os ma lags/ /gzhan gyi blo yi yul du'ang shong min pa'i/ /yon tan phung po'i khur chen mtha' yas pa/ /'degs byed rnar 'dzine bu mo mdzes sdug ma/ /da dung ngal ba med pa me byari ma tshar/ /phyogs bcu'i phun tshogs rma lus gros byas nas/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po khyod la 'dus pa na/ /mi bzad skyon kun 'khor ba 'dir lus pas/ /'gro 'di rta// tu sdug bsngal gyur min nam/ /khyod kyi yon tan yid bzhin mtsho chen por/ /ring nas zhugs pa'i dad pa'i gnyis 'thung 'di/ /nga /bas grub gzhan 9 yo na tan rdzing bu la/ /dga' bar 'dzin pa'i blo de dor bar gyur/ /ming tsam lhag mar gyur pa'i bstan pa 'di/ / rdzogs ldan4)bzhin du nyid kyis mdzad pa na/ /e ma snyigs dus rgyal ba gnyis pa zhes/ /phyogs kyi bu mos srid rtse'i bar du bsgrags/ /phyong/ṭa kyi bdas/ tra kun gyi ral ba la/ /zhabs rdul nor bus mdzes pa'i dang la ster ba/ /sngon med rgyal ba'i nyi ma gcig gis 49ri / /rgyal ba'i nya ma ma lus zil gyis gnon/ /de phyir lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'di/ /mgong / khyo da lhag pa ra bsngags pa'i bzlas1 ba jo — la/ /ngal ba med pa'i dka' thupa kyur blangs pas/ /bya ba tra/zhan la 'jug pa'i go 553
skabs phrogs/ /skal bzang kun da'i gnyen gcig ri bong can/ /thub bstan pad tshal rgyas mdzad nyin mo'i mgon/ /'dod dgu'i dngos grub sbyin mdzad dpag bsam shing / /bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal poyikhyod la 'dud/ /legs bshad bye bas khongs kyang khengs dang bral/ /gzhan don khur gyis ngal kyang ngal ba med/ /ring nas 'khor ba spangs kyang 'khor bar spyod/ /ngo mtshar kun gyi gter chen e ma mtshar/ /pad tshal dbus na pad+ma dkar po dang / /rgyu skar dbus na rgyu skar bdag poyibzhin/ /rgyal sras dbus na rgyal ba'i dbang po khyod/ /'jigs bral 'jigs med chos 'khor bskor la 'dud/ /legs bshad nor 'dzin smeg mo'i khyon kun la/ /lung rigs dpung gis 'dod dgur dbang sgyur zhing / /lus med bdag po'iyigayul ngo pham mdzad pa/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po khyod la 'dud/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug⑩rgyal sras/ kun gyi yab/ /dag dang ma dag 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs/ /sku gsu malhun grub rgyal ba kun gyi gtso/ /khyab bdag⑥rdo rje 'chang dbang khyod la 'dud/ /snying gi me long dbus su khyod kyi sku/ /byed po'i bar gyis gsal bar bris pa bzhin/ /bkod nas rtag tu gus pas mchod pa'i mthus/ /'bral med rjes su 'dzin par byin gyis rlobs/ /de yi mthu las rgyal ba'i dam chos kun/ /khyod zhal pad+mo'i sgo las legs 'ongs pa/ /snying gi bum par rtse gcig bsten pa las/ /nyon mongs nad kun 'joms par byin gyis rlobs/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /rang nyid gces par 'dzin pa'i blo sgangs nas/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don kun 554
dzub pa la/ /rgyal ba khyod dang mtshungs par phyin kyis rlebs/ /sems kyi gnyis 'thung dad pa'i lcags kyu yi/ /dbang du gyur nas khyod zhabs rtag mchod cing / /myur du rdo rje 'chang dbang thob gyur nas/ /'gro kun thar bar 'khrid par byin gyis rlobs/ /de ltar bstod pa'i dge ba dpag med dang / /gzhan yang dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba rnams/ /mgon po khyod kyis rjes su 'dzin pa dang / /khyod kyi lugs bzang rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces rgyal ba thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po blo bzang grags pa 'i dpal la/ gzhan las khyad par du 'phags par bsngags pa/ lha'i rnga bo che'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni/rje nyid la skyes tsam nyid nas dad pa mchog tu thob pa'i kha ba ri ba'i snya na ngag mkhan/ rnam dpyod kyi mgrin pa cung zad ma spro ba'i btsun pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho dpal bzang pos lo bcu bdun lon pa'i tshe/ gtsang rta nag gi sa cha/ grub pa'i dbang smyug a mo gha n+t+wa tsha la sogs pa dam pa mang pos byin gyis rlabs pa'i dben gnas rdo rje gdan zhes bya bar sbyar ba'o / //'chan 'grel bgrong 'dzomasadabang po/ lha4dbang po brgya 6na gyi ming gi rnam grangs / ①gtsug na zla ba mgrin sngon can/ lha dbang phyug chen po'iming ste/ sngon gyidus su bdud myi'irang bzhin gyi rgya mtsho zhig yod palha dang lha ma yin rnams kyis bsrubs pa las/ zla ba so gas 555
byur ba'i zla ba lha dbang phyug giri khyer nas — tsug rgyan byas pas na de la gtsug na zla ba zhes bya la/ mgrin sngon can yang lha dbang phyug gi ming ngo / /phu'idri bsung / ma yid las dri gsung zhes 'byung ba yig nor sa mngon/ ma kyā yongs 'dzin gyir / dri bsung ri dri ṭhā/ma pa'o/ /dri bsungs zhes yang 'jug yod pa rna rul dri'i mi nga ngo 'es gsungs/ ()ri 'ong can/ bla ba'i ming gzhan/ de yang ba 55 cag gi ston pa 'di sngon slob pa lam gyi zhanas skabs su snying rje dang sngon la ma gyi dbang n+t+wa/sa dgon pamingaganas yid du 'ong ba zhig na ri bong gi skye ba bzung ste r+sha dza' ba'i grogs sra ma dakhu / ce spyang khung /spre'u bcas rngu /na sa so/ /de da rna dud 'a sho'i rang bzhin las 'og ste gtang dza da dang / snying rje che ba dang / chos mthun gyis 'tsha bca/ 'tsho nga ro gca/ yo rkyu/ 〉( —/ r+nghi 17 da ge pa 'a —3 bca 3 〉pa ngo zlogayor bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe ri bor sem sa dpa' chen po de bdag sa ma4na zhig 'ongs na ci sbyin snya cho ri 46 2 44 4ri pas / rang gi lus 'ad sbyin bya'i rdzarnga ñtsha mcho sa tu na thong nas gting bar dam bcas pa na/ lha dbar brgya byin ngo ma tshar te nyal/sa sa da pa'iphyir bram ze zhig tu sprul nas de dang nya bar song lte bkres smo/ ma gyis nyam thag pa ltar byas shing spre sngags 'don pa na/ sum gyis nya bdun dang / ce sbyang gis sbyin gor ñtsha/ga dang zho rdzi'u gang / tre'us thi ra thog smyo za 'gal khyer 'ongs te sbyin no/ /ri bong tras rang lus skyi na par thag bcad de thabs btsal ba na/ brgyabyanagyi4 4 5me ma pa) mi / phung bo du ba med pa lag tu sprul lo/ /der ri bong sems dpa' chen po rab tu dgal bas tsham tshom med par me nang du mchodas pa na/ brgyabyin shin tu 556
dad cing ya mtshan ) lus dngos su bston nas me nang nas rngengs ) lha yul du khyer/ lharnams la bstan ) mtshad cing bstod do/ /ñtsha rabs kyi lha dang / 'dzam bu gling pa rnams la'ang sems dpa5che na po ri bor de'ishin tu bya dka' ba'i ngo ra tshar 6 mdzad pa bstan nas dadapa bskyed par bya ba'i ched sum cu rtsa 0sum gyi rnam par rgyal ba'i khar bzang dang / chos bzang lha'i'adun sa dang / zla ba'i dkyil 'alor gyi ngos la ri bong )lagazugs btan zis te bzhag go natra grags so/ /9)thub pa/ 'khor bar skyed byed kyi rgyu las dang nyon mongs dug gsum las rgyal kha thob tshar bas na 6ba pa zer/khiñtsa mchog mang ngo 'i nang gi ra chog tu gyur pa ste/ dbyangs can dkal dros / ba 'a nga ji su nga chog rna cang shes yin pa sa de song ba'i rje 5 26na na 'jin]sa skragasogs med pa'i la 'a bde bar 'khrid pa zhes gsungs so/ /tsosnyo sa kum/ myos bum zhes pa bud med kyi nu mar 'jugal/ 'dir glang po che'i/7 5/tsu/ gun pa'i dbyibs can dral ba tsam gyis srog thag 'bye ched pa zhig yod par grags ba de'o/ /()chu srin 'byung gnas/ rgya mtsho'i ming / phusna2chi me ) )/brag tshe ring ste tshe rir rnam drug gi 4 gyal zhig ri rab la 'ang (2jug pa sa 'dir ri rab bo/ /(yimes po'idabyangs/ me'angapo rna tshangs pa'i ming gi rnam grangs yin la/ mes ngo 'i dbyangs lda tshangs pa'idbyangs zhes pa ste/ sgra dbyangs snyan zhing 'jebs pa rna ba'i bcud len pa la zer/ 4sprerdzogs ldan/ 'dzam gling gi mi rnams kyichos dang / nor/ 'dod pa/ ba ba bzhi yopa sa su tshar bar longs spyod palidus te/ de'iyunatshad lalo grangs sa ya zhacinadang bdun 557
'bum nyis khri brgyad stong yod par grags/ ṣu bsam 'bal dbang gi rgyal po/ bya rgyal khyung chen gyis rgya mtshor gnas pa'i klu rigs za ba yin la / mthar lo nas shing 'khogs pa na/ rgyan tshoralhung ste ltogs grirashi/ khyung snying mtsho nang du yun ring po lus pa de ni rnyed dka'azhing shin tu dkon palirnar bu bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po zhes bya bar gyur ces grags/ yirgyu skar bdag ngo / zla ba'i ming /yilus med bdagapo/ bdud dga' rab dbang phyug yis bcu'i dbang phyug ji btsun byams pa mgonapo dang sa bcu thob zin pa'ibyang chub sems dpa'/ 0khyab bdaka sa ngas rgyas kyi mtshan/klu sgrub0zhabs la bstod pa ma chog tu dad pa'i sgra dbyangs/mgon po de nyid kyi zhabs kyi pad+mo la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyi ma'i gnyan gyi ljags yangs pad+mo'i mtshor/ /lung bstan②sung ba'i dar dir 'bum 'khrigs pas/ /dri za'i 'phang 'gro0lta bur khyod bsngags na/ bdag ltas cung zhig bstod la ci zhig bltos/ /'on kyang rnyed dka'i lus 'di ro 'dzin bcas/ /snying por bgyi slad mdon khyod yon tan gyi/ /rgya mtsho che las spobs pa'i rnga yab rtses/ /phra mo'i chu thigs blangs te gar bgyid do/ /mtha' dbus kun bral zab yangs yid bzhin mtshor/ /lta zer phreng bas stug po'i mun gnag 'joms/ /sa gsum rin cen①gcig gyur gdengs ka can/ dpal ldan klu yi dbang bo ra 4 sa/ 538
